text:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे।

तदेकं वद निश्िचत्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्।।3.2।।
text_kannada:
ವ್ಯಾಮಿಶ್ರೇಣೇವ ವಾಕ್ಯೇನ ಬುದ್ಧಿಂ ಮೋಹಯಸೀವ ಮೇ |
ತದೇಕಂ ವದ ನಿಶ್ಿಚತ್ಯ ಯೇನ ಶ್ರೇಯೋಽಹಮಾಪ್ನುಯಾಮ್ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
వ్యామిశ్రేణేవ వాక్యేన బుద్ధిం మోహయసీవ మే |
తదేకం వద నిశ్ిచత్య యేన శ్రేయోఽహమాప్నుయామ్ || ౨ ||
transliteration:
vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me
tad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām
translation_english: You bewilder my understanding, as it were, with a seemingly conflicting statement! Tell me for certain which one of these I may use to attain the highest Good.
context_english: vyāmiśhreṇa iva—by your apparently ambiguous; vākyena—words; buddhim—intellect; mohayasi—I am getting bewildered; iva—as it were; me—my; tat—therefore; ekam—one; vada—please tell; niśhchitya—decisively; yena—by which; śhreyaḥ—the highest good; aham—I; āpnuyām—may attain

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ।

ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्।।3.3।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಲೋಕೇಽಸ್ಮಿಂದ್ವಿವಿಧಾ ನಿಷ್ಠಾ ಪುರಾ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಾ ಮಯಾನಘ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಯೋಗೇನ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಾನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗೇನ ಯೋಗಿನಾಮ್ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
లోకేఽస్మింద్వివిధా నిష్ఠా పురా ప్రోక్తా మయానఘ |
జ్ఞానయోగేన సాంఖ్యానాం కర్మయోగేన యోగినామ్ || ౩ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
loke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, O unblemished one, two kinds of steadfastness in this world were spoken of by Me in days gone by—through the Yoga of Knowledge for the men of realization; through the Yoga of Action for the yogis.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Blessed Lord said; loke—in the world; asmin—this; dvi-vidhā—two kinds of; niṣhṭhā—faith; purā—previously; proktā—explained; mayā—by me (Shree Krishna); anagha—sinless; jñāna-yogena—through the path of knowledge; sānkhyānām—for those inclined toward contemplation; karma-yogena—through the path of action; yoginām—of the yogis

text:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।

न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति।।3.4।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಕರ್ಮಣಾಮನಾರಂಭಾನ್ನೈಷ್ಕರ್ಮ್ಯಂ ಪುರುಷೋಽಶ್ನುತೇ |
ನ ಚ ಸಂನ್ಯಸನಾದೇವ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಸಮಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
న కర్మణామనారంభాన్నైష్కర్మ్యం పురుషోఽశ్నుతే |
న చ సంన్యసనాదేవ సిద్ధిం సమధిగచ్ఛతి || ౪ ||
transliteration:
na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute
na cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati
translation_english: A person does not attain freedom from action by abstaining from action; nor does he attain fulfillment merely through renunciation.
context_english: na—not; karmaṇām—of actions; anārambhāt—by abstaining from; naiṣhkarmyam—freedom from karmic reactions; puruṣhaḥ—a person; aśhnute—attains; na—not; cha—and; sannyasanāt—by renunciation; eva—only; siddhim—perfection; samadhigachchhati—attains

text:
न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।

कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः।।3.5।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಹಿ ಕಶ್ಿಚತ್ಕ್ಷಣಮಪಿ ಜಾತು ತಿಷ್ಠತ್ಯಕರ್ಮಕೃತ್ |
ಕಾರ್ಯತೇ ಹ್ಯವಶಃ ಕರ್ಮ ಸರ್ವಃ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಜೈರ್ಗುಣೈಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
న హి కశ్ిచత్క్షణమపి జాతు తిష్ఠత్యకర్మకృత్ |
కార్యతే హ్యవశః కర్మ సర్వః ప్రకృతిజైర్గుణైః || ౫ ||
transliteration:
na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit
kāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ
translation_english: For no one ever remains even for a moment without doing work, for all are made to work under compulsion by the gunas born of Nature.
context_english: na—not; hi—certainly; kaśhchit—anyone; kṣhaṇam—a moment; api—even; jātu—ever; tiṣhṭhati—can remain; akarma-kṛit—without action; kāryate—are performed; hi—certainly; avaśhaḥ—helpless; karma—work; sarvaḥ—all; prakṛiti-jaiḥ—born of material nature; guṇaiḥ—by the qualities

text:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।

इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते।।3.6।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮೇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಿ ಸಂಯಮ್ಯ ಯ ಆಸ್ತೇ ಮನಸಾ ಸ್ಮರನ್ |
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾರ್ಥಾನ್ವಿಮೂಢಾತ್ಮಾ ಮಿಥ್ಯಾಚಾರಃ ಸ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మేంద్రియాణి సంయమ్య య ఆస్తే మనసా స్మరన్ |
ఇంద్రియార్థాన్విమూఢాత్మా మిథ్యాచారః స ఉచ్యతే || ౬ ||
transliteration:
karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran
indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate
translation_english: One who, after withdrawing the organs of action, sits mentally recollecting the objects of the senses, is called a hypocrite, for they have a deluded mind.
context_english: karma-indriyāṇi—the organs of action; sanyamya—restrain; yaḥ—who; āste—remain; manasā—in the mind; smaran—to remember; indriya-arthān—sense objects; vimūḍha-ātmā—the deluded; mithyā-āchāraḥ—hypocrite; saḥ—they; uchyate—are called

text:
यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।

कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते।।3.7।।
text_kannada:
ಯಸ್ತ್ವಿಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಿ ಮನಸಾ ನಿಯಮ್ಯಾರಭತೇಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಕರ್ಮೇಂದ್ರಿಯೈಃ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗಮಸಕ್ತಃ ಸ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಯತೇ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
యస్త్వింద్రియాణి మనసా నియమ్యారభతేఽర్జున |
కర్మేంద్రియైః కర్మయోగమసక్తః స విశిష్యతే || ౭ ||
transliteration:
yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna
karmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate
translation_english: But, O Arjuna, one who engages in Karma-yoga, controlling the organs of action with the mind and becoming unattached, excels.
context_english: yaḥ—who; tu—but; indriyāṇi—the senses; manasā—by the mind; niyamya—control; ārabhate—begins; arjuna—Arjun; karma-indriyaiḥ—by the working senses; karma-yogam—karm yog; asaktaḥ—without attachment; saḥ—they; viśhiṣhyate—are superior

text:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।

शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः।।3.8।।
text_kannada:
ನಿಯತಂ ಕುರು ಕರ್ಮ ತ್ವಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಜ್ಯಾಯೋ ಹ್ಯಕರ್ಮಣಃ |
ಶರೀರಯಾತ್ರಾಪಿ ಚ ತೇ ನ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ್ಯೇದಕರ್ಮಣಃ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
నియతం కురు కర్మ త్వం కర్మ జ్యాయో హ్యకర్మణః |
శరీరయాత్రాపి చ తే న ప్రసిద్ధ్యేదకర్మణః || ౮ ||
transliteration:
niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
śharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ
translation_english: You should perform your obligatory duties, for action is superior to inaction. Moreover, even the maintenance of your body will not be possible without action.
context_english: niyatam—constantly; kuru—perform; karma—Vedic duties; tvam—you; karma—action; jyāyaḥ—superior; hi—certainly; akarmaṇaḥ—than inaction; śharīra—bodily; yātrā—maintenance; api—even; cha—and; te—your; na prasiddhyet—would not be possible; akarmaṇaḥ—inaction

text:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः।

तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर।।3.9।।
text_kannada:
ಯಜ್ಞಾರ್ಥಾತ್ಕರ್ಮಣೋಽನ್ಯತ್ರ ಲೋಕೋಽಯಂ ಕರ್ಮಬಂಧನಃ |
ತದರ್ಥಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಮುಕ್ತಸಂಗಃ ಸಮಾಚರ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
యజ్ఞార్థాత్కర్మణోఽన్యత్ర లోకోఽయం కర్మబంధనః |
తదర్థం కర్మ కౌంతేయ ముక్తసంగః సమాచర || ౯ ||
transliteration:
yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ
tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara
translation_english: This man becomes bound by actions other than those intended for God. Without being attached, O son of Kunti, perform actions for Him.
context_english: yajña-arthāt—for the sake of sacrifice; karmaṇaḥ—than action; anyatra—else; lokaḥ—material world; ayam—this; karma-bandhanaḥ—bondage through one’s work; tat—that; artham—for the sake of; karma—action; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; mukta-saṅgaḥ—free from attachment; samāchara—perform properly

text:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।

अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्।।3.10।।
text_kannada:
ಸಹಯಜ್ಞಾಃ ಪ್ರಜಾಃ ಸೃಷ್ಟ್ವಾ ಪುರೋವಾಚ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಃ |
ಅನೇನ ಪ್ರಸವಿಷ್ಯಧ್ವಮೇಷ ವೋಽಸ್ತ್ವಿಷ್ಟಕಾಮಧುಕ್ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
సహయజ్ఞాః ప్రజాః సృష్ట్వా పురోవాచ ప్రజాపతిః |
అనేన ప్రసవిష్యధ్వమేష వోఽస్త్విష్టకామధుక్ || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk
translation_english: In days of yore, having created the beings together with the sacrifices, Prajapati said, "By this, you shall multiply. Let this be your yielder of coveted objects of desire."
context_english: saha—along with; yajñāḥ—sacrifices; prajāḥ—humankind; sṛiṣhṭvā—created; purā—in beginning; uvācha—said; prajā-patiḥ—Brahma; anena—by this; prasaviṣhyadhvam—increase prosperity; eṣhaḥ—these; vaḥ—your; astu—shall be; iṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk—bestower of all wishes

text:
देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।

परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ।।3.11।।
text_kannada:
ದೇವಾನ್ಭಾವಯತಾನೇನ ತೇ ದೇವಾ ಭಾವಯಂತು ವಃ |
ಪರಸ್ಪರಂ ಭಾವಯಂತಃ ಶ್ರೇಯಃ ಪರಮವಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಥ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
దేవాన్భావయతానేన తే దేవా భావయంతు వః |
పరస్పరం భావయంతః శ్రేయః పరమవాప్స్యథ || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
parasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha
translation_english: 'You nourish the gods with this. Let those gods nourish you in return. By mutually nourishing each other, you shall attain the supreme Good.'
context_english: devān—celestial gods; bhāvayatā—will be pleased; anena—by these (sacrifices); te—those; devāḥ—celestial gods; bhāvayantu—will be pleased; vaḥ—you; parasparam—one another; bhāvayantaḥ—pleasing one another; śhreyaḥ—prosperity; param—the supreme; avāpsyatha—shall achieve

text:
इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।

तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः।।3.12।।
text_kannada:
ಇಷ್ಟಾನ್ಭೋಗಾನ್ಹಿ ವೋ ದೇವಾ ದಾಸ್ಯಂತೇ ಯಜ್ಞಭಾವಿತಾಃ |
ತೈರ್ದತ್ತಾನಪ್ರದಾಯೈಭ್ಯೋ ಯೋ ಭುಂಕ್ತೇ ಸ್ತೇನ ಏವ ಸಃ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఇష్టాన్భోగాన్హి వో దేవా దాస్యంతే యజ్ఞభావితాః |
తైర్దత్తానప్రదాయైభ్యో యో భుంక్తే స్తేన ఏవ సః || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ
tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
translation_english: 'Being nourished by sacrifices, the gods will indeed give you the coveted enjoyments. He is certainly a thief who enjoys what has been given by them without offering it to them.'
context_english: iṣhṭān—desired; bhogān—necessities of life; hi—certainly; vaḥ—unto you; devāḥ—the celestial gods; dāsyante—will grant; yajña-bhāvitāḥ—satisfied by sacrifice; taiḥ—by them; dattān—things granted; apradāya—without offering; ebhyaḥ—to them; yaḥ—who; bhuṅkte—enjoys; stenaḥ—thieves; eva—verily; saḥ—they

text:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।

भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्।।3.13।।
text_kannada:
ಯಜ್ಞಶಿಷ್ಟಾಶಿನಃ ಸಂತೋ ಮುಚ್ಯಂತೇ ಸರ್ವಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷೈಃ |
ಭುಂಜತೇ ತೇ ತ್ವಘಂ ಪಾಪಾ ಯೇ ಪಚಂತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕಾರಣಾತ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
యజ్ఞశిష్టాశినః సంతో ముచ్యంతే సర్వకిల్బిషైః |
భుంజతే తే త్వఘం పాపా యే పచంత్యాత్మకారణాత్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt
translation_english: By partaking in the remnants of sacrifices, they become freed from all sins. But those who are unholy and cook for themselves incur sin.
context_english: yajña-śhiṣhṭa—of remnants of food offered in sacrifice; aśhinaḥ—eaters; santaḥ—saintly persons; muchyante—are released; sarva—all kinds of; kilbiṣhaiḥ—from sins; bhuñjate—enjoy; te—they; tu—but; agham—sins; pāpāḥ—sinners; ye—who; pachanti—cook (food); ātma-kāraṇāt—for their own sake

text:
अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।

यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः।।3.14।।
text_kannada:
ಅನ್ನಾದ್ಭವಂತಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಪರ್ಜನ್ಯಾದನ್ನಸಂಭವಃ |
ಯಜ್ಞಾದ್ಭವತಿ ಪರ್ಜನ್ಯೋ ಯಜ್ಞಃ ಕರ್ಮಸಮುದ್ಭವಃ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
అన్నాద్భవంతి భూతాని పర్జన్యాదన్నసంభవః |
యజ్ఞాద్భవతి పర్జన్యో యజ్ఞః కర్మసముద్భవః || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ
yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ
translation_english: From food are born the creatures; the origin of food is from rain; rain originates from sacrifice; sacrifice has action as its source.
context_english: annāt—from food; bhavanti—subsist; bhūtāni—living beings; parjanyāt—from rains; anna—of food grains; sambhavaḥ—production; yajñāt—from the performance of sacrifice; bhavati—becomes possible; parjanyaḥ—rain; yajñaḥ—performance of sacrifice; karma—prescribed duties; samudbhavaḥ—born of

text:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।

तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्।।3.15।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮೋದ್ಭವಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಕ್ಷರಸಮುದ್ಭವಮ್ |
ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ಸರ್ವಗತಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ಯಜ್ಞೇ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತಮ್ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మ బ్రహ్మోద్భవం విద్ధి బ్రహ్మాక్షరసముద్భవమ్ |
తస్మాత్సర్వగతం బ్రహ్మ నిత్యం యజ్ఞే ప్రతిష్ఠితమ్ || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam
tasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam
translation_english: Know that action has the Vedas as its origin; the Vedas have the Immutable as their source. Hence, the all-pervading Vedas are forever based on sacrifice.
context_english: karma—duties; brahma—in the Vedas; udbhavam—manifested; viddhi—you should know; brahma—The Vedas; akṣhara—from the Imperishable (God); samudbhavam—directly manifested; tasmāt—therefore; sarva-gatam—all-pervading; brahma—The Lord; nityam—eternally; yajñe—in sacrifice; pratiṣhṭhitam—established

text:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः।

अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति।।3.16।।
text_kannada:
ಏವಂ ಪ್ರವರ್ತಿತಂ ಚಕ್ರಂ ನಾನುವರ್ತಯತೀಹ ಯಃ |
ಅಘಾಯುರಿಂದ್ರಿಯಾರಾಮೋ ಮೋಘಂ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸ ಜೀವತಿ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
ఏవం ప్రవర్తితం చక్రం నానువర్తయతీహ యః |
అఘాయురింద్రియారామో మోఘం పార్థ స జీవతి || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ
aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati
translation_english: O Partha, he who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion lives in vain, their life is sinful, and they indulge in the senses.
context_english: evam—thus; pravartitam—set into motion; chakram—cycle; na—not; anuvartayati—follow; iha—in this life; yaḥ—who; agha-āyuḥ—sinful living; indriya-ārāmaḥ—for the delight of their senses; mogham—vainly; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; saḥ—they; jīvati—live

text:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः।

आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते।।3.17।।
text_kannada:
ಯಸ್ತ್ವಾತ್ಮರತಿರೇವ ಸ್ಯಾದಾತ್ಮತೃಪ್ತಶ್ಚ ಮಾನವಃ |
ಆತ್ಮನ್ಯೇವ ಚ ಸಂತುಷ್ಟಸ್ತಸ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಂ ನ ವಿದ್ಯತೇ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
యస్త్వాత్మరతిరేవ స్యాదాత్మతృప్తశ్చ మానవః |
ఆత్మన్యేవ చ సంతుష్టస్తస్య కార్యం న విద్యతే || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ
ātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate
translation_english: But that man who rejoices only in the Self, is satisfied with the Self, and is content only in the Self—for him there is no duty to perform.
context_english: yaḥ—who; tu—but; ātma-ratiḥ—rejoice in the self; eva—certainly; syāt—is; ātma-tṛiptaḥ—self-satisfied; cha—and; mānavaḥ—human being; ātmani—in the self; eva—certainly; cha—and; santuṣhṭaḥ—satisfied; tasya—his; kāryam—duty; na—not; vidyate—exist

text:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन।

न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्िचदर्थव्यपाश्रयः।।3.18।।
text_kannada:
ನೈವ ತಸ್ಯ ಕೃತೇನಾರ್ಥೋ ನಾಕೃತೇನೇಹ ಕಶ್ಚನ |
ನ ಚಾಸ್ಯ ಸರ್ವಭೂತೇಷು ಕಶ್ಿಚದರ್ಥವ್ಯಪಾಶ್ರಯಃ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
నైవ తస్య కృతేనార్థో నాకృతేనేహ కశ్చన |
న చాస్య సర్వభూతేషు కశ్ిచదర్థవ్యపాశ్రయః || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana
na chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ
translation_english: For him, there is no concern here at all with performing action, nor any with non-performance. Moreover, he has no dependence on any object to serve any purpose.
context_english: na—not; eva—indeed; tasya—his; kṛitena—by discharge of duty; arthaḥ—gain; na—not; akṛitena—without discharge of duty; iha—here; kaśhchana—whatsoever; na—never; cha—and; asya—of that person; sarva-bhūteṣhu—among all living beings; kaśhchit—any; artha—necessity; vyapāśhrayaḥ—to depend upon

text:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।

असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः।।3.19।।
text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾದಸಕ್ತಃ ಸತತಂ ಕಾರ್ಯಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಸಮಾಚರ |
ಅಸಕ್ತೋ ಹ್ಯಾಚರನ್ಕರ್ಮ ಪರಮಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಪೂರುಷಃ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
తస్మాదసక్తః సతతం కార్యం కర్మ సమాచర |
అసక్తో హ్యాచరన్కర్మ పరమాప్నోతి పూరుషః || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ
translation_english: Therefore, remaining unattached, always perform the obligatory duty; for, by performing one's duty without attachment, a person attains the highest.
context_english: tasmāt—therefore; asaktaḥ—without attachment; satatam—constantly; kāryam—duty; karma—action; samāchara—perform; asaktaḥ—unattached; hi—certainly; ācharan—performing; karma—work; param—the Supreme; āpnoti—attains; pūruṣhaḥ—a person

text:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः।

लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि।।3.20।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮಣೈವ ಹಿ ಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಿಮಾಸ್ಥಿತಾ ಜನಕಾದಯಃ |
ಲೋಕಸಂಗ್ರಹಮೇವಾಪಿ ಸಂಪಶ್ಯನ್ಕರ್ತುಮರ್ಹಸಿ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మణైవ హి సంసిద్ధిమాస్థితా జనకాదయః |
లోకసంగ్రహమేవాపి సంపశ్యన్కర్తుమర్హసి || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ
loka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi
translation_english: For Janaka and others strove to attain liberation through action itself. You should perform your duties, keeping in view the prevention of mankind from going astray.
context_english: karmaṇā—by the performance of prescribed duties; eva—only; hi—certainly; sansiddhim—perfection; āsthitāḥ—attained; janaka-ādayaḥ—King Janak and other kings; loka-saṅgraham—for the welfare of the masses; eva api—only; sampaśhyan—considering; kartum—to perform; arhasi—you should;

text:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।

स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते।।3.21।।
text_kannada:
ಯದ್ಯದಾಚರತಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠಸ್ತತ್ತದೇವೇತರೋ ಜನಃ |
ಸ ಯತ್ಪ್ರಮಾಣಂ ಕುರುತೇ ಲೋಕಸ್ತದನುವರ್ತತೇ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
యద్యదాచరతి శ్రేష్ఠస్తత్తదేవేతరో జనః |
స యత్ప్రమాణం కురుతే లోకస్తదనువర్తతే || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ
sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate
translation_english: Whatever a superior person does, another person does the same! Whatever they uphold as authority, an ordinary person follows that.
context_english: yat yat—whatever; ācharati—does; śhreṣhṭhaḥ—the best; tat tat—that (alone); eva—certainly; itaraḥ—common; janaḥ—people; saḥ—they; yat—whichever; pramāṇam—standard; kurute—perform; lokaḥ—world; tat—that; anuvartate—pursues

text:
न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।

नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि।।3.22।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಮೇ ಪಾರ್ಥಾಸ್ತಿ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಂ ತ್ರಿಷು ಲೋಕೇಷು ಕಿಂಚನ |
ನಾನವಾಪ್ತಮವಾಪ್ತವ್ಯಂ ವರ್ತ ಏವ ಚ ಕರ್ಮಣಿ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
న మే పార్థాస్తి కర్తవ్యం త్రిషు లోకేషు కించన |
నానవాప్తమవాప్తవ్యం వర్త ఏవ చ కర్మణి || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana
nānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi
translation_english: In all the three worlds, O Partha, there is no duty for Me to fulfill; nothing remains unachieved or to be achieved. (Still,) I continue in action.
context_english: na—not; me—mine; pārtha—Arjun; asti—is; kartavyam—duty; triṣhu—in the three; lokeṣhu—worlds; kiñchana—any; na—not; anavāptam—to be attained; avāptavyam—to be gained; varte—I am engaged; eva—yet; cha—also; karmaṇi—in prescribed duties

text:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।3.23।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಿ ಹ್ಯಹಂ ನ ವರ್ತೇಯಂ ಜಾತು ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯತಂದ್ರಿತಃ |
ಮಮ ವರ್ತ್ಮಾನುವರ್ತಂತೇ ಮನುಷ್ಯಾಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸರ್ವಶಃ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
యది హ్యహం న వర్తేయం జాతు కర్మణ్యతంద్రితః |
మమ వర్త్మానువర్తంతే మనుష్యాః పార్థ సర్వశః || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
translation_english: For, O Partha, if at any time I do not continue vigilantly in action, people will follow My path in every way.
context_english: yadi—if; hi—certainly; aham—I; na—not; varteyam—thus engage; jātu—ever; karmaṇi—in the performance of prescribed duties; atandritaḥ—carefully; mama—my; vartma—path; anuvartante—follow; manuṣhyāḥ—all men; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; sarvaśhaḥ—in all respects

text:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।

सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः।।3.24।।
text_kannada:
ಉತ್ಸೀದೇಯುರಿಮೇ ಲೋಕಾ ನ ಕುರ್ಯಾಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಚೇದಹಮ್ |
ಸಂಕರಸ್ಯ ಚ ಕರ್ತಾ ಸ್ಯಾಮುಪಹನ್ಯಾಮಿಮಾಃ ಪ್ರಜಾಃ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
ఉత్సీదేయురిమే లోకా న కుర్యాం కర్మ చేదహమ్ |
సంకరస్య చ కర్తా స్యాముపహన్యామిమాః ప్రజాః || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham
sankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ
translation_english: These worlds would be ruined if I did not perform action. And I shall become the agent of intermingling (of castes), and shall be destroying these beings.
context_english: utsīdeyuḥ—would perish; ime—all these; lokāḥ—worlds; na—not; kuryām—I perform; karma—prescribed duties; chet—if; aham—I; sankarasya—of uncultured population; cha—and; kartā—responsible; syām—would be; upahanyām—would destroy; imāḥ—all these; prajāḥ—living entities

text:
सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत।

कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्िचकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्।।3.25।।
text_kannada:
ಸಕ್ತಾಃ ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯವಿದ್ವಾಂಸೋ ಯಥಾ ಕುರ್ವಂತಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಕುರ್ಯಾದ್ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ್ತಥಾಸಕ್ತಶ್ಿಚಕೀರ್ಷುರ್ಲೋಕಸಂಗ್ರಹಮ್ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
సక్తాః కర్మణ్యవిద్వాంసో యథా కుర్వంతి భారత |
కుర్యాద్విద్వాంస్తథాసక్తశ్ిచకీర్షుర్లోకసంగ్రహమ్ || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata
kuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, as the unenlightened people act with attachment to work, so should the enlightened person act, without attachment, desiring to prevent people from going astray.
context_english: saktāḥ—attached; karmaṇi—duties; avidvānsaḥ—the ignorant; yathā—as much as; kurvanti—act; bhārata—scion of Bharat (Arjun); kuryāt—should do; vidvān—the wise; tathā—thus; asaktaḥ—unattached; chikīrṣhuḥ—wishing; loka-saṅgraham—welfare of the world

text:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्।

जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्।।3.26।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಬುದ್ಧಿಭೇದಂ ಜನಯೇದಜ್ಞಾನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಸಂಗಿನಾಮ್ |
ಜೋಷಯೇತ್ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ವಿದ್ವಾನ್ ಯುಕ್ತಃ ಸಮಾಚರನ್ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
న బుద్ధిభేదం జనయేదజ్ఞానాం కర్మసంగినామ్ |
జోషయేత్సర్వకర్మాణి విద్వాన్ యుక్తః సమాచరన్ || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām
joṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan
translation_english: The enlightened man should not disturb the beliefs of the ignorant, who are attached to work. He should remain diligent himself and make them perform all their duties.
context_english: na—not; buddhi-bhedam—discord in the intellects; janayet—should create; ajñānām—of the ignorant; karma-saṅginām—who are attached to fruitive actions; joṣhayet—should inspire (them) to perform; sarva—all; karmāṇi—prescribed; vidvān—the wise; yuktaḥ—enlightened; samācharan—performing properly

text:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।

अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते।।3.27।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಕೃತೇಃ ಕ್ರಿಯಮಾಣಾನಿ ಗುಣೈಃ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಸರ್ವಶಃ |
ಅಹಂಕಾರವಿಮೂಢಾತ್ಮಾ ಕರ್ತಾಽಹಮಿತಿ ಮನ್ಯತೇ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రకృతేః క్రియమాణాని గుణైః కర్మాణి సర్వశః |
అహంకారవిమూఢాత్మా కర్తాఽహమితి మన్యతే || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ
ahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate
translation_english: While actions are being done in every way by the gunas (qualities) of Nature, one who is deluded by egoism thinks, "I am the doer."
context_english: prakṛiteḥ—of material nature; kriyamāṇāni—carried out; guṇaiḥ—by the three modes; karmāṇi—activities; sarvaśhaḥ—all kinds of; ahankāra-vimūḍha-ātmā—those who are bewildered by the ego and misidentify themselves with the body; kartā—the doer; aham—I; iti—thus; manyate—thinks

text:
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः।

गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते।।3.28।।
text_kannada:
ತತ್ತ್ವವಿತ್ತು ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಗುಣಕರ್ಮವಿಭಾಗಯೋಃ |
ಗುಣಾ ಗುಣೇಷು ವರ್ತಂತ ಇತಿ ಮತ್ವಾ ನ ಸಜ್ಜತೇ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
తత్త్వవిత్తు మహాబాహో గుణకర్మవిభాగయోః |
గుణా గుణేషు వర్తంత ఇతి మత్వా న సజ్జతే || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
translation_english: But, O mighty-armed one, the one who is a knower of the facts about the varieties of the gunas and actions does not become attached, thinking thus: 'The organs act on the objects of the organs.'
context_english: tattva-vit—the knower of the Truth; tu—but; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; guṇa-karma—from guṇas and karma; vibhāgayoḥ—distinguish; guṇāḥ—modes of material nature in the shape of the senses, mind, etc; guṇeṣhu—modes of material nature in the shape of objects of perception; vartante—are engaged; iti—thus; matvā—knowing; na—never; sajjate—becomes attached

text:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।

तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्।।3.29।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಕೃತೇರ್ಗುಣಸಮ್ಮೂಢಾಃ ಸಜ್ಜಂತೇ ಗುಣಕರ್ಮಸು |
ತಾನಕೃತ್ಸ್ನವಿದೋ ಮಂದಾನ್ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನವಿನ್ನ ವಿಚಾಲಯೇತ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రకృతేర్గుణసమ్మూఢాః సజ్జంతే గుణకర్మసు |
తానకృత్స్నవిదో మందాన్కృత్స్నవిన్న విచాలయేత్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu
tān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet
translation_english: Those who are completely deluded by the gunas of Nature become attached to the activities of the gunas. The one who knows the All should not disturb those of dull intellect, who do not know the All.
context_english: prakṛiteḥ—of material nature; guṇa—by the modes of material nature; sammūḍhāḥ—deluded; sajjante—become attached; guṇa-karmasu—to results of actions; tān—those; akṛitsna-vidaḥ—persons without knowledge; mandān—the ignorant; kṛitsna-vit—persons with knowledge; na vichālayet—should not unsettle

text:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।

निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः।।3.30।।
text_kannada:
ಮಯಿ ಸರ್ವಾಣಿ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ಯಾಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಚೇತಸಾ |
ನಿರಾಶೀರ್ನಿರ್ಮಮೋ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಯುಧ್ಯಸ್ವ ವಿಗತಜ್ವರಃ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
మయి సర్వాణి కర్మాణి సంన్యస్యాధ్యాత్మచేతసా |
నిరాశీర్నిర్మమో భూత్వా యుధ్యస్వ విగతజ్వరః || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā
nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ
translation_english: Free from the fever of the soul, dedicate all actions to Me, with your mind intent on the Self, and become free from expectations and egoism, and engage in battle.
context_english: mayi—unto me; sarvāṇi—all; karmāṇi—works; sannyasya—renouncing completely; adhyātma-chetasā—with the thoughts resting on God; nirāśhīḥ—free from hankering for the results of the actions; nirmamaḥ—without ownership; bhūtvā—so being; yudhyasva—fight; vigata-jvaraḥ—without mental fever

text:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः।

श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः।।3.31।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇ ಮೇ ಮತಮಿದಂ ನಿತ್ಯಮನುತಿಷ್ಠಂತಿ ಮಾನವಾಃ |
ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಂತೋಽನಸೂಯಂತೋ ಮುಚ್ಯಂತೇ ತೇಽಪಿ ಕರ್ಮಭಿಃ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
యే మే మతమిదం నిత్యమనుతిష్ఠంతి మానవాః |
శ్రద్ధావంతోఽనసూయంతో ముచ్యంతే తేఽపి కర్మభిః || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ
śhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ
translation_english: Those who faithfully follow this teaching of Mine without cavil, they too become freed from their actions.
context_english: ye—who; me—my; matam—teachings; idam—these; nityam—constantly; anutiṣhṭhanti—abide by; mānavāḥ—human beings; śhraddhā-vantaḥ—with profound faith; anasūyantaḥ—free from cavilling; muchyante—become free; te—those; api—also; karmabhiḥ—from the bondage of karma

text:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्।

सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः।।3.32।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇ ತ್ವೇತದಭ್ಯಸೂಯಂತೋ ನಾನುತಿಷ್ಠಂತಿ ಮೇ ಮತಮ್ |
ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞಾನವಿಮೂಢಾಂಸ್ತಾನ್ವಿದ್ಧಿ ನಷ್ಟಾನಚೇತಸಃ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
యే త్వేతదభ్యసూయంతో నానుతిష్ఠంతి మే మతమ్ |
సర్వజ్ఞానవిమూఢాంస్తాన్విద్ధి నష్టానచేతసః || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam
sarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ
translation_english: But those who, finding fault where there is none, do not follow My teaching, know them—who are deluded about all knowledge concerning the qualified and the unqualified Brahman and who are devoid of discrimination—to have gone to ruin.
context_english: ye—those; tu—but; etat—this; abhyasūyantaḥ—cavilling; na—not; anutiṣhṭhanti—follow; me—my; matam—teachings; sarva-jñāna—in all types of knowledge; vimūḍhān—deluded; tān—they are; viddhi—know; naṣhṭān—ruined; achetasaḥ—devoid of discrimination

text:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि।

प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति।।3.33।।
text_kannada:
ಸದೃಶಂ ಚೇಷ್ಟತೇ ಸ್ವಸ್ಯಾಃ ಪ್ರಕೃತೇರ್ಜ್ಞಾನವಾನಪಿ |
ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ಯಾಂತಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ನಿಗ್ರಹಃ ಕಿಂ ಕರಿಷ್ಯತಿ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
సదృశం చేష్టతే స్వస్యాః ప్రకృతేర్జ్ఞానవానపి |
ప్రకృతిం యాంతి భూతాని నిగ్రహః కిం కరిష్యతి || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api
prakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati
translation_english: Even a man of wisdom behaves according to his own nature. They follow their nature. What can restraint do?
context_english: sadṛiśham—accordingly; cheṣhṭate—act; svasyāḥ—by their own; prakṛiteḥ—modes of nature; jñāna-vān—the wise; api—even; prakṛitim—nature; yānti—follow; bhūtāni—all living beings; nigrahaḥ—repression; kim—what; kariṣhyati—will do

text:
इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ।

तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ।।3.34।।
text_kannada:
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಸ್ಯೇಂದ್ರಿಯಸ್ಯಾರ್ಥೇ ರಾಗದ್ವೇಷೌ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತೌ |
ತಯೋರ್ನ ವಶಮಾಗಚ್ಛೇತ್ತೌ ಹ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಪರಿಪಂಥಿನೌ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
ఇంద్రియస్యేంద్రియస్యార్థే రాగద్వేషౌ వ్యవస్థితౌ |
తయోర్న వశమాగచ్ఛేత్తౌ హ్యస్య పరిపంథినౌ || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau
tayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau
translation_english: Attraction and repulsion are ordained with respect to the objects of all the organs. One should not be swayed by these two, as they are adversaries.
context_english: indriyasya—of the senses; indriyasya arthe—in the sense objects; rāga—attachment; dveṣhau—aversion; vyavasthitau—situated; tayoḥ—of them; na—never; vaśham—be controlled; āgachchhet—should become; tau—those; hi—certainly; asya—for him; paripanthinau—foes

text:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।

स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः।।3.35।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೇಯಾನ್ಸ್ವಧರ್ಮೋ ವಿಗುಣಃ ಪರಧರ್ಮಾತ್ಸ್ವನುಷ್ಠಿತಾತ್ |
ಸ್ವಧರ್ಮೇ ನಿಧನಂ ಶ್ರೇಯಃ ಪರಧರ್ಮೋ ಭಯಾವಹಃ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రేయాన్స్వధర్మో విగుణః పరధర్మాత్స్వనుష్ఠితాత్ |
స్వధర్మే నిధనం శ్రేయః పరధర్మో భయావహః || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
swa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ
translation_english: One's own duty, though defective, is superior to another's duty well-performed. Death is better while engaged in one's own duty; another's duty is full of fear.
context_english: śhreyān—better; swa-dharmaḥ—personal duty; viguṇaḥ—tinged with faults; para-dharmāt—than another’s prescribed duties; su-anuṣhṭhitāt—perfectly done; swa-dharme—in one’s personal duties; nidhanam—death; śhreyaḥ—better; para-dharmaḥ—duties prescribed for others; bhaya-āvahaḥ—fraught with fear

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।

अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः।।3.36।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಅಥ ಕೇನ ಪ್ರಯುಕ್ತೋಽಯಂ ಪಾಪಂ ಚರತಿ ಪೂರುಷಃ |
ಅನಿಚ್ಛನ್ನಪಿ ವಾರ್ಷ್ಣೇಯ ಬಲಾದಿವ ನಿಯೋಜಿತಃ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
అథ కేన ప్రయుక్తోఽయం పాపం చరతి పూరుషః |
అనిచ్ఛన్నపి వార్ష్ణేయ బలాదివ నియోజితః || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
atha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ
anichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ
translation_english: Arjuna said, "Now then, O scion of the Vrsni dynasty (Krsna), what compels this man to commit sin even against his will, as if he were constrained by force?"
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; atha—then; kena—by what; prayuktaḥ—impelled; ayam—one; pāpam—sins; charati—commit; pūruṣhaḥ—a person; anichchhan—unwillingly; api—even; vārṣhṇeya—he who belongs to the Vrishni clan, Shree Krishna; balāt—by force; iva—as if; niyojitaḥ—engaged

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः।

महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्।।3.37।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಕಾಮ ಏಷ ಕ್ರೋಧ ಏಷ ರಜೋಗುಣಸಮುದ್ಭವಃ |
ಮಹಾಶನೋ ಮಹಾಪಾಪ್ಮಾ ವಿದ್ಧ್ಯೇನಮಿಹ ವೈರಿಣಮ್ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
కామ ఏష క్రోధ ఏష రజోగుణసముద్భవః |
మహాశనో మహాపాప్మా విద్ధ్యేనమిహ వైరిణమ్ || ౩౭ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ
mahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "This desire, this anger, born of the quality of rajas, is a great devourer, a great source of sin. Know this to be the enemy here."
context_english: śhri-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; kāmaḥ—desire; eṣhaḥ—this; krodhaḥ—wrath; eṣhaḥ—this; rajaḥ-guṇa—the mode of passion; samudbhavaḥ—born of; mahā-aśhanaḥ—all-devouring; mahā-pāpmā—greatly sinful; viddhi—know; enam—this; iha—in the material world; vairiṇam—the enemy

text:
धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च।

यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्।।3.38।।
text_kannada:
ಧೂಮೇನಾವ್ರಿಯತೇ ವಹ್ನಿರ್ಯಥಾಽಽದರ್ಶೋ ಮಲೇನ ಚ |
ಯಥೋಲ್ಬೇನಾವೃತೋ ಗರ್ಭಸ್ತಥಾ ತೇನೇದಮಾವೃತಮ್ || ೩೮ ||
text_telugu:
ధూమేనావ్రియతే వహ్నిర్యథాఽఽదర్శో మలేన చ |
యథోల్బేనావృతో గర్భస్తథా తేనేదమావృతమ్ || ౩౮ ||
transliteration:
dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha
yatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam
translation_english: As fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is obscured by dirt, and as a fetus remains enclosed in the womb, so is this shrouded by that.
context_english: dhūmena—by smoke; āvriyate—is covered; vahniḥ—fire; yathā—just as; ādarśhaḥ—mirror; malena—by dust; cha—also; yathā—just as; ulbena—by the womb; āvṛitaḥ—is covered; garbhaḥ—embryo; tathā—similarly; tena—by that (desire); idam—this; āvṛitam—is covered

text:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।

कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च।।3.39।।
text_kannada:
ಆವೃತಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಮೇತೇನ ಜ್ಞಾನಿನೋ ನಿತ್ಯವೈರಿಣಾ |
ಕಾಮರೂಪೇಣ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ದುಷ್ಪೂರೇಣಾನಲೇನ ಚ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఆవృతం జ్ఞానమేతేన జ్ఞానినో నిత్యవైరిణా |
కామరూపేణ కౌంతేయ దుష్పూరేణానలేన చ || ౩౯ ||
transliteration:
āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā
kāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha
translation_english: O son of Kunti, knowledge is covered by this constant enemy of the wise, in the form of desire, which is an insatiable fire.
context_english: āvṛitam—covered; jñānam—knowledge; etena—by this; jñāninaḥ—of the wise; nitya-vairiṇā—by the perpetual enemy; kāma-rūpeṇa—in the form of desires; kaunteya—Arjun the son of Kunti; duṣhpūreṇa—insatiable; analena—like fire; cha—and

text:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।

एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्।।3.40।।
text_kannada:
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಿ ಮನೋ ಬುದ್ಧಿರಸ್ಯಾಧಿಷ್ಠಾನಮುಚ್ಯತೇ |
ಏತೈರ್ವಿಮೋಹಯತ್ಯೇಷ ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾವೃತ್ಯ ದೇಹಿನಮ್ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
ఇంద్రియాణి మనో బుద్ధిరస్యాధిష్ఠానముచ్యతే |
ఏతైర్విమోహయత్యేష జ్ఞానమావృత్య దేహినమ్ || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate
etair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam
translation_english: The organs, mind, and intellect are said to be its abode. This one diversely deludes the embodied being, veiling Knowledge with the help of these.
context_english: indriyāṇi—the senses; manaḥ—the mind; buddhiḥ—the intellect; asya—of this; adhiṣhṭhānam—dwelling place; uchyate—are said to be; etaiḥ—by these; vimohayati—deludes; eṣhaḥ—this; jñānam—knowledge; āvṛitya—clouds; dehinam—the embodied soul

text:
तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।

पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्।।3.41।।
text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ತ್ವಮಿಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣ್ಯಾದೌ ನಿಯಮ್ಯ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ |
ಪಾಪ್ಮಾನಂ ಪ್ರಜಹಿ ಹ್ಯೇನಂ ಜ್ಞಾನವಿಜ್ಞಾನನಾಶನಮ್ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
తస్మాత్త్వమింద్రియాణ్యాదౌ నియమ్య భరతర్షభ |
పాప్మానం ప్రజహి హ్యేనం జ్ఞానవిజ్ఞాననాశనమ్ || ౪౧ ||
transliteration:
tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha
pāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam
translation_english: Therefore, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, after first controlling the organs, completely renounce this one which is sinful and a destroyer of learning and wisdom.
context_english: tasmāt—therefore; tvam—you; indriyāṇi—senses; ādau—in the very beginning; niyamya—having controlled; bharata-ṛiṣhabha—Arjun, the best of the Bharatas; pāpmānam—the sinful; prajahi—slay; hi—certainly; enam—this; jñāna—knowledge; vijñāna—realization; nāśhanam—the destroyer

text:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।

मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः।।3.42।।
text_kannada:
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಿ ಪರಾಣ್ಯಾಹುರಿಂದ್ರಿಯೇಭ್ಯಃ ಪರಂ ಮನಃ |
ಮನಸಸ್ತು ಪರಾ ಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ಯೋ ಬುದ್ಧೇಃ ಪರತಸ್ತು ಸಃ || ೪೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఇంద్రియాణి పరాణ్యాహురింద్రియేభ్యః పరం మనః |
మనసస్తు పరా బుద్ధిర్యో బుద్ధేః పరతస్తు సః || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ
manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ
translation_english: They say that the organs are superior to the gross body; the mind is superior to the organs; and the intellect is superior to the mind. However, He is superior to the intellect.
context_english: indriyāṇi—senses; parāṇi—superior; āhuḥ—are said; indriyebhyaḥ—than the senses; param—superior; manaḥ—the mind; manasaḥ—than the mind; tu—but; parā—superior; buddhiḥ—intellect; yaḥ—who; buddheḥ—than the intellect; parataḥ—more superior; tu—but; saḥ—that (soul)

text:
एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।

जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्।।3.43।।
text_kannada:
ಏವಂ ಬುದ್ಧೇಃ ಪರಂ ಬುದ್ಧ್ವಾ ಸಂಸ್ತಭ್ಯಾತ್ಮಾನಮಾತ್ಮನಾ |
ಜಹಿ ಶತ್ರುಂ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಕಾಮರೂಪಂ ದುರಾಸದಮ್ || ೪೩ ||
text_telugu:
ఏవం బుద్ధేః పరం బుద్ధ్వా సంస్తభ్యాత్మానమాత్మనా |
జహి శత్రుం మహాబాహో కామరూపం దురాసదమ్ || ౪౩ ||
transliteration:
evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā
jahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam
translation_english: [The Ast, introduces this verse with, 'Tatah kim, what follows from that?'-Tr.] Understanding the Self thus as superior to the intellect, and completely establishing (the Self) through spiritual absorption with the (help of) the mind, O mighty-armed one, the enemy in the form of desire, which is difficult to subdue, vanishes.
context_english: evam—thus; buddheḥ—than the intellect; param—superior; buddhvā—knowing; sanstabhya—subdue; ātmānam—the lower self (senses, mind, and intellect); ātmanā—by higher self (soul); jahi—kill; śhatrum—the enemy; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; kāma-rūpam—in the form of desire; durāsadam—formidable

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।

विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्।।4.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಇಮಂ ವಿವಸ್ವತೇ ಯೋಗಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತವಾನಹಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ |
ವಿವಸ್ವಾನ್ ಮನವೇ ಪ್ರಾಹ ಮನುರಿಕ್ಷ್ವಾಕವೇಽಬ್ರವೀತ್ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
ఇమం వివస్వతే యోగం ప్రోక్తవానహమవ్యయమ్ |
వివస్వాన్ మనవే ప్రాహ మనురిక్ష్వాకవేఽబ్రవీత్ || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "I imparted this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan, who then taught it to Manu, who in turn transmitted it to Iksavaku.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord Shree Krishna said; imam—this; vivasvate—to the Sun-god; yogam—the science of Yog; proktavān—taught; aham—I; avyayam—eternal; vivasvān—Sun-god; manave—to Manu, the original progenitor of humankind; prāha—told; manuḥ—Manu; ikṣhvākave—to Ikshvaku, first king of the Solar dynasty; abravīt—instructed

text:
एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।

स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप।।4.2।।
text_kannada:
ಏವಂ ಪರಂಪರಾಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಮಿಮಂ ರಾಜರ್ಷಯೋ ವಿದುಃ |
ಸ ಕಾಲೇನೇಹ ಮಹತಾ ಯೋಗೋ ನಷ್ಟಃ ಪರಂತಪ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఏవం పరంపరాప్రాప్తమిమం రాజర్షయో విదుః |
స కాలేనేహ మహతా యోగో నష్టః పరంతప || ౨ ||
transliteration:
evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa
translation_english: The king-sages knew this yoga, which was received in regular succession. That yoga, O destroyer of foes, is now lost due to a long lapse of time.
context_english: evam—thus; paramparā—in a continuous tradition; prāptam—received; imam—this (science); rāja-ṛiṣhayaḥ—the saintly kings; viduḥ—understood; saḥ—that; kālena—with the long passage of time; iha—in this world; mahatā—great; yogaḥ—the science of Yog; naṣhṭaḥ—lost; parantapa—Arjun, the scorcher of foes

text:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।

भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्।।4.3।।
text_kannada:
ಸ ಏವಾಯಂ ಮಯಾ ತೇಽದ್ಯ ಯೋಗಃ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಃ ಪುರಾತನಃ |
ಭಕ್ತೋಽಸಿ ಮೇ ಸಖಾ ಚೇತಿ ರಹಸ್ಯಂ ಹ್ಯೇತದುತ್ತಮಮ್ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
స ఏవాయం మయా తేఽద్య యోగః ప్రోక్తః పురాతనః |
భక్తోఽసి మే సఖా చేతి రహస్యం హ్యేతదుత్తమమ్ || ౩ ||
transliteration:
sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam
translation_english: That ancient Yoga itself, which is this, has been taught to you by Me today, considering you to be My devotee and friend, for this Yoga is a profound secret.
context_english: saḥ—that; eva—certainly; ayam—this; mayā—by me; te—unto you; adya—today; yogaḥ—the science of Yog; proktaḥ—reveal; purātanaḥ—ancient; bhaktaḥ—devotee; asi—you are; me—my; sakhā—friend; cha—and; iti—therefore; rahasyam—secret; hi—certainly; etat—this; uttamam—supreme

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।

कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति।।4.4।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಅಪರಂ ಭವತೋ ಜನ್ಮ ಪರಂ ಜನ್ಮ ವಿವಸ್ವತಃ |
ಕಥಮೇತದ್ವಿಜಾನೀಯಾಂ ತ್ವಮಾದೌ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತವಾನಿತಿ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
అపరం భవతో జన్మ పరం జన్మ వివస్వతః |
కథమేతద్విజానీయాం త్వమాదౌ ప్రోక్తవానితి || ౪ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ
katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti
translation_english: Arjuna said, "Your birth was later, whereas Vivasvan's birth was earlier. How am I to understand that You instructed him in the beginning?"
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; aparam—later; bhavataḥ—your; janma—birth; param—prior; janma—birth; vivasvataḥ—Vivasvan, the sun-god; katham—how; etat—this; vijānīyām—am I to understand; tvam—you; ādau—in the beginning; proktavān—taught; iti—thus

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।

तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप।।4.5।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಬಹೂನಿ ಮೇ ವ್ಯತೀತಾನಿ ಜನ್ಮಾನಿ ತವ ಚಾರ್ಜುನ |
ತಾನ್ಯಹಂ ವೇದ ಸರ್ವಾಣಿ ನ ತ್ವಂ ವೇತ್ಥ ಪರಂತಪ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
బహూని మే వ్యతీతాని జన్మాని తవ చార్జున |
తాన్యహం వేద సర్వాణి న త్వం వేత్థ పరంతప || ౫ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, many lives of Mine have passed, and so have yours. I know them all, but you do not know, O scorcher of enemies!"
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; bahūni—many; me—of mine; vyatītāni—have passed; janmāni—births; tava—of yours; cha—and; arjuna—Arjun; tāni—them; aham—I; veda—know; sarvāṇi—all; na—not; tvam—you; vettha—know; parantapa—Arjun, the scorcher of foes

text:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।

प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया।।4.6।।
text_kannada:
ಅಜೋಽಪಿ ಸನ್ನವ್ಯಯಾತ್ಮಾ ಭೂತಾನಾಮೀಶ್ವರೋಽಪಿ ಸನ್ |
ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ಸ್ವಾಮಧಿಷ್ಠಾಯ ಸಂಭವಾಮ್ಯಾತ್ಮಮಾಯಯಾ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
అజోఽపి సన్నవ్యయాత్మా భూతానామీశ్వరోఽపి సన్ |
ప్రకృతిం స్వామధిష్ఠాయ సంభవామ్యాత్మమాయయా || ౬ ||
transliteration:
ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san
prakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā
translation_english: Though I am birthless and undecaying by nature, and the Lord of beings, yet by subjugating My Prakriti, I take birth through My own Maya.
context_english: ajaḥ—unborn; api—although; san—being so; avyaya ātmā—Imperishable nature; bhūtānām—of (all) beings; īśhvaraḥ—the Lord; api—although; san—being; prakṛitim—nature; svām—of myself; adhiṣhṭhāya—situated; sambhavāmi—I manifest; ātma-māyayā—by my Yogmaya power

text:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।

अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्।।4.7।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ಯದಾ ಹಿ ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯ ಗ್ಲಾನಿರ್ಭವತಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಅಭ್ಯುತ್ಥಾನಮಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯ ತದಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ಸೃಜಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
యదా యదా హి ధర్మస్య గ్లానిర్భవతి భారత |
అభ్యుత్థానమధర్మస్య తదాఽఽత్మానం సృజామ్యహమ్ || ౭ ||
transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, whenever there is a decline in virtue and an increase in vice, then I manifest Myself.
context_english: yadā yadā—whenever; hi—certainly; dharmasya—of righteousness; glāniḥ—decline; bhavati—is; bhārata—Arjun, descendant of Bharat; abhyutthānam—increase; adharmasya—of unrighteousness; tadā—at that time; ātmānam—self; sṛijāmi—manifest; aham—I

text:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।

धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे।।4.8।।
text_kannada:
ಪರಿತ್ರಾಣಾಯ ಸಾಧೂನಾಂ ವಿನಾಶಾಯ ಚ ದುಷ್ಕೃತಾಮ್ |
ಧರ್ಮಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪನಾರ್ಥಾಯ ಸಂಭವಾಮಿ ಯುಗೇ ಯುಗೇ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
పరిత్రాణాయ సాధూనాం వినాశాయ చ దుష్కృతామ్ |
ధర్మసంస్థాపనార్థాయ సంభవామి యుగే యుగే || ౮ ||
transliteration:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām
dharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
translation_english: For the protection of the pious, the destruction of the evil-doers, and the establishment of virtue, I manifest myself in every age.
context_english: paritrāṇāya—to protect; sādhūnām—the righteous; vināśhāya—to annihilate; cha—and; duṣhkṛitām—the wicked; dharma—the eternal religion; sansthāpana-arthāya—to reestablish; sambhavāmi—I appear; yuge yuge—age after age

text:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन।।4.9।।
text_kannada:
ಜನ್ಮ ಕರ್ಮ ಚ ಮೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮೇವಂ ಯೋ ವೇತ್ತಿ ತತ್ತ್ವತಃ |
ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ದೇಹಂ ಪುನರ್ಜನ್ಮ ನೈತಿ ಮಾಮೇತಿ ಸೋಽರ್ಜುನ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
జన్మ కర్మ చ మే దివ్యమేవం యో వేత్తి తత్త్వతః |
త్యక్త్వా దేహం పునర్జన్మ నైతి మామేతి సోఽర్జున || ౯ ||
transliteration:
janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna
translation_english: He who thus knows truly the divine birth and actions of Mine does not get rebirth after casting off the body. He attains Me, O Arjuna.
context_english: janma—birth; karma—activities; cha—and; me—of mine; divyam—divine; evam—thus; yaḥ—who; vetti—know; tattvataḥ—in truth; tyaktvā—having abandoned; deham—the body; punaḥ—again; janma—birth; na—never; eti—takes; mām—to me; eti—comes; saḥ—he; arjuna—Arjun

text:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।

बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः।।4.10।।
text_kannada:
ವೀತರಾಗಭಯಕ್ರೋಧಾ ಮನ್ಮಯಾ ಮಾಮುಪಾಶ್ರಿತಾಃ |
ಬಹವೋ ಜ್ಞಾನತಪಸಾ ಪೂತಾ ಮದ್ಭಾವಮಾಗತಾಃ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
వీతరాగభయక్రోధా మన్మయా మాముపాశ్రితాః |
బహవో జ్ఞానతపసా పూతా మద్భావమాగతాః || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ
bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ
translation_english: Many who were devoid of attachment, fear, and anger, who were absorbed in Me, who had taken refuge in Me, and were purified by the austerity of knowledge, have attained My state.
context_english: vīta—freed from; rāga—attachment; bhaya—fear; krodhāḥ—and anger; mat-mayā—completely absorbed in me; mām—in me; upāśhritāḥ—taking refuge (of); bahavaḥ—many (persons); jñāna—of knowledge; tapasā—by the fire of knowledge; pūtāḥ—purified; mat-bhāvam—my divine love; āgatāḥ—attained

text:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।4.11।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇ ಯಥಾ ಮಾಂ ಪ್ರಪದ್ಯಂತೇ ತಾಂಸ್ತಥೈವ ಭಜಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ |
ಮಮ ವರ್ತ್ಮಾನುವರ್ತಂತೇ ಮನುಷ್ಯಾಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸರ್ವಶಃ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
యే యథా మాం ప్రపద్యంతే తాంస్తథైవ భజామ్యహమ్ |
మమ వర్త్మానువర్తంతే మనుష్యాః పార్థ సర్వశః || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
translation_english: According to the manner in which they approach Me, I favor them in that same manner. O son of Partha, humans follow My path in every way.
context_english: ye—who; yathā—in whatever way; mām—unto me; prapadyante—surrender; tān—them; tathā—so; eva—certainly; bhajāmi—reciprocate; aham—I; mama—my; vartma—path; anuvartante—follow; manuṣhyāḥ—men; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; sarvaśhaḥ—in all respects

text:
काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।

क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा।।4.12।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಂಕ್ಷಂತಃ ಕರ್ಮಣಾಂ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಯಜಂತ ಇಹ ದೇವತಾಃ |
ಕ್ಷಿಪ್ರಂ ಹಿ ಮಾನುಷೇ ಲೋಕೇ ಸಿದ್ಧಿರ್ಭವತಿ ಕರ್ಮಜಾ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
కాంక్షంతః కర్మణాం సిద్ధిం యజంత ఇహ దేవతాః |
క్షిప్రం హి మానుషే లోకే సిద్ధిర్భవతి కర్మజా || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā
translation_english: Longing for the fruition of their actions (of their rites and duties), they worship the gods here. For, in the human world, success from action comes quickly.
context_english: kāṅkṣhantaḥ—desiring; karmaṇām—material activities; siddhim—success; yajante—worship; iha—in this world; devatāḥ—the celestial gods; kṣhipram—quickly; hi—certainly; mānuṣhe—in human society; loke—within this world; siddhiḥ—rewarding; bhavati—manifest; karma-jā—from material activities

text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः।

तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्।।4.13।।
text_kannada:
ಚಾತುರ್ವರ್ಣ್ಯಂ ಮಯಾ ಸೃಷ್ಟಂ ಗುಣಕರ್ಮವಿಭಾಗಶಃ |
ತಸ್ಯ ಕರ್ತಾರಮಪಿ ಮಾಂ ವಿದ್ಧ್ಯಕರ್ತಾರಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
చాతుర్వర్ణ్యం మయా సృష్టం గుణకర్మవిభాగశః |
తస్య కర్తారమపి మాం విద్ధ్యకర్తారమవ్యయమ్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ
tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam
translation_english: The four castes have been created by Me through a classification of the gunas and duties. Even though I am the agent of that (act of classification), still know Me to be non-agentive and changeless.
context_english: chātuḥ-varṇyam—the four categories of occupations; mayā—by me; sṛiṣhṭam—were created; guṇa—of quality; karma—and activities; vibhāgaśhaḥ—according to divisions; tasya—of that; kartāram—the creator; api—although; mām—me; viddhi—know; akartāram—non-doer; avyayam—unchangeable

text:
न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।

इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते।।4.14।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಮಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಲಿಂಪಂತಿ ನ ಮೇ ಕರ್ಮಫಲೇ ಸ್ಪೃಹಾ |
ಇತಿ ಮಾಂ ಯೋಽಭಿಜಾನಾತಿ ಕರ್ಮಭಿರ್ನ ಸ ಬಧ್ಯತೇ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
న మాం కర్మాణి లింపంతి న మే కర్మఫలే స్పృహా |
ఇతి మాం యోఽభిజానాతి కర్మభిర్న స బధ్యతే || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā
iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
translation_english: Actions do not taint Me; for I have no hankering for the results of actions. One who knows Me thus, does not become bound by their actions.
