text:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।

कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्।।4.15।।
text_kannada:
ಏವಂ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಕೃತಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಪೂರ್ವೈರಪಿ ಮುಮುಕ್ಷುಭಿಃ |
ಕುರು ಕರ್ಮೈವ ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ತ್ವಂ ಪೂರ್ವೈಃ ಪೂರ್ವತರಂ ಕೃತಮ್ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
ఏవం జ్ఞాత్వా కృతం కర్మ పూర్వైరపి ముముక్షుభిః |
కురు కర్మైవ తస్మాత్త్వం పూర్వైః పూర్వతరం కృతమ్ || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam
translation_english: Thus having known, even the ancient seekers of liberation performed their duties. Therefore, you should undertake action as was performed earlier by the ancients.
context_english: evam—thus; jñātvā—knowing; kṛitam—performed; karma—actions; pūrvaiḥ—of ancient times; api—indeed; mumukṣhubhiḥ—seekers of liberation; kuru—should perform; karma—duty; eva—certainly; tasmāt—therefore; tvam—you; pūrvaiḥ—of those ancient sages; pūrva-taram—in ancient times; kṛitam—performed

text:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः।

तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।4.16।।
text_kannada:
ಕಿಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕಿಮಕರ್ಮೇತಿ ಕವಯೋಽಪ್ಯತ್ರ ಮೋಹಿತಾಃ |
ತತ್ತೇ ಕರ್ಮ ಪ್ರವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಮೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇಽಶುಭಾತ್ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
కిం కర్మ కిమకర్మేతి కవయోఽప్యత్ర మోహితాః |
తత్తే కర్మ ప్రవక్ష్యామి యజ్జ్ఞాత్వా మోక్ష్యసేఽశుభాత్ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ
tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
translation_english: Even the intelligent are confounded as to what is action and what is inaction. I shall tell you of that action, knowing which you will become free from evil.
context_english: kim—what; karma—action; kim—what; akarma—inaction; iti—thus; kavayaḥ—the wise; api—even; atra—in this; mohitāḥ—are confused; tat—that; te—to you; karma—action; pravakṣhyāmi—I shall explain; yat—which; jñātvā—knowing; mokṣhyase—you may free yourself; aśhubhāt—from inauspiciousness

text:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।

अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः।।4.17।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮಣೋ ಹ್ಯಪಿ ಬೋದ್ಧವ್ಯಂ ಬೋದ್ಧವ್ಯಂ ಚ ವಿಕರ್ಮಣಃ |
ಅಕರ್ಮಣಶ್ಚ ಬೋದ್ಧವ್ಯಂ ಗಹನಾ ಕರ್ಮಣೋ ಗತಿಃ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మణో హ్యపి బోద్ధవ్యం బోద్ధవ్యం చ వికర్మణః |
అకర్మణశ్చ బోద్ధవ్యం గహనా కర్మణో గతిః || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ
akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
translation_english: For there is something to be known even about action, and something to be known about prohibited action; and something needs to be known about inaction. The true nature of action is inscrutable.
context_english: karmaṇaḥ—recommended action; hi—certainly; api—also; boddhavyam—should be known; boddhavyam—must understand; cha—and; vikarmaṇaḥ—forbidden action; akarmaṇaḥ—inaction; cha—and; boddhavyam—must understand; gahanā—profound; karmaṇaḥ—of action; gatiḥ—the true path

text:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।

स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्।।4.18।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯಕರ್ಮ ಯಃ ಪಶ್ಯೇದಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಚ ಕರ್ಮ ಯಃ |
ಸ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮಾನ್ ಮನುಷ್ಯೇಷು ಸ ಯುಕ್ತಃ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಕರ್ಮಕೃತ್ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మణ్యకర్మ యః పశ్యేదకర్మణి చ కర్మ యః |
స బుద్ధిమాన్ మనుష్యేషు స యుక్తః కృత్స్నకర్మకృత్ || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ
sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit
translation_english: He who finds inaction in action, and action in inaction, is the wise one [possessed of the knowledge of Brahman] among men; they are engaged in yoga and are performers of all actions!
context_english: karmaṇi—action; akarma—in inaction; yaḥ—who; paśhyet—see; akarmaṇi—inaction; cha—also; karma—action; yaḥ—who; saḥ—they; buddhi-mān—wise; manuṣhyeṣhu—amongst humans; saḥ—they; yuktaḥ—yogis; kṛitsna-karma-kṛit—performers all kinds of actions

text:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।

ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः।।4.19।।
text_kannada:
ಯಸ್ಯ ಸರ್ವೇ ಸಮಾರಂಭಾಃ ಕಾಮಸಂಕಲ್ಪವರ್ಜಿತಾಃ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಾಗ್ನಿದಗ್ಧಕರ್ಮಾಣಂ ತಮಾಹುಃ ಪಂಡಿತಂ ಬುಧಾಃ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
యస్య సర్వే సమారంభాః కామసంకల్పవర్జితాః |
జ్ఞానాగ్నిదగ్ధకర్మాణం తమాహుః పండితం బుధాః || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ
jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṁ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṁ budhāḥ
translation_english: The wise call him learned whose actions are all devoid of desires and their thoughts, and whose actions have been burned away by the fire of wisdom.
context_english: yasya—whose; sarve—every; samārambhāḥ—undertakings; kāma—desire for material pleasures; saṅkalpa—resolve; varjitāḥ—devoid of; jñāna—divine knowledge; agni—in the fire; dagdha—burnt; karmāṇam—actions; tam—him; āhuḥ—address; paṇḍitam—a sage; budhāḥ—the wise

text:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः।

कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः।।4.20।।
text_kannada:
ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಾಸಂಗಂ ನಿತ್ಯತೃಪ್ತೋ ನಿರಾಶ್ರಯಃ |
ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯಭಿಪ್ರವೃತ್ತೋಽಪಿ ನೈವ ಕಿಂಚಿತ್ಕರೋತಿ ಸಃ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
త్యక్త్వా కర్మఫలాసంగం నిత్యతృప్తో నిరాశ్రయః |
కర్మణ్యభిప్రవృత్తోఽపి నైవ కించిత్కరోతి సః || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṁ nitya-tṛipto nirāśhrayaḥ
karmaṇyabhipravṛitto ’pi naiva kiñchit karoti saḥ
translation_english: Having given up attachment to the results of action, he who is ever-content, dependent on nothing, does not really do anything even though he is engaged in action.
context_english: tyaktvā—having given up; karma-phala-āsaṅgam—attachment to the fruits of action; nitya—always; tṛiptaḥ—satisfied; nirāśhrayaḥ—without dependence; karmaṇi—in activities; abhipravṛittaḥ—engaged; api—despite; na—not; eva—certainly; kiñchit—anything; karoti—do; saḥ—that person

text:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः।

शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।4.21।।
text_kannada:
ನಿರಾಶೀರ್ಯತಚಿತ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ತ್ಯಕ್ತಸರ್ವಪರಿಗ್ರಹಃ |
ಶಾರೀರಂ ಕೇವಲಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷಮ್ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
నిరాశీర్యతచిత్తాత్మా త్యక్తసర్వపరిగ్రహః |
శారీరం కేవలం కర్మ కుర్వన్నాప్నోతి కిల్బిషమ్ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
nirāśhīr yata-chittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ
śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
translation_english: One who is without solicitation, who has the mind and senses under control, and is totally without possessions, incurs no sin by performing actions merely for the maintenance of the body.
context_english: nirāśhīḥ—free from expectations; yata—controlled; chitta-ātmā—mind and intellect; tyakta—having abandoned; sarva—all; parigrahaḥ—the sense of ownership; śhārīram—bodily; kevalam—only; karma—actions; kurvan—performing; na—never; āpnoti—incurs; kilbiṣham—sin

text:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः।

समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते।।4.22।।
text_kannada:
ಯದೃಚ್ಛಾಲಾಭಸಂತುಷ್ಟೋ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಾತೀತೋ ವಿಮತ್ಸರಃ |
ಸಮಃ ಸಿದ್ಧಾವಸಿದ್ಧೌ ಚ ಕೃತ್ವಾಪಿ ನ ನಿಬಧ್ಯತೇ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
యదృచ్ఛాలాభసంతుష్టో ద్వంద్వాతీతో విమత్సరః |
సమః సిద్ధావసిద్ధౌ చ కృత్వాపి న నిబధ్యతే || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
yadṛichchhā-lābha-santuṣhṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate
translation_english: Remaining satisfied with what comes unasked for, having transcended the dualities, being free from spite, and balanced under success and failure, he is not bound even by performing actions.
context_english: yadṛichchhā—which comes of its own accord; lābha—gain; santuṣhṭaḥ—contented; dvandva—duality; atītaḥ—surpassed; vimatsaraḥ—free from envy; samaḥ—equipoised; siddhau—in success; asiddhau—failure; cha—and; kṛitvā—performing; api—even; na—never; nibadhyate—is bound

text:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः।

यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते।।4.23।।
text_kannada:
ಗತಸಂಗಸ್ಯ ಮುಕ್ತಸ್ಯ ಜ್ಞಾನಾವಸ್ಥಿತಚೇತಸಃ |
ಯಜ್ಞಾಯಾಚರತಃ ಕರ್ಮ ಸಮಗ್ರಂ ಪ್ರವಿಲೀಯತೇ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
గతసంగస్య ముక్తస్య జ్ఞానావస్థితచేతసః |
యజ్ఞాయాచరతః కర్మ సమగ్రం ప్రవిలీయతే || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-chetasaḥ
yajñāyācharataḥ karma samagraṁ pravilīyate
translation_english: The liberated person, who has rid themselves of attachment and whose mind is fixed in knowledge, has their actions undertaken for a sacrifice completely destroyed.
context_english: gata-saṅgasya—free from material attachments; muktasya—of the liberated; jñāna-avasthita—established in divine knowledge; chetasaḥ—whose intellect; yajñāya—as a sacrifice (to God); ācharataḥ—performing; karma—action; samagram—completely; pravilīyate—are freed

text:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्।

ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना।।4.24।।
text_kannada:
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾರ್ಪಣಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಹವಿರ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಗ್ನೌ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಾ ಹುತಮ್ |
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮೈವ ತೇನ ಗಂತವ್ಯಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಕರ್ಮಸಮಾಧಿನಾ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
బ్రహ్మార్పణం బ్రహ్మహవిర్బ్రహ్మాగ్నౌ బ్రహ్మణా హుతమ్ |
బ్రహ్మైవ తేన గంతవ్యం బ్రహ్మకర్మసమాధినా || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṁ brahma-karma-samādhinā
translation_english: The ladle is Brahman, the oblations are Brahman, and the offering is poured by Brahman into the fire of Brahman. He who has concentration on Brahman as the objective can only reach Brahman.
context_english: brahma—Brahman; arpaṇam—the ladle and other offerings; brahma—Brahman; haviḥ—the oblation; brahma—Brahman; agnau—in the sacrificial fire; brahmaṇā—by that person; hutam—offered; brahma—Brahman; eva—certainly; tena—by that; gantavyam—to be attained; brahma—Brahman; karma—offering; samādhinā—those completely absorbed in God-consciousness

text:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते।

ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति।।4.25।।
text_kannada:
ದೈವಮೇವಾಪರೇ ಯಜ್ಞಂ ಯೋಗಿನಃ ಪರ್ಯುಪಾಸತೇ |
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಗ್ನಾವಪರೇ ಯಜ್ಞಂ ಯಜ್ಞೇನೈವೋಪಜುಹ್ವತಿ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
దైవమేవాపరే యజ్ఞం యోగినః పర్యుపాసతే |
బ్రహ్మాగ్నావపరే యజ్ఞం యజ్ఞేనైవోపజుహ్వతి || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
daivam evāpare yajñaṁ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṁ yajñenaivopajuhvati
translation_english: Other yogis undertake sacrifice to gods alone, while others offer the Self as a sacrifice by themselves, in the fire of Brahman.
context_english: daivam—the celestial gods; eva—indeed; apare—others; yajñam—sacrifice; yoginaḥ—spiritual practioners; paryupāsate—worship; brahma—of the Supreme Truth; agnau—in the fire; apare—others; yajñam—sacrifice; yajñena—by sacrifice; eva—indeed; upajuhvati—offer

text:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति।

शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति।।4.26।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೋತ್ರಾದೀನೀಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣ್ಯನ್ಯೇ ಸಂಯಮಾಗ್ನಿಷು ಜುಹ್ವತಿ |
ಶಬ್ದಾದೀನ್ವಿಷಯಾನನ್ಯ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಗ್ನಿಷು ಜುಹ್ವತಿ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రోత్రాదీనీంద్రియాణ్యన్యే సంయమాగ్నిషు జుహ్వతి |
శబ్దాదీన్విషయానన్య ఇంద్రియాగ్నిషు జుహ్వతి || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
śhrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye sanyamāgniṣhu juhvati
śhabdādīn viṣhayānanya indriyāgniṣhu juhvati
translation_english: Others offer their organs, such as their ears, etc., in the fires of self-control. Others offer the objects, such as sound, etc., in the fires of their organs.
context_english: śhrotra-ādīni—such as the hearing process; indriyāṇi—senses; anye—others; sanyama—restraint; agniṣhu—in the sacrficial fire; juhvati—sacrifice; śhabda-ādīn—sound vibration, etc; viṣhayān—objects of sense-gratification; anye—others; indriya—of the senses; agniṣhu—in the fire; juhvati—sacrifice

text:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे।

आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते।।4.27।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಾಣೀಂದ್ರಿಯಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಪ್ರಾಣಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಚಾಪರೇ |
ಆತ್ಮಸಂಯಮಯೋಗಾಗ್ನೌ ಜುಹ್ವತಿ ಜ್ಞಾನದೀಪಿತೇ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వాణీంద్రియకర్మాణి ప్రాణకర్మాణి చాపరే |
ఆత్మసంయమయోగాగ్నౌ జుహ్వతి జ్ఞానదీపితే || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi chāpare
ātma-sanyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite
translation_english: Others offer all the activities of the organs and the activities of the vital force into the fire of the yoga of self-control, lit by Knowledge.
context_english: sarvāṇi—all; indriya—the senses; karmāṇi—functions; prāṇa-karmāṇi—functions of the life breath; cha—and; apare—others; ātma-sanyama yogāgnau—in the fire of the controlled mind; juhvati—sacrifice; jñāna-dīpite—kindled by knowledge

text:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे।

स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः।।4.28।।
text_kannada:
ದ್ರವ್ಯಯಜ್ಞಾಸ್ತಪೋಯಜ್ಞಾ ಯೋಗಯಜ್ಞಾಸ್ತಥಾಪರೇ |
ಸ್ವಾಧ್ಯಾಯಜ್ಞಾನಯಜ್ಞಾಶ್ಚ ಯತಯಃ ಸಂಶಿತವ್ರತಾಃ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
ద్రవ్యయజ్ఞాస్తపోయజ్ఞా యోగయజ్ఞాస్తథాపరే |
స్వాధ్యాయజ్ఞానయజ్ఞాశ్చ యతయః సంశితవ్రతాః || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare
swādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāśh cha yatayaḥ sanśhita-vratāḥ
translation_english: Similarly, others are performers of sacrifices through wealth, through austerity, through yoga, and through study and knowledge; others are ascetics with severe vows.
context_english: dravya-yajñāḥ—offering one’s own wealth as sacrifice; tapaḥ-yajñāḥ—offering severe austerities as sacrifice; yoga-yajñāḥ—performance of eight-fold path of yogic practices as sacrifice; tathā—thus; apare—others; swādhyāya—cultivating knowledge by studying the scriptures; jñāna-yajñāḥ—those offer cultivation of transcendental knowledge as sacrifice; cha—also; yatayaḥ—these ascetics; sanśhita-vratāḥ—observing strict vows

text:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे।

प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः।।4.29।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪಾನೇ ಜುಹ್ವತಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಪ್ರಾಣೇಽಪಾನಂ ತಥಾಽಪರೇ |
ಪ್ರಾಣಾಪಾನಗತೀ ರುದ್ಧ್ವಾ ಪ್ರಾಣಾಯಾಮಪರಾಯಣಾಃ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
అపానే జుహ్వతి ప్రాణ ప్రాణేఽపానం తథాఽపరే |
ప్రాణాపానగతీ రుద్ధ్వా ప్రాణాయామపరాయణాః || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
apāne juhvati prāṇaṁ prāṇe ’pānaṁ tathāpare
prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ
 apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣhu juhvati
sarve ’pyete yajña-vido yajña-kṣhapita-kalmaṣhāḥ
translation_english: Constantly practicing control of the vital forces by stopping the movements of the outgoing and incoming breaths, some offer as a sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming breath; while still others, the incoming breath into the outgoing breath.
context_english:
apāne—the incoming breath; juhvati—offer; prāṇam—the outgoing breath; prāṇe—in the outgoing breath; apānam—incoming breath; tathā—also; apare—others; prāṇa—of the outgoing breath; apāna—and the incoming breath; gatī—movement; ruddhvā—blocking; prāṇa-āyāma—control of breath; parāyaṇāḥ—wholly devoted
 apare—others; niyata—having controlled; āhārāḥ—food intake; prāṇān—life-breaths; prāṇeṣhu—life-energy; juhvati—sacrifice; sarve—all; api—also; ete—these; yajña-vidaḥ—knowers of sacrifices; yajña-kṣhapita—being cleansed by performances of sacrifices; kalmaṣhāḥ—of impurities

text:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति।

सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः।।4.30।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪರೇ ನಿಯತಾಹಾರಾಃ ಪ್ರಾಣಾನ್ಪ್ರಾಣೇಷು ಜುಹ್ವತಿ |
ಸರ್ವೇಽಪ್ಯೇತೇ ಯಜ್ಞವಿದೋ ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ಷಪಿತಕಲ್ಮಷಾಃ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
అపరే నియతాహారాః ప్రాణాన్ప్రాణేషు జుహ్వతి |
సర్వేఽప్యేతే యజ్ఞవిదో యజ్ఞక్షపితకల్మషాః || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān  prāṇeṣu juhvati

sarve py 'ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ
translation_english: Others, having their food regulated, offer the vital forces in the vital forces. All of them are knowers of the sacrifice and have their sins destroyed by the sacrifice.
context_english: apare—others;  niyata—controlled;  āhārāḥ—eating;  prāṇān—outgoing air; prāṇeṣu—in  the outgoing  air; sarve—all;  api—although    apparently  different;  ete—all     these;  yajñavidaḥ—conversant   with the purpose of performing; yajña—sacrifices; kṣapita—being cleansed of the result of such performances; kalmaṣāḥ—sinful    reactions;  juhvati—sacrifices.

text:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्।

नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम।।4.31।।
text_kannada:
ಯಜ್ಞಶಿಷ್ಟಾಮೃತಭುಜೋ ಯಾಂತಿ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಸನಾತನಮ್ |
ನಾಯಂ ಲೋಕೋಽಸ್ತ್ಯಯಜ್ಞಸ್ಯ ಕುತೋಽನ್ಯಃ ಕುರುಸತ್ತಮ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
యజ్ఞశిష్టామృతభుజో యాంతి బ్రహ్మ సనాతనమ్ |
నాయం లోకోఽస్త్యయజ్ఞస్య కుతోఽన్యః కురుసత్తమ || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāmṛita-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṁ loko ’styayajñasya kuto ’nyaḥ kuru-sattama
translation_english: Those who partake of the nectar left over after a sacrifice reach the eternal Brahman. This world ceases to exist for one who does not perform sacrifices; what, then, to speak of the other world, O best among the Kurus (Arjuna)!
context_english: yajña-śhiṣhṭa amṛita-bhujaḥ—they partake of the nectarean remnants of sacrifice; yānti—go; brahma—the Absolute Truth; sanātanam—eternal; na—never; ayam—this; lokaḥ—planet; asti—is; ayajñasya—for one who performs no sacrifice; kutaḥ—how; anyaḥ—other (world); kuru-sat-tama—best of the Kurus, Arjun

text:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।

कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे।।4.32।।
text_kannada:
ಏವಂ ಬಹುವಿಧಾ ಯಜ್ಞಾ ವಿತತಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣೋ ಮುಖೇ |
ಕರ್ಮಜಾನ್ವಿದ್ಧಿ ತಾನ್ಸರ್ವಾನೇವಂ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ವಿಮೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఏవం బహువిధా యజ్ఞా వితతా బ్రహ్మణో ముఖే |
కర్మజాన్విద్ధి తాన్సర్వానేవం జ్ఞాత్వా విమోక్ష్యసే || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase
translation_english: Thus, various kinds of sacrifices are spread at the mouth of the Vedas. Know them all to be born of action. Knowing this, you will become liberated.
context_english: evam—thus; bahu-vidhāḥ—various kinds of; yajñāḥ—sacrifices; vitatāḥ—have been described; brahmaṇaḥ—of the Vedas; mukhe—through the mouth; karma-jān—originating from works; viddhi—know; tān—them; sarvān—all; evam—thus; jñātvā—having known; vimokṣhyase—you shall be liberated

text:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप।

सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते।।4.33।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೇಯಾಂದ್ರವ್ಯಮಯಾದ್ಯಜ್ಞಾಜ್ಜ್ಞಾನಯಜ್ಞಃ ಪರಂತಪ |
ಸರ್ವಂ ಕರ್ಮಾಖಿಲಂ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಜ್ಞಾನೇ ಪರಿಸಮಾಪ್ಯತೇ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రేయాంద్రవ్యమయాద్యజ్ఞాజ్జ్ఞానయజ్ఞః పరంతప |
సర్వం కర్మాఖిలం పార్థ జ్ఞానే పరిసమాప్యతే || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
śhreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa
sarvaṁ karmākhilaṁ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
translation_english: O destroyer of enemies, knowledge considered as a sacrifice is greater than sacrifices requiring materials. O son of Prtha, all actions in their totality culminate in knowledge.
context_english: śhreyān—superior; dravya-mayāt—of material possessions; yajñāt—than the sacrifice; jñāna-yajñaḥ—sacrifice performed in knowledge; parantapa—subduer of enemies, Arjun; sarvam—all; karma—works; akhilam—all; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; jñāne—in knowledge; parisamāpyate—culminate

text:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया।

उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः।।4.34।।
text_kannada:
ತದ್ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಪ್ರಣಿಪಾತೇನ ಪರಿಪ್ರಶ್ನೇನ ಸೇವಯಾ |
ಉಪದೇಕ್ಷ್ಯಂತಿ ತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಿನಸ್ತತ್ತ್ವದರ್ಶಿನಃ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
తద్విద్ధి ప్రణిపాతేన పరిప్రశ్నేన సేవయా |
ఉపదేక్ష్యంతి తే జ్ఞానం జ్ఞానినస్తత్త్వదర్శినః || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśhnena sevayā
upadekṣhyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśhinaḥ
translation_english: Know that the wise ones who have realized the Truth will impart the Knowledge to you through prostration, inquiry, and service.
context_english: tat—the Truth; viddhi—try to learn; praṇipātena—by approaching a spiritual master; paripraśhnena—by humble inquiries; sevayā—by rendering service; upadekṣhyanti—can impart; te—unto you; jñānam—knowledge; jñāninaḥ—the enlightened; tattva-darśhinaḥ—those who have realized the Truth

text:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव।

येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि।।4.35।।
text_kannada:
ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ನ ಪುನರ್ಮೋಹಮೇವಂ ಯಾಸ್ಯಸಿ ಪಾಂಡವ |
ಯೇನ ಭೂತಾನ್ಯಶೇಷೇಣ ದ್ರಕ್ಷ್ಯಸ್ಯಾತ್ಮನ್ಯಥೋ ಮಯಿ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
యజ్జ్ఞాత్వా న పునర్మోహమేవం యాస్యసి పాండవ |
యేన భూతాన్యశేషేణ ద్రక్ష్యస్యాత్మన్యథో మయి || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
yena bhūtānyaśheṣheṇa drakṣhyasyātmanyatho mayi
translation_english: Knowing this, O Pandava, you will not be deluded again in this way, and through it, you will see all beings, without exception, in the Self and also in Me.
context_english: yat—which; jñātvā—having known; na—never; punaḥ—again; moham—delusion; evam—like this; yāsyasi—you shall get; pāṇḍava—Arjun, the son of Pandu; yena—by this; bhūtāni—living beings; aśheṣhāṇi—all; drakṣhyasi—you will see; ātmani—within me (Shree Krishna); atho—that is to say; mayi—in me

text:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः।

सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि।।4.36।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪಿ ಚೇದಸಿ ಪಾಪೇಭ್ಯಃ ಸರ್ವೇಭ್ಯಃ ಪಾಪಕೃತ್ತಮಃ |
ಸರ್ವಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಪ್ಲವೇನೈವ ವೃಜಿನಂ ಸಂತರಿಷ್ಯಸಿ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
అపి చేదసి పాపేభ్యః సర్వేభ్యః పాపకృత్తమః |
సర్వం జ్ఞానప్లవేనైవ వృజినం సంతరిష్యసి || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ
sarvaṁ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛijinaṁ santariṣhyasi
translation_english: Even if you are the worst sinner among all sinners, you can still cross over all wickedness with the raft of Knowledge alone.
context_english: api—even; chet—if; asi—you are; pāpebhyaḥ—sinners; sarvebhyaḥ—of all; pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ—most sinful; sarvam—all; jñāna-plavena—by the boat of divine knowledge; eva—certainly; vṛijinam—sin; santariṣhyasi—you shall cross over

text:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन।

ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा।।4.37।।
text_kannada:
ಯಥೈಧಾಂಸಿ ಸಮಿದ್ಧೋಽಗ್ನಿರ್ಭಸ್ಮಸಾತ್ಕುರುತೇಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಾಗ್ನಿಃ ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಭಸ್ಮಸಾತ್ಕುರುತೇ ತಥಾ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
యథైధాంసి సమిద్ధోఽగ్నిర్భస్మసాత్కురుతేఽర్జున |
జ్ఞానాగ్నిః సర్వకర్మాణి భస్మసాత్కురుతే తథా || ౩౭ ||
transliteration:
yathaidhānsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sāt kurute ’rjuna
jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā
translation_english: O Arjuna, just as a blazing fire reduces wood to ashes, similarly the fire of Knowledge reduces all actions to ashes.
context_english: yathā—as; edhānsi—firewood; samiddhaḥ—blazing; agniḥ—fire; bhasma-sāt—to ashes; kurute—turns; arjuna—Arjun; jñāna-agniḥ—the fire of knowledge; sarva-karmāṇi—all reactions from material activities; bhasma-sāt—to ashes; kurute—it turns; tathā—similarly

text:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।

तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति।।4.38।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಹಿ ಜ್ಞಾನೇನ ಸದೃಶಂ ಪವಿತ್ರಮಿಹ ವಿದ್ಯತೇ |
ತತ್ಸ್ವಯಂ ಯೋಗಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಃ ಕಾಲೇನಾತ್ಮನಿ ವಿಂದತಿ || ೩೮ ||
text_telugu:
న హి జ్ఞానేన సదృశం పవిత్రమిహ విద్యతే |
తత్స్వయం యోగసంసిద్ధః కాలేనాత్మని విందతి || ౩౮ ||
transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate
tatsvayaṁ yogasansiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
translation_english: Indeed, there is nothing purifying here comparable to Knowledge. One who has become perfected over time through yoga, realizes That in their own heart.
context_english: na—not; hi—certainly; jñānena—with divine knowledge; sadṛiśham—like; pavitram—pure; iha—in this world; vidyate—exists; tat—that; svayam—oneself; yoga—practice of yog; sansiddhaḥ—he who has attained perfection; kālena—in course of time; ātmani—wihtin the heart; vindati—finds

text:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।

ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।4.39।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಾಁಲ್ಲಭತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ತತ್ಪರಃ ಸಂಯತೇಂದ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಲಬ್ಧ್ವಾ ಪರಾಂ ಶಾಂತಿಮಚಿರೇಣಾಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రద్ధావాఁల్లభతే జ్ఞానం తత్పరః సంయతేంద్రియః |
జ్ఞానం లబ్ధ్వా పరాం శాంతిమచిరేణాధిగచ్ఛతి || ౩౯ ||
transliteration:
śhraddhāvān labhate jñānaṁ tat-paraḥ sanyatendriyaḥ
jñānaṁ labdhvā parāṁ śhāntim achireṇādhigachchhati
translation_english: The one who has faith, is diligent, and has control over their organs, attains Knowledge. Achieving Knowledge, one soon attains supreme Peace.
context_english: śhraddhā-vān—a faithful person; labhate—achieves; jñānam—divine knowledge; tat-paraḥ—devoted (to that); sanyata—controlled; indriyaḥ—senses; jñānam—transcendental knowledge; labdhvā—having achieved; parām—supreme; śhāntim—peace; achireṇa—without delay; adhigachchhati—attains

text:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति।

नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः।।4.40।।
text_kannada:
ಅಜ್ಞಶ್ಚಾಶ್ರದ್ದಧಾನಶ್ಚ ಸಂಶಯಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿನಶ್ಯತಿ |
ನಾಯಂ ಲೋಕೋಽಸ್ತಿ ನ ಪರೋ ನ ಸುಖಂ ಸಂಶಯಾತ್ಮನಃ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
అజ్ఞశ్చాశ్రద్దధానశ్చ సంశయాత్మా వినశ్యతి |
నాయం లోకోఽస్తి న పరో న సుఖం సంశయాత్మనః || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
ajñaśh chāśhraddadhānaśh cha sanśhayātmā vinaśhyati
nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ
translation_english: One who is ignorant and faithless, and has a doubting mind, perishes. Neither this world nor the next, nor happiness, exists for one who has a doubting mind.
context_english: ajñaḥ—the ignorant; cha—and; aśhraddadhānaḥ—without faith; cha—and; sanśhaya—skeptical; ātmā—a person; vinaśhyati—falls down; na—never; ayam—in this; lokaḥ—world; asti—is; na—not; paraḥ—in the next; na—not; sukham—happiness; sanśhaya-ātmanaḥ—for the skeptical soul

text:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्।

आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।।4.41।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಗಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ತಕರ್ಮಾಣಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಛಿನ್ನಸಂಶಯಮ್ |
ಆತ್ಮವಂತಂ ನ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ನಿಬಧ್ನಂತಿ ಧನಂಜಯ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
యోగసంన్యస్తకర్మాణం జ్ఞానసంఛిన్నసంశయమ్ |
ఆత్మవంతం న కర్మాణి నిబధ్నంతి ధనంజయ || ౪౧ ||
transliteration:
yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṁ jñāna-sañchhinna-sanśhayam
ātmavantaṁ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
translation_english: O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), actions do not bind one who has renounced actions through yoga, whose doubts have been fully dispelled by Knowledge, and who is not inattentive.
context_english: yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇam—those who renounce ritualistic karm, dedicating their body, mind, and soul to God; jñāna—by knowledge; sañchhinna—dispelled; sanśhayam—doubts; ātma-vantam—situated in knowledge of the self; na—not; karmāṇi—actions; nibadhnanti—bind; dhanañjaya—Arjun, the conqueror of wealth

text:
तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः।

छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत।।4.42।।
text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾದಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಭೂತಂ ಹೃತ್ಸ್ಥಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಾಸಿನಾಽಽತ್ಮನಃ |
ಛಿತ್ತ್ವೈನಂ ಸಂಶಯಂ ಯೋಗಮಾತಿಷ್ಠೋತ್ತಿಷ್ಠ ಭಾರತ || ೪೨ ||
text_telugu:
తస్మాదజ్ఞానసంభూతం హృత్స్థం జ్ఞానాసినాఽఽత్మనః |
ఛిత్త్వైనం సంశయం యోగమాతిష్ఠోత్తిష్ఠ భారత || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṁ hṛit-sthaṁ jñānāsinātmanaḥ
chhittvainaṁ sanśhayaṁ yogam ātiṣhṭhottiṣhṭha bhārata
translation_english: Therefore, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, take recourse to yoga and rise up, cutting asunder with the sword of knowledge this doubt in your heart, arising from ignorance.
context_english: tasmāt—therefore; ajñāna-sambhūtam—born of ignorance; hṛit-stham—situated in the heart; jñāna—of knowledge; asinā—with the sword; ātmanaḥ—of the self; chhittvā—cut asunder; enam—this; sanśhayam—doubt; yogam—in karm yog; ātiṣhṭha—take shelter; uttiṣhṭha—arise; bhārata—Arjun, descendant of Bharat

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि।

यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्िचतम्।।5.1।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಂ ಕರ್ಮಣಾಂ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಪುನರ್ಯೋಗಂ ಚ ಶಂಸಸಿ |
ಯಚ್ಛ್ರೇಯ ಏತಯೋರೇಕಂ ತನ್ಮೇ ಬ್ರೂಹಿ ಸುನಿಶ್ಿಚತಮ್ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
సంన్యాసం కర్మణాం కృష్ణ పునర్యోగం చ శంససి |
యచ్ఛ్రేయ ఏతయోరేకం తన్మే బ్రూహి సునిశ్ిచతమ్ || ౧ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi
yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam
translation_english: Arjuna said, "O Krsna, you praise renunciation of actions and, at the same time, Karma-yoga. Please tell me for certain which one is better between these two."
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; sanyāsam—renunciation; karmaṇām—of actions; kṛiṣhṇa—Shree Krishna; punaḥ—again; yogam—about karm yog; cha—also; śhansasi—you praise; yat—which; śhreyaḥ—more beneficial; etayoḥ—of the two; ekam—one; tat—that; me—unto me; brūhi—please tell; su-niśhchitam—conclusively

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ।

तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते।।5.2।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಃ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗಶ್ಚ ನಿಃಶ್ರೇಯಸಕರಾವುಭೌ |
ತಯೋಸ್ತು ಕರ್ಮಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಾತ್ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗೋ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಯತೇ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
సంన్యాసః కర్మయోగశ్చ నిఃశ్రేయసకరావుభౌ |
తయోస్తు కర్మసంన్యాసాత్కర్మయోగో విశిష్యతే || ౨ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
sannyāsaḥ karma-yogaśh cha niḥśhreyasa-karāvubhau
tayos tu karma-sannyāsāt karma-yogo viśhiṣhyate
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "Both renunciation of actions and Karma-yoga lead to liberation; however, Karma-yoga excels over renunciation of actions."
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; sanyāsaḥ—renunciation; karma-yogaḥ—working in devotion; cha—and; niḥśhreyasa-karau—lead to the supreme goal; ubhau—both; tayoḥ—of the two; tu—but; karma-sanyāsāt—renunciation of actions; karma-yogaḥ—working in devotion; viśhiṣhyate—is superior

text:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति।

निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते।।5.3।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞೇಯಃ ಸ ನಿತ್ಯಸಂನ್ಯಾಸೀ ಯೋ ನ ದ್ವೇಷ್ಟಿ ನ ಕಾಂಕ್ಷತಿ |
ನಿರ್ದ್ವಂದ್ವೋ ಹಿ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಸುಖಂ ಬಂಧಾತ್ಪ್ರಮುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞేయః స నిత్యసంన్యాసీ యో న ద్వేష్టి న కాంక్షతి |
నిర్ద్వంద్వో హి మహాబాహో సుఖం బంధాత్ప్రముచ్యతే || ౩ ||
transliteration:
jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati
nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate
translation_english: He who neither hates nor craves should be known as a man of constant renunciation.
context_english: jñeyaḥ—should be considered; saḥ—that person; nitya—always; sanyāsī—practising renunciation; yaḥ—who; na—never; dveṣhṭi—hate; na—nor; kāṅkṣhati—desire; nirdvandvaḥ—free from all dualities; hi—certainly; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; sukham—easily; bandhāt—from bondage; pramuchyate—is liberated

text:
सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः।

एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्।।5.4।।
text_kannada:
ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಯೋಗೌ ಪೃಥಗ್ಬಾಲಾಃ ಪ್ರವದಂತಿ ನ ಪಂಡಿತಾಃ |
ಏಕಮಪ್ಯಾಸ್ಥಿತಃ ಸಮ್ಯಗುಭಯೋರ್ವಿಂದತೇ ಫಲಮ್ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
సాంఖ్యయోగౌ పృథగ్బాలాః ప్రవదంతి న పండితాః |
ఏకమప్యాస్థితః సమ్యగుభయోర్విందతే ఫలమ్ || ౪ ||
transliteration:
sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
translation_english: The fools, not the learned ones, speak of Sankhya and (Karma-) yoga as being different. Anyone who properly resorts to either one of them gets the results of both.
context_english: sānkhya—renunciation of actions; yogau—karm yog; pṛithak—different; bālāḥ—the ignorant; pravadanti—say; na—never; paṇḍitāḥ—the learned; ekam—in one; api—even; āsthitaḥ—being situated; samyak—completely; ubhayoḥ—of both; vindate—achieve; phalam—the result

text:
यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते।

एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।5.5।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ಸಾಂಖ್ಯೈಃ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯತೇ ಸ್ಥಾನಂ ತದ್ಯೋಗೈರಪಿ ಗಮ್ಯತೇ |
ಏಕಂ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಂ ಚ ಯೋಗಂ ಚ ಯಃ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ಸ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
యత్సాంఖ్యైః ప్రాప్యతే స్థానం తద్యోగైరపి గమ్యతే |
ఏకం సాంఖ్యం చ యోగం చ యః పశ్యతి స పశ్యతి || ౫ ||
transliteration:
yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate
ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
translation_english: The state that is reached by the Sankhyas, and that is also reached by the yogis, is seen by one who sees Sankhya and yoga as one.
context_english: yat—what; sānkhyaiḥ—by means of karm sanyās; prāpyate—is attained; sthānam—place; tat—that; yogaiḥ—by working in devotion; api—also; gamyate—is attained; ekam—one; sānkhyam—renunciation of actions; cha—and; yogam—karm yog; cha—and; yaḥ—who; paśhyati—sees; saḥ—that person; paśhyati—actually sees

text:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः।

योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।5.6।।
text_kannada:
ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಸ್ತು ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ದುಃಖಮಾಪ್ತುಮಯೋಗತಃ |
ಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತೋ ಮುನಿರ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ನಚಿರೇಣಾಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
సంన్యాసస్తు మహాబాహో దుఃఖమాప్తుమయోగతః |
యోగయుక్తో మునిర్బ్రహ్మ నచిరేణాధిగచ్ఛతి || ౬ ||
transliteration:
sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ
yoga-yukto munir brahma na chireṇādhigachchhati
translation_english: But, O mighty-armed one, renunciation is hard to attain without (Karma-) yoga. The meditative man equipped with yoga attains Brahman without delay.
context_english: sanyāsaḥ—renunciation; tu—but; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; duḥkham—distress; āptum—attains; ayogataḥ—without karm yog; yoga-yuktaḥ—one who is adept in karm yog; muniḥ—a sage; brahma—Brahman; na chireṇa—quickly; adhigachchhati—goes

text:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः।

सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते।।5.7।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತೋ ವಿಶುದ್ಧಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿಜಿತಾತ್ಮಾ ಜಿತೇಂದ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾತ್ಮಭೂತಾತ್ಮಾ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನಪಿ ನ ಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
యోగయుక్తో విశుద్ధాత్మా విజితాత్మా జితేంద్రియః |
సర్వభూతాత్మభూతాత్మా కుర్వన్నపి న లిప్యతే || ౭ ||
transliteration:
yoga-yukto viśhuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
sarva-bhūtātma-bhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate
translation_english: Endowed with yoga, pure in mind, controlled in body, a conqueror of the organs, the Self of the selves of all beings—he does not become tainted even while performing actions. When this person resorts to nitya and naimittika rites and duties as a means to the achievement of full illumination, and thus becomes fully enlightened, then, even when he acts through the apparent functions of the mind, organs, etc., he does not become affected.
context_english: yoga-yuktaḥ—united in consciousness with God; viśhuddha-ātmā—one with purified intellect; vijita-ātmā—one who has conquered the mind; jita-indriyaḥ—having conquered the senses; sarva-bhūta-ātma-bhūta-ātmā—one who sees the Soul of all souls in every living being; kurvan—performing; api—although; na—never; lipyate—entangled

text:
नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।

पश्यन् श्रृणवन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपन् श्वसन्।।5.8।।
text_kannada:
ನೈವ ಕಿಂಚಿತ್ಕರೋಮೀತಿ ಯುಕ್ತೋ ಮನ್ಯೇತ ತತ್ತ್ವವಿತ್ |
ಪಶ್ಯನ್ ಶ್ರೃಣವನ್ಸ್ಪೃಶಂಜಿಘ್ರನ್ನಶ್ನನ್ಗಚ್ಛನ್ಸ್ವಪನ್ ಶ್ವಸನ್ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
నైవ కించిత్కరోమీతి యుక్తో మన్యేత తత్త్వవిత్ |
పశ్యన్ శ్రృణవన్స్పృశంజిఘ్రన్నశ్నన్గచ్ఛన్స్వపన్ శ్వసన్ || ౮ ||
transliteration:
naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit
paśhyañ śhṛiṇvan spṛiśhañjighrann aśhnangachchhan svapañśhvasan
 pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣhu vartanta iti dhārayan
translation_english: - Remaining absorbed in the Self, the knower of Reality should think, 'I certainly do not do anything', even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing, speaking, releasing, holding, opening, and closing the eyes—remembering that the organs function in relation to the objects of the organs.
context_english:
na—not; eva—certainly; kiñchit—anything; karomi—I do; iti—thus; yuktaḥ—steadfast in karm yog; manyeta—thinks; tattva-vit—one who knows the truth; paśhyan—seeing; śhṛiṇvan—hearing; spṛiśhan—touching; jighran—smelling; aśhnan—eating; gachchhan—moving; svapan—sleeping; śhvasan—breathing;
 pralapan—talking; visṛijan—giving up; gṛihṇan—accepting; unmiṣhan—opening (the eyes); nimiṣhan—closing (the eyes); api—although; indriyāṇi—the senses; indriya-artheṣhu—in sense-objects; vartante—moving; iti—thus; dhārayan—convinced

text:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्।।5.9।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಲಪನ್ವಿಸೃಜನ್ಗೃಹ್ಣನ್ನುನ್ಮಿಷನ್ನಿಮಿಷನ್ನಪಿ |
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣೀಂದ್ರಿಯಾರ್ಥೇಷು ವರ್ತಂತ ಇತಿ ಧಾರಯನ್ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రలపన్విసృజన్గృహ్ణన్నున్మిషన్నిమిషన్నపి |
ఇంద్రియాణీంద్రియార్థేషు వర్తంత ఇతి ధారయన్ || ౯ ||
transliteration: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
translation_english: - Remaining absorbed in the Self, the knower of Reality should think, 'I certainly do not do anything', even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing, speaking, releasing, holding, opening, and closing the eyes—remembering that the organs function in relation to the objects of the organs.
context_english: pralapan—by talking; visṛjan—by giving up; gṛhṇan—by accepting; unmiṣan—opening; nimiṣan—closing; api—in spite of; indriyāṇi—the senses; indriya-artheṣu—in sense gratification;   vartante—let    them be so engaged; iti—thus;   dhārayan—considering.

text:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।

लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा।।5.10।।
text_kannada:
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣ್ಯಾಧಾಯ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಸಂಗಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಕರೋತಿ ಯಃ |
ಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ ನ ಸ ಪಾಪೇನ ಪದ್ಮಪತ್ರಮಿವಾಂಭಸಾ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
బ్రహ్మణ్యాధాయ కర్మాణి సంగం త్యక్త్వా కరోతి యః |
లిప్యతే న స పాపేన పద్మపత్రమివాంభసా || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā
translation_english: One who acts by dedicating their actions to Brahman and by renouncing attachment, they do not become polluted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not by water.
context_english: brahmaṇi—to God; ādhāya—dedicating; karmāṇi—all actions; saṅgam—attachment; tyaktvā—abandoning; karoti—performs; yaḥ—who; lipyate—is affected; na—never; saḥ—that person; pāpena—by sin; padma-patram—a lotus leaf; iva—like; ambhasā—by water

text:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।

योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये।।5.11।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಯೇನ ಮನಸಾ ಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ ಕೇವಲೈರಿಂದ್ರಿಯೈರಪಿ |
ಯೋಗಿನಃ ಕರ್ಮ ಕುರ್ವಂತಿ ಸಂಗಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾಽಽತ್ಮಶುದ್ಧಯೇ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
కాయేన మనసా బుద్ధ్యా కేవలైరింద్రియైరపి |
యోగినః కర్మ కుర్వంతి సంగం త్యక్త్వాఽఽత్మశుద్ధయే || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṁ tyaktvātma-śhuddhaye
translation_english: By giving up attachment, the yogis undertake work solely through the body, mind, intellect, and even the organs, for their own purification.
context_english: kāyena—with the body; manasā—with the mind; buddhyā—with the intellect; kevalaiḥ—only; indriyaiḥ—with the senses; api—even; yoginaḥ—the yogis; karma—actions; kurvanti—perform; saṅgam—attachment; tyaktvā—giving up; ātma—of the self; śhuddhaye—for the purification

text:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्।

अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते।।5.12।।
text_kannada:
ಯುಕ್ತಃ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಶಾಂತಿಮಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ನೈಷ್ಠಿಕೀಮ್ |
ಅಯುಕ್ತಃ ಕಾಮಕಾರೇಣ ಫಲೇ ಸಕ್ತೋ ನಿಬಧ್ಯತೇ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
యుక్తః కర్మఫలం త్యక్త్వా శాంతిమాప్నోతి నైష్ఠికీమ్ |
అయుక్తః కామకారేణ ఫలే సక్తో నిబధ్యతే || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm
ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
translation_english: Giving up the results of work by becoming resolute in faith, one attains peace arising from steadfastness. One who is lacking in resolute faith, being attached to the results under the impulse of desire, becomes bound.
context_english: yuktaḥ—one who is united in consciousness with God; karma-phalam—the results of all activities; tyaktvā—giving up; śhāntim—peace; āpnoti—attains; naiṣhṭhikīm—everlasting; ayuktaḥ—one who is not united with God in consciousness; kāma-kāreṇa—impelled by desires; phale—in the result; saktaḥ—attached; nibadhyate—becomes entangled

text:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी।

नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्।।5.13।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಮನಸಾ ಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ಯಾಸ್ತೇ ಸುಖಂ ವಶೀ |
ನವದ್ವಾರೇ ಪುರೇ ದೇಹೀ ನೈವ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನ ಕಾರಯನ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వకర్మాణి మనసా సంన్యస్యాస్తే సుఖం వశీ |
నవద్వారే పురే దేహీ నైవ కుర్వన్న కారయన్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
sarva-karmāṇi manasā sannyasyāste sukhaṁ vaśhī
nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan
translation_english: The embodied man of self-control, having given up all actions mentally, continues happily in the city of nine gates, without doing or causing anyone else to do anything.
context_english: sarva—all; karmāṇi—activities; manasā—by the mind; sannyasya—having renounced; āste—remains; sukham—happily; vaśhī—the self-controlled; nava-dvāre—of nine gates; pure—in the city; dehī—the embodied being; na—never; eva—certainly; kurvan—doing anything; na—not; kārayan—causing to be done

text:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।

न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते।।5.14।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಕರ್ತೃತ್ವಂ ನ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಲೋಕಸ್ಯ ಸೃಜತಿ ಪ್ರಭುಃ |
ನ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಸಂಯೋಗಂ ಸ್ವಭಾವಸ್ತು ಪ್ರವರ್ತತೇ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
న కర్తృత్వం న కర్మాణి లోకస్య సృజతి ప్రభుః |
న కర్మఫలసంయోగం స్వభావస్తు ప్రవర్తతే || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ
na karma-phala-saṅyogaṁ svabhāvas tu pravartate
translation_english: The Self does not create agency or any objects of desire for anyone, nor does it associate with the results of actions; rather, it is Nature that acts.
context_english: na—neither; kartṛitvam—sense of doership; na—nor; karmāṇi—actions; lokasya—of the people; sṛijati—creates; prabhuḥ—God; na—nor; karma-phala—fruits of actions; sanyogam—connection; svabhāvaḥ—one’s nature; tu—but; pravartate—is enacted

text:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।

अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः।।5.15।।
text_kannada:
ನಾದತ್ತೇ ಕಸ್ಯಚಿತ್ಪಾಪಂ ನ ಚೈವ ಸುಕೃತಂ ವಿಭುಃ |
ಅಜ್ಞಾನೇನಾವೃತಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ತೇನ ಮುಹ್ಯಂತಿ ಜಂತವಃ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
నాదత్తే కస్యచిత్పాపం న చైవ సుకృతం విభుః |
అజ్ఞానేనావృతం జ్ఞానం తేన ముహ్యంతి జంతవః || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛitaṁ jñānaṁ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
translation_english: The Omnipresent neither accepts anyone's sin nor even virtue; knowledge remains covered by ignorance, thus the creatures become deluded.
context_english: na—not; ādatte—accepts; kasyachit—anyone’s; pāpam—sin; na—not; cha—and; eva—certainly; su-kṛitam—virtuous deeds; vibhuḥ—the omnipresent God; ajñānena—by ignorance; āvṛitam—covered; jñānam—knowledge; tena—by that; muhyanti—are deluded; jantavaḥ—the living entities

text:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः।

तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्।।5.16।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞಾನೇನ ತು ತದಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಯೇಷಾಂ ನಾಶಿತಮಾತ್ಮನಃ |
ತೇಷಾಮಾದಿತ್ಯವಜ್ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಯತಿ ತತ್ಪರಮ್ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞానేన తు తదజ్ఞానం యేషాం నాశితమాత్మనః |
తేషామాదిత్యవజ్జ్ఞానం ప్రకాశయతి తత్పరమ్ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ
teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param
translation_english: But in the case of those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge (of the Self), their knowledge, like the sun, reveals that supreme Reality.
context_english: jñānena—by divine knowledge; tu—but; tat—that; ajñānam—ignorance; yeṣhām—whose; nāśhitam—has been destroyed; ātmanaḥ—of the self; teṣhām—their; āditya-vat—like the sun; jñānam—knowledge; prakāśhayati—illumines; tat—that; param—Supreme Entity

text:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।

गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः।।5.17।।
text_kannada:
ತದ್ಬುದ್ಧಯಸ್ತದಾತ್ಮಾನಸ್ತನ್ನಿಷ್ಠಾಸ್ತತ್ಪರಾಯಣಾಃ |
ಗಚ್ಛಂತ್ಯಪುನರಾವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಜ್ಞಾನನಿರ್ಧೂತಕಲ್ಮಷಾಃ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
తద్బుద్ధయస్తదాత్మానస్తన్నిష్ఠాస్తత్పరాయణాః |
గచ్ఛంత్యపునరావృత్తిం జ్ఞాననిర్ధూతకల్మషాః || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
tad-buddhayas tad-ātmānas tan-niṣhṭhās tat-parāyaṇāḥ
gachchhantyapunar-āvṛittiṁ jñāna-nirdhūta-kalmaṣhāḥ
translation_english: Those whose intellect is absorbed in That, whose Self is That, who are steadfast in That, and who have That as their supreme Goal—they attain the state of non-returning, their impurities having been removed by Knowledge.
context_english: tat-buddhayaḥ—those whose intellect is directed toward God; tat-ātmānaḥ—those whose heart (mind and intellect) is solely absorbed in God; tat-niṣhṭhāḥ—those whose intellect has firm faith in God; tat-parāyaṇāḥ—those who strive after God as the supreme goal and refuge; gachchhanti—go; apunaḥ-āvṛittim—not returning; jñāna—by knowledge; nirdhūta—dispelled; kalmaṣhāḥ—sins

text:
विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि।

शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः।।5.18।।
text_kannada:
ವಿದ್ಯಾವಿನಯಸಂಪನ್ನೇ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣೇ ಗವಿ ಹಸ್ತಿನಿ |
ಶುನಿ ಚೈವ ಶ್ವಪಾಕೇ ಚ ಪಂಡಿತಾಃ ಸಮದರ್ಶಿನಃ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
విద్యావినయసంపన్నే బ్రాహ్మణే గవి హస్తిని |
శుని చైవ శ్వపాకే చ పండితాః సమదర్శినః || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
vidyā-vinaya-sampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ
translation_english: The learned ones look with equanimity on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humility, a cow, an elephant, and even a dog, as well as one who eats dog meat.
context_english: vidyā—divine knowledge; vinaya—humbleness; sampanne—equipped with; brāhmaṇe—a Brahmin; gavi—a cow; hastini—an elephant; śhuni—a dog; cha—and; eva—certainly; śhva-pāke—a dog-eater; cha—and; paṇḍitāḥ—the learned; sama-darśhinaḥ—see with equal vision

text:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।

निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः।।5.19।।
text_kannada:
ಇಹೈವ ತೈರ್ಜಿತಃ ಸರ್ಗೋ ಯೇಷಾಂ ಸಾಮ್ಯೇ ಸ್ಥಿತಂ ಮನಃ |
ನಿರ್ದೋಷಂ ಹಿ ಸಮಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಿ ತೇ ಸ್ಥಿತಾಃ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఇహైవ తైర్జితః సర్గో యేషాం సామ్యే స్థితం మనః |
నిర్దోషం హి సమం బ్రహ్మ తస్మాద్బ్రహ్మణి తే స్థితాః || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ
nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
translation_english: Here itself is mirth attained by those whose minds are established in sameness. Since Brahman is the same in all and free from defects, they are established in Brahman.
context_english: iha eva—in this very life; taiḥ—by them; jitaḥ—conquer; sargaḥ—the creation; yeṣhām—whose; sāmye—in equanimity; sthitam—situated; manaḥ—mind; nirdoṣham—flawless; hi—certainly; samam—in equality; brahma—God; tasmāt—therefore; brahmaṇi—in the Absolute Truth; te—they; sthitāḥ—are seated

text:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्।

स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः।।5.20।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಪ್ರಹೃಷ್ಯೇತ್ಪ್ರಿಯಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ನೋದ್ವಿಜೇತ್ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಚಾಪ್ರಿಯಮ್ |
ಸ್ಥಿರಬುದ್ಧಿರಸಮ್ಮೂಢೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮವಿದ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಃ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
న ప్రహృష్యేత్ప్రియం ప్రాప్య నోద్విజేత్ప్రాప్య చాప్రియమ్ |
స్థిరబుద్ధిరసమ్మూఢో బ్రహ్మవిద్బ్రహ్మణి స్థితః || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam
sthira-buddhir asammūḍho brahma-vid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
translation_english: A knower of Brahman, who is established in Brahman, should have their intellect steady and should not be deluded. They should not get delighted by getting what is desirable, nor become dejected by getting what is undesirable.

text:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्।

स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते।।5.21।।
text_kannada:
ಬಾಹ್ಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶೇಷ್ವಸಕ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿಂದತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಿ ಯತ್ಸುಖಮ್ |
ಸ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ಸುಖಮಕ್ಷಯಮಶ್ನುತೇ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
బాహ్యస్పర్శేష్వసక్తాత్మా విందత్యాత్మని యత్సుఖమ్ |
స బ్రహ్మయోగయుక్తాత్మా సుఖమక్షయమశ్నుతే || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
bāhya-sparśheṣhvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham
sa brahma-yoga-yuktātmā sukham akṣhayam aśhnute
translation_english: With his heart unattached to external objects, he gets the bliss that is in the Self. With his heart absorbed in meditation on Brahman, he acquires undying Bliss.

text:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।

आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः।।5.22।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇ ಹಿ ಸಂಸ್ಪರ್ಶಜಾ ಭೋಗಾ ದುಃಖಯೋನಯ ಏವ ತೇ |
ಆದ್ಯಂತವಂತಃ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ನ ತೇಷು ರಮತೇ ಬುಧಃ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
యే హి సంస్పర్శజా భోగా దుఃఖయోనయ ఏవ తే |
ఆద్యంతవంతః కౌంతేయ న తేషు రమతే బుధః || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ
translation_english: Since enjoyments that result from contact with objects are indeed the sources of sorrow, having a beginning and an end, O son of Kunti, the wise one does not delight in them.

text:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्।

कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः।।5.23।।
text_kannada:
ಶಕ್ನೋತೀಹೈವ ಯಃ ಸೋಢುಂ ಪ್ರಾಕ್ಶರೀರವಿಮೋಕ್ಷಣಾತ್ |
ಕಾಮಕ್ರೋಧೋದ್ಭವಂ ವೇಗಂ ಸ ಯುಕ್ತಃ ಸ ಸುಖೀ ನರಃ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
శక్నోతీహైవ యః సోఢుం ప్రాక్శరీరవిమోక్షణాత్ |
కామక్రోధోద్భవం వేగం స యుక్తః స సుఖీ నరః || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
śhaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṁ prāk śharīra-vimokṣhaṇāt
kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
translation_english: One who can withstand here itself, before departing from the body, the impulse arising from desire and anger, that person is a yogi; they are happy.

text:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः।

स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति।।5.24।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಽಂತಃಸುಖೋಽಂತರಾರಾಮಸ್ತಥಾಂತರ್ಜ್ಯೋತಿರೇವ ಯಃ |
ಸ ಯೋಗೀ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿರ್ವಾಣಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂತೋಽಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
యోఽంతఃసుఖోఽంతరారామస్తథాంతర్జ్యోతిరేవ యః |
స యోగీ బ్రహ్మనిర్వాణం బ్రహ్మభూతోఽధిగచ్ఛతి || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
yo 'ntaḥ-sukho 'ntar-ārāmas tathāntar-jyotir eva yaḥ
sa yogī brahma-nirvāṇaṁ brahma-bhūto 'dhigachchhati
translation_english: One who is content within, whose pleasure is within, and whose light is only within, that yogi, having become Brahman, attains absorption into Brahman.

text:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।

छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।5.25।।
text_kannada:
ಲಭಂತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿರ್ವಾಣಮೃಷಯಃ ಕ್ಷೀಣಕಲ್ಮಷಾಃ |
ಛಿನ್ನದ್ವೈಧಾ ಯತಾತ್ಮಾನಃ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಹಿತೇ ರತಾಃ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
లభంతే బ్రహ్మనిర్వాణమృషయః క్షీణకల్మషాః |
ఛిన్నద్వైధా యతాత్మానః సర్వభూతహితే రతాః || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
labhante brahma-nirvāṇam ṛiṣhayaḥ kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ
chhinna-dvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
translation_english: The seers whose sins have been attenuated, who are free from doubt, whose senses are under control, who are engaged in doing good to all beings, attain absorption in Brahman.
context_english: labhante—achieve; brahma-nirvāṇam—liberation from material existence; ṛiṣhayaḥ—holy persons; kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ—whose sins have been purged; chhinna—annihilated; dvaidhāḥ—doubts; yata-ātmānaḥ—whose minds are disciplined; sarva-bhūta—for all living entities; hite—in welfare work; ratāḥ—rejoice

text:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्।

अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्।।5.26।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಮಕ್ರೋಧವಿಯುಕ್ತಾನಾಂ ಯತೀನಾಂ ಯತಚೇತಸಾಮ್ |
ಅಭಿತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿರ್ವಾಣಂ ವರ್ತತೇ ವಿದಿತಾತ್ಮನಾಮ್ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
కామక్రోధవియుక్తానాం యతీనాం యతచేతసామ్ |
అభితో బ్రహ్మనిర్వాణం వర్తతే విదితాత్మనామ్ || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
kāma-krodha-viyuktānāṁ yatīnāṁ yata-chetasām
abhito brahma-nirvāṇaṁ vartate viditātmanām
translation_english: To those monks who have control over their internal organs, who are free from desire and anger, who have known the Self, there is absorption into Brahman either way.
context_english: kāma—desires; krodha—anger; vimuktānām—of those who are liberated; yatīnām—of the saintly persons; yata-chetasām—those self-realized persons who have subdued their mind; abhitaḥ—from every side; brahma—spiritual; nirvāṇam—liberation from material existence; vartate—exists; vidita-ātmanām—of those who are self-realized

text:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।

प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ।।5.27।।
text_kannada:
ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಾನ್ಕೃತ್ವಾ ಬಹಿರ್ಬಾಹ್ಯಾಂಶ್ಚಕ್ಷುಶ್ಚೈವಾಂತರೇ ಭ್ರುವೋಃ |
ಪ್ರಾಣಾಪಾನೌ ಸಮೌ ಕೃತ್ವಾ ನಾಸಾಭ್ಯಂತರಚಾರಿಣೌ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
స్పర్శాన్కృత్వా బహిర్బాహ్యాంశ్చక్షుశ్చైవాంతరే భ్రువోః |
ప్రాణాపానౌ సమౌ కృత్వా నాసాభ్యంతరచారిణౌ || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ
prāṇāpānau samau kṛitvā nāsābhyantara-chāriṇau
 yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣha-parāyaṇaḥ
vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ

He who is ever thus is verily free.

यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः।

विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः।।5.28।।

text:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।

सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति।।5.29।।
text_kannada:
ಭೋಕ್ತಾರಂ ಯಜ್ಞತಪಸಾಂ ಸರ್ವಲೋಕಮಹೇಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ಸುಹೃದಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಮಾಂ ಶಾಂತಿಮೃಚ್ಛತಿ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
భోక్తారం యజ్ఞతపసాం సర్వలోకమహేశ్వరమ్ |
సుహృదం సర్వభూతానాం జ్ఞాత్వా మాం శాంతిమృచ్ఛతి || ౨౯ ||

translation_english: One attains peace by knowing Me, who am the great Lord of all the worlds, the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, and the friend of all creatures.

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।

स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः।।6.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಅನಾಶ್ರಿತಃ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಂ ಕಾರ್ಯಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕರೋತಿ ಯಃ |
ಸ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸೀ ಚ ಯೋಗೀ ಚ ನ ನಿರಗ್ನಿರ್ನ ಚಾಕ್ರಿಯಃ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
అనాశ్రితః కర్మఫలం కార్యం కర్మ కరోతి యః |
స సంన్యాసీ చ యోగీ చ న నిరగ్నిర్న చాక్రియః || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
anāśhritaḥ karma-phalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ
sa sannyāsī cha yogī cha na niragnir na chākriyaḥ
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "He who performs an action which is his duty, without depending on the result of the action, is a monk and a yogi; not so in he who does not keep afire and is actionless."

text:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।

न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन।।6.2।।
text_kannada:
ಯಂ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಮಿತಿ ಪ್ರಾಹುರ್ಯೋಗಂ ತಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಪಾಂಡವ |
ನ ಹ್ಯಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ತಸಂಕಲ್ಪೋ ಯೋಗೀ ಭವತಿ ಕಶ್ಚನ || ೨ ||

text:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।

योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते।।6.3।।
text_kannada:
ಆರುರುಕ್ಷೋರ್ಮುನೇರ್ಯೋಗಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾರಣಮುಚ್ಯತೇ |
