text_telugu:
ఆరురుక్షోర్మునేర్యోగం కర్మ కారణముచ్యతే |
యోగారూఢస్య తస్యైవ శమః కారణముచ్యతే || ౩ ||
transliteration:
ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śhamaḥ kāraṇam uchyate
translation_english: For the sage who wishes to ascend to (Dhyana-) yoga, action is said to be the means. For that person, once he has ascended to (Dhyana-)yoga, inaction alone is said to be the means.
context_english: ārurukṣhoḥ—a beginner; muneḥ—of a sage; yogam—Yog; karma—working without attachment; kāraṇam—the cause; uchyate—is said; yoga ārūḍhasya—of those who are elevated in Yog; tasya—their; eva—certainly; śhamaḥ—meditation; kāraṇam—the cause; uchyate—is said

text:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।

सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते।।6.4।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ಹಿ ನೇಂದ್ರಿಯಾರ್ಥೇಷು ನ ಕರ್ಮಸ್ವನುಷಜ್ಜತೇ |
ಸರ್ವಸಂಕಲ್ಪಸಂನ್ಯಾಸೀ ಯೋಗಾರೂಢಸ್ತದೋಚ್ಯತೇ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
యదా హి నేంద్రియార్థేషు న కర్మస్వనుషజ్జతే |
సర్వసంకల్పసంన్యాసీ యోగారూఢస్తదోచ్యతే || ౪ ||
transliteration:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣhu na karmasv-anuṣhajjate
sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadochyate
translation_english: Verily, when a man who has given up thought about everything does not get attached to sense-objects or actions, he is then said to be established in Yoga.
context_english: yadā—when; hi—certainly; na—not; indriya-artheṣhu—for sense-objects; na—not; karmasu—to actions; anuṣhajjate—is attachment; sarva-saṅkalpa—all desires for the fruits of actions; sanyāsī—renouncer; yoga-ārūḍhaḥ—elevated in the science of Yog; tadā—at that time; uchyate—is said

text:
उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।

आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः।।6.5।।
text_kannada:
ಉದ್ಧರೇದಾತ್ಮನಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ನಾತ್ಮಾನಮವಸಾದಯೇತ್ |
ಆತ್ಮೈವ ಹ್ಯಾತ್ಮನೋ ಬಂಧುರಾತ್ಮೈವ ರಿಪುರಾತ್ಮನಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
ఉద్ధరేదాత్మనాఽఽత్మానం నాత్మానమవసాదయేత్ |
ఆత్మైవ హ్యాత్మనో బంధురాత్మైవ రిపురాత్మనః || ౫ ||
transliteration:
uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
translation_english: One should save oneself by oneself; one should not degrade oneself. For oneself is indeed one's own friend; oneself is indeed one's own enemy.
context_english: uddharet—elevate; ātmanā—through the mind; ātmānam—the self; na—not; ātmānam—the self; avasādayet—degrade; ātmā—the mind; eva—certainly; hi—indeed; ātmanaḥ—of the self; bandhuḥ—friend; ātmā—the mind; eva—certainly; ripuḥ—enemy; ātmanaḥ—of the self

text:
बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।

अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्।।6.6।।
text_kannada:
ಬಂಧುರಾತ್ಮಾಽಽತ್ಮನಸ್ತಸ್ಯ ಯೇನಾತ್ಮೈವಾತ್ಮನಾ ಜಿತಃ |
ಅನಾತ್ಮನಸ್ತು ಶತ್ರುತ್ವೇ ವರ್ತೇತಾತ್ಮೈವ ಶತ್ರುವತ್ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
బంధురాత్మాఽఽత్మనస్తస్య యేనాత్మైవాత్మనా జితః |
అనాత్మనస్తు శత్రుత్వే వర్తేతాత్మైవ శత్రువత్ || ౬ ||
transliteration:
bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat
translation_english: He who has conquered his own self by the self, his self is his own friend. But for one who has not conquered his own self, his self itself acts like an enemy.
context_english: bandhuḥ—friend; ātmā—the mind; ātmanaḥ—for the person; tasya—of him; yena—by whom; ātmā—the mind; eva—certainly; ātmanā—for the person; jitaḥ—conquered; anātmanaḥ—of those with unconquered mind; tu—but; śhatrutve—for an enemy; varteta—remains; ātmā—the mind; eva—as; śhatru-vat—like an enemy

text:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।

शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः।।6.7।।
text_kannada:
ಜಿತಾತ್ಮನಃ ಪ್ರಶಾಂತಸ್ಯ ಪರಮಾತ್ಮಾ ಸಮಾಹಿತಃ |
ಶೀತೋಷ್ಣಸುಖದುಃಖೇಷು ತಥಾ ಮಾನಾಪಮಾನಯೋಃ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
జితాత్మనః ప్రశాంతస్య పరమాత్మా సమాహితః |
శీతోష్ణసుఖదుఃఖేషు తథా మానాపమానయోః || ౭ ||
transliteration:
jitātmanaḥ praśhāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
translation_english: The supreme Self of one who has control over the aggregate of his body and organs, and who is tranquil, becomes manifest. He should be poised in the midst of cold and heat, happiness and sorrow, as well as honor and dishonor.
context_english: jita-ātmanaḥ—one who has conquered one’s mind; praśhāntasya—of the peaceful; parama-ātmā—God; samāhitaḥ—steadfast; śhīta—in cold; uṣhṇa—heat; sukha—happiness; duḥkheṣhu—and distress; tathā—also; māna—in honor; apamānayoḥ—and dishonor

text:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।

युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।।6.8।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞಾನವಿಜ್ಞಾನತೃಪ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ಕೂಟಸ್ಥೋ ವಿಜಿತೇಂದ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಯುಕ್ತ ಇತ್ಯುಚ್ಯತೇ ಯೋಗೀ ಸಮಲೋಷ್ಟಾಶ್ಮಕಾಂಚನಃ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞానవిజ్ఞానతృప్తాత్మా కూటస్థో విజితేంద్రియః |
యుక్త ఇత్యుచ్యతే యోగీ సమలోష్టాశ్మకాంచనః || ౮ ||
transliteration:
jñāna-vijñāna-tṛiptātmā kūṭa-stho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityuchyate yogī sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
translation_english: One whose mind is satisfied with knowledge and realization, who is unmoved, who has his organs under control, is said to be Self-absorbed. The yogi treats all alike, a lump of earth, a stone, and gold.
context_english: jñāna—knowledge; vijñāna—realized knowledge, wisdom from within; tṛipta ātmā—one fully satisfied; kūṭa-sthaḥ—undisturbed; vijita-indriyaḥ—one who has conquered the senses; yuktaḥ—one who is in constant communion with the Supreme; iti—thus; uchyate—is said; yogī—a yogi; sama—looks equally; loṣhṭra—pebbles; aśhma—stone; kāñchanaḥ—gold

text:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।

साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते।।6.9।।
text_kannada:
ಸುಹೃನ್ಮಿತ್ರಾರ್ಯುದಾಸೀನಮಧ್ಯಸ್ಥದ್ವೇಷ್ಯಬಂಧುಷು |
ಸಾಧುಷ್ವಪಿ ಚ ಪಾಪೇಷು ಸಮಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ವಿಶಿಷ್ಯತೇ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
సుహృన్మిత్రార్యుదాసీనమధ్యస్థద్వేష్యబంధుషు |
సాధుష్వపి చ పాపేషు సమబుద్ధిర్విశిష్యతే || ౯ ||
transliteration:
suhṛin-mitrāryudāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣhya-bandhuṣhu
sādhuṣhvapi cha pāpeṣhu sama-buddhir viśhiṣhyate
translation_english: He excels who has sameness of view with regard to a benefactor, a friend, an enemy, a neutral, an arbiter, the hateful, a relative, good people, and even sinners.
context_english: su-hṛit—toward the well-wishers; mitra—friends; ari—enemies; udāsīna—neutral persons; madhya-stha—mediators; dveṣhya—the envious; bandhuṣhu—relatives; sādhuṣhu—pious; api—as well as; cha—and; pāpeṣhu—the sinners; sama-buddhiḥ—of impartial intellect; viśhiṣhyate—is distinguished

text:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।

एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः।।6.10।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಗೀ ಯುಂಜೀತ ಸತತಮಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ರಹಸಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಃ |
ಏಕಾಕೀ ಯತಚಿತ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ನಿರಾಶೀರಪರಿಗ್ರಹಃ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
యోగీ యుంజీత సతతమాత్మానం రహసి స్థితః |
ఏకాకీ యతచిత్తాత్మా నిరాశీరపరిగ్రహః || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yata-chittātmā nirāśhīr aparigrahaḥ
translation_english: A yogi should constantly concentrate his mind by staying in a solitary place, alone, with mind and body controlled, free from expectations, and free from acquisition.
context_english: yogī—a yogi; yuñjīta—should remain engaged in meditation; satatam—constantly; ātmānam—self; rahasi—in seclusion; sthitaḥ—remaining; ekākī—alone; yata-chitta-ātmā—with a controlled mind and body; nirāśhīḥ—free from desires; aparigrahaḥ—free from desires for possessions for enjoyment

text:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।

नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्।।6.11।।
text_kannada:
ಶುಚೌ ದೇಶೇ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಾಪ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರಮಾಸನಮಾತ್ಮನಃ |
ನಾತ್ಯುಚ್ಛ್ರಿತಂ ನಾತಿನೀಚಂ ಚೈಲಾಜಿನಕುಶೋತ್ತರಮ್ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
శుచౌ దేశే ప్రతిష్ఠాప్య స్థిరమాసనమాత్మనః |
నాత్యుచ్ఛ్రితం నాతినీచం చైలాజినకుశోత్తరమ్ || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ
nātyuchchhritaṁ nāti-nīchaṁ chailājina-kuśhottaram
translation_english: Having firmly established in a clean place his seat, neither too high nor too low, composed of cloth, skin, and kusa-grass placed successively one below the other;
context_english: śhuchau—in a clean; deśhe—place; pratiṣhṭhāpya—having established; sthiram—steadfast; āsanam—seat; ātmanaḥ—his own; na—not; ati—too; uchchhritam—high; na—not; ati—too; nīcham—low; chaila—cloth; ajina—a deerskin; kuśha—kuśh grass; uttaram—one over the other

text:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।

उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये।।6.12।।
text_kannada:
ತತ್ರೈಕಾಗ್ರಂ ಮನಃ ಕೃತ್ವಾ ಯತಚಿತ್ತೇಂದ್ರಿಯಕ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಉಪವಿಶ್ಯಾಸನೇ ಯುಂಜ್ಯಾದ್ಯೋಗಮಾತ್ಮವಿಶುದ್ಧಯೇ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
తత్రైకాగ్రం మనః కృత్వా యతచిత్తేంద్రియక్రియః |
ఉపవిశ్యాసనే యుంజ్యాద్యోగమాత్మవిశుద్ధయే || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
tatraikāgraṁ manaḥ kṛitvā yata-chittendriya-kriyaḥ
upaviśhyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśhuddhaye
translation_english: Sitting on that seat, he should concentrate his mind for the purification of the internal organ, making the mind one-pointed and keeping the actions of the mind and senses under control.
context_english: tatra—there; eka-agram—one-pointed; manaḥ—mind; kṛitvā—having made; yata-chitta—controlling the mind; indriya—senses; kriyaḥ—activities; upaviśhya—being seated; āsane—on the seat; yuñjyāt yogam—should strive to practice yog; ātma viśhuddhaye—for purification of the mind;

text:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।

संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्।।6.13।।
text_kannada:
ಸಮಂ ಕಾಯಶಿರೋಗ್ರೀವಂ ಧಾರಯನ್ನಚಲಂ ಸ್ಥಿರಃ |
ಸಂಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯ ನಾಸಿಕಾಗ್ರಂ ಸ್ವಂ ದಿಶಶ್ಚಾನವಲೋಕಯನ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
సమం కాయశిరోగ్రీవం ధారయన్నచలం స్థిరః |
సంప్రేక్ష్య నాసికాగ్రం స్వం దిశశ్చానవలోకయన్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
samaṁ kāya-śhiro-grīvaṁ dhārayann achalaṁ sthiraḥ
samprekṣhya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśhaśh chānavalokayan
translation_english: Holding the body, head, and neck erect and still, being steady, looking at the tip of his own nose and not looking around.
context_english: samam—straight; kāya—body; śhiraḥ—head; grīvam—neck; dhārayan—holding; achalam—unmoving; sthiraḥ—still; samprekṣhya—gazing; nāsika-agram—at the tip of the nose; svam—own; diśhaḥ—directions; cha—and; anavalokayan—not looking

text:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।

मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः।।6.14।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಶಾಂತಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿಗತಭೀರ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚಾರಿವ್ರತೇ ಸ್ಥಿತಃ |
ಮನಃ ಸಂಯಮ್ಯ ಮಚ್ಚಿತ್ತೋ ಯುಕ್ತ ಆಸೀತ ಮತ್ಪರಃ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రశాంతాత్మా విగతభీర్బ్రహ్మచారివ్రతే స్థితః |
మనః సంయమ్య మచ్చిత్తో యుక్త ఆసీత మత్పరః || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
praśhāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmachāri-vrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ sanyamya mach-chitto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
translation_english: He should remain seated with a placid mind, free from fear, firm in the vow of celibacy, and with the mind fixed on Me by controlling it through concentration, having Me as the supreme goal.
context_english: praśhānta—serene; ātmā—mind; vigata-bhīḥ—fearless; brahmachāri-vrate—in the vow of celibacy; sthitaḥ—situated; manaḥ—mind; sanyamya—having controlled; mat-chittaḥ—meditate on me (Shree Krishna); yuktaḥ—engaged; āsīta—should sit; mat-paraḥ—having me as the supreme goal

text:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।

शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति।।6.15।।
text_kannada:
ಯುಂಜನ್ನೇವಂ ಸದಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ಯೋಗೀ ನಿಯತಮಾನಸಃ |
ಶಾಂತಿಂ ನಿರ್ವಾಣಪರಮಾಂ ಮತ್ಸಂಸ್ಥಾಮಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
యుంజన్నేవం సదాఽఽత్మానం యోగీ నియతమానసః |
శాంతిం నిర్వాణపరమాం మత్సంస్థామధిగచ్ఛతి || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ
śhantiṁ nirvāṇa-paramāṁ mat-sansthām adhigachchhati
translation_english: Concentrating the mind thus, forever, the yogi of a controlled mind achieves the peace that culminates in liberation and abides in Me.
context_english: yuñjan—keeping the mind absorbed in God; evam—thus; sadā—constantly; ātmānam—the mind; yogī—a yogi; niyata-mānasaḥ—one with a disciplined mind; śhāntim—peace; nirvāṇa—liberation from the material bondage; paramām—supreme; mat-sansthām—abides in me; adhigachchhati—attains

text:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।

न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन।।6.16।।
text_kannada:
ನಾತ್ಯಶ್ನತಸ್ತು ಯೋಗೋಽಸ್ತಿ ನ ಚೈಕಾಂತಮನಶ್ನತಃ |
ನ ಚಾತಿಸ್ವಪ್ನಶೀಲಸ್ಯ ಜಾಗ್ರತೋ ನೈವ ಚಾರ್ಜುನ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
నాత్యశ్నతస్తు యోగోఽస్తి న చైకాంతమనశ్నతః |
న చాతిస్వప్నశీలస్య జాగ్రతో నైవ చార్జున || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
nātyaśhnatastu yogo ’sti na chaikāntam anaśhnataḥ
na chāti-svapna-śhīlasya jāgrato naiva chārjuna
translation_english: But, O Arjuna, Yoga is not for one who eats excessively, nor for one who does not eat at all; neither for one who habitually sleeps too long, nor for one who stays awake.
context_english: na—not; ati—too much; aśhnataḥ—of one who eats; tu—however; yogaḥ—Yog; asti—there is; na—not; cha—and; ekāntam—at all; anaśhnataḥ—abstaining from eating; na—not; cha—and; ati—too much; svapna-śhīlasya—of one who sleeps; jāgrataḥ—of one who does not sleep enough; na—not; eva—certainly; cha—and; arjuna—Arjun

text:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।

युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा।।6.17।।
text_kannada:
ಯುಕ್ತಾಹಾರವಿಹಾರಸ್ಯ ಯುಕ್ತಚೇಷ್ಟಸ್ಯ ಕರ್ಮಸು |
ಯುಕ್ತಸ್ವಪ್ನಾವಬೋಧಸ್ಯ ಯೋಗೋ ಭವತಿ ದುಃಖಹಾ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
యుక్తాహారవిహారస్య యుక్తచేష్టస్య కర్మసు |
యుక్తస్వప్నావబోధస్య యోగో భవతి దుఃఖహా || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-cheṣhṭasya karmasu
yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā
translation_english: Yoga becomes a destroyer of sorrow for one whose eating and movements are regulated, whose effort in works is moderate, and whose sleep and wakefulness are temperate.
context_english: yukta—moderate; āhāra—eating; vihārasya—recreation; yukta cheṣhṭasya karmasu—balanced in work; yukta—regulated; svapna-avabodhasya—sleep and wakefulness; yogaḥ—Yog; bhavati—becomes; duḥkha-hā—the slayer of sorrows

text:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।

निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा।।6.18।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ವಿನಿಯತಂ ಚಿತ್ತಮಾತ್ಮನ್ಯೇವಾವತಿಷ್ಠತೇ |
ನಿಃಸ್ಪೃಹಃ ಸರ್ವಕಾಮೇಭ್ಯೋ ಯುಕ್ತ ಇತ್ಯುಚ್ಯತೇ ತದಾ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
యదా వినియతం చిత్తమాత్మన్యేవావతిష్ఠతే |
నిఃస్పృహః సర్వకామేభ్యో యుక్త ఇత్యుచ్యతే తదా || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
yadā viniyataṁ chittam ātmanyevāvatiṣhṭhate
niḥspṛihaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadā
translation_english: A person who has become free from hankering for all desirable objects is said to be Self-absorbed when the controlled mind rests solely in the Self.
context_english: yadā—when; viniyatam—fully controlled; chittam—the mind; ātmani—of the self; eva—certainly; avatiṣhṭhate—stays; nispṛihaḥ—free from cravings: sarva; kāmebhyaḥ—for yearning of the senses; yuktaḥ—situated in perfect Yog; iti—thus; uchyate—is said; tadā—then

text:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।

योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः।।6.19।।
text_kannada:
ಯಥಾ ದೀಪೋ ನಿವಾತಸ್ಥೋ ನೇಂಗತೇ ಸೋಪಮಾ ಸ್ಮೃತಾ |
ಯೋಗಿನೋ ಯತಚಿತ್ತಸ್ಯ ಯುಂಜತೋ ಯೋಗಮಾತ್ಮನಃ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
యథా దీపో నివాతస్థో నేంగతే సోపమా స్మృతా |
యోగినో యతచిత్తస్య యుంజతో యోగమాత్మనః || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā
yogino yata-chittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ
translation_english: As a lamp kept in a windless place does not flicker, so is the simile for the yogi whose mind is under control and who is engaged in concentration on the Self.
context_english: yathā—as; dīpaḥ—a lamp; nivāta-sthaḥ—in a windless place; na—does not; iṅgate—flickers; sā—this; upamā—analogy; smṛitā—is considered; yoginaḥ—of a yogi; yata-chittasya—whose mind is disciplined; yuñjataḥ—steadily practicing; yogam—in meditation; ātmanaḥ—on the Supreme

text:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।

यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति।।6.20।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ರೋಪರಮತೇ ಚಿತ್ತಂ ನಿರುದ್ಧಂ ಯೋಗಸೇವಯಾ |
ಯತ್ರ ಚೈವಾತ್ಮನಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ಪಶ್ಯನ್ನಾತ್ಮನಿ ತುಷ್ಯತಿ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
యత్రోపరమతే చిత్తం నిరుద్ధం యోగసేవయా |
యత్ర చైవాత్మనాఽఽత్మానం పశ్యన్నాత్మని తుష్యతి || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
yatroparamate chittaṁ niruddhaṁ yoga-sevayā
yatra chaivātmanātmānaṁ paśhyann ātmani tuṣhyati
translation_english: At the time when the mind, restrained through the practice of Yoga, is withdrawn, and just when one sees the Self by the self and remains contented in the Self alone;
context_english: yatra—when; uparamate—rejoice inner joy; chittam—the mind; niruddham—restrained; yoga-sevayā—by the practice of yog; yatra—when; cha—and; eva—certainly; ātmanā—through the purified mind; ātmānam—the soul; paśhyan—behold; ātmani—in the self; tuṣhyati—is satisfied

text:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।

वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः।।6.21।।
text_kannada:
ಸುಖಮಾತ್ಯಂತಿಕಂ ಯತ್ತದ್ಬುದ್ಧಿಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯಮತೀಂದ್ರಿಯಮ್ |
ವೇತ್ತಿ ಯತ್ರ ನ ಚೈವಾಯಂ ಸ್ಥಿತಶ್ಚಲತಿ ತತ್ತ್ವತಃ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
సుఖమాత్యంతికం యత్తద్బుద్ధిగ్రాహ్యమతీంద్రియమ్ |
వేత్తి యత్ర న చైవాయం స్థితశ్చలతి తత్త్వతః || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam
vetti yatra na chaivāyaṁ sthitaśh chalati tattvataḥ
translation_english: When one experiences that absolute Bliss, which can be intuited by the intellect and which is beyond the senses, and being thus established, this person surely does not swerve from Reality.
context_english: sukham—happiness; ātyantikam—limitless; yat—which; tat—that; buddhi—by intellect; grāhyam—grasp; atīndriyam—transcending the senses; vetti—knows; yatra—wherein; na—never; cha—and; eva—certainly; ayam—he; sthitaḥ—situated; chalati—deviates; tattvataḥ—from the Eternal Truth

text:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।

यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते।।6.22।।
text_kannada:
ಯಂ ಲಬ್ಧ್ವಾ ಚಾಪರಂ ಲಾಭಂ ಮನ್ಯತೇ ನಾಧಿಕಂ ತತಃ |
ಯಸ್ಮಿನ್ಸ್ಥಿತೋ ನ ದುಃಖೇನ ಗುರುಣಾಪಿ ವಿಚಾಲ್ಯತೇ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
యం లబ్ధ్వా చాపరం లాభం మన్యతే నాధికం తతః |
యస్మిన్స్థితో న దుఃఖేన గురుణాపి విచాల్యతే || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ
yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vichālyate
translation_english: Obtaining which one does not consider any other acquisition to be superior, and being established in which one is not perturbed even by great sorrow;
context_english: yam—which; labdhvā—having gained; cha—and; aparam—any other; lābham—gain; manyate—considers; na—not; adhikam—greater; tataḥ—than that; yasmin—in which; sthitaḥ—being situated; na—never; duḥkhena—by sorrow; guruṇā—(by) the greatest; api—even; vichālyate—is shaken

text:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।

स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा।।6.23।।
text_kannada:
ತಂ ವಿದ್ಯಾದ್ ದುಃಖಸಂಯೋಗವಿಯೋಗಂ ಯೋಗಸಂಜ್ಞಿತಮ್ |
ಸ ನಿಶ್ಚಯೇನ ಯೋಕ್ತವ್ಯೋ ಯೋಗೋಽನಿರ್ವಿಣ್ಣಚೇತಸಾ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
తం విద్యాద్ దుఃఖసంయోగవియోగం యోగసంజ్ఞితమ్ |
స నిశ్చయేన యోక్తవ్యో యోగోఽనిర్విణ్ణచేతసా || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
taṁ vidyād duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogaṁ yogasaṅjñitam
sa niśhchayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviṇṇa-chetasā
translation_english: One should know that severance of contact with sorrow to be what is called Yoga. That Yoga should be practiced with perseverance and with an undepressed heart.
context_english: tam—that; vidyāt—you should know; duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogam—state of severance from union with misery; yoga-saṁjñitam—is known as yog; saḥ—that; niśhchayena—resolutely; yoktavyaḥ—should be practiced; yogaḥ—yog; anirviṇṇa-chetasā—with an undeviating mind

text:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।

मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः।।6.24।।
text_kannada:
ಸಂಕಲ್ಪಪ್ರಭವಾನ್ಕಾಮಾಂಸ್ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಸರ್ವಾನಶೇಷತಃ |
ಮನಸೈವೇಂದ್ರಿಯಗ್ರಾಮಂ ವಿನಿಯಮ್ಯ ಸಮಂತತಃ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
సంకల్పప్రభవాన్కామాంస్త్యక్త్వా సర్వానశేషతః |
మనసైవేంద్రియగ్రామం వినియమ్య సమంతతః || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāns tyaktvā sarvān aśheṣhataḥ
manasaivendriya-grāmaṁ viniyamya samantataḥ
translation_english: By totally eschewing all desires that arise from thoughts and restraining all the organs with the mind from every side;
context_english: saṅkalpa—a resolve; prabhavān—born of; kāmān—desires; tyaktvā—having abandoned; sarvān—all; aśheṣhataḥ—completely; manasā—through the mind; eva—certainly; indriya-grāmam—the group of senses; viniyamya—restraining; samantataḥ—from all sides;

text:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।

आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्।।6.25।।
text_kannada:
ಶನೈಃ ಶನೈರುಪರಮೇದ್ ಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ ಧೃತಿಗೃಹೀತಯಾ |
ಆತ್ಮಸಂಸ್ಥಂ ಮನಃ ಕೃತ್ವಾ ನ ಕಿಂಚಿದಪಿ ಚಿಂತಯೇತ್ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
శనైః శనైరుపరమేద్ బుద్ధ్యా ధృతిగృహీతయా |
ఆత్మసంస్థం మనః కృత్వా న కించిదపి చింతయేత్ || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
śhanaiḥ śhanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛiti-gṛihītayā
ātma-sansthaṁ manaḥ kṛitvā na kiñchid api chintayet
translation_english: One should gradually withdraw with the intellect, endowed with steadiness. Making the mind fixed in the Self, one should not think of anything at all.
context_english: śhanaiḥ—gradually; śhanaiḥ—gradually; uparamet—attain peace; buddhyā—by intellect; dhṛiti-gṛihītayā—achieved through determination of resolve that is in accordance with scriptures; ātma-sanstham—fixed in God; manaḥ—mind; kṛitvā—having made; na—not; kiñchit—anything; api—even; chintayet—should think of

text:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।

ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्।।6.26।।
text_kannada:
ಯತೋ ಯತೋ ನಿಶ್ಚರತಿ ಮನಶ್ಚಂಚಲಮಸ್ಥಿರಮ್ |
ತತಸ್ತತೋ ನಿಯಮ್ಯೈತದಾತ್ಮನ್ಯೇವ ವಶಂ ನಯೇತ್ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
యతో యతో నిశ్చరతి మనశ్చంచలమస్థిరమ్ |
తతస్తతో నియమ్యైతదాత్మన్యేవ వశం నయేత్ || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet
translation_english: The yogi should bring this mind under the subjugation of the Self itself, restraining it from all those causes that cause the restless, unsteady mind to wander away.
context_english: yataḥ yataḥ—whenever and wherever; niśhcharati—wanders; manaḥ—the mind; chañchalam—restless; asthiram—unsteady; tataḥ tataḥ—from there; niyamya—having restrained; etat—this; ātmani—on God; eva—certainly; vaśham—control; nayet—should bring

text:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।

उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्।।6.27।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಶಾಂತಮನಸಂ ಹ್ಯೇನಂ ಯೋಗಿನಂ ಸುಖಮುತ್ತಮಮ್ |
ಉಪೈತಿ ಶಾಂತರಜಸಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂತಮಕಲ್ಮಷಮ್ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రశాంతమనసం హ్యేనం యోగినం సుఖముత్తమమ్ |
ఉపైతి శాంతరజసం బ్రహ్మభూతమకల్మషమ్ || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
praśhānta-manasaṁ hyenaṁ yoginaṁ sukham uttamam
upaiti śhānta-rajasaṁ brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣham
translation_english: Supreme Bliss comes to this yogi alone whose mind has become perfectly tranquil, whose quality of rajas has been eliminated, who has become identified with Brahman, and is untainted.
context_english: praśhānta—peaceful; manasam—mind; hi—certainly; enam—this; yoginam—yogi; sukham uttamam—the highest bliss; upaiti—attains; śhānta-rajasam—whose passions are subdued; brahma-bhūtam—endowed with God-realization; akalmaṣham—without sin

text:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।

सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते।।6.28।।
text_kannada:
ಯುಂಜನ್ನೇವಂ ಸದಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ಯೋಗೀ ವಿಗತಕಲ್ಮಷಃ |
ಸುಖೇನ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಸಂಸ್ಪರ್ಶಮತ್ಯಂತಂ ಸುಖಮಶ್ನುತೇ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
యుంజన్నేవం సదాఽఽత్మానం యోగీ విగతకల్మషః |
సుఖేన బ్రహ్మసంస్పర్శమత్యంతం సుఖమశ్నుతే || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī vigata-kalmaṣhaḥ
sukhena brahma-sansparśham atyantaṁ sukham aśhnute
translation_english: By constantly concentrating his mind in this way, the taintless yogi easily attains the absolute bliss of contact with Brahman.
context_english: yuñjan—uniting (the self with God); evam—thus; sadā—always; ātmānam—the self; yogī—a yogi; vigata—freed from; kalmaṣhaḥ—sins; sukhena—easily; brahma-sansparśham—constantly in touch with the Supreme; atyantam—the highest; sukham—bliss; aśhnute—attains

text:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।

ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः।।6.29।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಭೂತಸ್ಥಮಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಿ ಚಾತ್ಮನಿ |
ಈಕ್ಷತೇ ಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸಮದರ್ಶನಃ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వభూతస్థమాత్మానం సర్వభూతాని చాత్మని |
ఈక్షతే యోగయుక్తాత్మా సర్వత్ర సమదర్శనః || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṁ sarva-bhūtāni chātmani
īkṣhate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśhanaḥ
translation_english: One who has their mind Self-absorbed through Yoga, and who has the vision of sameness everywhere, sees this Self existing in everything, and everything in their Self.
context_english: sarva-bhūta-stham—situated in all living beings; ātmānam—Supreme Soul; sarva—all; bhūtāni—living beings; cha—and; ātmani—in God; īkṣhate—sees; yoga-yukta-ātmā—one united in consciousness with God; sarvatra—everywhere; sama-darśhanaḥ—equal vision

text:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।

तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति।।6.30।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋ ಮಾಂ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸರ್ವಂ ಚ ಮಯಿ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ |
ತಸ್ಯಾಹಂ ನ ಪ್ರಣಶ್ಯಾಮಿ ಸ ಚ ಮೇ ನ ಪ್ರಣಶ್ಯತಿ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
యో మాం పశ్యతి సర్వత్ర సర్వం చ మయి పశ్యతి |
తస్యాహం న ప్రణశ్యామి స చ మే న ప్రణశ్యతి || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati
tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśhyāmi sa cha me na praṇaśhyati
translation_english: One who sees Me in everything and sees all things in Me—I do not lose sight of him, and he also is not lost to My vision.
context_english: yaḥ—who; mām—me; paśhyati—see; sarvatra—everywhere; sarvam—everything; cha—and; mayi—in me; paśhyati—see; tasya—for him; aham—I; na—not; praṇaśhyāmi—lost; saḥ—that person; cha—and; me—to me; na—nor; praṇaśhyati—lost

text:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।

सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते।।6.31।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಭೂತಸ್ಥಿತಂ ಯೋ ಮಾಂ ಭಜತ್ಯೇಕತ್ವಮಾಸ್ಥಿತಃ |
ಸರ್ವಥಾ ವರ್ತಮಾನೋಽಪಿ ಸ ಯೋಗೀ ಮಯಿ ವರ್ತತೇ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వభూతస్థితం యో మాం భజత్యేకత్వమాస్థితః |
సర్వథా వర్తమానోఽపి స యోగీ మయి వర్తతే || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
sarva-bhūta-sthitaṁ yo māṁ bhajatyekatvam āsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi sa yogī mayi vartate
translation_english: That yogi, who, being established in unity, adores Me as existing in all things, exists in Me—in whatever condition he may be.
context_english: sarva-bhūta-sthitam—situated in all beings; yaḥ—who; mām—me; bhajati—worships; ekatvam—in unity; āsthitaḥ—established; sarvathā—in all kinds of; varta-mānaḥ—remain; api—although; saḥ—he; yogī—a yogi; mayi—in me; vartate—dwells

text:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।

सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः।।6.32।।
text_kannada:
ಆತ್ಮೌಪಮ್ಯೇನ ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸಮಂ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ಯೋಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಸುಖಂ ವಾ ಯದಿ ವಾ ದುಃಖಂ ಸಃ ಯೋಗೀ ಪರಮೋ ಮತಃ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఆత్మౌపమ్యేన సర్వత్ర సమం పశ్యతి యోఽర్జున |
సుఖం వా యది వా దుఃఖం సః యోగీ పరమో మతః || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṁ paśhyati yo ’rjuna
sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
translation_english: O Arjuna, that yogi is considered the best who judges what is happiness and sorrow in all beings by the same standard as they would apply to themselves.
context_english: ātma-aupamyena—similar to oneself; sarvatra—everywhere; samam—equally; paśhyati—see; yaḥ—who; arjuna—Arjun; sukham—joy; vā—or; yadi—if; vā—or; duḥkham—sorrow; saḥ—such; yogī—a yogi; paramaḥ—highest; mataḥ—is considered

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।

एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्।।6.33।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಯೋಽಯಂ ಯೋಗಸ್ತ್ವಯಾ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಃ ಸಾಮ್ಯೇನ ಮಧುಸೂದನ |
ಏತಸ್ಯಾಹಂ ನ ಪಶ್ಯಾಮಿ ಚಂಚಲತ್ವಾತ್ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಂ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಮ್ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
యోఽయం యోగస్త్వయా ప్రోక్తః సామ్యేన మధుసూదన |
ఏతస్యాహం న పశ్యామి చంచలత్వాత్ స్థితిం స్థిరామ్ || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
yo ’yaṁ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṁ na paśhyāmi chañchalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām
translation_english: Arjuna said, "O Madhusudana (Krsna), this Yoga that You have spoken of as sameness, I do not see its steady continuance due to the restlessness of the mind."
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; yaḥ—which; ayam—this; yogaḥ—system of Yog; tvayā—by you; proktaḥ—described; sāmyena—by equanimity; madhu-sūdana—Shree Krishna, the killer of the demon named Madhu; etasya—of this; aham—I; na—do not; paśhyāmi—see; chañchalatvāt—due to restlessness; sthitim—situation; sthirām—steady

text:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।

तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्।।6.34।।
text_kannada:
ಚಂಚಲಂ ಹಿ ಮನಃ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಪ್ರಮಾಥಿ ಬಲವದ್ದೃಢಮ್ |
ತಸ್ಯಾಹಂ ನಿಗ್ರಹಂ ಮನ್ಯೇ ವಾಯೋರಿವ ಸುದುಷ್ಕರಮ್ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
చంచలం హి మనః కృష్ణ ప్రమాథి బలవద్దృఢమ్ |
తస్యాహం నిగ్రహం మన్యే వాయోరివ సుదుష్కరమ్ || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham
tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣhkaram
translation_english: For, O Kṛṣṇa, the mind is unsteady, turbulent, strong, and obstinate; I consider its control to be as difficult as that of the wind.
context_english: chañchalam—restless; hi—certainly; manaḥ—mind; kṛiṣhṇa—Shree Krishna; pramāthi—turbulent; bala-vat—strong; dṛiḍham—obstinate; tasya—its; aham—I; nigraham—control; manye—think; vāyoḥ—of the wind; iva—like; su-duṣhkaram—difficult to perform

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं।

अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।।6.35।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಅಸಂಶಯಂ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಮನೋ ದುರ್ನಿಗ್ರಹಂ ಚಲಂ |
ಅಭ್ಯಾಸೇನ ತು ಕೌಂತೇಯ ವೈರಾಗ್ಯೇಣ ಚ ಗೃಹ್ಯತೇ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
అసంశయం మహాబాహో మనో దుర్నిగ్రహం చలం |
అభ్యాసేన తు కౌంతేయ వైరాగ్యేణ చ గృహ్యతే || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, O mighty-armed one, undoubtedly the mind is untamable and restless. But, O son of Kunti, it can be brought under control through practice and detachment.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—Lord Krishna said; asanśhayam—undoubtedly; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; manaḥ—the mind; durnigraham—difficult to restrain; chalam—restless; abhyāsena—by practice; tu—but; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; vairāgyeṇa—by detachment; cha—and; gṛihyate—can be controlled

text:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।

वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः।।6.36।।
text_kannada:
ಅಸಂಯತಾತ್ಮನಾ ಯೋಗೋ ದುಷ್ಪ್ರಾಪ ಇತಿ ಮೇ ಮತಿಃ |
ವಶ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾ ತು ಯತತಾ ಶಕ್ಯೋಽವಾಪ್ತುಮುಪಾಯತಃ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
అసంయతాత్మనా యోగో దుష్ప్రాప ఇతి మే మతిః |
వశ్యాత్మనా తు యతతా శక్యోఽవాప్తుముపాయతః || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo ’vāptum upāyataḥ
translation_english: My conviction is that Yoga is difficult to attain for one with an uncontrolled mind. But it is possible to attain through the aforementioned means for one who strives and has a controlled mind.
context_english: asanyata-ātmanā—one whose mind is unbridled; yogaḥ—Yog; duṣhprāpaḥ—difficult to attain; iti—thus; me—my; matiḥ—opinion; vaśhya-ātmanā—by one whose mind is controlled; tu—but; yatatā—one who strives; śhakyaḥ—possible; avāptum—to achieve; upāyataḥ—by right means

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।

अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति।।6.37।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಅಯತಿಃ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯೋಪೇತೋ ಯೋಗಾಚ್ಚಲಿತಮಾನಸಃ |
ಅಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಯೋಗಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಕಾಂ ಗತಿಂ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
అయతిః శ్రద్ధయోపేతో యోగాచ్చలితమానసః |
అప్రాప్య యోగసంసిద్ధిం కాం గతిం కృష్ణ గచ్ఛతి || ౩౭ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
ayatiḥ śhraddhayopeto yogāch chalita-mānasaḥ
aprāpya yoga-sansiddhiṁ kāṅ gatiṁ kṛiṣhṇa gachchhati
translation_english: Arjuna said, "O Krsna, what goal does one attain who, despite having faith, fails to achieve perfection in Yoga due to lack of diligence, and whose mind becomes deflected from Yoga?"
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; ayatiḥ—lax; śhraddhayā—with faith; upetaḥ—possessed; yogāt—from Yog; chalita-mānasaḥ—whose mind becomes deviated; aprāpya—failing to attain; yoga-sansiddhim—the highest perfection in yog; kām—which; gatim—destination; kṛiṣhṇa—Shree Krishna; gachchhati—goes

text:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।

अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि।।6.38।।
text_kannada:
ಕಚ್ಚಿನ್ನೋಭಯವಿಭ್ರಷ್ಟಶ್ಛಿನ್ನಾಭ್ರಮಿವ ನಶ್ಯತಿ |
ಅಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೋ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ವಿಮೂಢೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಃ ಪಥಿ || ೩೮ ||
text_telugu:
కచ్చిన్నోభయవిభ్రష్టశ్ఛిన్నాభ్రమివ నశ్యతి |
అప్రతిష్ఠో మహాబాహో విమూఢో బ్రహ్మణః పథి || ౩౮ ||
transliteration:
kachchin nobhaya-vibhraṣhṭaśh chhinnābhram iva naśhyati
apratiṣhṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
translation_english: O Mighty-armed one, having fallen from both [paths], without support, deluded on the path to Brahman, does he not get ruined like a scattered cloud?
context_english: kachchit—whether; na—not; ubhaya—both; vibhraṣhṭaḥ—deviated from; chhinna—broken; abhram—cloud; iva—like; naśhyati—perishes; apratiṣhṭhaḥ—without any support; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed Krishna; vimūḍhaḥ—bewildered; brahmaṇaḥ—of God-realization; pathi—one on the path

text:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।

त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते।।6.39।।
text_kannada:
ಏತನ್ಮೇ ಸಂಶಯಂ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಛೇತ್ತುಮರ್ಹಸ್ಯಶೇಷತಃ |
ತ್ವದನ್ಯಃ ಸಂಶಯಸ್ಯಾಸ್ಯ ಛೇತ್ತಾ ನ ಹ್ಯುಪಪದ್ಯತೇ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఏతన్మే సంశయం కృష్ణ ఛేత్తుమర్హస్యశేషతః |
త్వదన్యః సంశయస్యాస్య ఛేత్తా న హ్యుపపద్యతే || ౩౯ ||
transliteration:
etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ
tvad-anyaḥ sanśhayasyāsya chhettā na hyupapadyate
translation_english: O Krsna, you should totally eradicate this doubt of mine, for none other than yourself can be the dispeller of this doubt!
context_english: etat—this; me—my; sanśhayam—doubt; kṛiṣhṇa—Krishna; chhettum—to dispel; arhasi—you can; aśheṣhataḥ—completely; tvat—than you; anyaḥ—other; sanśhayasya—of doubt; asya—this; chhettā—a dispeller; na—never; hi—certainly; upapadyate—is fit

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।

नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्िचद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति।।6.40।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಪಾರ್ಥ ನೈವೇಹ ನಾಮುತ್ರ ವಿನಾಶಸ್ತಸ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯತೇ |
ನಹಿ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣಕೃತ್ಕಶ್ಿಚದ್ದುರ್ಗತಿಂ ತಾತ ಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
పార్థ నైవేహ నాముత్ర వినాశస్తస్య విద్యతే |
నహి కల్యాణకృత్కశ్ిచద్దుర్గతిం తాత గచ్ఛతి || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśhas tasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇa-kṛit kaśhchid durgatiṁ tāta gachchhati
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "O Partha, there is certainly no ruin for him here or hereafter, for no one engaged in good meets with a deplorable end, my son!"
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; na eva—never; iha—in this world; na—never; amutra—in the next world; vināśhaḥ—destruction; tasya—his; vidyate—exists; na—never; hi—certainly; kalyāṇa-kṛit—one who strives for God-realization; kaśhchit—anyone; durgatim—evil destination; tāta—my friend; gachchhati—goes

text:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।

शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते।।6.41।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಪುಣ್ಯಕೃತಾಂ ಲೋಕಾನುಷಿತ್ವಾ ಶಾಶ್ವತೀಃ ಸಮಾಃ |
ಶುಚೀನಾಂ ಶ್ರೀಮತಾಂ ಗೇಹೇ ಯೋಗಭ್ರಷ್ಟೋಽಭಿಜಾಯತೇ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రాప్య పుణ్యకృతాం లోకానుషిత్వా శాశ్వతీః సమాః |
శుచీనాం శ్రీమతాం గేహే యోగభ్రష్టోఽభిజాయతే || ౪౧ ||
transliteration:
prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ
śhuchīnāṁ śhrīmatāṁ gehe yoga-bhraṣhṭo’bhijāyate
translation_english: Attaining the worlds of the righteous and residing there for eternal years, the man who has fallen from Yoga is born in the house of the pious and prosperous.
context_english: prāpya—attain; puṇya-kṛitām—of the virtuous; lokān—abodes; uṣhitvā—after dwelling; śhāśhvatīḥ—many; samāḥ—ages; śhuchīnām—of the pious; śhrī-matām—of the prosperous; gehe—in the house; yoga-bhraṣhṭaḥ—the unsuccessful yogis; abhijāyate—take birth;

text:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।

एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्।।6.42।।
text_kannada:
ಅಥವಾ ಯೋಗಿನಾಮೇವ ಕುಲೇ ಭವತಿ ಧೀಮತಾಮ್ |
ಏತದ್ಧಿ ದುರ್ಲಭತರಂ ಲೋಕೇ ಜನ್ಮ ಯದೀದೃಶಮ್ || ೪೨ ||
text_telugu:
అథవా యోగినామేవ కులే భవతి ధీమతామ్ |
ఏతద్ధి దుర్లభతరం లోకే జన్మ యదీదృశమ్ || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etad dhi durlabhataraṁ loke janma yad īdṛiśham
translation_english: Or, he is born in the family of wise yogis. Such a birth is indeed more difficult to come by in the world.
context_english: atha vā—else; yoginām—of those endowed with divine wisdom; eva—certainly; kule—in the family; bhavati—take birth; dhī-matām—of the wise; etat—this; hi—certainly; durlabha-taram—very rare; loke—in this world; janma—birth; yat—which; īdṛiśham—like this

text:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।

यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन।।6.43।।
text_kannada:
ತತ್ರ ತಂ ಬುದ್ಧಿಸಂಯೋಗಂ ಲಭತೇ ಪೌರ್ವದೇಹಿಕಮ್ |
ಯತತೇ ಚ ತತೋ ಭೂಯಃ ಸಂಸಿದ್ಧೌ ಕುರುನಂದನ || ೪೩ ||
text_telugu:
తత్ర తం బుద్ధిసంయోగం లభతే పౌర్వదేహికమ్ |
యతతే చ తతో భూయః సంసిద్ధౌ కురునందన || ౪౩ ||
transliteration:
tatra taṁ buddhi-sanyogaṁ labhate paurva-dehikam
yatate cha tato bhūyaḥ sansiddhau kuru-nandana
translation_english: There he becomes endowed with the wisdom acquired in the previous body, and he strives even more than before for perfection, O scion of the Kuru dynasty.
context_english: tatra—there; tam—that; buddhi-sanyogam—reawaken their wisdom; labhate—obtains; paurva-dehikam—from the previous lives; yatate—strives; cha—and; tataḥ—thereafter; bhūyaḥ—again; sansiddhau—for perfection; kuru-nandana—Arjun, descendant of the Kurus

text:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।

जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते।।6.44।।
text_kannada:
ಪೂರ್ವಾಭ್ಯಾಸೇನ ತೇನೈವ ಹ್ರಿಯತೇ ಹ್ಯವಶೋಽಪಿ ಸಃ |
ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸುರಪಿ ಯೋಗಸ್ಯ ಶಬ್ದಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾತಿವರ್ತತೇ || ೪೪ ||
text_telugu:
పూర్వాభ్యాసేన తేనైవ హ్రియతే హ్యవశోఽపి సః |
జిజ్ఞాసురపి యోగస్య శబ్దబ్రహ్మాతివర్తతే || ౪౪ ||
transliteration:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśho ’pi saḥ
jijñāsur api yogasya śhabda-brahmātivartate
translation_english: For, by that very past practice, he is carried forward even in spite of himself! Even a seeker of Yoga transcends the results of the performance of Vedic rituals!
context_english: pūrva—past; abhyāsena—discipline; tena—by that; eva—certainly; hriyate—is attracted; hi—surely; avaśhaḥ—helplessly; api—although; saḥ—that person; jijñāsuḥ—inquisitive; api—even; yogasya—about yog; śhabda-brahma—fruitive portion of the Vedas; ativartate—transcends

text:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।

अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।6.45।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಾದ್ಯತಮಾನಸ್ತು ಯೋಗೀ ಸಂಶುದ್ಧಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷಃ |
ಅನೇಕಜನ್ಮಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಸ್ತತೋ ಯಾತಿ ಪರಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೪೫ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రయత్నాద్యతమానస్తు యోగీ సంశుద్ధకిల్బిషః |
అనేకజన్మసంసిద్ధస్తతో యాతి పరాం గతిమ్ || ౪౫ ||
transliteration:
prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī sanśhuddha-kilbiṣhaḥ
aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
translation_english: However, the yogi, applying himself assiduously, becoming purified from sin and attaining perfection through many births, they achieve the highest Goal.
context_english: prayatnāt—with great effort; yatamānaḥ—endeavoring; tu—and; yogī—a yogi; sanśhuddha—purified; kilbiṣhaḥ—from material desires; aneka—after many, many; janma—births; sansiddhaḥ—attain perfection; tataḥ—then; yāti—attains; parām—the highest; gatim—path

text:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।

कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन।।6.46।।
text_kannada:
ತಪಸ್ವಿಭ್ಯೋಽಧಿಕೋ ಯೋಗೀ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಭ್ಯೋಽಪಿ ಮತೋಽಧಿಕಃ |
ಕರ್ಮಿಭ್ಯಶ್ಚಾಧಿಕೋ ಯೋಗೀ ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ಯೋಗೀ ಭವಾರ್ಜುನ || ೪೬ ||
text_telugu:
తపస్విభ్యోఽధికో యోగీ జ్ఞానిభ్యోఽపి మతోఽధికః |
కర్మిభ్యశ్చాధికో యోగీ తస్మాద్యోగీ భవార్జున || ౪౬ ||
transliteration:
tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogī
jñānibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaḥ
karmibhyaśh chādhiko yogī
tasmād yogī bhavārjuna
translation_english: A yogi is higher than those of austerity; they are considered higher even than those of knowledge. The yogi is also higher than those of action. Therefore, O Arjuna, become a yogi.
context_english: tapasvibhyaḥ—than the ascetics; adhikaḥ—superior; yogī—a yogi; jñānibhyaḥ—than the persons of learning; api—even; mataḥ—considered; adhikaḥ—superior; karmibhyaḥ—than the ritualistic performers; cha—and; adhikaḥ—superior; yogī—a yogi; tasmāt—therefore; yogī—a yogi; bhava—just become; arjuna—Arjun

text:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।

श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः।।6.47।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಗಿನಾಮಪಿ ಸರ್ವೇಷಾಂ ಮದ್ಗತೇನಾಂತರಾತ್ಮನಾ |
ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಾನ್ಭಜತೇ ಯೋ ಮಾಂ ಸ ಮೇ ಯುಕ್ತತಮೋ ಮತಃ || ೪೭ ||
text_telugu:
యోగినామపి సర్వేషాం మద్గతేనాంతరాత్మనా |
శ్రద్ధావాన్భజతే యో మాం స మే యుక్తతమో మతః || ౪౭ ||
transliteration:
yoginām api sarveṣhāṁ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā
śhraddhāvān bhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
translation_english: Even among all the yogis, he who adores Me with his mind fixed on Me and with faith is considered by Me to be the best of the yogis.
context_english: yoginām—of all yogis; api—however; sarveṣhām—all types of; mat-gatena—absorbed in me (God); antaḥ—inner; ātmanā—with the mind; śhraddhā-vān—with great faith; bhajate—engage in devotion; yaḥ—who; mām—to me; saḥ—he; me—by me; yukta-tamaḥ—the highest yogi; mataḥ—is considered

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।

असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु।।7.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಮಯ್ಯಾಸಕ್ತಮನಾಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಯೋಗಂ ಯುಂಜನ್ಮದಾಶ್ರಯಃ |
ಅಸಂಶಯಂ ಸಮಗ್ರಂ ಮಾಂ ಯಥಾ ಜ್ಞಾಸ್ಯಸಿ ತಚ್ಛೃಣು || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
మయ్యాసక్తమనాః పార్థ యోగం యుంజన్మదాశ్రయః |
అసంశయం సమగ్రం మాం యథా జ్ఞాస్యసి తచ్ఛృణు || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
mayyāsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṁ yuñjan mad-āśhrayaḥ
asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "O Partha, hear how, with your mind fixed on Me, practicing the Yoga of Meditation and taking refuge in Me, you will certainly and fully know Me.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; mayi—to me; āsakta-manāḥ—with the mind attached; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; yogam—bhakti yog; yuñjan—practicing; mat-āśhrayaḥ—surrendering to me; asanśhayam—free from doubt; samagram—completely; mām—me; yathā—how; jñāsyasi—you shall know; tat—that; śhṛiṇu—listen

text:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।

यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।7.2।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ತೇಽಹಂ ಸವಿಜ್ಞಾನಮಿದಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮ್ಯಶೇಷತಃ |
ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ನೇಹ ಭೂಯೋಽನ್ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತವ್ಯಮವಶಿಷ್ಯತೇ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞానం తేఽహం సవిజ్ఞానమిదం వక్ష్యామ్యశేషతః |
యజ్జ్ఞాత్వా నేహ భూయోఽన్యజ్జ్ఞాతవ్యమవశిష్యతే || ౨ ||
transliteration:
jñānaṁ te ’haṁ sa-vijñānam idaṁ vakṣhyāmyaśheṣhataḥ
yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo ’nyaj jñātavyam-avaśhiṣhyate
translation_english: I shall tell you in detail of this Knowledge, which is combined with realization, after experiencing which there remains nothing else here to be known.
context_english: jñānam—knowledge; te—unto you; aham—I; sa—with; vijñānam—wisdom; idam—this; vakṣhyāmi—shall reveal; aśheṣhataḥ—in full; yat—which; jñātvā—having known; na—not; iha—in this world; bhūyaḥ—further; anyat—anything else; jñātavyam—to be known; avaśhiṣhyate—remains

text:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्िचद्यतति सिद्धये।

यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्िचन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।।7.3।।
text_kannada:
ಮನುಷ್ಯಾಣಾಂ ಸಹಸ್ರೇಷು ಕಶ್ಿಚದ್ಯತತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಯೇ |
ಯತತಾಮಪಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾನಾಂ ಕಶ್ಿಚನ್ಮಾಂ ವೇತ್ತಿ ತತ್ತ್ವತಃ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
మనుష్యాణాం సహస్రేషు కశ్ిచద్యతతి సిద్ధయే |
యతతామపి సిద్ధానాం కశ్ిచన్మాం వేత్తి తత్త్వతః || ౩ ||
transliteration:
manuṣhyāṇāṁ sahasreṣhu kaśhchid yatati siddhaye
yatatām api siddhānāṁ kaśhchin māṁ vetti tattvataḥ
translation_english: Among thousands of men, a rare one endeavors for perfection. Even among the perfected ones who are diligent, one perchance knows Me in truth.
context_english: manuṣhyāṇām—of men; sahasreṣhu—out of many thousands; kaśhchit—someone; yatati—strives; siddhaye—for perfection; yatatām—of those who strive; api—even; siddhānām—of those who have achieved perfection; kaśhchit—someone; mām—me; vetti—knows; tattvataḥ—in truth

text:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।

अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा।।7.4।।
text_kannada:
ಭೂಮಿರಾಪೋಽನಲೋ ವಾಯುಃ ಖಂ ಮನೋ ಬುದ್ಧಿರೇವ ಚ |
ಅಹಂಕಾರ ಇತೀಯಂ ಮೇ ಭಿನ್ನಾ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿರಷ್ಟಧಾ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
భూమిరాపోఽనలో వాయుః ఖం మనో బుద్ధిరేవ చ |
అహంకార ఇతీయం మే భిన్నా ప్రకృతిరష్టధా || ౪ ||
transliteration:
bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha
ahankāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛitir aṣhṭadhā
translation_english: This Prakrti of Mine is divided eightfold thus: earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect, and egoism.
context_english: bhūmiḥ—earth; āpaḥ—water; analaḥ—fire; vāyuḥ—air; kham—space; manaḥ—mind; buddhiḥ—intellect; eva—certainly; cha—and; ahankāraḥ—ego; iti—thus; iyam—all these; me—my; bhinnā—divisions; prakṛitiḥ—material energy; aṣhṭadhā—eightfold

text:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।

जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्।।7.5।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪರೇಯಮಿತಸ್ತ್ವನ್ಯಾಂ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಮೇ ಪರಾಮ್ |
ಜೀವಭೂತಾಂ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಯಯೇದಂ ಧಾರ್ಯತೇ ಜಗತ್ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
అపరేయమితస్త్వన్యాం ప్రకృతిం విద్ధి మే పరామ్ |
జీవభూతాం మహాబాహో యయేదం ధార్యతే జగత్ || ౫ ||
transliteration:
apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām
jīva-bhūtāṁ mahā-bāho yayedaṁ dhāryate jagat
translation_english: O mighty-armed one, this is the inferior Prakrti. Know the other Prakrti of Mine, which is however higher than this, which has taken the form of individual souls, and by which this world is upheld.
context_english: aparā—inferior; iyam—this; itaḥ—besides this; tu—but; anyām—another; prakṛitim—energy; viddhi—know; me—my; parām—superior; jīva-bhūtām—living beings; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; yayā—by whom; idam—this; dhāryate—the basis; jagat—the material world

text:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।

अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा।।7.6।।
text_kannada:
ಏತದ್ಯೋನೀನಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಸರ್ವಾಣೀತ್ಯುಪಧಾರಯ |
ಅಹಂ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಸ್ಯ ಜಗತಃ ಪ್ರಭವಃ ಪ್ರಲಯಸ್ತಥಾ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
ఏతద్యోనీని భూతాని సర్వాణీత్యుపధారయ |
అహం కృత్స్నస్య జగతః ప్రభవః ప్రలయస్తథా || ౬ ||
transliteration:
etad-yonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṁ kṛitsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā
translation_english: Understand thus that all things—sentient and insentient—have these as their source. I am the origin as well as the end of the entire universe.
context_english: etat yonīni—these two (energies) are the source of; bhūtāni—living beings; sarvāṇi—all; iti—that; upadhāraya—know; aham—I; kṛitsnasya—entire; jagataḥ—creation; prabhavaḥ—the source; pralayaḥ—dissolution; tathā—and

text:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।

मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।।7.7।।
text_kannada:
ಮತ್ತಃ ಪರತರಂ ನಾನ್ಯತ್ಕಿಂಚಿದಸ್ತಿ ಧನಂಜಯ |
ಮಯಿ ಸರ್ವಮಿದಂ ಪ್ರೋತಂ ಸೂತ್ರೇ ಮಣಿಗಣಾ ಇವ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
మత్తః పరతరం నాన్యత్కించిదస్తి ధనంజయ |
మయి సర్వమిదం ప్రోతం సూత్రే మణిగణా ఇవ || ౭ ||
transliteration:
mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva
translation_english: O Dhananjaya, there is nothing else higher than Myself. All this is strung on Me like pearls on a string.
context_english: mattaḥ—than me; para-taram—superior; na—not; anyat kiñchit—anything else; asti—there is; dhanañjaya—Arjun, conqueror of wealth; mayi—in me; sarvam—all; idam—which we see; protam—is strung; sūtre—on a thread; maṇi-gaṇāḥ—beads; iva—like

text:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।

प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु।।7.8।।
text_kannada:
ರಸೋಽಹಮಪ್ಸು ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಪ್ರಭಾಸ್ಮಿ ಶಶಿಸೂರ್ಯಯೋಃ |
ಪ್ರಣವಃ ಸರ್ವವೇದೇಷು ಶಬ್ದಃ ಖೇ ಪೌರುಷಂ ನೃಷು || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
రసోఽహమప్సు కౌంతేయ ప్రభాస్మి శశిసూర్యయోః |
ప్రణవః సర్వవేదేషు శబ్దః ఖే పౌరుషం నృషు || ౮ ||
transliteration:
raso ’ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śhaśhi-sūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣhu śhabdaḥ khe pauruṣhaṁ nṛiṣhu
translation_english: O son of Kunti, I am the taste of water, I am the effulgence of the moon and the sun; the letter 'Om' in all the Vedas, the sound in space, and manhood in men.
context_english: rasaḥ—taste; aham—I; apsu—in water; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; prabhā—the radiance; asmi—I am; śhaśhi-sūryayoḥ—of the moon and the sun; praṇavaḥ—the sacred syllable Om; sarva—in all; vedeṣhu—Vedas; śhabdaḥ—sound; khe—in ether; pauruṣham—ability; nṛiṣhu—in humans

text:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।

जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु।।7.9।।
text_kannada:
ಪುಣ್ಯೋ ಗಂಧಃ ಪೃಥಿವ್ಯಾಂ ಚ ತೇಜಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ವಿಭಾವಸೌ |
ಜೀವನಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತೇಷು ತಪಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ತಪಸ್ವಿಷು || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
పుణ్యో గంధః పృథివ్యాం చ తేజశ్చాస్మి విభావసౌ |
జీవనం సర్వభూతేషు తపశ్చాస్మి తపస్విషు || ౯ ||
transliteration:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu tapaśh chāsmi tapasviṣhu
translation_english: I am also the sweet fragrance in the earth; I am the brilliance in the fire, and the life in all beings; and I am the austerity of the ascetics.
context_english: puṇyaḥ—pure; gandhaḥ—fragrance; pṛithivyām—of the earth; cha—and; tejaḥ—brilliance; cha—and; asmi—I am; vibhāvasau—in the fire; jīvanam—the life-force; sarva—in all; bhūteṣhu—beings; tapaḥ—penance; cha—and; asmi—I am; tapasviṣhu—of the ascetics

text:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।

बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।।7.10।।
text_kannada:
ಬೀಜಂ ಮಾಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸನಾತನಮ್ |
ಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ತೇಜಸ್ತೇಜಸ್ವಿನಾಮಹಮ್ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
బీజం మాం సర్వభూతానాం విద్ధి పార్థ సనాతనమ్ |
బుద్ధిర్బుద్ధిమతామస్మి తేజస్తేజస్వినామహమ్ || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
translation_english: O Partha, know Me to be the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intellect of the intelligent, and I am the courage of the courageous.
context_english: bījam—the seed; mām—me; sarva-bhūtānām—of all beings; viddhi—know; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; sanātanam—the eternal; buddhiḥ—intellect; buddhi-matām—of the intelligent; asmi—(I) am; tejaḥ—splendor; tejasvinām—of the splendid; aham—I

text:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।

धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ।।7.11।।
text_kannada:
ಬಲಂ ಬಲವತಾಂ ಚಾಹಂ ಕಾಮರಾಗವಿವರ್ಜಿತಮ್ |
ಧರ್ಮಾವಿರುದ್ಧೋ ಭೂತೇಷು ಕಾಮೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
బలం బలవతాం చాహం కామరాగవివర్జితమ్ |
ధర్మావిరుద్ధో భూతేషు కామోఽస్మి భరతర్షభ || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
balaṁ balavatāṁ chāhaṁ kāma-rāga-vivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣhu kāmo ’smi bharatarṣhabha
translation_english: And of the strong, I am the strength that is devoid of passion and attachment. Among creatures, I am desire that is not contrary to righteousness, O scion of the Bharata dynasty.
context_english: balam—strength; bala-vatām—of the strong; cha—and; aham—I; kāma—desire; rāga—passion; vivarjitam—devoid of; dharma-aviruddhaḥ—not conflicting with dharma; bhūteṣhu—in all beings; kāmaḥ—sexual activity; asmi—(I) am; bharata-ṛiṣhabha—Arjun, the best of the Bharats

text:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।

मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि।।7.12।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇ ಚೈವ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಾ ಭಾವಾ ರಾಜಸಾಸ್ತಾಮಸಾಶ್ಚ ಯೇ |
ಮತ್ತ ಏವೇತಿ ತಾನ್ವಿದ್ಧಿ ನತ್ವಹಂ ತೇಷು ತೇ ಮಯಿ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
యే చైవ సాత్త్వికా భావా రాజసాస్తామసాశ్చ యే |
మత్త ఏవేతి తాన్విద్ధి నత్వహం తేషు తే మయి || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣhu te mayi
translation_english: Those things that are made of the quality of sattva, and those things that are made of the quality of rajas and tamas, know them to have sprung from Me alone. However, I am not in them; they are within Me!
context_english: ye—whatever; cha—and; eva—certainly; sāttvikāḥ—in the mode of goodness; bhāvāḥ—states of material existence; rājasāḥ—in the mode of passion; tāmasāḥ—in the mode of ignorance; cha—and; ye—whatever; mattaḥ—from me; eva—certainly; iti—thus; tān—those; viddhi—know; na—not; tu—but; aham—I; teṣhu—in them; te—they; mayi—in me

text:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।

मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्।।7.13।।
text_kannada:
ತ್ರಿಭಿರ್ಗುಣಮಯೈರ್ಭಾವೈರೇಭಿಃ ಸರ್ವಮಿದಂ ಜಗತ್ |
ಮೋಹಿತಂ ನಾಭಿಜಾನಾತಿ ಮಾಮೇಭ್ಯಃ ಪರಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
త్రిభిర్గుణమయైర్భావైరేభిః సర్వమిదం జగత్ |
మోహితం నాభిజానాతి మామేభ్యః పరమవ్యయమ్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat
mohitaṁ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ param avyayam
translation_english: All this world, deluded as it is by these three qualities made of the gunas, does not know Me, who am transcendental to these and undecaying.
context_english: tribhiḥ—by three; guṇa-mayaiḥ—consisting of the modes of material nature; bhāvaiḥ—states; ebhiḥ—all these; sarvam—whole; idam—this; jagat—universe; mohitam—deluded; na—not; abhijānāti—know; mām—me; ebhyaḥ—these; param—the supreme; avyayam—imperishable

text:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।

मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते।।7.14।।
text_kannada:
ದೈವೀ ಹ್ಯೇಷಾ ಗುಣಮಯೀ ಮಮ ಮಾಯಾ ದುರತ್ಯಯಾ |
ಮಾಮೇವ ಯೇ ಪ್ರಪದ್ಯಂತೇ ಮಾಯಾಮೇತಾಂ ತರಂತಿ ತೇ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
దైవీ హ్యేషా గుణమయీ మమ మాయా దురత్యయా |
మామేవ యే ప్రపద్యంతే మాయామేతాం తరంతి తే || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te
translation_english: Since this divine Maya of Mine, which is constituted by the gunas, is difficult to cross over, those who take refuge in Me alone can transcend this Maya.
context_english: daivī—divine; hi—certainly; eṣhā—this; guṇa-mayī—consisting of the three modes of nature; mama—my; māyā—one of God’s energies. It that veils God’s true nature from souls who have not yet attained the eligibility for God-realization; duratyayā—very difficult to overcome; mām—unto me; eva—certainly; ye—who; prapadyante—surrender; māyām etām—this Maya; taranti—cross over; te—they

text:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।

माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः।।7.15।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಮಾಂ ದುಷ್ಕೃತಿನೋ ಮೂಢಾಃ ಪ್ರಪದ್ಯಂತೇ ನರಾಧಮಾಃ |
ಮಾಯಯಾಪಹೃತಜ್ಞಾನಾ ಆಸುರಂ ಭಾವಮಾಶ್ರಿತಾಃ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
న మాం దుష్కృతినో మూఢాః ప్రపద్యంతే నరాధమాః |
మాయయాపహృతజ్ఞానా ఆసురం భావమాశ్రితాః || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛita-jñānā āsuraṁ bhāvam āśhritāḥ
translation_english: The foolish evildoers, who are the most depraved among men, who are deprived of their wisdom by Maya, and who resort to demonic ways, do not take refuge in Me.
context_english: na—not; mām—unto me; duṣhkṛitinaḥ—the evil doers; mūḍhāḥ—the ignorant; prapadyante—surrender; nara-adhamāḥ—one who lazily follows one’s lower nature; māyayā—by God’s material energy; apahṛita jñānāḥ—those with deluded intellect; āsuram—demoniac; bhāvam—nature; āśhritāḥ—surrender

text:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।

आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ।।7.16।।
text_kannada:
ಚತುರ್ವಿಧಾ ಭಜಂತೇ ಮಾಂ ಜನಾಃ ಸುಕೃತಿನೋಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಆರ್ತೋ ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸುರರ್ಥಾರ್ಥೀ ಜ್ಞಾನೀ ಚ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
చతుర్విధా భజంతే మాం జనాః సుకృతినోఽర్జున |
ఆర్తో జిజ్ఞాసురర్థార్థీ జ్ఞానీ చ భరతర్షభ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
chatur-vidhā bhajante māṁ janāḥ sukṛitino ’rjuna
ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha
translation_english: O Arjuna, foremost of the Bharata dynasty, four classes of people of virtuous deeds adore Me: the afflicted, the seekers of Knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the man of Knowledge.
context_english: chatuḥ-vidhāḥ—four kinds; bhajante—worship; mām—me; janāḥ—people; su-kṛitinaḥ—those who are pious; arjuna—Arjun; ārtaḥ—the distressed; jijñāsuḥ—the seekers of knowledge; artha-arthī—the seekers of material gain; jñānī—those who are situated in knowledge; cha—and; bharata-ṛiṣhabha—The best amongst the Bharatas, Arjun

text:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते।

प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः।।7.17।।
text_kannada:
ತೇಷಾಂ ಜ್ಞಾನೀ ನಿತ್ಯಯುಕ್ತ ಏಕಭಕ್ಿತರ್ವಿಶಿಷ್ಯತೇ |
ಪ್ರಿಯೋ ಹಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಿನೋಽತ್ಯರ್ಥಮಹಂ ಸ ಚ ಮಮ ಪ್ರಿಯಃ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
తేషాం జ్ఞానీ నిత్యయుక్త ఏకభక్ితర్విశిష్యతే |
ప్రియో హి జ్ఞానినోఽత్యర్థమహం స చ మమ ప్రియః || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
teṣhāṁ jñānī nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viśhiṣhyate
priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ
translation_english: Of them, the man of knowledge, endowed with constant steadfastness and one-pointed devotion, excels. For I am very dear to the man of knowledge, and he too is dear to me.
context_english: teṣhām—amongst these; jñānī—those who are situated in knowledge; nitya-yuktaḥ—ever steadfast; eka—exclusively; bhaktiḥ—devotion; viśhiṣhyate—highest; priyaḥ—very dear; hi—certainly; jñāninaḥ—to the person in knowledge; atyartham—highly; aham—I; saḥ—he; cha—and; mama—to me; priyaḥ—dear

text:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।

आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्।।7.18।।
text_kannada:
ಉದಾರಾಃ ಸರ್ವ ಏವೈತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನೀ ತ್ವಾತ್ಮೈವ ಮೇ ಮತಮ್ |
ಆಸ್ಥಿತಃ ಸ ಹಿ ಯುಕ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ಮಾಮೇವಾನುತ್ತಮಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
ఉదారాః సర్వ ఏవైతే జ్ఞానీ త్వాత్మైవ మే మతమ్ |
ఆస్థితః స హి యుక్తాత్మా మామేవానుత్తమాం గతిమ్ || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim
translation_english: Indeed, all of these are noble, but the man of Knowledge is the Self itself. This is my opinion. For, with a steadfast mind, he is set on the path leading only to Me, who am the supreme Goal.
context_english: udārāḥ—noble; sarve—all; eva—indeed; ete—these; jñānī—those in knowledge; tu—but; ātmā eva—my very self; me—my; matam—opinion; āsthitaḥ—situated; saḥ—he; hi—certainly; yukta-ātmā—those who are united; mām—in me; eva—certainly; anuttamām—the supreme; gatim—goal

text:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।

वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः।।7.19।।
text_kannada:
ಬಹೂನಾಂ ಜನ್ಮನಾಮಂತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನವಾನ್ಮಾಂ ಪ್ರಪದ್ಯತೇ |
ವಾಸುದೇವಃ ಸರ್ವಮಿತಿ ಸ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾ ಸುದುರ್ಲಭಃ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
బహూనాం జన్మనామంతే జ్ఞానవాన్మాం ప్రపద్యతే |
వాసుదేవః సర్వమితి స మహాత్మా సుదుర్లభః || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ
translation_english: At the end of many births, the man of knowledge attains Me, realizing that Vasudeva is all. Such a high-souled one is very rare.
context_english: bahūnām—many; janmanām—births; ante—after; jñāna-vān—one who is endowed with knowledge; mām—unto me; prapadyate—surrenders; vāsudevaḥ—Shree Krishna, the son of Vasudev; sarvam—all; iti—that; saḥ—that; mahā-ātmā—great soul; su-durlabhaḥ—very rare

text:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।

तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया।।7.20।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಮೈಸ್ತೈಸ್ತೈರ್ಹೃತಜ್ಞಾನಾಃ ಪ್ರಪದ್ಯಂತೇಽನ್ಯದೇವತಾಃ |
ತಂ ತಂ ನಿಯಮಮಾಸ್ಥಾಯ ಪ್ರಕೃತ್ಯಾ ನಿಯತಾಃ ಸ್ವಯಾ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
కామైస్తైస్తైర్హృతజ్ఞానాః ప్రపద్యంతేఽన్యదేవతాః |
తం తం నియమమాస్థాయ ప్రకృత్యా నియతాః స్వయా || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
kāmais tais tair hṛita-jñānāḥ prapadyante ’nya-devatāḥ
taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā
translation_english: People, deprived of their wisdom by desires for various objects and guided by their own nature, resort to other deities, following the relevant methods.
context_english: kāmaiḥ—by material desires; taiḥ taiḥ—by various; hṛita-jñānāḥ—whose knowledge has been carried away; prapadyante—surrender; anya—to other; devatāḥ—celestial gods; tam tam—the various; niyamam—rules and regulations; āsthāya—following; prakṛityā—by nature; niyatāḥ—controlled; svayā—by their own

text:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।

तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्।।7.21।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋ ಯೋ ಯಾಂ ಯಾಂ ತನುಂ ಭಕ್ತಃ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾರ್ಚಿತುಮಿಚ್ಛತಿ |
ತಸ್ಯ ತಸ್ಯಾಚಲಾಂ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾಂ ತಾಮೇವ ವಿದಧಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
యో యో యాం యాం తనుం భక్తః శ్రద్ధయార్చితుమిచ్ఛతి |
తస్య తస్యాచలాం శ్రద్ధాం తామేవ విదధామ్యహమ్ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham
translation_english: Whichever form of a deity any devotee wants to worship with faith, I strengthen that very firm faith of theirs.
context_english: yaḥ yaḥ—whoever; yām yām—whichever; tanum—form; bhaktaḥ—devotee; śhraddhayā—with faith; architum—to worship; ichchhati—desires; tasya tasya—to him; achalām—steady; śhraddhām—faith; tām—in that; eva—certainly; vidadhāmi—bestow; aham—I

text:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।

लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्।।7.22।।
text_kannada:
ಸ ತಯಾ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ ಯುಕ್ತಸ್ತಸ್ಯಾರಾಧನಮೀಹತೇ |
ಲಭತೇ ಚ ತತಃ ಕಾಮಾನ್ಮಯೈವ ವಿಹಿತಾನ್ ಹಿ ತಾನ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
స తయా శ్రద్ధయా యుక్తస్తస్యారాధనమీహతే |
లభతే చ తతః కామాన్మయైవ విహితాన్ హి తాన్ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān
translation_english: Being imbued with that faith, that person engages in worshipping that form, and they get those very desired results as dispensed by Me alone.
context_english: saḥ—he; tayā—with that; śhraddhayā—faith; yuktaḥ—endowed with; tasya—of that; ārādhanam—worship; īhate—tries to engange in; labhate—obtains; cha—and; tataḥ—from that; kāmān—desires; mayā—by me; eva—alone; vihitān—granted; hi—certainly; tān—those

text:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।

देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि।।7.23।।
text_kannada:
ಅಂತವತ್ತು ಫಲಂ ತೇಷಾಂ ತದ್ಭವತ್ಯಲ್ಪಮೇಧಸಾಮ್ |
ದೇವಾಂದೇವಯಜೋ ಯಾಂತಿ ಮದ್ಭಕ್ತಾ ಯಾಂತಿ ಮಾಮಪಿ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
అంతవత్తు ఫలం తేషాం తద్భవత్యల్పమేధసామ్ |
దేవాందేవయజో యాంతి మద్భక్తా యాంతి మామపి || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api
translation_english: The result of those who are of poor intellect is indeed limited. The worshippers of gods go to the gods, while My devotees go to Me alone.
context_english: anta-vat—perishable; tu—but; phalam—fruit; teṣhām—by them; tat—that; bhavati—is; alpa-medhasām—people of small understanding; devān—to the celestial gods; deva-yajaḥ—the worshipers of the celestial gods; yānti—go; mat—my; bhaktāḥ—devotees; yānti—go; mām—to me; api—whereas

text:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।

परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।7.24।।
text_kannada:
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತಂ ವ್ಯಕ್ಿತಮಾಪನ್ನಂ ಮನ್ಯಂತೇ ಮಾಮಬುದ್ಧಯಃ |
ಪರಂ ಭಾವಮಜಾನಂತೋ ಮಮಾವ್ಯಯಮನುತ್ತಮಮ್ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
అవ్యక్తం వ్యక్ితమాపన్నం మన్యంతే మామబుద్ధయః |
పరం భావమజానంతో మమావ్యయమనుత్తమమ్ || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam
translation_english: The unintelligent, unaware of My supreme state which is immutable and unsurpassable, think of Me as having become manifest from the unmanifest.
context_english: avyaktam—formless; vyaktim—possessing a personality; āpannam—to have assumed; manyante—think; mām—me; abuddhayaḥ—less intelligent; param—Supreme; bhāvam—nature; ajānantaḥ—not understanding; mama—my; avyayam—imperishable; anuttamam—excellent

text:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।

मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्।।7.25।।
text_kannada:
ನಾಹಂ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಃ ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಯೋಗಮಾಯಾಸಮಾವೃತಃ |
ಮೂಢೋಽಯಂ ನಾಭಿಜಾನಾತಿ ಲೋಕೋ ಮಾಮಜಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
నాహం ప్రకాశః సర్వస్య యోగమాయాసమావృతః |
మూఢోఽయం నాభిజానాతి లోకో మామజమవ్యయమ్ || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
nāhaṁ prakāśhaḥ sarvasya yoga-māyā-samāvṛitaḥ
mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam
translation_english: Being enveloped by yoga-maya, I do not become manifest to all. This deluded world does not know Me, who am birthless and undecaying.
context_english: na—not; aham—I; prakāśhaḥ—manifest; sarvasya—to everyone; yoga-māyā—God’s supreme (divine) energy; samāvṛitaḥ—veiled; mūḍhaḥ—deluded; ayam—these; na—not; abhijānāti—know; lokaḥ—persons; mām—me; ajam—unborn; avyayam—immutable

text:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।

भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन।।7.26।।
text_kannada:
ವೇದಾಹಂ ಸಮತೀತಾನಿ ವರ್ತಮಾನಾನಿ ಚಾರ್ಜುನ |
ಭವಿಷ್ಯಾಣಿ ಚ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಮಾಂ ತು ವೇದ ನ ಕಶ್ಚನ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
వేదాహం సమతీతాని వర్తమానాని చార్జున |
భవిష్యాణి చ భూతాని మాం తు వేద న కశ్చన || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
vedāhaṁ samatītāni vartamānāni chārjuna
bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana
translation_english: O Arjuna, I know the past, present, and future beings; but no one knows Me!
context_english: veda—know; aham—I; samatītāni—the past; vartamānāni—the present; cha—and; arjuna—Arjun; bhaviṣhyāṇi—the future; cha—also; bhūtāni—all living beings; mām—me; tu—but; veda—knows; na kaśhchana—no one

text:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।

सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप।।7.27।।
text_kannada:
ಇಚ್ಛಾದ್ವೇಷಸಮುತ್ಥೇನ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಮೋಹೇನ ಭಾರತ |
ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಿ ಸಂಮೋಹಂ ಸರ್ಗೇ ಯಾಂತಿ ಪರಂತಪ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఇచ్ఛాద్వేషసముత్థేన ద్వంద్వమోహేన భారత |
సర్వభూతాని సంమోహం సర్గే యాంతి పరంతప || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
ichchhā-dveṣha-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhārata
sarva-bhūtāni sammohaṁ sarge yānti parantapa
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, O destroyer of foes, due to the delusion of duality arising from likes and dislikes, all creatures become bewildered upon their birth.
context_english: ichchhā—desire; dveṣha—aversion; samutthena—arise from; dvandva—of duality; mohena—from the illusion; bhārata—Arjun, descendant of Bharat; sarva—all; bhūtāni—living beings; sammoham—into delusion; sarge—since birth; yānti—enter; parantapa—Arjun, conqueror of enemies

text:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।

ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः।।7.28।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇಷಾಂ ತ್ವಂತಗತಂ ಪಾಪಂ ಜನಾನಾಂ ಪುಣ್ಯಕರ್ಮಣಾಮ್ |
ತೇ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಮೋಹನಿರ್ಮುಕ್ತಾ ಭಜಂತೇ ಮಾಂ ದೃಢವ್ರತಾಃ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
యేషాం త్వంతగతం పాపం జనానాం పుణ్యకర్మణామ్ |
తే ద్వంద్వమోహనిర్ముక్తా భజంతే మాం దృఢవ్రతాః || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
yeṣhāṁ tvanta-gataṁ pāpaṁ janānāṁ puṇya-karmaṇām
te dvandva-moha-nirmuktā bhajante māṁ dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
translation_english: On the other hand, those persons who have done virtuous deeds, whose sin has come to an end, they, being free from the delusion of duality and firm in their convictions, adore Me.
context_english: yeṣhām—whose; tu—but; anta-gatam—completely destroyed; pāpam—sins; janānām—of persons; puṇya—pious; karmaṇām—activities; te—they; dvandva—of dualities; moha—illusion; nirmuktāḥ—free from; bhajante—worship;mām; dṛiḍha-vratāḥ—with determination

text:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।

ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्।।7.29।।
text_kannada:
ಜರಾಮರಣಮೋಕ್ಷಾಯ ಮಾಮಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ಯತಂತಿ ಯೇ |
ತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ತದ್ವಿದುಃ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಮಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಚಾಖಿಲಮ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
జరామరణమోక్షాయ మామాశ్రిత్య యతంతి యే |
తే బ్రహ్మ తద్విదుః కృత్స్నమధ్యాత్మం కర్మ చాఖిలమ్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
jarā-maraṇa-mokṣhāya mām āśhritya yatanti ye
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛitsnam adhyātmaṁ karma chākhilam
translation_english: Those who strive by resorting to Me for becoming free from old age and death, they know Brahman, the individual Self, and all about actions. [They know Brahman as being all the individual entities and all actions. This verse prescribes meditation on the qualified Brahman for aspirants of the middle class. Verses beginning with the 14th speak about the realization of the unqualified Brahman by aspirants of the highest class.]
context_english: jarā—from old age; maraṇa—and death; mokṣhāya—for liberation; mām—me; āśhritya—take shelter in; yatanti—strive; ye—who; te—they; brahma—Brahman; tat—that; viduḥ—know; kṛitsnam—everything; adhyātmam—the individual self; karma—karmic action; cha—and; akhilam—entire

text:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।

प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः।।7.30।।
text_kannada:
ಸಾಧಿಭೂತಾಧಿದೈವಂ ಮಾಂ ಸಾಧಿಯಜ್ಞಂ ಚ ಯೇ ವಿದುಃ |
ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕಾಲೇಽಪಿ ಚ ಮಾಂ ತೇ ವಿದುರ್ಯುಕ್ತಚೇತಸಃ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
సాధిభూతాధిదైవం మాం సాధియజ్ఞం చ యే విదుః |
ప్రయాణకాలేఽపి చ మాం తే విదుర్యుక్తచేతసః || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ
prayāṇa-kāle ’pi cha māṁ te vidur yukta-chetasaḥ
translation_english: Those who know me as existing in both the physical and divine planes, and also in the context of the sacrifice, they with concentrated minds know me even at the time of death.
context_english: sa-adhibhūta—governing principle of the field of matter; adhidaivam—governing principle of the celestial gods; mām—me; sa-adhiyajñam—governing principle of the Lord all sacrificial performances; cha—and; ye—who; viduḥ—know; prayāṇa—of death; kāle—at the time; api—even; cha—and; mām—me; te—they; viduḥ—know; yukta-chetasaḥ—in full consciousness of me

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम।

अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते।।8.1।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಕಿಂ ತದ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಕಿಮಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಂ ಕಿಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಪುರುಷೋತ್ತಮ |
ಅಧಿಭೂತಂ ಚ ಕಿಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಮಧಿದೈವಂ ಕಿಮುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
కిం తద్బ్రహ్మ కిమధ్యాత్మం కిం కర్మ పురుషోత్తమ |
అధిభూతం చ కిం ప్రోక్తమధిదైవం కిముచ్యతే || ౧ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
kiṁ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṁ kiṁ karma puruṣhottama
adhibhūtaṁ cha kiṁ proktam adhidaivaṁ kim uchyate
translation_english: Arjuna said, O Supreme Person, what is Brahman? What exists in the individual plane? What is action? What is said to exist in the physical plane? And what is said to exist in the divine plane?

text:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन।

प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः।।8.2।।
text_kannada:
ಅಧಿಯಜ್ಞಃ ಕಥಂ ಕೋಽತ್ರ ದೇಹೇಽಸ್ಮಿನ್ಮಧುಸೂದನ |
ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕಾಲೇ ಚ ಕಥಂ ಜ್ಞೇಯೋಽಸಿ ನಿಯತಾತ್ಮಭಿಃ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
అధియజ్ఞః కథం కోఽత్ర దేహేఽస్మిన్మధుసూదన |
ప్రయాణకాలే చ కథం జ్ఞేయోఽసి నియతాత్మభిః || ౨ ||
transliteration:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṁ ko ’tra dehe ’smin madhusūdana
prayāṇa-kāle cha kathaṁ jñeyo ’si niyatātmabhiḥ
translation_english: O Madhusudana, how is the entity existing in the sacrifice here in this body, and who is it? And how are You to be known by people of concentrated minds at the time of death?

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते।

भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः।।8.3।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಅಕ್ಷರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಪರಮಂ ಸ್ವಭಾವೋಽಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಮುಚ್ಯತೇ |
ಭೂತಭಾವೋದ್ಭವಕರೋ ವಿಸರ್ಗಃ ಕರ್ಮಸಂಜ್ಞಿತಃ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
అక్షరం బ్రహ్మ పరమం స్వభావోఽధ్యాత్మముచ్యతే |
భూతభావోద్భవకరో విసర్గః కర్మసంజ్ఞితః || ౩ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
akṣharaṁ brahma paramaṁ svabhāvo ’dhyātmam uchyate
bhūta-bhāvodbhava-karo visargaḥ karma-sanjñitaḥ
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "The Immutable is the supreme Brahman; selfhood is said to be the entity present in the individual plane. By action is meant the offerings that bring about the origin of existence of things."

text:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।

अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर।।8.4।।
text_kannada:
ಅಧಿಭೂತಂ ಕ್ಷರೋ ಭಾವಃ ಪುರುಷಶ್ಚಾಧಿದೈವತಮ್ |
ಅಧಿಯಜ್ಞೋಽಹಮೇವಾತ್ರ ದೇಹೇ ದೇಹಭೃತಾಂ ವರ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
అధిభూతం క్షరో భావః పురుషశ్చాధిదైవతమ్ |
అధియజ్ఞోఽహమేవాత్ర దేహే దేహభృతాం వర || ౪ ||
transliteration:
adhibhūtaṁ kṣharo bhāvaḥ puruṣhaśh chādhidaivatam
adhiyajño ’ham evātra dehe deha-bhṛitāṁ vara
translation_english: That which exists in the physical plane is the mutable entity, and what exists in the divine plane is the Person. O best among the embodied beings, I Myself am the entity that exists in the sacrifice within this body.

text:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।

यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः।।8.5।।
text_kannada:
ಅಂತಕಾಲೇ ಚ ಮಾಮೇವ ಸ್ಮರನ್ಮುಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಕಲೇವರಮ್ |
ಯಃ ಪ್ರಯಾತಿ ಸ ಮದ್ಭಾವಂ ಯಾತಿ ನಾಸ್ತ್ಯತ್ರ ಸಂಶಯಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
అంతకాలే చ మామేవ స్మరన్ముక్త్వా కలేవరమ్ |
యః ప్రయాతి స మద్భావం యాతి నాస్త్యత్ర సంశయః || ౫ ||
transliteration:
anta-kāle cha mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāstyatra sanśhayaḥ
translation_english: And at the time of death, anyone who departs, giving up the body while thinking of Me alone, attains My state; there is no doubt about this.

text:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।

तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः।।8.6।।
text_kannada:
ಯಂ ಯಂ ವಾಪಿ ಸ್ಮರನ್ಭಾವಂ ತ್ಯಜತ್ಯಂತೇ ಕಲೇವರಮ್ |
ತಂ ತಮೇವೈತಿ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಸದಾ ತದ್ಭಾವಭಾವಿತಃ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
యం యం వాపి స్మరన్భావం త్యజత్యంతే కలేవరమ్ |
తం తమేవైతి కౌంతేయ సదా తద్భావభావితః || ౬ ||
transliteration:
yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṁ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ
translation_english: O son of Kunti, thinking of any entity, whichever it may be, one gives up the body at the end; he attains that very one, having been always engrossed in its thought.

text:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।

मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्।।8.7।।
text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಕಾಲೇಷು ಮಾಮನುಸ್ಮರ ಯುಧ್ಯ ಚ |
ಮಯ್ಯರ್ಪಿತಮನೋಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ಮಾಮೇವೈಷ್ಯಸ್ಯಸಂಶಯಮ್ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
తస్మాత్సర్వేషు కాలేషు మామనుస్మర యుధ్య చ |
మయ్యర్పితమనోబుద్ధిర్మామేవైష్యస్యసంశయమ్ || ౭ ||
transliteration:
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu mām anusmara yudhya cha
mayyarpita-mano-buddhir mām evaiṣhyasyasanśhayam
translation_english: Therefore, think of Me at all times and fight; there is no doubt that by dedicating your mind and intellect to Me, you will attain only Me.

text:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना।

परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्।।8.8।।
text_kannada:
ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತೇನ ಚೇತಸಾ ನಾನ್ಯಗಾಮಿನಾ |
ಪರಮಂ ಪುರುಷಂ ದಿವ್ಯಂ ಯಾತಿ ಪಾರ್ಥಾನುಚಿಂತಯನ್ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
అభ్యాసయోగయుక్తేన చేతసా నాన్యగామినా |
పరమం పురుషం దివ్యం యాతి పార్థానుచింతయన్ || ౮ ||
transliteration:
abhyāsa-yoga-yuktena chetasā nānya-gāminā
paramaṁ puruṣhaṁ divyaṁ yāti pārthānuchintayan
translation_english: O son of Prtha, by meditating with a mind engaged in the yoga of practice and not straying away to anything else, one reaches the supreme Person existing in the effulgent region.

text:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार

मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः।

सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप

मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्।।8.9।।
text_kannada:
ಕವಿಂ ಪುರಾಣಮನುಶಾಸಿತಾರ |
ಮಣೋರಣೀಯಾಂಸಮನುಸ್ಮರೇದ್ಯಃ |
ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಧಾತಾರಮಚಿಂತ್ಯರೂಪ |
ಮಾದಿತ್ಯವರ್ಣಂ ತಮಸಃ ಪರಸ್ತಾತ್ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
కవిం పురాణమనుశాసితార |
మణోరణీయాంసమనుస్మరేద్యః |
సర్వస్య ధాతారమచింత్యరూప |
మాదిత్యవర్ణం తమసః పరస్తాత్ || ౯ ||
transliteration:
kaviṁ purāṇam anuśhāsitāram
aṇor aṇīyānsam anusmared yaḥ
sarvasya dhātāram achintya-rūpam
āditya-varṇaṁ tamasaḥ parastāt
translation_english: He who meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, the Ruler, subtler than the subtle, the Ordainer of everything, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun, and beyond darkness—he attains the Supreme Person.

text:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन

भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव।

भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्

स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्।।8.10।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕಾಲೇ ಮನಸಾಽಚಲೇನ |
ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಯುಕ್ತೋ ಯೋಗಬಲೇನ ಚೈವ |
ಭ್ರುವೋರ್ಮಧ್ಯೇ ಪ್ರಾಣಮಾವೇಶ್ಯ ಸಮ್ಯಕ್ |
ಸ ತಂ ಪರಂ ಪುರುಷಮುಪೈತಿ ದಿವ್ಯಮ್ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రయాణకాలే మనసాఽచలేన |
భక్త్యా యుక్తో యోగబలేన చైవ |
భ్రువోర్మధ్యే ప్రాణమావేశ్య సమ్యక్ |
స తం పరం పురుషముపైతి దివ్యమ్ || ౧౦ ||

prayāṇa-kāle manasāchalena
bhaktyā yukto yoga-balena chaiva

sa taṁ paraṁ puruṣham upaiti divyam
translation_english: At the time of death, having fully fixed the Prana (vital force) between the eyebrows with an unwavering mind, and being imbued with devotion as well as the strength of concentration, he reaches that resplendent Supreme Person.

text:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति

विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।

यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति

तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये।।8.11।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಕ್ಷರಂ ವೇದವಿದೋ ವದಂತಿ |
ವಿಶಂತಿ ಯದ್ಯತಯೋ ವೀತರಾಗಾಃ |
ಯದಿಚ್ಛಂತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಂ ಚರಂತಿ |
ತತ್ತೇ ಪದಂ ಸಂಗ್ರಹೇಣ ಪ್ರವಕ್ಷ್ಯೇ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
యదక్షరం వేదవిదో వదంతి |
విశంతి యద్యతయో వీతరాగాః |
యదిచ్ఛంతో బ్రహ్మచర్యం చరంతి |
తత్తే పదం సంగ్రహేణ ప్రవక్ష్యే || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
yad akṣharaṁ veda-vido vadanti

yad ichchhanto brahmacharyaṁ charanti
tat te padaṁ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣhye
translation_english: I will briefly tell you about that immutable Goal which the knowers of the Vedas declare; those who are diligent, free from attachment, and aspire for it, enter into it. People practice celibacy for it.

text:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।

मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्।।8.12।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವದ್ವಾರಾಣಿ ಸಂಯಮ್ಯ ಮನೋ ಹೃದಿ ನಿರುಧ್ಯ ಚ |
ಮೂರ್ಧ್ನ್ಯಾಧಾಯಾತ್ಮನಃ ಪ್ರಾಣಮಾಸ್ಥಿತೋ ಯೋಗಧಾರಣಾಮ್ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వద్వారాణి సంయమ్య మనో హృది నిరుధ్య చ |
మూర్ధ్న్యాధాయాత్మనః ప్రాణమాస్థితో యోగధారణామ్ || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
sarva-dvārāṇi sanyamya mano hṛidi nirudhya cha
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇam āsthito yoga-dhāraṇām
translation_english: Having controlled all the senses, confined the mind in the heart, and fixed his own vital force in the head, he should remain firm in yoga.

text:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।

यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्।।8.13।।
text_kannada:
ಓಮಿತ್ಯೇಕಾಕ್ಷರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಹರನ್ಮಾಮನುಸ್ಮರನ್ |
