text_telugu:
ఓమిత్యేకాక్షరం బ్రహ్మ వ్యాహరన్మామనుస్మరన్ |
యః ప్రయాతి త్యజందేహం స యాతి పరమాం గతిమ్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
oṁ ityekākṣharaṁ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim
translation_english: He who departs, leaving the body while uttering the single syllable, "Om," which is Brahman, and thinking of Me, attains the supreme Goal.
context_english: om—sacred syllable representing the formless aspect of God; iti—thus; eka-akṣharam—one syllabled; brahma—the Absolute Truth; vyāharan—chanting; mām—me (Shree Krishna); anusmaran—remembering; yaḥ—who; prayāti—departs; tyajan—quitting; deham—the body; saḥ—he; yāti—attains; paramām—the supreme; gatim—goal

text:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।

तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः।।8.14।।
text_kannada:
ಅನನ್ಯಚೇತಾಃ ಸತತಂ ಯೋ ಮಾಂ ಸ್ಮರತಿ ನಿತ್ಯಶಃ |
ತಸ್ಯಾಹಂ ಸುಲಭಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ನಿತ್ಯಯುಕ್ತಸ್ಯ ಯೋಗಿನಃ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
అనన్యచేతాః సతతం యో మాం స్మరతి నిత్యశః |
తస్యాహం సులభః పార్థ నిత్యయుక్తస్య యోగినః || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
ananya-chetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśhaḥ
tasyāhaṁ sulabhaḥ pārtha nitya-yuktasya yoginaḥ
translation_english: O son of Prtha, to that yogi of constant concentration and single-minded attention, who remembers Me uninterruptedly and for a long time, I am easily attained.
context_english: ananya-chetāḥ—without deviation of the mind; satatam—always; yaḥ—who; mām—me; smarati—remembers; nityaśhaḥ—regularly; tasya—to him; aham—I; su-labhaḥ—easily attainable; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; nitya—constantly; yuktasya—engaged; yoginaḥ—of the yogis

text:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।

नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः।।8.15।।
text_kannada:
ಮಾಮುಪೇತ್ಯ ಪುನರ್ಜನ್ಮ ದುಃಖಾಲಯಮಶಾಶ್ವತಮ್ |
ನಾಪ್ನುವಂತಿ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾನಃ ಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಪರಮಾಂ ಗತಾಃ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
మాముపేత్య పునర్జన్మ దుఃఖాలయమశాశ్వతమ్ |
నాప్నువంతి మహాత్మానః సంసిద్ధిం పరమాం గతాః || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśhāśhvatam
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ sansiddhiṁ paramāṁ gatāḥ
translation_english: As a result of reaching Me, the exalted ones who have attained the highest perfection do not get rebirth, which is an abode of sorrows and is impermanent.
context_english: mām—me; upetya—having attained; punaḥ—again; janma—birth; duḥkha-ālayam—place full of miseries; aśhāśhvatam—temporary; na—never; āpnuvanti—attain; mahā-ātmānaḥ—the great souls; sansiddhim—perfection; paramām—highest; gatāḥ—having achieved

text:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।

मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते।।8.16।।
text_kannada:
ಆಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭುವನಾಲ್ಲೋಕಾಃ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿನೋಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಮಾಮುಪೇತ್ಯ ತು ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಪುನರ್ಜನ್ಮ ನ ವಿದ್ಯತೇ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
ఆబ్రహ్మభువనాల్లోకాః పునరావర్తినోఽర్జున |
మాముపేత్య తు కౌంతేయ పునర్జన్మ న విద్యతే || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
ā-brahma-bhuvanāl lokāḥ punar āvartino ’rjuna
mām upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate
translation_english: O Arjuna, all the worlds together with the world of Brahma are subject to return. But, O son of Kunti, there is no return after reaching Me.
context_english: ā-brahma-bhuvanāt—up to the abode of Brahma; lokāḥ—worlds; punaḥ āvartinaḥ—subject to rebirth; arjuna—Arjun; mām—mine; upetya—having attained; tu—but; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; punaḥ janma—rebirth; na—never; vidyate—is

text:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।

रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः।।8.17।।
text_kannada:
ಸಹಸ್ರಯುಗಪರ್ಯಂತಮಹರ್ಯದ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣೋ ವಿದುಃ |
ರಾತ್ರಿಂ ಯುಗಸಹಸ್ರಾಂತಾಂ ತೇಽಹೋರಾತ್ರವಿದೋ ಜನಾಃ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
సహస్రయుగపర్యంతమహర్యద్బ్రహ్మణో విదుః |
రాత్రిం యుగసహస్రాంతాం తేఽహోరాత్రవిదో జనాః || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ
rātriṁ yuga-sahasrāntāṁ te ’ho-rātra-vido janāḥ
translation_english: Those people who know what day and night are, know the day of Brahma which ends in a thousand yugas, and His night which also ends in a thousand yugas.
context_english: sahasra—one thousand; yuga—age; paryantam—until; ahaḥ—one day; yat—which; brahmaṇaḥ—of Brahma; viduḥ—know; rātrim—night; yuga-sahasra-antām—lasts one thousand yugas; te—they; ahaḥ-rātra-vidaḥ—those who know his day and night; janāḥ—people

text:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।

रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके।।8.18।।
text_kannada:
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತಾದ್ವ್ಯಕ್ತಯಃ ಸರ್ವಾಃ ಪ್ರಭವಂತ್ಯಹರಾಗಮೇ |
ರಾತ್ರ್ಯಾಗಮೇ ಪ್ರಲೀಯಂತೇ ತತ್ರೈವಾವ್ಯಕ್ತಸಂಜ್ಞಕೇ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
అవ్యక్తాద్వ్యక్తయః సర్వాః ప్రభవంత్యహరాగమే |
రాత్ర్యాగమే ప్రలీయంతే తత్రైవావ్యక్తసంజ్ఞకే || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyahar-āgame
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyakta-sanjñake
translation_english: With the coming of day, all manifested things emerge from the Unmanifest, and when night comes, they merge into that which is called the Unmanifested.
context_english: avyaktāt—from the unmanifested; vyaktayaḥ—the manifested; sarvāḥ—all; prabhavanti—emanate; ahaḥ-āgame—at the advent of Brahma’s day; rātri-āgame—at the fall of Brahma’s night; pralīyante—they dissolve; tatra—into that; eva—certainly; avyakta-sanjñake—in that which is called the unmanifest

text:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।

रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे।।8.19।।
text_kannada:
ಭೂತಗ್ರಾಮಃ ಸ ಏವಾಯಂ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಪ್ರಲೀಯತೇ |
ರಾತ್ರ್ಯಾಗಮೇಽವಶಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಪ್ರಭವತ್ಯಹರಾಗಮೇ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
భూతగ్రామః స ఏవాయం భూత్వా భూత్వా ప్రలీయతే |
రాత్ర్యాగమేఽవశః పార్థ ప్రభవత్యహరాగమే || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
rātryāgame ’vaśhaḥ pārtha prabhavatyahar-āgame
translation_english: O son of Prtha, after being born again and again, that very multitude of beings disappears of its own accord at the approach of night. It comes to life again at the approach of day.
context_english: bhūta-grāmaḥ—the multitude of beings; saḥ—these; eva—certainly; ayam—this; bhūtvā bhūtvā—repeatedly taking birth; pralīyate—dissolves; rātri-āgame—with the advent of night; avaśhaḥ—helpless; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; prabhavati—become manifest; ahaḥ-āgame—with the advent of day

text:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।

यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति।।8.20।।
text_kannada:
ಪರಸ್ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ತು ಭಾವೋಽನ್ಯೋಽವ್ಯಕ್ತೋಽವ್ಯಕ್ತಾತ್ಸನಾತನಃ |
ಯಃ ಸ ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಭೂತೇಷು ನಶ್ಯತ್ಸು ನ ವಿನಶ್ಯತಿ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
పరస్తస్మాత్తు భావోఽన్యోఽవ్యక్తోఽవ్యక్తాత్సనాతనః |
యః స సర్వేషు భూతేషు నశ్యత్సు న వినశ్యతి || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
paras tasmāt tu bhāvo ’nyo ’vyakto ’vyaktāt sanātanaḥ
yaḥ sa sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu naśhyatsu na vinaśhyati
translation_english: But distinct from that Unmanifested is the other eternal, unmanifest Reality, who does not get destroyed when all beings are destroyed.
context_english: paraḥ—transcendental; tasmāt—than that; tu—but; bhāvaḥ—creation; anyaḥ—another; avyaktaḥ—unmanifest; avyaktāt—to the unmanifest; sanātanaḥ—eternal; yaḥ—who; saḥ—that; sarveṣhu—all; bhūteṣhu—in beings; naśhyatsu—cease to exist; na—never; vinaśhyati—is annihilated

text:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।

यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।8.21।।
text_kannada:
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತೋಽಕ್ಷರ ಇತ್ಯುಕ್ತಸ್ತಮಾಹುಃ ಪರಮಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ |
ಯಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ನ ನಿವರ್ತಂತೇ ತದ್ಧಾಮ ಪರಮಂ ಮಮ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
అవ్యక్తోఽక్షర ఇత్యుక్తస్తమాహుః పరమాం గతిమ్ |
యం ప్రాప్య న నివర్తంతే తద్ధామ పరమం మమ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
avyakto ’kṣhara ityuktas tam āhuḥ paramāṁ gatim
yaṁ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
translation_english: They call Him who has been mentioned as the Unmanifested, the Immutable, the supreme Goal. That is the supreme abode of Mine, from which they do not return once they reach it.
context_english: avyaktaḥ—unmanifest; akṣharaḥ—imperishable; iti—thus; uktaḥ—is said; tam—that; āhuḥ—is called; paramām—the supreme; gatim—destination; yam—which; prāpya—having reached; na—never; nivartante—come back; tat—that; dhāma—abode; paramam—the supreme; mama—my

text:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।

यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।।8.22।।
text_kannada:
ಪುರುಷಃ ಸ ಪರಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಲಭ್ಯಸ್ತ್ವನನ್ಯಯಾ |
ಯಸ್ಯಾಂತಃಸ್ಥಾನಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಯೇನ ಸರ್ವಮಿದಂ ತತಮ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
పురుషః స పరః పార్థ భక్త్యా లభ్యస్త్వనన్యయా |
యస్యాంతఃస్థాని భూతాని యేన సర్వమిదం తతమ్ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
puruṣhaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tvananyayā
yasyāntaḥ-sthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
translation_english: O son of Prtha, that supreme Person—in whom all beings are included and by whom all this is pervaded—is, indeed, reached through one-pointed devotion.
context_english: puruṣhaḥ—the Supreme Divine Personality; saḥ—he; paraḥ—greatest; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; bhaktyā—through devotion; labhyaḥ—is attainable; tu—indeed; ananyayā—without another; yasya—of whom; antaḥ-sthāni—situated within; bhūtāni—beings; yena—by whom; sarvam—all; idam—this; tatam—is pervaded

text:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।

प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ।।8.23।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ರ ಕಾಲೇ ತ್ವನಾವೃತ್ತಿಮಾವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಚೈವ ಯೋಗಿನಃ |
ಪ್ರಯಾತಾ ಯಾಂತಿ ತಂ ಕಾಲಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
యత్ర కాలే త్వనావృత్తిమావృత్తిం చైవ యోగినః |
ప్రయాతా యాంతి తం కాలం వక్ష్యామి భరతర్షభ || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛittim āvṛittiṁ chaiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṁ kālaṁ vakṣhyāmi bharatarṣhabha
translation_english: O best of the Bharata dynasty, I shall now speak of that time by which the yogis depart and attain the State of Non-return, and also the State of Return.
context_english: yatra—where; kāle—time; tu—certainly; anāvṛittim—no return; āvṛittim—return; cha—and; eva—certainly; yoginaḥ—a yogi; prayātāḥ—having departed; yānti—attain; tam—that; kālam—time; vakṣhyāmi—I shall describe; bharata-ṛiṣhabha—Arjun, the best of the Bharatas;

text:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।

तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः।।8.24।।
text_kannada:
ಅಗ್ನಿರ್ಜ್ಯೋತಿರಹಃ ಶುಕ್ಲಃ ಷಣ್ಮಾಸಾ ಉತ್ತರಾಯಣಮ್ |
ತತ್ರ ಪ್ರಯಾತಾ ಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮವಿದೋ ಜನಾಃ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
అగ్నిర్జ్యోతిరహః శుక్లః షణ్మాసా ఉత్తరాయణమ్ |
తత్ర ప్రయాతా గచ్ఛంతి బ్రహ్మ బ్రహ్మవిదో జనాః || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
agnir jyotir ahaḥ śhuklaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gachchhanti brahma brahma-vido janāḥ
translation_english: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern solstice—by following this path, persons who are knowers of Brahman attain Brahman when they die.
context_english: agniḥ—fire; jyotiḥ—light; ahaḥ—day; śhuklaḥ—the bright fortnight of the moon; ṣhaṭ-māsāḥ—six months; uttara-ayanam—the sun’s northern course; tatra—there; prayātāḥ—departed; gachchhanti—go; brahma—Brahman; brahma-vidaḥ—those who know the Brahman; janāḥ—persons;

text:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।

तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते।।8.25।।
text_kannada:
ಧೂಮೋ ರಾತ್ರಿಸ್ತಥಾ ಕೃಷ್ಣಃ ಷಣ್ಮಾಸಾ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಾಯನಮ್ |
ತತ್ರ ಚಾಂದ್ರಮಸಂ ಜ್ಯೋತಿರ್ಯೋಗೀ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ನಿವರ್ತತೇ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
ధూమో రాత్రిస్తథా కృష్ణః షణ్మాసా దక్షిణాయనమ్ |
తత్ర చాంద్రమసం జ్యోతిర్యోగీ ప్రాప్య నివర్తతే || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
dhūmo rātris tathā kṛiṣhṇaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā dakṣhiṇāyanam
tatra chāndramasaṁ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate
translation_english: Following this Path, the yogi, having reached the lunar light, returns, smoke, night, as also the dark fortnight and the six months of the Southern solstice.

text:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।

एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः।।8.26।।
text_kannada:
ಶುಕ್ಲಕೃಷ್ಣೇ ಗತೀ ಹ್ಯೇತೇ ಜಗತಃ ಶಾಶ್ವತೇ ಮತೇ |
ಏಕಯಾ ಯಾತ್ಯನಾವೃತ್ತಿಮನ್ಯಯಾಽಽವರ್ತತೇ ಪುನಃ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
శుక్లకృష్ణే గతీ హ్యేతే జగతః శాశ్వతే మతే |
ఏకయా యాత్యనావృత్తిమన్యయాఽఽవర్తతే పునః || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
śhukla-kṛiṣhṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śhāśhvate mate
ekayā yātyanāvṛittim anyayāvartate punaḥ
translation_english: These two paths of the world, which are white and black, are indeed considered eternal. Through one, a person goes to the state of non-return; through the other, they return again.
context_english: śhukla—bright; kṛiṣhṇe—dark; gatī—paths; hi—certainly; ete—these; jagataḥ—of the material world; śhāśhvate—eternal; mate—opinion; ekayā—by one; yāti—goes; anāvṛittim—to non return; anyayā—by the other; āvartate—comes back; punaḥ—again

text:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।

तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन।।8.27।।
text_kannada:
ನೈತೇ ಸೃತೀ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಜಾನನ್ಯೋಗೀ ಮುಹ್ಯತಿ ಕಶ್ಚನ |
ತಸ್ಮಾತ್ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಕಾಲೇಷು ಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತೋ ಭವಾರ್ಜುನ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
నైతే సృతీ పార్థ జానన్యోగీ ముహ్యతి కశ్చన |
తస్మాత్సర్వేషు కాలేషు యోగయుక్తో భవార్జున || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
naite sṛitī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaśhchana
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu yoga-yukto bhavārjuna
translation_english: O son of Prtha, no yogi—one steadfast in meditation—whosoever has known these two courses becomes deluded. Therefore, O Arjuna, be steadfast in yoga at all times.

text:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव

दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।

अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा

योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्।।8.28।।
text_kannada:
ವೇದೇಷು ಯಜ್ಞೇಷು ತಪಃಸು ಚೈವ |
ದಾನೇಷು ಯತ್ಪುಣ್ಯಫಲಂ ಪ್ರದಿಷ್ಟಮ್ |
ಅತ್ಯೇತಿ ತತ್ಸರ್ವಮಿದಂ ವಿದಿತ್ವಾ |
ಯೋಗೀ ಪರಂ ಸ್ಥಾನಮುಪೈತಿ ಚಾದ್ಯಮ್ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
వేదేషు యజ్ఞేషు తపఃసు చైవ |
దానేషు యత్పుణ్యఫలం ప్రదిష్టమ్ |
అత్యేతి తత్సర్వమిదం విదిత్వా |
యోగీ పరం స్థానముపైతి చాద్యమ్ || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
vedeṣhu yajñeṣhu tapaḥsu chaiva
dāneṣhu yat puṇya-phalaṁ pradiṣhṭam
atyeti tat sarvam idaṁ viditvā
yogī paraṁ sthānam upaiti chādyam
translation_english: Having known this, the yogi transcends all the results of righteous deeds declared in the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and charities, and reaches the primordial, supreme state.
context_english: vedeṣhu—in the study of the Vedas; yajñeṣhu—in performance of sacrifices; tapaḥsu—in austerities; cha—and; eva—certainly; dāneṣhu—in giving charities; yat—which; puṇya-phalam—fruit of merit; pradiṣhṭam—is gained; atyeti—surpasses; tat sarvam—all; idam—this; viditvā—having known; yogī—a yogi; param—Supreme; sthānam—Abode; upaiti—achieves; cha—and; ādyam—original

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।

ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।9.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಇದಂ ತು ತೇ ಗುಹ್ಯತಮಂ ಪ್ರವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮ್ಯನಸೂಯವೇ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಸಹಿತಂ ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಮೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇಽಶುಭಾತ್ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
ఇదం తు తే గుహ్యతమం ప్రవక్ష్యామ్యనసూయవే |
జ్ఞానం విజ్ఞానసహితం యజ్జ్ఞాత్వా మోక్ష్యసేఽశుభాత్ || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
idaṁ tu te guhyatamaṁ pravakṣhyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṁ vijñāna-sahitaṁ yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said: However, to you who are not given to cavilling, I shall speak of this highest secret itself, which is knowledge combined with experience, by realizing which you shall be free from evil.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; idam—this; tu—but; te—to you; guhya-tamam—the most confidential; pravakṣhyāmi—I shall impart; anasūyave—nonenvious; jñānam—knowledge; vijñāna—realized knowledge; sahitam—with; yat—which; jñātvā—knowing; mokṣhyase—you will be released; aśhubhāt—miseries of material existence

text:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।

प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्।।9.2।।
text_kannada:
ರಾಜವಿದ್ಯಾ ರಾಜಗುಹ್ಯಂ ಪವಿತ್ರಮಿದಮುತ್ತಮಮ್ |
ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷಾವಗಮಂ ಧರ್ಮ್ಯಂ ಸುಸುಖಂ ಕರ್ತುಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
రాజవిద్యా రాజగుహ్యం పవిత్రమిదముత్తమమ్ |
ప్రత్యక్షావగమం ధర్మ్యం సుసుఖం కర్తుమవ్యయమ్ || ౨ ||
transliteration:
rāja-vidyā rāja-guhyaṁ pavitram idam uttamam
pratyakṣhāvagamaṁ dharmyaṁ su-sukhaṁ kartum avyayam
translation_english: This is the sovereign knowledge, the sovereign profundity, the best sanctifier; directly realizable, righteous, very easy to practice, and imperishable.
context_english: rāja-vidyā—the king of sciences; rāja-guhyam—the most profound secret; pavitram—pure; idam—this; uttamam—highest; pratyakṣha—directly perceptible; avagamam—directly realizable; dharmyam—virtuous; su-sukham—easy; kartum—to practice; avyayam—everlasting

text:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।

अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि।।9.3।।
text_kannada:
ಅಶ್ರದ್ದಧಾನಾಃ ಪುರುಷಾ ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯಾಸ್ಯ ಪರಂತಪ |
ಅಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಮಾಂ ನಿವರ್ತಂತೇ ಮೃತ್ಯುಸಂಸಾರವರ್ತ್ಮನಿ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
అశ్రద్దధానాః పురుషా ధర్మస్యాస్య పరంతప |
అప్రాప్య మాం నివర్తంతే మృత్యుసంసారవర్త్మని || ౩ ||
transliteration:
aśhraddadhānāḥ puruṣhā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṁ nivartante mṛityu-samsāra-vartmani
translation_english: O destroyer of foes, those who are disregarding this Dharma (knowledge of the Self) certainly go round and round, without reaching Me, along the path of transmigration which is fraught with death.
context_english: aśhraddadhānāḥ—people without faith; puruṣhāḥ—(such) persons; dharmasya—of dharma; asya—this; parantapa—Arjun, conqueror the enemies; aprāpya—without attaining; mām—me; nivartante—come back; mṛityu—death; samsāra—material existence; vartmani—in the path

text:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।

मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः।।9.4।।
text_kannada:
ಮಯಾ ತತಮಿದಂ ಸರ್ವಂ ಜಗದವ್ಯಕ್ತಮೂರ್ತಿನಾ |
ಮತ್ಸ್ಥಾನಿ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಿ ನ ಚಾಹಂ ತೇಷ್ವವಸ್ಥಿತಃ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
మయా తతమిదం సర్వం జగదవ్యక్తమూర్తినా |
మత్స్థాని సర్వభూతాని న చాహం తేష్వవస్థితః || ౪ ||
transliteration:
mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā
mat-sthāni sarva-bhūtāni na chāhaṁ teṣhvavasthitaḥ
translation_english: This whole world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest form. All beings exist in Me, but I am not contained within them!
context_english: mayā—by me; tatam—pervaded; idam—this; sarvam—entire; jagat—cosmic manifestation; avyakta-mūrtinā—the unmanifested form; mat-sthāni—in me; sarva-bhūtāni—all living beings; na—not; cha—and; aham—I; teṣhu—in them; avasthitaḥ—dwell

text:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।

भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः।।9.5।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಚ ಮತ್ಸ್ಥಾನಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಪಶ್ಯ ಮೇ ಯೋಗಮೈಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ಭೂತಭೃನ್ನ ಚ ಭೂತಸ್ಥೋ ಮಮಾತ್ಮಾ ಭೂತಭಾವನಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
న చ మత్స్థాని భూతాని పశ్య మే యోగమైశ్వరమ్ |
భూతభృన్న చ భూతస్థో మమాత్మా భూతభావనః || ౫ ||
transliteration:
na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
bhūta-bhṛin na cha bhūta-stho mamātmā bhūta-bhāvanaḥ
translation_english: Neither do the beings dwell in Me. Behold My divine Yoga! I am the sustainer and originator of beings, but My Self is not contained within the beings.

text:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।

तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय।।9.6।।
text_kannada:
ಯಥಾಽಽಕಾಶಸ್ಥಿತೋ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ವಾಯುಃ ಸರ್ವತ್ರಗೋ ಮಹಾನ್ |
ತಥಾ ಸರ್ವಾಣಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಮತ್ಸ್ಥಾನೀತ್ಯುಪಧಾರಯ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
యథాఽఽకాశస్థితో నిత్యం వాయుః సర్వత్రగో మహాన్ |
తథా సర్వాణి భూతాని మత్స్థానీత్యుపధారయ || ౬ ||
transliteration:
yathākāśha-sthito nityaṁ vāyuḥ sarvatra-go mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mat-sthānītyupadhāraya
translation_english: Understand thus that just as the voluminous wind, moving everywhere, is ever present in space, similarly all beings abide in Me.

text:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।

कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्।।9.7।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಿ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ಯಾಂತಿ ಮಾಮಿಕಾಮ್ |
ಕಲ್ಪಕ್ಷಯೇ ಪುನಸ್ತಾನಿ ಕಲ್ಪಾದೌ ವಿಸೃಜಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వభూతాని కౌంతేయ ప్రకృతిం యాంతి మామికామ్ |
కల్పక్షయే పునస్తాని కల్పాదౌ విసృజామ్యహమ్ || ౭ ||
transliteration:
sarva-bhūtāni kaunteya prakṛitiṁ yānti māmikām
kalpa-kṣhaye punas tāni kalpādau visṛijāmyaham
translation_english: O son of Kunti, all the beings at the end of a cycle go back to My Prakrti. At the beginning of a cycle, I project them forth again.
context_english: sarva-bhūtāni—all living beings; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; prakṛitim—primordial material energy; yānti—merge; māmikām—my; kalpa-kṣhaye—at the end of a kalpa; punaḥ—again; tāni—them; kalpa-ādau—at the beginning of a kalpa; visṛijāmi—manifest; aham—I

text:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।

भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्।।9.8।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ಸ್ವಾಮವಷ್ಟಭ್ಯ ವಿಸೃಜಾಮಿ ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ |
ಭೂತಗ್ರಾಮಮಿಮಂ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಮವಶಂ ಪ್ರಕೃತೇರ್ವಶಾತ್ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రకృతిం స్వామవష్టభ్య విసృజామి పునః పునః |
భూతగ్రామమిమం కృత్స్నమవశం ప్రకృతేర్వశాత్ || ౮ ||
transliteration:
prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūta-grāmam imaṁ kṛitsnam avaśhaṁ prakṛiter vaśhāt
translation_english: Keeping My own prakṛti under control, I project forth again and again this multitude of beings, which are powerless due to the influence of their own nature.
context_english: prakṛitim—the material energy; svām—my own; avaṣhṭabhya—presiding over; visṛijāmi—generate; punaḥ punaḥ—again and again; bhūta-grāmam—myriad forms; imam—these; kṛitsnam—all; avaśham—beyond their control; prakṛiteḥ—nature; vaśhāt—force

text:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।

उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु।।9.9।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಚ ಮಾಂ ತಾನಿ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ನಿಬಧ್ನಂತಿ ಧನಂಜಯ |
ಉದಾಸೀನವದಾಸೀನಮಸಕ್ತಂ ತೇಷು ಕರ್ಮಸು || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
న చ మాం తాని కర్మాణి నిబధ్నంతి ధనంజయ |
ఉదాసీనవదాసీనమసక్తం తేషు కర్మసు || ౯ ||
transliteration:
na cha māṁ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
udāsīna-vad āsīnam asaktaṁ teṣhu karmasu
translation_english: O Dhananjaya, those actions do not bind Me, for I remain unconcerned and unattached to them.
context_english: na—none; cha—as; mām—me; tāni—those; karmāṇi—actions; nibadhnanti—bind; dhanañjaya—Arjun, conqueror of wealth; udāsīna-vat—as neutral; āsīnam—situated; asaktam—detached; teṣhu—those; karmasu—actions

text:
मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।

हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते।।9.10।।
text_kannada:
ಮಯಾಽಧ್ಯಕ್ಷೇಣ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಃ ಸೂಯತೇ ಸಚರಾಚರಮ್ |
ಹೇತುನಾಽನೇನ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಜಗದ್ವಿಪರಿವರ್ತತೇ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
మయాఽధ్యక్షేణ ప్రకృతిః సూయతే సచరాచరమ్ |
హేతునాఽనేన కౌంతేయ జగద్విపరివర్తతే || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
mayādhyakṣheṇa prakṛitiḥ sūyate sa-charācharam
hetunānena kaunteya jagad viparivartate
translation_english: Under Me as the supervisor, the Prakrti produces the world of the moving and the non-moving things. Owing to this, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.
context_english: mayā—by me; adhyakṣheṇa—direction; prakṛitiḥ—material energy; sūyate—brings into being; sa—both; chara-acharam—the animate and the inanimate; hetunā—reason; anena—this; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; jagat—the material world; viparivartate—undergoes the changes

text:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।

परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्।।9.11।।
text_kannada:
ಅವಜಾನಂತಿ ಮಾಂ ಮೂಢಾ ಮಾನುಷೀಂ ತನುಮಾಶ್ರಿತಮ್ |
ಪರಂ ಭಾವಮಜಾನಂತೋ ಮಮ ಭೂತಮಹೇಶ್ವರಮ್ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
అవజానంతి మాం మూఢా మానుషీం తనుమాశ్రితమ్ |
పరం భావమజానంతో మమ భూతమహేశ్వరమ్ || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mama bhūta-maheśhvaram
translation_english: Not knowing My supreme nature as the Lord of all beings, foolish people disregard Me, who have taken a human form.
context_english: avajānanti—disregard; mām—me; mūḍhāḥ—dim-witted; mānuṣhīm—human; tanum—form; āśhritam—take on; param—divine; bhāvam—personality; ajānantaḥ—not knowing; mama—my; bhūta—all beings; mahā-īśhvaram—the Supreme Lord

text:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।

राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः।।9.12।।
text_kannada:
ಮೋಘಾಶಾ ಮೋಘಕರ್ಮಾಣೋ ಮೋಘಜ್ಞಾನಾ ವಿಚೇತಸಃ |
ರಾಕ್ಷಸೀಮಾಸುರೀಂ ಚೈವ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಂ ಮೋಹಿನೀಂ ಶ್ರಿತಾಃ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
మోఘాశా మోఘకర్మాణో మోఘజ్ఞానా విచేతసః |
రాక్షసీమాసురీం చైవ ప్రకృతిం మోహినీం శ్రితాః || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
moghāśhā mogha-karmāṇo mogha-jñānā vichetasaḥ
rākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ
translation_english: Possessed of vain hopes, vain actions, vain knowledge, and senselessness, they become verily possessed of the deceptive disposition of fiends and demons.
context_english: mogha-āśhāḥ—of vain hopes; mogha-karmāṇaḥ—of vain actions; mogha-jñānāḥ—of baffled knowledge; vichetasaḥ—deluded; rākṣhasīm—demoniac; āsurīm—atheistic; cha—and; eva—certainly; prakṛitim—material energy; mohinīm—bewildered; śhritāḥ—take shelter

text:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।

भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्।।9.13।।
text_kannada:
ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾನಸ್ತು ಮಾಂ ಪಾರ್ಥ ದೈವೀಂ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಮಾಶ್ರಿತಾಃ |
ಭಜಂತ್ಯನನ್ಯಮನಸೋ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಭೂತಾದಿಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
మహాత్మానస్తు మాం పార్థ దైవీం ప్రకృతిమాశ్రితాః |
భజంత్యనన్యమనసో జ్ఞాత్వా భూతాదిమవ్యయమ్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ
bhajantyananya-manaso jñātvā bhūtādim avyayam
translation_english: O son of Prtha, the noble ones, being possessed of divine nature, surely adore Me with single-mindedness, knowing Me to be the immutable source of all objects.
context_english: mahā-ātmānaḥ—the great souls; tu—but; mām—me; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; daivīm prakṛitim—divine energy; āśhritāḥ—take shelter of; bhajanti—engage in devotion; ananya-manasaḥ—with mind fixed exclusively; jñātvā—knowing; bhūta—all creation; ādim—the origin; avyayam—imperishable

text:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।

नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।।9.14।।
text_kannada:
ಸತತಂ ಕೀರ್ತಯಂತೋ ಮಾಂ ಯತಂತಶ್ಚ ದೃಢವ್ರತಾಃ |
ನಮಸ್ಯಂತಶ್ಚ ಮಾಂ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ನಿತ್ಯಯುಕ್ತಾ ಉಪಾಸತೇ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
సతతం కీర్తయంతో మాం యతంతశ్చ దృఢవ్రతాః |
నమస్యంతశ్చ మాం భక్త్యా నిత్యయుక్తా ఉపాసతే || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
namasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate
translation_english: Always glorifying Me and striving, the men of firm vows worship Me by paying obeisance to Me and being ever endowed with devotion.
context_english: satatam—always; kīrtayantaḥ—singing divine glories; mām—me; yatantaḥ—striving; cha—and; dṛiḍha-vratāḥ—with great determination; namasyantaḥ—humbly bowing down; cha—and; mām—me; bhaktyā—loving devotion; nitya-yuktāḥ—constantly united; upāsate—worship

text:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।

एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्।।9.15।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞಾನಯಜ್ಞೇನ ಚಾಪ್ಯನ್ಯೇ ಯಜಂತೋ ಮಾಮುಪಾಸತೇ |
ಏಕತ್ವೇನ ಪೃಥಕ್ತ್ವೇನ ಬಹುಧಾ ವಿಶ್ವತೋಮುಖಮ್ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞానయజ్ఞేన చాప్యన్యే యజంతో మాముపాసతే |
ఏకత్వేన పృథక్త్వేన బహుధా విశ్వతోముఖమ్ || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
jñāna-yajñena chāpyanye yajanto mām upāsate
ekatvena pṛithaktvena bahudhā viśhvato-mukham
translation_english: Others indeed worship Me by exclusively adoring through the sacrifice of the knowledge of oneness; (others worship Me) in many ways, and (others) as the multiform existing in various forms.
context_english: jñāna-yajñena—yajña of cultivating knowledge; cha—and; api—also; anye—others; yajantaḥ—worship; mām—me; upāsate—worship; ekatvena—undifferentiated oneness; pṛithaktvena—separately; bahudhā—various; viśhwataḥ-mukham—the cosmic form

text:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्।

मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्।।9.16।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂ ಕ್ರತುರಹಂ ಯಜ್ಞಃ ಸ್ವಧಾಽಹಮಹಮೌಷಧಮ್ |
ಮಂತ್ರೋಽಹಮಹಮೇವಾಜ್ಯಮಹಮಗ್ನಿರಹಂ ಹುತಮ್ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
అహం క్రతురహం యజ్ఞః స్వధాఽహమహమౌషధమ్ |
మంత్రోఽహమహమేవాజ్యమహమగ్నిరహం హుతమ్ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham
mantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam
translation_english: I am the ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the oblation, I am the medicinal herb, I am the mantra, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.
context_english: aham—I; kratuḥ—Vedic ritual; aham—I; yajñaḥ—sacrifice; svadhā—oblation; aham—I; aham—I; auṣhadham—medicinal herb; mantraḥ—Vedic mantra; aham—I; aham—I; eva—also; ājyam—clarified butter; aham—I; agniḥ—fire; aham—I; hutam—the act offering;

text:
पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।

वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च।।9.17।।
text_kannada:
ಪಿತಾಽಹಮಸ್ಯ ಜಗತೋ ಮಾತಾ ಧಾತಾ ಪಿತಾಮಹಃ |
ವೇದ್ಯಂ ಪವಿತ್ರಮೋಂಕಾರ ಋಕ್ ಸಾಮ ಯಜುರೇವ ಚ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
పితాఽహమస్య జగతో మాతా ధాతా పితామహః |
వేద్యం పవిత్రమోంకార ఋక్ సామ యజురేవ చ || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha
translation_english: Of this world, I am the father, mother, ordainer, and grandfather; I am the knowable, the sanctifier, the syllable Om, as well as the Rk, Sama, and Yajus.
context_english: pitā—Father; aham—I; asya—of this; jagataḥ—universe; mātā—Mother; dhātā—Sustainer; pitāmahaḥ—Grandsire; vedyam—the goal of knowledge; pavitram—the purifier; om-kāra—the sacred syllable Om; ṛik—the Rig Veda; sāma—the Sama Veda; yajuḥ—the Yajur Veda; eva—also; cha—and

text:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।

प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्।।9.18।।
text_kannada:
ಗತಿರ್ಭರ್ತಾ ಪ್ರಭುಃ ಸಾಕ್ಷೀ ನಿವಾಸಃ ಶರಣಂ ಸುಹೃತ್ |
ಪ್ರಭವಃ ಪ್ರಲಯಃ ಸ್ಥಾನಂ ನಿಧಾನಂ ಬೀಜಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
గతిర్భర్తా ప్రభుః సాక్షీ నివాసః శరణం సుహృత్ |
ప్రభవః ప్రలయః స్థానం నిధానం బీజమవ్యయమ్ || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam
translation_english: I am the fruit of actions, the nourisher, the Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, end, foundation, store, and the imperishable seed.
context_english: gatiḥ—the supreme goal; bhartā—sustainer; prabhuḥ—master; sākṣhī—witness; nivāsaḥ—abode; śharaṇam—shelter; su-hṛit—friend; prabhavaḥ—the origin; pralayaḥ—dissolution; sthānam—store house; nidhānam—resting place; bījam—seed; avyayam—imperishable

text:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।

अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन।।9.19।।
text_kannada:
ತಪಾಮ್ಯಹಮಹಂ ವರ್ಷಂ ನಿಗೃಹ್ಣಾಮ್ಯುತ್ಸೃಜಾಮಿ ಚ |
ಅಮೃತಂ ಚೈವ ಮೃತ್ಯುಶ್ಚ ಸದಸಚ್ಚಾಹಮರ್ಜುನ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
తపామ్యహమహం వర్షం నిగృహ్ణామ్యుత్సృజామి చ |
అమృతం చైవ మృత్యుశ్చ సదసచ్చాహమర్జున || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
tapāmyaham ahaṁ varṣhaṁ nigṛihṇāmyutsṛijāmi cha
amṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna
translation_english: O Arjuna, I give heat, I withhold and pour down rain; I am verily the nectar, and also death, existence, and non-existence.
context_english: tapāmi—radiate heat; aham—I; aham—I; varṣham—rain; nigṛihṇāmi—withhold; utsṛijāmi—send forth; cha—and; amṛitam—immortality; cha—and; eva—also; mṛityuḥ—death; cha—and; sat—eternal spirit; asat—temporary matter; cha—and; aham—I; arjuna—Arjun

text:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा

यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।

ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक

मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्।।9.20।।
text_kannada:
ತ್ರೈವಿದ್ಯಾ ಮಾಂ ಸೋಮಪಾಃ ಪೂತಪಾಪಾ |
ಯಜ್ಞೈರಿಷ್ಟ್ವಾ ಸ್ವರ್ಗತಿಂ ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥಯಂತೇ |
ತೇ ಪುಣ್ಯಮಾಸಾದ್ಯ ಸುರೇಂದ್ರಲೋಕ |
ಮಶ್ನಂತಿ ದಿವ್ಯಾಂದಿವಿ ದೇವಭೋಗಾನ್ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
త్రైవిద్యా మాం సోమపాః పూతపాపా |
యజ్ఞైరిష్ట్వా స్వర్గతిం ప్రార్థయంతే |
తే పుణ్యమాసాద్య సురేంద్రలోక |
మశ్నంతి దివ్యాందివి దేవభోగాన్ || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
trai-vidyā māṁ soma-pāḥ pūta-pāpā
yajñair iṣhṭvā svar-gatiṁ prārthayante
te puṇyam āsādya surendra-lokam
aśhnanti divyān divi deva-bhogān
translation_english: Those who are versed in the Vedas, who drink Soma and are purified of sin, pray for the heavenly goal by worshipping Me through sacrifices. Having reached the place (world) of the king of gods, which is the result of righteousness, they enjoy the divine pleasure of the gods in heaven.
context_english: trai-vidyāḥ—the science of karm kāṇḍ (Vedic Rituals); mām—me; soma-pāḥ—drinkers of the Soma juice; pūta—purified; pāpāḥ—sins; yajñaiḥ—through sacrifices; iṣhṭvā—worship; svaḥ-gatim—way to the abode of the king of heaven; prārthayante—seek; te—they; puṇyam—pious; āsādya—attain; sura-indra—of Indra; lokam—abode; aśhnanti—enjoy; divyān—celestial; divi—in heaven; deva-bhogān—the pleasures of the celestial gods

text:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं

क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।

एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना

गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते।।9.21।।
text_kannada:
ತೇ ತಂ ಭುಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಲೋಕಂ ವಿಶಾಲಂ |
ಕ್ಷೀಣೇ ಪುಣ್ಯೇ ಮರ್ತ್ಯಲೋಕಂ ವಿಶಂತಿ |
ಏವ ತ್ರಯೀಧರ್ಮಮನುಪ್ರಪನ್ನಾ |
ಗತಾಗತಂ ಕಾಮಕಾಮಾ ಲಭಂತೇ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
తే తం భుక్త్వా స్వర్గలోకం విశాలం |
క్షీణే పుణ్యే మర్త్యలోకం విశంతి |
ఏవ త్రయీధర్మమనుప్రపన్నా |
గతాగతం కామకామా లభంతే || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
te taṁ bhuktvā swarga-lokaṁ viśhālaṁ
kṣhīṇe puṇye martya-lokaṁ viśhanti
evaṁ trayī-dharmam anuprapannā
gatāgataṁ kāma-kāmā labhante
translation_english: After having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they enter into the human world upon the exhaustion of their merit. Thus, those who follow the rites and duties prescribed in the three Vedas, and are desirous of pleasures, attain the state of coming and going.
context_english: te—they; tam—that; bhuktvā—having enjoyed; swarga-lokam—heaven; viśhālam—vast; kṣhīṇe—at the exhaustion of; puṇye—stock of merits; martya-lokam—to the earthly plane; viśhanti—return; evam—thus; trayī dharmam—the karm-kāṇḍ portion of the three Vedas; anuprapannāḥ—follow; gata-āgatam—repeated coming and going; kāma-kāmāḥ—desiring objects of enjoyments; labhante—attain

text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।

तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्।।9.22।।
text_kannada:
ಅನನ್ಯಾಶ್ಚಿಂತಯಂತೋ ಮಾಂ ಯೇ ಜನಾಃ ಪರ್ಯುಪಾಸತೇ |
ತೇಷಾಂ ನಿತ್ಯಾಭಿಯುಕ್ತಾನಾಂ ಯೋಗಕ್ಷೇಮಂ ವಹಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
అనన్యాశ్చింతయంతో మాం యే జనాః పర్యుపాసతే |
తేషాం నిత్యాభియుక్తానాం యోగక్షేమం వహామ్యహమ్ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣhāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣhemaṁ vahāmyaham
translation_english: Those persons who, becoming non-different from Me and meditating, worship Me everywhere, for them, who are ever attached to Me, I arrange for securing what they lack and preserving what they have.
context_english: ananyāḥ—always; chintayantaḥ—think of; mām—me; ye—those who; janāḥ—persons; paryupāsate—worship exclusively; teṣhām—of them; nitya abhiyuktānām—who are always absorbed; yoga—supply spiritual assets; kṣhemam—protect spiritual assets; vahāmi—carry; aham—I

text:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।

तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्।।9.23।।
text_kannada:
ಯೇಽಪ್ಯನ್ಯದೇವತಾ ಭಕ್ತಾ ಯಜಂತೇ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾಽನ್ವಿತಾಃ |
ತೇಽಪಿ ಮಾಮೇವ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಯಜಂತ್ಯವಿಧಿಪೂರ್ವಕಮ್ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
యేఽప్యన్యదేవతా భక్తా యజంతే శ్రద్ధయాఽన్వితాః |
తేఽపి మామేవ కౌంతేయ యజంత్యవిధిపూర్వకమ్ || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
ye ’pyanya-devatā-bhaktā yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
te ’pi mām eva kaunteya yajantyavidhi-pūrvakam
translation_english: Even those who, being devoted to other deities and endowed with faith, worship them, they also, O son of Kunti, worship Me alone, though following the wrong method.
context_english: ye—those who; api—although; anya—other; devatā—celestial gods; bhaktāḥ—devotees; yajante—worship; śhraddhayā anvitāḥ—faithfully; te—they; api—also; mām—me; eva—only; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; yajanti—worship; avidhi-pūrvakam—by the wrong method

text:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।

न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते।।9.24।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂ ಹಿ ಸರ್ವಯಜ್ಞಾನಾಂ ಭೋಕ್ತಾ ಚ ಪ್ರಭುರೇವ ಚ |
ನ ತು ಮಾಮಭಿಜಾನಂತಿ ತತ್ತ್ವೇನಾತಶ್ಚ್ಯವಂತಿ ತೇ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
అహం హి సర్వయజ్ఞానాం భోక్తా చ ప్రభురేవ చ |
న తు మామభిజానంతి తత్త్వేనాతశ్చ్యవంతి తే || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha
na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te
translation_english: Indeed, I am the enjoyer and the Lord of all sacrifices, but they do not know Me truly. Therefore, they fall.
context_english: aham—I; hi—verily; sarva—of all; yajñānām—sacrifices; bhoktā—the enjoyer; cha—and; prabhuḥ—the Lord; eva—only; cha—and; na—not; tu—but; mām—me; abhijānanti—realize; tattvena—divine nature; ataḥ—therefore; chyavanti—fall down (wander in samsara); te—they

text:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।

भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्।।9.25।।
text_kannada:
ಯಾಂತಿ ದೇವವ್ರತಾ ದೇವಾನ್ ಪಿತೃನ್ಯಾಂತಿ ಪಿತೃವ್ರತಾಃ |
ಭೂತಾನಿ ಯಾಂತಿ ಭೂತೇಜ್ಯಾ ಯಾಂತಿ ಮದ್ಯಾಜಿನೋಽಪಿ ಮಾಮ್ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
యాంతి దేవవ్రతా దేవాన్ పితృన్యాంతి పితృవ్రతాః |
భూతాని యాంతి భూతేజ్యా యాంతి మద్యాజినోఽపి మామ్ || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām
translation_english: Those who worship the gods reach the gods; the worshippers of the manes go to the manes; the devotees of the Beings reach the Beings; and those who worship Me come to Me.
context_english: yānti—go; deva-vratāḥ—worshipers of celestial gods; devān—amongst the celestial gods; pitṝīn—to the ancestors; yānti—go; pitṛi-vratā—worshippers of ancestors; bhūtāni—to the ghosts; yānti—go; bhūta-ijyāḥ—worshippers of ghosts; yānti—go; mat—my; yājinaḥ—devotees; api—and; mām—to me

text:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।

तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः।।9.26।।
text_kannada:
ಪತ್ರಂ ಪುಷ್ಪಂ ಫಲಂ ತೋಯಂ ಯೋ ಮೇ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಪ್ರಯಚ್ಛತಿ |
ತದಹಂ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯುಪಹೃತಮಶ್ನಾಮಿ ಪ್ರಯತಾತ್ಮನಃ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
పత్రం పుష్పం ఫలం తోయం యో మే భక్త్యా ప్రయచ్ఛతి |
తదహం భక్త్యుపహృతమశ్నామి ప్రయతాత్మనః || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati
tadahaṁ bhaktyupahṛitam aśhnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
translation_english: Whoever offers Me with devotion—a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water—I accept that gift of the pure-hearted man which has been presented devotionally.
context_english: patram—a leaf; puṣhpam—a flower; phalam—a fruit; toyam—water; yaḥ—who; me—to me; bhaktyā—with devotion; prayachchhati—offers; tat—that; aham—I; bhakti-upahṛitam—offered with devotion; aśhnāmi—partake; prayata-ātmanaḥ—one in pure consciousness

text:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।

यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्।।9.27।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ಕರೋಷಿ ಯದಶ್ನಾಸಿ ಯಜ್ಜುಹೋಷಿ ದದಾಸಿ ಯತ್ |
ಯತ್ತಪಸ್ಯಸಿ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ತತ್ಕುರುಷ್ವ ಮದರ್ಪಣಮ್ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
యత్కరోషి యదశ్నాసి యజ్జుహోషి దదాసి యత్ |
యత్తపస్యసి కౌంతేయ తత్కురుష్వ మదర్పణమ్ || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam
translation_english: O son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer as a sacrifice, whatever you give, and whatever austerities you undertake—all of that you offer to Me.
context_english: yat—whatever; karoṣhi—you do; yat—whatever; aśhnāsi—you eat; yat—whatever; juhoṣhi—offer to the sacred fire; dadāsi—bestow as a gift; yat—whatever; yat—whatever; tapasyasi—austerities you perform; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; tat—them; kuruṣhva—do; mad arpaṇam—as an offering to me

text:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।

संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि।।9.28।।
text_kannada:
ಶುಭಾಶುಭಫಲೈರೇವಂ ಮೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇ ಕರ್ಮಬಂಧನೈಃ |
ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಯೋಗಯುಕ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿಮುಕ್ತೋ ಮಾಮುಪೈಷ್ಯಸಿ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
శుభాశుభఫలైరేవం మోక్ష్యసే కర్మబంధనైః |
సంన్యాసయోగయుక్తాత్మా విముక్తో మాముపైష్యసి || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
śhubhāśhubha-phalair evaṁ mokṣhyase karma-bandhanaiḥ
sannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣhyasi
translation_english: Thus, you will become free from bondage in the form of actions which are productive of good and bad results. Having your mind imbued with the yoga of renunciation and becoming free, you will attain Me.
context_english: śhubha aśhubha phalaiḥ—from good and bad results; evam—thus; mokṣhyase—you shall be freed; karma—work; bandhanaiḥ—from the bondage; sanyāsa-yoga—renunciation of selfishness; yukta-ātmā—having the mind attached to me; vimuktaḥ—liberated; mām—to me; upaiṣhyasi—you shall reach

text:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।

ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्।।9.29।।
text_kannada:
ಸಮೋಽಹಂ ಸರ್ವಭೂತೇಷು ನ ಮೇ ದ್ವೇಷ್ಯೋಽಸ್ತಿ ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಯೇ ಭಜಂತಿ ತು ಮಾಂ ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಮಯಿ ತೇ ತೇಷು ಚಾಪ್ಯಹಮ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
సమోఽహం సర్వభూతేషు న మే ద్వేష్యోఽస్తి న ప్రియః |
యే భజంతి తు మాం భక్త్యా మయి తే తేషు చాప్యహమ్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham
translation_english: I am impartial towards all beings; to Me there is none detestable or none dear. But those who worship Me with devotion, they exist in Me, and I too exist in them.
context_english: samaḥ—equally disposed; aham—I; sarva-bhūteṣhu—to all living beings; na—no one; me—to me; dveṣhyaḥ—inimical; asti—is; na—not; priyaḥ—dear; ye—who; bhajanti—worship with love; tu—but; mām—me; bhaktyā—with devotion; mayi—reside in me; te—such persons; teṣhu—in them; cha—and; api—also; aham—I

text:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।

साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः।।9.30।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪಿ ಚೇತ್ಸುದುರಾಚಾರೋ ಭಜತೇ ಮಾಮನನ್ಯಭಾಕ್ |
ಸಾಧುರೇವ ಸ ಮಂತವ್ಯಃ ಸಮ್ಯಗ್ವ್ಯವಸಿತೋ ಹಿ ಸಃ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
అపి చేత్సుదురాచారో భజతే మామనన్యభాక్ |
సాధురేవ స మంతవ్యః సమ్యగ్వ్యవసితో హి సః || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ
translation_english: Even if a man of very bad conduct worships Me with single-minded devotion, he is to be considered truly good; for he has rightly resolved.
context_english: api—even; chet—if; su-durāchāraḥ—the vilest sinners; bhajate—worship; mām—me; ananya-bhāk—exclusive devotion; sādhuḥ—righteous; eva—certainly; saḥ—that person; mantavyaḥ—is to be considered; samyak—properly; vyavasitaḥ—resolve; hi—certainly; saḥ—that person

text:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।

कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति।।9.31।।
text_kannada:
ಕ್ಷಿಪ್ರಂ ಭವತಿ ಧರ್ಮಾತ್ಮಾ ಶಶ್ವಚ್ಛಾಂತಿಂ ನಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ |
ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಪ್ರತಿಜಾನೀಹಿ ನ ಮೇ ಭಕ್ತಃ ಪ್ರಣಶ್ಯತಿ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
క్షిప్రం భవతి ధర్మాత్మా శశ్వచ్ఛాంతిం నిగచ్ఛతి |
కౌంతేయ ప్రతిజానీహి న మే భక్తః ప్రణశ్యతి || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
kṣhipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śhaśhvach-chhāntiṁ nigachchhati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati
translation_english: He soon becomes possessed of a virtuous mind; he attains everlasting peace. Do you proclaim boldly, O son of Kunti, that My devotee will not be ruined.
context_english: kṣhipram—quickly; bhavati—become; dharma-ātmā—virtuous; śhaśhvat-śhāntim—lasting peace; nigachchhati—attain; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; pratijānīhi—declare; na—never; me—my; bhaktaḥ—devotee; praṇaśhyati—perishes

text:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।

स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्।।9.32।।
text_kannada:
ಮಾಂ ಹಿ ಪಾರ್ಥ ವ್ಯಪಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ಯೇಽಪಿ ಸ್ಯುಃ ಪಾಪಯೋನಯಃ |
ಸ್ತ್ರಿಯೋ ವೈಶ್ಯಾಸ್ತಥಾ ಶೂದ್ರಾಸ್ತೇಽಪಿ ಯಾಂತಿ ಪರಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
మాం హి పార్థ వ్యపాశ్రిత్య యేఽపి స్యుః పాపయోనయః |
స్త్రియో వైశ్యాస్తథా శూద్రాస్తేఽపి యాంతి పరాం గతిమ్ || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim
translation_english: For, O son of Prtha, even those who are born of sin-women, Vaisyas, as well as Sudras—[S.'s construction of this portion is: women, Vaisyas as well as Sudras, and even others who are born of sin (i.e., those who are born low and are of vile deeds, viz Mlecchas, Pukkasas and others). M.S. also takes papa-yonayah (born of sin) as a separate phrase, and classifies women and others only as those darred from Vedic study, etc.-Tr.]—even they reach the highest Goal by taking shelter under Me.
context_english: mām—in me; hi—certainly; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; vyapāśhritya—take refuge; ye—who; api—even; syuḥ—may be; pāpa yonayaḥ—of low birth; striyaḥ—women; vaiśhyāḥ—mercantile people; tathā—and; śhūdrāḥ—manual workers; te api—even they; yānti—go; parām—the supreme; gatim—destination

text:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।

अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्।।9.33।।
text_kannada:
ಕಿಂ ಪುನರ್ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಾಃ ಪುಣ್ಯಾ ಭಕ್ತಾ ರಾಜರ್ಷಯಸ್ತಥಾ |
ಅನಿತ್ಯಮಸುಖಂ ಲೋಕಮಿಮಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಭಜಸ್ವ ಮಾಮ್ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
కిం పునర్బ్రాహ్మణాః పుణ్యా భక్తా రాజర్షయస్తథా |
అనిత్యమసుఖం లోకమిమం ప్రాప్య భజస్వ మామ్ || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā
anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām
translation_english: What of the holy Brahmanas and devoted, wise sages? Having come to this fleeting, miserable world, worship Me.
context_english: kim—what; punaḥ—then; brāhmaṇāḥ—sages; puṇyāḥ—meritorius; bhaktāḥ—devotees; rāja-ṛiṣhayaḥ—saintly kings; tathā—and; anityam—transient; asukham—joyless; lokam—world; imam—this; prāpya—having achieved; bhajasva—engage in devotion; mām—unto me

text:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।

मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः।।9.34।।
text_kannada:
ಮನ್ಮನಾ ಭವ ಮದ್ಭಕ್ತೋ ಮದ್ಯಾಜೀ ಮಾಂ ನಮಸ್ಕುರು |
ಮಾಮೇವೈಷ್ಯಸಿ ಯುಕ್ತ್ವೈವಮಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ಮತ್ಪರಾಯಣಃ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
మన్మనా భవ మద్భక్తో మద్యాజీ మాం నమస్కురు |
మామేవైష్యసి యుక్త్వైవమాత్మానం మత్పరాయణః || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṁ mat-parāyaṇaḥ
translation_english: Having your mind fixed on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. By concentrating your mind and accepting Me as the supreme goal, you shall surely attain Me, who am thus the Self.
context_english: mat-manāḥ—always think of me; bhava—be; mat—my; bhaktaḥ—devotee; mat—my; yājī—worshipper; mām—to me; namaskuru—offer obeisances; mām—to me; eva—certainly; eṣhyasi—you will come; yuktvā—united with me; evam—thus; ātmānam—your mind and body; mat-parāyaṇaḥ—having dedicated to me

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।

यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया।।10.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಭೂಯ ಏವ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ಶ್ರೃಣು ಮೇ ಪರಮಂ ವಚಃ |
ಯತ್ತೇಽಹಂ ಪ್ರೀಯಮಾಣಾಯ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಹಿತಕಾಮ್ಯಯಾ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
భూయ ఏవ మహాబాహో శ్రృణు మే పరమం వచః |
యత్తేఽహం ప్రీయమాణాయ వక్ష్యామి హితకామ్యయా || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bhūya eva mahā-bāho śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
yatte ’haṁ prīyamāṇāya vakṣhyāmi hita-kāmyayā
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, O mighty-armed one, listen once more to My supreme utterance, which I, wishing for your welfare, shall speak to you who take delight in it.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Blessed Lord said; bhūyaḥ—again; eva—verily; mahā-bāho—mighty armed one; śhṛiṇu—hear; me—my; paramam—divine; vachaḥ—teachings; yat—which; te—to you; aham—I; prīyamāṇāya—you are my beloved confidant; vakṣhyāmi—say; hita-kāmyayā—for desiring your welfare

text:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।

अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः।।10.2।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಮೇ ವಿದುಃ ಸುರಗಣಾಃ ಪ್ರಭವಂ ನ ಮಹರ್ಷಯಃ |
ಅಹಮಾದಿರ್ಹಿ ದೇವಾನಾಂ ಮಹರ್ಷೀಣಾಂ ಚ ಸರ್ವಶಃ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
న మే విదుః సురగణాః ప్రభవం న మహర్షయః |
అహమాదిర్హి దేవానాం మహర్షీణాం చ సర్వశః || ౨ ||
transliteration:
na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ
aham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣhīṇāṁ cha sarvaśhaḥ
translation_english: Neither the gods nor the great sages know My majesty, for I am the source of them all in all respects.
context_english: na—neither; me—my; viduḥ—know; sura-gaṇāḥ—the celestial gods; prabhavam—origin; na—nor; mahā-ṛiṣhayaḥ—the great sages; aham—I; ādiḥ—the source; hi—certainly; devānām—of the celestial gods; mahā-ṛiṣhīṇām—of the great seers; cha—also; sarvaśhaḥ—in every way

text:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।

असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।।10.3।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋ ಮಾಮಜಮನಾದಿಂ ಚ ವೇತ್ತಿ ಲೋಕಮಹೇಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ಅಸಮ್ಮೂಢಃ ಸ ಮರ್ತ್ಯೇಷು ಸರ್ವಪಾಪೈಃ ಪ್ರಮುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
యో మామజమనాదిం చ వేత్తి లోకమహేశ్వరమ్ |
అసమ్మూఢః స మర్త్యేషు సర్వపాపైః ప్రముచ్యతే || ౩ ||
transliteration:
yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣhu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramuchyate
translation_english: He who knows Me—the birthless, beginningless, and great Lord of the worlds—he, the undeluded one among mortals, becomes freed from all sins.
context_english: verseyaḥ—who; mām—me; ajam—unborn; anādim—beginningless; cha—and; vetti—know; loka—of the universe; mahā-īśhvaram—the Supreme Lord; asammūḍhaḥ—undeluded; saḥ—they; martyeṣhu—among mortals; sarva-pāpaiḥ—from all evils; pramuchyate—are freed from-3

text:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।

सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च।।10.4।।
text_kannada:
ಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ಜ್ಞಾನಮಸಂಮೋಹಃ ಕ್ಷಮಾ ಸತ್ಯಂ ದಮಃ ಶಮಃ |
ಸುಖಂ ದುಃಖಂ ಭವೋಽಭಾವೋ ಭಯಂ ಚಾಭಯಮೇವ ಚ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
బుద్ధిర్జ్ఞానమసంమోహః క్షమా సత్యం దమః శమః |
సుఖం దుఃఖం భవోఽభావో భయం చాభయమేవ చ || ౪ ||
transliteration:
buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ
sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo ’bhāvo bhayaṁ chābhayameva cha
translation_english: Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, control of the external organs, control of the internal organs, happiness, sorrow, birth, death, and fearlessness;
context_english: buddhiḥ—intellect; jñānam—knowledge; asammohaḥ—clarity of thought; kṣhamā—forgiveness; satyam—truthfulness; damaḥ—control over the senses; śhamaḥ—control of the mind; sukham—joy; duḥkham—sorrow; bhavaḥ—birth; abhāvaḥ—death; bhayam—fear; cha—and; abhayam—courage; eva—certainly; cha—and;

text:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।

भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः।।10.5।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಿಂಸಾ ಸಮತಾ ತುಷ್ಟಿಸ್ತಪೋ ದಾನಂ ಯಶೋಽಯಶಃ |
ಭವಂತಿ ಭಾವಾ ಭೂತಾನಾಂ ಮತ್ತ ಏವ ಪೃಥಗ್ವಿಧಾಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
అహింసా సమతా తుష్టిస్తపో దానం యశోఽయశః |
భవంతి భావా భూతానాం మత్త ఏవ పృథగ్విధాః || ౫ ||
transliteration: ahiṁsā   samatā  tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ   yaśo    'yaśaḥ  bhavanti    bhāvā   bhūtānāṁ    matta   eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ
translation_english: Non-injury, equanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame, and infamy—these different dispositions of beings spring from Me alone.
context_english: ahiṁsā—nonviolence;    samatā—equilibrium; tuṣṭiḥ—satisfaction;    tapaḥ—penance;  dānam—charity;  yaśaḥ—fame; ayaśaḥ—infamy;  bhavanti—become;    bhāvāḥ—natures;     bhūtānām—of living  entities;   mattaḥ—from Me; eva—certainly;  pṛthakvidhāḥ—differently    arranged.

text:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।

मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः।।10.6।।
text_kannada:
ಮಹರ್ಷಯಃ ಸಪ್ತ ಪೂರ್ವೇ ಚತ್ವಾರೋ ಮನವಸ್ತಥಾ |
ಮದ್ಭಾವಾ ಮಾನಸಾ ಜಾತಾ ಯೇಷಾಂ ಲೋಕ ಇಮಾಃ ಪ್ರಜಾಃ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
మహర్షయః సప్త పూర్వే చత్వారో మనవస్తథా |
మద్భావా మానసా జాతా యేషాం లోక ఇమాః ప్రజాః || ౬ ||
transliteration:
maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā
mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣhāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
translation_english: The seven great sages, as well as the four Manus of ancient days, from whom all these creatures in the world have descended, had their thoughts fixed on Me, and they were born from My mind.
context_english: mahā-ṛiṣhayaḥ—the great Sages; sapta—seven; pūrve—before; chatvāraḥ—four; manavaḥ—Manus; tathā—also; mat bhāvāḥ—are born from me; mānasāḥ—mind; jātāḥ—born; yeṣhām—from them; loke—in the world; imāḥ—all these; prajāḥ—people

text:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः।।10.7।।
text_kannada:
ಏತಾಂ ವಿಭೂತಿಂ ಯೋಗಂ ಚ ಮಮ ಯೋ ವೇತ್ತಿ ತತ್ತ್ವತಃ |
ಸೋಽವಿಕಂಪೇನ ಯೋಗೇನ ಯುಜ್ಯತೇ ನಾತ್ರ ಸಂಶಯಃ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఏతాం విభూతిం యోగం చ మమ యో వేత్తి తత్త్వతః |
సోఽవికంపేన యోగేన యుజ్యతే నాత్ర సంశయః || ౭ ||
transliteration:
etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so ’vikampena yogena yujyate nātra sanśhayaḥ
translation_english: One who knows truly this majesty and yoga of Mine, he becomes imbued with unwavering yoga. There is no doubt about it.
context_english: etām—these; vibhūtim—glories; yogam—divine powers; cha—and; mama—my; yaḥ—those who; vetti—know; tattvataḥ—in truth; saḥ—they; avikalpena—unwavering; yogena—in bhakti yog; yujyate—becomes united; na—never; atra—here; sanśhayaḥ—doubt

text:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।

इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.8।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂ ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಪ್ರಭವೋ ಮತ್ತಃ ಸರ್ವಂ ಪ್ರವರ್ತತೇ |
ಇತಿ ಮತ್ವಾ ಭಜಂತೇ ಮಾಂ ಬುಧಾ ಭಾವಸಮನ್ವಿತಾಃ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
అహం సర్వస్య ప్రభవో మత్తః సర్వం ప్రవర్తతే |
ఇతి మత్వా భజంతే మాం బుధా భావసమన్వితాః || ౮ ||
transliteration:
ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ
translation_english: I am the origin of all; everything moves on due to Me. Realizing this, the wise ones, filled with fervor, adore Me.
context_english: aham—I; sarvasya—of all creation; prabhavaḥ—the origin of; mattaḥ—from me; sarvam—everything; pravartate—proceeds; iti—thus; matvā—having known; bhajante—worship; mām—me; budhāḥ—the wise; bhāva-samanvitāḥ—endowed with great faith and devotion

text:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।

कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च।।10.9।।
text_kannada:
ಮಚ್ಚಿತ್ತಾ ಮದ್ಗತಪ್ರಾಣಾ ಬೋಧಯಂತಃ ಪರಸ್ಪರಮ್ |
ಕಥಯಂತಶ್ಚ ಮಾಂ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ತುಷ್ಯಂತಿ ಚ ರಮಂತಿ ಚ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
మచ్చిత్తా మద్గతప్రాణా బోధయంతః పరస్పరమ్ |
కథయంతశ్చ మాం నిత్యం తుష్యంతి చ రమంతి చ || ౯ ||
transliteration:
mach-chittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam
kathayantaśh cha māṁ nityaṁ tuṣhyanti cha ramanti cha
translation_english: With their minds fixed on Me, dedicating their lives to Me, enlightening one another, and always speaking of Me, they derive satisfaction and rejoice.
context_english: mat-chittāḥ—those with minds fixed on me; mat-gata-prāṇāḥ—those who have surrendered their lives to me; bodhayantaḥ—enlightening (with divine knowledge of God); parasparam—one another; kathayantaḥ—speaking; cha—and; mām—about me; nityam—continously; tuṣhyanti—satisfaction; cha—and; ramanti—(they) delight; cha—also

text:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।

ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते।।10.10।।
text_kannada:
ತೇಷಾಂ ಸತತಯುಕ್ತಾನಾಂ ಭಜತಾಂ ಪ್ರೀತಿಪೂರ್ವಕಮ್ |
ದದಾಮಿ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯೋಗಂ ತಂ ಯೇನ ಮಾಮುಪಯಾಂತಿ ತೇ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
తేషాం సతతయుక్తానాం భజతాం ప్రీతిపూర్వకమ్ |
దదామి బుద్ధియోగం తం యేన మాముపయాంతి తే || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
teṣhāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam
dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te
translation_english: To those who are ever devoted and worship Me with love, I grant the possession of wisdom that leads them to Me.
context_english: teṣhām—to them; satata-yuktānām—ever steadfast; bhajatām—who engage in devotion; prīti-pūrvakam—with love; dadāmi—I give; buddhi-yogam—divine knowledge; tam—that; yena—by which; mām—to me; upayānti—come; te—they

text:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।

नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता।।10.11।।
text_kannada:
ತೇಷಾಮೇವಾನುಕಂಪಾರ್ಥಮಹಮಜ್ಞಾನಜಂ ತಮಃ |
ನಾಶಯಾಮ್ಯಾತ್ಮಭಾವಸ್ಥೋ ಜ್ಞಾನದೀಪೇನ ಭಾಸ್ವತಾ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
తేషామేవానుకంపార్థమహమజ్ఞానజం తమః |
నాశయామ్యాత్మభావస్థో జ్ఞానదీపేన భాస్వతా || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
teṣhām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṁ tamaḥ
nāśhayāmyātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā
translation_english: Out of compassion for them alone, I, residing in their hearts, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.
context_english: teṣhām—for them; eva—only; anukampā-artham—out of compassion; aham—I; ajñāna-jam—born of ignorance; tamaḥ—darkness; nāśhayāmi—destroy; ātma-bhāva—within their hearts; sthaḥ—dwelling; jñāna—of knowledge; dīpena—with the lamp; bhāsvatā—luminous

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।

पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्।।10.12।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಪರಂ ಧಾಮ ಪವಿತ್ರಂ ಪರಮಂ ಭವಾನ್ |
ಪುರುಷಂ ಶಾಶ್ವತಂ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾದಿದೇವಮಜಂ ವಿಭುಮ್ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
పరం బ్రహ్మ పరం ధామ పవిత్రం పరమం భవాన్ |
పురుషం శాశ్వతం దివ్యమాదిదేవమజం విభుమ్ || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān
puruṣhaṁ śhāśhvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum
translation_english: Arjuna said, "You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages, as well as the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', they are still named separately due to their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself indeed tell me this."
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; param—Supreme; brahma—Brahman; param—Supreme; dhāma—Abode; pavitram—purifier; paramam—Supreme; bhavān—you; puruṣham—personality; śhāśhvatam—Eternal; divyam—Divine; ādi-devam—the Primal Being; ajam—the Unborn; vibhum—the Great;

text:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।

असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे।।10.13।।
text_kannada:
ಆಹುಸ್ತ್ವಾಮೃಷಯಃ ಸರ್ವೇ ದೇವರ್ಷಿರ್ನಾರದಸ್ತಥಾ |
ಅಸಿತೋ ದೇವಲೋ ವ್ಯಾಸಃ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಚೈವ ಬ್ರವೀಷಿ ಮೇ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
ఆహుస్త్వామృషయః సర్వే దేవర్షిర్నారదస్తథా |
అసితో దేవలో వ్యాసః స్వయం చైవ బ్రవీషి మే || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ chaiva bravīṣhi me
translation_english: Arjuna said, "You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages, as well as the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', they are still named separately due to their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself indeed tell me this."
context_english: āhuḥ—(they) declare; tvām—you; ṛiṣhayaḥ—sages; sarve—all; deva-ṛiṣhiḥ-nāradaḥ—devarṣhi Narad; tathā—also; asitaḥ—Asit; devalaḥ—Deval; vyāsaḥ—Vyās; svayam—personally; cha—and; eva—even; bravīṣhī—you are declaring; me—to me

text:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।

न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः।।10.14।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಮೇತದೃತಂ ಮನ್ಯೇ ಯನ್ಮಾಂ ವದಸಿ ಕೇಶವ |
ನ ಹಿ ತೇ ಭಗವನ್ ವ್ಯಕ್ಿತಂ ವಿದುರ್ದೇವಾ ನ ದಾನವಾಃ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వమేతదృతం మన్యే యన్మాం వదసి కేశవ |
న హి తే భగవన్ వ్యక్ితం విదుర్దేవా న దానవాః || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava
na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ
translation_english: O Kesava, I accept as true all that You have told me. Certainly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons can comprehend Your glory.
context_english: sarvam—everything; etat—this; ṛitam—truth; manye—I accept; yat—which; mām—me; vadasi—you tell; keśhava—Shree Krishna, the killer of the demon named Keshi; na—neither; hi—verily; te—your; bhagavan—the Supreme Lord; vyaktim—personality; viduḥ—can understand; devāḥ—the celestial gods; na—nor; dānavāḥ—the demons

text:
स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।

भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते।।10.15।।
text_kannada:
ಸ್ವಯಮೇವಾತ್ಮನಾಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ವೇತ್ಥ ತ್ವಂ ಪುರುಷೋತ್ತಮ |
ಭೂತಭಾವನ ಭೂತೇಶ ದೇವದೇವ ಜಗತ್ಪತೇ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
స్వయమేవాత్మనాఽత్మానం వేత్థ త్వం పురుషోత్తమ |
భూతభావన భూతేశ దేవదేవ జగత్పతే || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
swayam evātmanātmānaṁ vettha tvaṁ puruṣhottama
bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśha deva-deva jagat-pate
translation_english: O Supreme Person, Creator of beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the worlds, You alone know Yourself by Yourself.
context_english: swayam—yourself; eva—indeed; ātmanā—by yourself; ātmānam—yourself; vettha—know; tvam—you; puruṣha-uttama—the Supreme Personality; bhūta-bhāvana—the Creator of all beings; bhūta-īśha—the Lord of everything; deva-deva—the God of gods; jagat-pate—the Lord of the universe

text:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि।।10.16।।
text_kannada:
ವಕ್ತುಮರ್ಹಸ್ಯಶೇಷೇಣ ದಿವ್ಯಾ ಹ್ಯಾತ್ಮವಿಭೂತಯಃ |
ಯಾಭಿರ್ವಿಭೂತಿಭಿರ್ಲೋಕಾನಿಮಾಂಸ್ತ್ವಂ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ಯ ತಿಷ್ಠಸಿ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
వక్తుమర్హస్యశేషేణ దివ్యా హ్యాత్మవిభూతయః |
యాభిర్విభూతిభిర్లోకానిమాంస్త్వం వ్యాప్య తిష్ఠసి || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
vaktum arhasyaśheṣheṇa divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣhṭhasi
translation_english: Be pleased to speak in full of Your own divine manifestations, through which You exist pervading these worlds.
context_english: vaktum—to describe; arhasi—please do; aśheṣheṇa—completely; divyāḥ—divine; hi—indeed; ātma—your own; vibhūtayaḥ—opulences; yābhiḥ—by which; vibhūtibhiḥ—opulences; lokān—all worlds; imān—these; tvam—you; vyāpya—pervade; tiṣhṭhasi—reside;

text:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।

केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया।।10.17।।
text_kannada:
ಕಥಂ ವಿದ್ಯಾಮಹಂ ಯೋಗಿಂಸ್ತ್ವಾಂ ಸದಾ ಪರಿಚಿಂತಯನ್ |
ಕೇಷು ಕೇಷು ಚ ಭಾವೇಷು ಚಿಂತ್ಯೋಽಸಿ ಭಗವನ್ಮಯಾ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
కథం విద్యామహం యోగింస్త్వాం సదా పరిచింతయన్ |
కేషు కేషు చ భావేషు చింత్యోఽసి భగవన్మయా || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan
keṣhu keṣhu cha bhāveṣhu chintyo ’si bhagavan mayā
translation_english: O Yogi, how shall I know You by remaining ever-engaged in meditation? And through what objects, O Lord, should I meditate on You?
context_english: katham—how; vidyām aham—shall I know; yogin—the Supreme Master of Yogmaya; tvām—you; sadā—always; parichintayan—meditating; keṣhu—in what; keṣhu—in what; cha—and; bhāveṣhu—forms; chintyaḥ asi—to be thought of; bhagavan—the Supreme Divine Personality; mayā—by me

text:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।

भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्।।10.18।।
text_kannada:
ವಿಸ್ತರೇಣಾತ್ಮನೋ ಯೋಗಂ ವಿಭೂತಿಂ ಚ ಜನಾರ್ದನ |
ಭೂಯಃ ಕಥಯ ತೃಪ್ತಿರ್ಹಿ ಶ್ರೃಣ್ವತೋ ನಾಸ್ತಿ ಮೇಽಮೃತಮ್ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
విస్తరేణాత్మనో యోగం విభూతిం చ జనార్దన |
భూయః కథయ తృప్తిర్హి శ్రృణ్వతో నాస్తి మేఽమృతమ్ || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
vistareṇātmano yogaṁ vibhūtiṁ cha janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛiptir hi śhṛiṇvato nāsti me ’mṛitam
translation_english: O Janardana, please narrate to me again in detail Your own yoga and divine manifestations. For, while hearing Your nectar-like words, I am not satiated.
context_english: vistareṇa—in detail; ātmanaḥ—your; yogam—divine glories; vibhūtim—opulences; cha—also; janaārdana—Shree Krishna, he who looks after the public; bhūyaḥ—again; kathaya—describe; tṛiptiḥ—satisfaction; hi—because; śhṛiṇvataḥ—hearing; na—not; asti—is; me—my; amṛitam—nectar

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे।।10.19।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಹಂತ ತೇ ಕಥಯಿಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ದಿವ್ಯಾ ಹ್ಯಾತ್ಮವಿಭೂತಯಃ |
ಪ್ರಾಧಾನ್ಯತಃ ಕುರುಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ನಾಸ್ತ್ಯಂತೋ ವಿಸ್ತರಸ್ಯ ಮೇ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
హంత తే కథయిష్యామి దివ్యా హ్యాత్మవిభూతయః |
ప్రాధాన్యతః కురుశ్రేష్ఠ నాస్త్యంతో విస్తరస్య మే || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
hanta te kathayiṣhyāmi divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuru-śhreṣhṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, O best of the Kurus, now, according to their importance, I shall describe to you My own glories, which are indeed divine. There is no end to My manifestations.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Blessed Lord spoke; hanta—yes; te—to you; kathayiṣhyāmi—I shall describe; divyāḥ—divine; hi—certainly; ātma-vibhūtayaḥ—my divine glories; prādhānyataḥ—salient; kuru-śhreṣhṭha—best of the Kurus; na—not; asti—is; antaḥ—limit; vistarasya—extensive glories; me—my

text:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।

अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च।।10.20।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಮಾತ್ಮಾ ಗುಡಾಕೇಶ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾಶಯಸ್ಥಿತಃ |
ಅಹಮಾದಿಶ್ಚ ಮಧ್ಯಂ ಚ ಭೂತಾನಾಮಂತ ಏವ ಚ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
అహమాత్మా గుడాకేశ సర్వభూతాశయస్థితః |
అహమాదిశ్చ మధ్యం చ భూతానామంత ఏవ చ || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
aham ātmā guḍākeśha sarva-bhūtāśhaya-sthitaḥ
aham ādiśh cha madhyaṁ cha bhūtānām anta eva cha
translation_english: O Gudakesa, I am the Self residing in the hearts of all beings, and I am the beginning, middle, and end of all beings.
context_english: aham—I; ātmā—soul; guḍākeśha—Arjun, the conqueror of sleep; sarva-bhūta—of all living entities; āśhaya-sthitaḥ—seated in the heart; aham—I; ādiḥ—the beginning; cha—and; madhyam—middle; cha—and; bhūtānām—of all beings; antaḥ—end; eva—even; cha—also

text:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।

मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी।।10.21।।
text_kannada:
ಆದಿತ್ಯಾನಾಮಹಂ ವಿಷ್ಣುರ್ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಾಂ ರವಿರಂಶುಮಾನ್ |
ಮರೀಚಿರ್ಮರುತಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಾಣಾಮಹಂ ಶಶೀ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
ఆదిత్యానామహం విష్ణుర్జ్యోతిషాం రవిరంశుమాన్ |
మరీచిర్మరుతామస్మి నక్షత్రాణామహం శశీ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān
marīchir marutām asmi nakṣhatrāṇām ahaṁ śhaśhī
translation_english: Among the Adityas [viz Dhata, Mitra, Aryama, Rudra, Varuna, Surya, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusa, Savita, Tvasta, and Visnu.-Tr.], I am Visnu; among the luminaries, the radiant sun; among the (forty-nine) Maruts [The seven groups of Maruts are Avaha, Pravaha, Vivaha, Paravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha, and Parivaha.-Tr.], I am Marici; among the stars, I am the moon.
context_english: ādityānām—amongst the twelve sons of Aditi; aham—I; viṣhṇuḥ—Lord Vishnu; jyotiṣhām—amongst luminous objects; raviḥ—the sun; anśhu-mān—radiant; marīchiḥ—Marichi; marutām—of the Maruts; asmi—(I) am; nakṣhatrāṇām—amongst the stars; aham—I; śhaśhī—the moon

text:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।

इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना।।10.22।।
text_kannada:
ವೇದಾನಾಂ ಸಾಮವೇದೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ದೇವಾನಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ವಾಸವಃ |
ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಾಂ ಮನಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ಭೂತಾನಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ಚೇತನಾ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
వేదానాం సామవేదోఽస్మి దేవానామస్మి వాసవః |
ఇంద్రియాణాం మనశ్చాస్మి భూతానామస్మి చేతనా || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
vedānāṁ sāma-vedo ’smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṁ manaśh chāsmi bhūtānām asmi chetanā
translation_english: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Indra. Among the organs, I am the mind, and I am the intelligence in creatures.
context_english: vedānām—amongst the Vedas; sāma-vedaḥ—the Sāma Veda; asmi—I am; devānām—of all the celestial gods; asmi—I am; vāsavaḥ̣—Indra; indriyāṇām—of amongst the senses; manaḥ—the mind; ca—and; asmi—I am; bhūtānām—amongst the living beings; asmi—I am; chetanā—consciousness

text:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।

वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्।।10.23।।
text_kannada:
ರುದ್ರಾಣಾಂ ಶಂಕರಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ವಿತ್ತೇಶೋ ಯಕ್ಷರಕ್ಷಸಾಮ್ |
ವಸೂನಾಂ ಪಾವಕಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ಮೇರುಃ ಶಿಖರಿಣಾಮಹಮ್ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
రుద్రాణాం శంకరశ్చాస్మి విత్తేశో యక్షరక్షసామ్ |
వసూనాం పావకశ్చాస్మి మేరుః శిఖరిణామహమ్ || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
rudrāṇāṁ śhaṅkaraśh chāsmi vitteśho yakṣha-rakṣhasām
vasūnāṁ pāvakaśh chāsmi meruḥ śhikhariṇām aham
translation_english: Among the Rudras, I am Aja, Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya, Pinaki, Aparajita, Tryam-baka, Mahesvara, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, Harana, and Isvara; among the Yaksas and goblins, I am Kubera; among the Vasus, I am Fire; and among the mountains, I am Meru.
context_english: rudrāṇām—amongst the Rudras; śhaṅkaraḥ—Lord Shiv; cha—and; asmi—I am; vitta-īśhaḥ—the god of wealth and the treasurer of the celestial gods; yakṣha—amongst the semi-divine demons; rakṣhasām—amongst the demons; vasūnām—amongst the Vasus; pāvakaḥ—Agni (fire); cha—and; asmi—I am; meruḥ—Mount Meru; śhikhariṇām—amongst the mountains; aham—I am

text:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।

सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः।।10.24।।
text_kannada:
ಪುರೋಧಸಾಂ ಚ ಮುಖ್ಯಂ ಮಾಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿಮ್ |
ಸೇನಾನೀನಾಮಹಂ ಸ್ಕಂದಃ ಸರಸಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ಸಾಗರಃ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
పురోధసాం చ ముఖ్యం మాం విద్ధి పార్థ బృహస్పతిమ్ |
సేనానీనామహం స్కందః సరసామస్మి సాగరః || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim
senānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
translation_english: O son of Prtha, know me to be Brhaspati, the foremost among the priests of kings. Among commanders of armies, I am Skanda; among large expanses of water, I am the sea.
context_english: purodhasām—amongst priests; cha—and; mukhyam—the chiefs; mām—me; viddhi—know; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; bṛihaspatim—Brihaspati; senānīnām—warrior chief; aham—I; skandaḥ—Kartikeya; sarasām—amongst reservoirs of water; asmi—I am; sāgaraḥ—the ocean

text:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।

यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः।।10.25।।
text_kannada:
ಮಹರ್ಷೀಣಾಂ ಭೃಗುರಹಂ ಗಿರಾಮಸ್ಮ್ಯೇಕಮಕ್ಷರಮ್ |
ಯಜ್ಞಾನಾಂ ಜಪಯಜ್ಞೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಸ್ಥಾವರಾಣಾಂ ಹಿಮಾಲಯಃ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
మహర్షీణాం భృగురహం గిరామస్మ్యేకమక్షరమ్ |
యజ్ఞానాం జపయజ్ఞోఽస్మి స్థావరాణాం హిమాలయః || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam
yajñānāṁ japa-yajño ’smi sthāvarāṇāṁ himālayaḥ
translation_english: Among the great sages, I am Bhrgu; of words, I am the single syllable (Om). Among rituals, I am the ritual of Japa of the immovables, the Himalayas.
context_english: mahā-ṛiṣhīṇām—among the great seers; bhṛiguḥ—Bhrigu; aham—I; girām—amongst chants; asmi—I am; ekam akṣharam—the syllable Om; yajñānām—of sacrifices; japa-yajñaḥ—sacrifice of the devotional repetition of the divine names of God; asmi—I am; sthāvarāṇām—amongst immovable things; himālayaḥ—the Himalayas

text:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।

गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.26।।
text_kannada:
ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಃ ಸರ್ವವೃಕ್ಷಾಣಾಂ ದೇವರ್ಷೀಣಾಂ ಚ ನಾರದಃ |
ಗಂಧರ್ವಾಣಾಂ ಚಿತ್ರರಥಃ ಸಿದ್ಧಾನಾಂ ಕಪಿಲೋ ಮುನಿಃ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
అశ్వత్థః సర్వవృక్షాణాం దేవర్షీణాం చ నారదః |
గంధర్వాణాం చిత్రరథః సిద్ధానాం కపిలో మునిః || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
aśhvatthaḥ sarva-vṛikṣhāṇāṁ devarṣhīṇāṁ cha nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṁ chitrarathaḥ siddhānāṁ kapilo muniḥ
translation_english: Among all trees, I am the Ashvattha tree, and among divine sages, Narada. Among the Gandharvas, I am Citraratha; among the perfected ones, I am the sage Kapila.
context_english: aśhvatthaḥ—the banyan tree; sarva-vṛikṣhāṇām—amongst all trees; deva-ṛiṣhīṇām—amongst celestial sages; cha—and; nāradaḥ—Narad; gandharvāṇām—amongst the gandharvas; chitrarathaḥ—Chitrarath; siddhānām—of all those who are perfected; kapilaḥ muniḥ—sage Kapil

text:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।

ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्।।10.27।।
text_kannada:
ಉಚ್ಚೈಃಶ್ರವಸಮಶ್ವಾನಾಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಮಾಮಮೃತೋದ್ಭವಮ್ |
ಐರಾವತಂ ಗಜೇಂದ್ರಾಣಾಂ ನರಾಣಾಂ ಚ ನರಾಧಿಪಮ್ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఉచ్చైఃశ్రవసమశ్వానాం విద్ధి మామమృతోద్భవమ్ |
ఐరావతం గజేంద్రాణాం నరాణాం చ నరాధిపమ్ || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
uchchaiḥśhravasam aśhvānāṁ viddhi mām amṛitodbhavam
airāvataṁ gajendrāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ cha narādhipam
translation_english: Among horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, born from nectar; Airavata among the lordly elephants; and among men, the King of men. [Uccaihsravas and Airavata are respectively the divine horse and elephant of Indra.]
context_english: uchchaiḥśhravasam—Uchchaihshrava; aśhvānām—amongst horses; viddhi—know; mām—me; amṛita-udbhavam—begotten from the churning of the ocean of nectar; airāvatam—Airavata; gaja-indrāṇām—amongst all lordly elephants; narāṇām—amongst humans; cha—and; nara-adhipam—the king

text:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।

प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः।।10.28।।
text_kannada:
ಆಯುಧಾನಾಮಹಂ ವಜ್ರಂ ಧೇನೂನಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ಕಾಮಧುಕ್ |
ಪ್ರಜನಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ಕಂದರ್ಪಃ ಸರ್ಪಾಣಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ವಾಸುಕಿಃ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
ఆయుధానామహం వజ్రం ధేనూనామస్మి కామధుక్ |
ప్రజనశ్చాస్మి కందర్పః సర్పాణామస్మి వాసుకిః || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk
prajanaśh chāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
translation_english: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am Kamadhenu. I am Kandarpa, the Progenitor, and among serpents I am Vasuki.
context_english: āyudhānām—amongst weapons; aham—I; vajram—the Vajra (thunderbolt); dhenūnām—amongst cows; asmi—I am; kāma-dhuk—Kamdhenu; prajanaḥ—amongst causes for procreation; cha—and; asmi—I am; kandarpaḥ—Kaamdev, the god of love; sarpāṇām—amongst serpents; asmi—I am; vāsukiḥ—serpent Vasuki

text:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।

पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्।।10.29।।
text_kannada:
ಅನಂತಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ನಾಗಾನಾಂ ವರುಣೋ ಯಾದಸಾಮಹಮ್ |
ಪಿತೃಣಾಮರ್ಯಮಾ ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ಯಮಃ ಸಂಯಮತಾಮಹಮ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
అనంతశ్చాస్మి నాగానాం వరుణో యాదసామహమ్ |
పితృణామర్యమా చాస్మి యమః సంయమతామహమ్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham
pitṝīṇām aryamā chāsmi yamaḥ sanyamatām aham
translation_english: Among snakes, I am Ananta; among gods of the waters, Varuna; among the manes, Aryama; and among the maintainers of law and order, I am Yama (King of death).
context_english: anantaḥ—Anant; cha—and; asmi—I am; nāgānām—amongst snakes; varuṇaḥ—the celestial god of the ocean; yādasām—amongst aquatics; aham—I; pitṝīṇām—amongst the departed ancestors; aryamā—Aryama; cha—and; asmi—am; yamaḥ—the celestial god of death; sanyamatām—amongst dispensers of law; aham—I

text:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।

मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्।।10.30।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಹ್ಲಾದಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ದೈತ್ಯಾನಾಂ ಕಾಲಃ ಕಲಯತಾಮಹಮ್ |
ಮೃಗಾಣಾಂ ಚ ಮೃಗೇಂದ್ರೋಽಹಂ ವೈನತೇಯಶ್ಚ ಪಕ್ಷಿಣಾಮ್ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రహ్లాదశ్చాస్మి దైత్యానాం కాలః కలయతామహమ్ |
మృగాణాం చ మృగేంద్రోఽహం వైనతేయశ్చ పక్షిణామ్ || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham
mṛigāṇāṁ cha mṛigendro ’haṁ vainateyaśh cha pakṣhiṇām
translation_english: Among demons, I am Prahlada, and among reckoners of time, I am Time. Among animals, I am the lion, and among birds, I am Garuda.
context_english: prahlādaḥ—Prahlad; cha—and; asmi—I am; daityānām—of the demons; kālaḥ—time; kalayatām—of all that controls; aham—I; mṛigāṇām—amongst animals; cha—and; mṛiga-indraḥ—the lion; aham—I; vainateyaḥ—Garud; cha—and; pakṣhiṇām—amongst birds

text:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।

झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी।।10.31।।
text_kannada:
ಪವನಃ ಪವತಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ರಾಮಃ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಭೃತಾಮಹಮ್ |
ಝಷಾಣಾಂ ಮಕರಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ಸ್ರೋತಸಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ಜಾಹ್ನವೀ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
పవనః పవతామస్మి రామః శస్త్రభృతామహమ్ |
ఝషాణాం మకరశ్చాస్మి స్రోతసామస్మి జాహ్నవీ || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham
jhaṣhāṇāṁ makaraśh chāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī
translation_english: Of the purifiers, I am the air; among the wielders of weapons, I am Rama. Among fishes, I am the shark; among rivers, I am Ganga.
context_english: pavanaḥ—the wind; pavatām—of all that purifies; asmi—I am; rāmaḥ—Ram; śhastra-bhṛitām—of the carriers of weapons; aham—I am; jhaṣhāṇām—of all acquatics; makaraḥ—crocodile; cha—also; asmi—I am; srotasām—of flowing rivers; asmi—I am; jāhnavī—the Ganges

text:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।

अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्।।10.32।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ಗಾಣಾಮಾದಿರಂತಶ್ಚ ಮಧ್ಯಂ ಚೈವಾಹಮರ್ಜುನ |
ಅಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮವಿದ್ಯಾ ವಿದ್ಯಾನಾಂ ವಾದಃ ಪ್ರವದತಾಮಹಮ್ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
సర్గాణామాదిరంతశ్చ మధ్యం చైవాహమర్జున |
అధ్యాత్మవిద్యా విద్యానాం వాదః ప్రవదతామహమ్ || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna
adhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṁ vādaḥ pravadatām aham
translation_english: O Arjuna, of creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end; I am the knowledge of the Self among knowledge; of those who debate, I am vada.
context_english: sargāṇām—of all creations; ādiḥ—the beginning; antaḥ—end; cha—and; madhyam—middle; cha—and; eva—indeed; aham—I; arjuna—Arjun; adhyātma-vidyā—science of spirituality; vidyānām—amongst sciences; vādaḥ—the logical conclusion; pravadatām—of debates; aham—I

text:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।

अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।।
text_kannada:
ಅಕ್ಷರಾಣಾಮಕಾರೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಃ ಸಾಮಾಸಿಕಸ್ಯ ಚ |
ಅಹಮೇವಾಕ್ಷಯಃ ಕಾಲೋ ಧಾತಾಽಹಂ ವಿಶ್ವತೋಮುಖಃ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
అక్షరాణామకారోఽస్మి ద్వంద్వః సామాసికస్య చ |
అహమేవాక్షయః కాలో ధాతాఽహం విశ్వతోముఖః || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
अहमेवाक्षय: कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुख: || 33||

akṣharāṇām a-kāro ’smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya cha
aham evākṣhayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśhvato-mukhaḥ
translation_english: Of the letters, I am the letter A, and of the group of compound words, I am the compound called Dvandva. I am Myself the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.
context_english: akṣharāṇām—amongst all letters; a-kāraḥ—the beginning letter “A”; asmi—I am; dvandvaḥ—the dual; sāmāsikasya—amongst grammatical compounds; cha—and; aham—I; eva—only; akṣhayaḥ—endless; kālaḥ—time; dhātā—amongst the creators; aham—I; viśhwataḥ-mukhaḥ—Brahma

text:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।

कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।10.34।।
text_kannada:
ಮೃತ್ಯುಃ ಸರ್ವಹರಶ್ಚಾಹಮುದ್ಭವಶ್ಚ ಭವಿಷ್ಯತಾಮ್ |
ಕೀರ್ತಿಃ ಶ್ರೀರ್ವಾಕ್ಚ ನಾರೀಣಾಂ ಸ್ಮೃತಿರ್ಮೇಧಾ ಧೃತಿಃ ಕ್ಷಮಾ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
మృత్యుః సర్వహరశ్చాహముద్భవశ్చ భవిష్యతామ్ |
కీర్తిః శ్రీర్వాక్చ నారీణాం స్మృతిర్మేధా ధృతిః క్షమా || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
kīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā
translation_english: And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the bestower of prosperity to those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine qualities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective qualities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude, and forbearance.
context_english: mṛityuḥ—death; sarva-haraḥ—all-devouring; cha—and; aham—I; udbhavaḥ—the origin; cha—and; bhaviṣhyatām—those things that are yet to be; kīrtiḥ—fame; śhrīḥ—prospective; vāk—fine speech; cha—and; nārīṇām—amongst feminine qualities; smṛitiḥ—memory; medhā—intelligence; dhṛitiḥ—courage; kṣhamā—forgiveness

text:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।

मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः।।10.35।।
text_kannada:
ಬೃಹತ್ಸಾಮ ತಥಾ ಸಾಮ್ನಾಂ ಗಾಯತ್ರೀ ಛಂದಸಾಮಹಮ್ |
ಮಾಸಾನಾಂ ಮಾರ್ಗಶೀರ್ಷೋಽಹಮೃತೂನಾಂ ಕುಸುಮಾಕರಃ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
బృహత్సామ తథా సామ్నాం గాయత్రీ ఛందసామహమ్ |
మాసానాం మార్గశీర్షోఽహమృతూనాం కుసుమాకరః || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
māsānāṁ mārga-śhīrṣho ’ham ṛitūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ
translation_english: I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama-mantras; of the meters, Gayatri. Of the months, I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.
context_english: bṛihat-sāma—the Brihatsama; tathā—also; sāmnām—amongst the hymns in the Sama Veda; gāyatrī—the Gayatri mantra; chhandasām—amongst poetic meters; aham—I; māsānām—of the twelve months; mārga-śhīrṣhaḥ—the month of November-December; aham—I; ṛitūnām—of all seasons; kusuma-ākaraḥ—spring

text:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।

जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्।।10.36।।
text_kannada:
ದ್ಯೂತಂ ಛಲಯತಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ತೇಜಸ್ತೇಜಸ್ವಿನಾಮಹಮ್ |
ಜಯೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ವ್ಯವಸಾಯೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಸತ್ತ್ವವತಾಮಹಮ್ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
ద్యూతం ఛలయతామస్మి తేజస్తేజస్వినామహమ్ |
జయోఽస్మి వ్యవసాయోఽస్మి సత్త్వం సత్త్వవతామహమ్ || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
jayo ’smi vyavasāyo ’smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham
translation_english: Of the fraudulent, I am the gambling; I am the irresistible end of the mighty. I am excellence, I am effort, I am the sattva quality of those possessed of sattva.

text:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।

मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः।।10.37।।
text_kannada:
ವೃಷ್ಣೀನಾಂ ವಾಸುದೇವೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಪಾಂಡವಾನಾಂ ಧನಂಜಯಃ |
ಮುನೀನಾಮಪ್ಯಹಂ ವ್ಯಾಸಃ ಕವೀನಾಮುಶನಾ ಕವಿಃ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
వృష్ణీనాం వాసుదేవోఽస్మి పాండవానాం ధనంజయః |
మునీనామప్యహం వ్యాసః కవీనాముశనా కవిః || ౩౭ ||
transliteration:
vṛiṣhṇīnāṁ vāsudevo ’smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ
translation_english: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). Of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.

text:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।

मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्।।10.38।।
text_kannada:
ದಂಡೋ ದಮಯತಾಮಸ್ಮಿ ನೀತಿರಸ್ಮಿ ಜಿಗೀಷತಾಮ್ |
ಮೌನಂ ಚೈವಾಸ್ಮಿ ಗುಹ್ಯಾನಾಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಜ್ಞಾನವತಾಮಹಮ್ || ೩೮ ||
text_telugu:
దండో దమయతామస్మి నీతిరస్మి జిగీషతామ్ |
మౌనం చైవాస్మి గుహ్యానాం జ్ఞానం జ్ఞానవతామహమ్ || ౩౮ ||

daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
maunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham
translation_english: Of the punishers, I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to conquer. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am the knowledge of the wise.

text:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।

न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्।।10.39।।
text_kannada:
ಯಚ್ಚಾಪಿ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ಬೀಜಂ ತದಹಮರ್ಜುನ |
ನ ತದಸ್ತಿ ವಿನಾ ಯತ್ಸ್ಯಾನ್ಮಯಾ ಭೂತಂ ಚರಾಚರಮ್ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
యచ్చాపి సర్వభూతానాం బీజం తదహమర్జున |
న తదస్తి వినా యత్స్యాన్మయా భూతం చరాచరమ్ || ౩౯ ||
transliteration:
yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam
translation_english: Moreover, O Arjuna, I am the seed of all beings. There is nothing, moving or non-moving, that can exist without Me.

text:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।

एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया।।10.40।।
text_kannada:
ನಾಂತೋಽಸ್ತಿ ಮಮ ದಿವ್ಯಾನಾಂ ವಿಭೂತೀನಾಂ ಪರಂತಪ |
ಏಷ ತೂದ್ದೇಶತಃ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತೋ ವಿಭೂತೇರ್ವಿಸ್ತರೋ ಮಯಾ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
నాంతోఽస్తి మమ దివ్యానాం విభూతీనాం పరంతప |
ఏష తూద్దేశతః ప్రోక్తో విభూతేర్విస్తరో మయా || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
nānto ’sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa
eṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
translation_english: O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of My manifestations, however, has been stated by Me as an illustration.

text:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।

तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्।।10.41।।
text_kannada:
ಯದ್ಯದ್ವಿಭೂತಿಮತ್ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಶ್ರೀಮದೂರ್ಜಿತಮೇವ ವಾ |
ತತ್ತದೇವಾವಗಚ್ಛ ತ್ವಂ ಮಮ ತೇಜೋಂಽಶಸಂಭವಮ್ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
యద్యద్విభూతిమత్సత్త్వం శ్రీమదూర్జితమేవ వా |
తత్తదేవావగచ్ఛ త్వం మమ తేజోంఽశసంభవమ్ || ౪౧ ||

yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā

translation_english: Whatever object [all living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.

text:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।

विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।।10.42।।
text_kannada:
ಅಥವಾ ಬಹುನೈತೇನ ಕಿಂ ಜ್ಞಾತೇನ ತವಾರ್ಜುನ |
ವಿಷ್ಟಭ್ಯಾಹಮಿದಂ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಮೇಕಾಂಶೇನ ಸ್ಥಿತೋ ಜಗತ್ || ೪೨ ||

అథవా బహునైతేన కిం జ్ఞాతేన తవార్జున |
విష్టభ్యాహమిదం కృత్స్నమేకాంశేన స్థితో జగత్ || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।

यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम।।11.1।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಮದನುಗ್ರಹಾಯ ಪರಮಂ ಗುಹ್ಯಮಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಸಂಜ್ಞಿತಮ್ |
ಯತ್ತ್ವಯೋಕ್ತಂ ವಚಸ್ತೇನ ಮೋಹೋಽಯಂ ವಿಗತೋ ಮಮ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
మదనుగ్రహాయ పరమం గుహ్యమధ్యాత్మసంజ్ఞితమ్ |
యత్త్వయోక్తం వచస్తేన మోహోఽయం విగతో మమ || ౧ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
mad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-sanjñitam
yat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama
translation_english: Arjuna said, "This delusion of mine has departed as a result of that speech which is most secret and pertains to the Self, uttered by You for my benefit."

text:
