text: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।13.28।।
text_kannada:
ಸಮಂ ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಭೂತೇಷು ತಿಷ್ಠಂತಂ ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ವಿನಶ್ಯತ್ಸ್ವವಿನಶ್ಯಂತಂ ಯಃ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ಸ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
సమం సర్వేషు భూతేషు తిష్ఠంతం పరమేశ్వరమ్ |
వినశ్యత్స్వవినశ్యంతం యః పశ్యతి స పశ్యతి || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
samaṁ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu tiṣhṭhantaṁ parameśhvaram
vinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
translation_english: He who sees the Supreme Lord existing truly in all beings, and the Imperishable among the perishable, sees indeed.
context_english: samam—equally; sarveṣhu—in all; bhūteṣhu—beings; tiṣhṭhan-tam—accompanying; parama-īśhvaram—Supreme Soul; vinaśhyatsu—amongst the perishable; avinaśhyantam—the imperishable; yaḥ—who; paśhyati—see; saḥ—they; paśhyati—perceive

text: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.29।।
text_kannada:
ಸಮಂ ಪಶ್ಯನ್ಹಿ ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸಮವಸ್ಥಿತಮೀಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ನ ಹಿನಸ್ತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ತತೋ ಯಾತಿ ಪರಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
సమం పశ్యన్హి సర్వత్ర సమవస్థితమీశ్వరమ్ |
న హినస్త్యాత్మనాఽఽత్మానం తతో యాతి పరాం గతిమ్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram
na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim
translation_english: Since, by truly seeing God, who is present everywhere alike, he does not injure the Self by the Self, he therefore attains the supreme Goal.
context_english: samam—equally; paśhyan—see; hi—indeed; sarvatra—everywhere; samavasthitam—equally present; īśhvaram—God as the Supreme soul; na—do not; hinasti—degrade; ātmanā—by one’s mind; ātmānam—the self; tataḥ—thereby; yāti—reach; parām—the supreme; gatim—destination

text: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।13.30।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರಕೃತ್ಯೈವ ಚ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಕ್ರಿಯಮಾಣಾನಿ ಸರ್ವಶಃ |
ಯಃ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ತಥಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಮಕರ್ತಾರಂ ಸ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రకృత్యైవ చ కర్మాణి క్రియమాణాని సర్వశః |
యః పశ్యతి తథాఽఽత్మానమకర్తారం స పశ్యతి || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
prakṛityaiva cha karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśhaḥ
yaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati
translation_english: And he who sees actions being done in various ways by Nature itself, and also the Self as the non-agent, he sees.
context_english: prakṛityā—by material nature; eva—truly; cha—also; karmāṇi—actions; kriyamāṇāni—are performed; sarvaśhaḥ—all; yaḥ—who; paśhyati—see; tathā—also; ātmānam—(embodied) soul; akartāram—actionless; saḥ—they; paśhyati—see

text: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।13.31।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ಭೂತಪೃಥಗ್ಭಾವಮೇಕಸ್ಥಮನುಪಶ್ಯತಿ |
ತತ ಏವ ಚ ವಿಸ್ತಾರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಸಂಪದ್ಯತೇ ತದಾ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
యదా భూతపృథగ్భావమేకస్థమనుపశ్యతి |
తత ఏవ చ విస్తారం బ్రహ్మ సంపద్యతే తదా || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
yadā bhūta-pṛithag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśhyati
tata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā
translation_english: When one realizes that the state of diversity of living things is rooted in the One, and that their manifestation also comes from That, then one becomes identified with Brahman.
context_english: yadā—when; bhūta—living entities; pṛithak-bhāvam—diverse variety; eka-stham—situated in the same place; anupaśhyati—see; tataḥ—thereafter; eva—indeed; cha—and; vistāram—born from; brahma—Brahman; sampadyate—(they) attain; tadā—then

text: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते।।13.32।।
text_kannada:
ಅನಾದಿತ್ವಾನ್ನಿರ್ಗುಣತ್ವಾತ್ಪರಮಾತ್ಮಾಯಮವ್ಯಯಃ |
ಶರೀರಸ್ಥೋಽಪಿ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ನ ಕರೋತಿ ನ ಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
అనాదిత్వాన్నిర్గుణత్వాత్పరమాత్మాయమవ్యయః |
శరీరస్థోఽపి కౌంతేయ న కరోతి న లిప్యతే || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ
śharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
translation_english: Being without beginning and without end, O son of Kunti, this immutable, supreme Self does not act, nor is It affected [Also translated as tainted.-Tr.], although It exists in the body.
context_english: anāditvāt—being without beginning; nirguṇatvāt—being devoid of any material qualities; parama—the Supreme; ātmā—soul; ayam—this; avyayaḥ—imperishable; śharīra-sthaḥ—dwelling in the body; api—although; kaunteya—Arjun, the the son of Kunti; na—neither; karoti—acts; na—nor; lipyate—is tainted

text: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते।।13.33।।
text_kannada:
ಯಥಾ ಸರ್ವಗತಂ ಸೌಕ್ಷ್ಮ್ಯಾದಾಕಾಶಂ ನೋಪಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ |
ಸರ್ವತ್ರಾವಸ್ಥಿತೋ ದೇಹೇ ತಥಾಽಽತ್ಮಾ ನೋಪಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
యథా సర్వగతం సౌక్ష్మ్యాదాకాశం నోపలిప్యతే |
సర్వత్రావస్థితో దేహే తథాఽఽత్మా నోపలిప్యతే || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣhmyād ākāśhaṁ nopalipyate
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
translation_english: As the all-pervading space is not defiled, due to its subtlety, similarly the Self, present everywhere in bodies, is not defiled.
context_english: yathā—as; sarva-gatam—all-pervading; saukṣhmyāt—due to subtlety; ākāśham—the space; na—not; upalipyate—is contaminated; sarvatra—everywhere; avasthitaḥ—situated; dehe—the body; tathā—similarly; ātmā—the soul; na—not; upalipyate—is contaminated

text: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत।।13.34।।
text_kannada:
ಯಥಾ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಯತ್ಯೇಕಃ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಂ ಲೋಕಮಿಮಂ ರವಿಃ |
ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಂ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರೀ ತಥಾ ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನಂ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಯತಿ ಭಾರತ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
యథా ప్రకాశయత్యేకః కృత్స్నం లోకమిమం రవిః |
క్షేత్రం క్షేత్రీ తథా కృత్స్నం ప్రకాశయతి భారత || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ
kṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata
translation_english: As the single sun illuminates this entire world, similarly, O descendant of the Bharata dynasty, the Knower of the field illuminates the entire field.
context_english: yathā—as; prakāśhayati—illumines; ekaḥ—one; kṛitsnam—entire; lokam—solar system; imam—this; raviḥ—sun; kṣhetram—the body; kṣhetrī—the soul; tathā—so; kṛitsnam—entire; prakāśhayati—illumine; bhārata—Arjun, the son of Bharat

text: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्।।13.35।।
text_kannada:
ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಜ್ಞಯೋರೇವಮಂತರಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಚಕ್ಷುಷಾ |
ಭೂತಪ್ರಕೃತಿಮೋಕ್ಷಂ ಚ ಯೇ ವಿದುರ್ಯಾಂತಿ ತೇ ಪರಮ್ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
క్షేత్రక్షేత్రజ్ఞయోరేవమంతరం జ్ఞానచక్షుషా |
భూతప్రకృతిమోక్షం చ యే విదుర్యాంతి తే పరమ్ || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā
bhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param
translation_english: Those who, through the eye of wisdom, know the distinction between the field and the Knower of the field, and the annihilation of the Matrix of beings, reach the Supreme.
context_english: kṣhetra—the body; kṣhetra-jñayoḥ—of the knower of the body; evam—thus; antaram—the difference; jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā—with the eyes of knowledge; bhūta—the living entity; prakṛiti-mokṣham—release from material nature; cha—and; ye—who; viduḥ—know; yānti—approach; te—they; param—the Supreme

text: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः।।14.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚಪರಂ ಭೂಯಃ ಪ್ರವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಾನಾಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಮುತ್ತಮಮ್ |
ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಮುನಯಃ ಸರ್ವೇ ಪರಾಂ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಮಿತೋ ಗತಾಃ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచపరం భూయః ప్రవక్ష్యామి జ్ఞానానాం జ్ఞానముత్తమమ్ |
యజ్జ్ఞాత్వా మునయః సర్వే పరాం సిద్ధిమితో గతాః || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam
yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "I shall speak again of the supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, by realizing which all the contemplatives have reached the highest perfection from here."
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Divine Lord said; param—supreme; bhūyaḥ—again; pravakṣhyāmi—I shall explain; jñānānām—of all knowledge; jñānam uttamam—the supreme wisdom; yat—which; jñātvā—knowing; munayaḥ—saints; sarve—all; parām—highest; siddhim—perfection; itaḥ—through this; gatāḥ—attained

text: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।14.2।।
text_kannada:
ಇದಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಮುಪಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ಮಮ ಸಾಧರ್ಮ್ಯಮಾಗತಾಃ |
ಸರ್ಗೇಽಪಿ ನೋಪಜಾಯಂತೇ ಪ್ರಲಯೇ ನ ವ್ಯಥಂತಿ ಚ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఇదం జ్ఞానముపాశ్రిత్య మమ సాధర్మ్యమాగతాః |
సర్గేఽపి నోపజాయంతే ప్రలయే న వ్యథంతి చ || ౨ ||
transliteration:
idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ
sarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha
translation_english: Those who attain identity with Me by resorting to this Knowledge are not born even during creation, nor do they suffer pain during dissolution.
context_english: idam—this; jñānam—wisdom; upāśhritya—take refuge in; mama—mine; sādharmyam—of similar nature; āgatāḥ—having attained; sarge—at the time of creation; api—even; na—not; upajāyante—are born; pralaye—at the time of dissolution; na-vyathanti—they will not experience misery; cha—and

text: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।14.3।।
text_kannada:
ಮಮ ಯೋನಿರ್ಮಹದ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ತಸ್ಮಿನ್ ಗರ್ಭಂ ದಧಾಮ್ಯಹಮ್ |
ಸಂಭವಃ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ತತೋ ಭವತಿ ಭಾರತ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
మమ యోనిర్మహద్బ్రహ్మ తస్మిన్ గర్భం దధామ్యహమ్ |
సంభవః సర్వభూతానాం తతో భవతి భారత || ౩ ||
transliteration:
mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham
sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata
translation_english: My womb is the great sustainer. In it, I place the seed. From that, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, all things are born.
context_english: mama—my; yoniḥ—womb; mahat brahma—the total material substance, prakṛiti; tasmin—in that; garbham—womb; dadhāmi—impregnate; aham—I; sambhavaḥ—birth; sarva-bhūtānām—of all living beings; tataḥ—thereby; bhavati—becomes; bhārata—Arjun, the son of Bharat;

text: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।।14.4।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಯೋನಿಷು ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಮೂರ್ತಯಃ ಸಂಭವಂತಿ ಯಾಃ |
ತಾಸಾಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಮಹದ್ಯೋನಿರಹಂ ಬೀಜಪ್ರದಃ ಪಿತಾ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వయోనిషు కౌంతేయ మూర్తయః సంభవంతి యాః |
తాసాం బ్రహ్మ మహద్యోనిరహం బీజప్రదః పితా || ౪ ||
transliteration:
sarva-yoniṣhu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā
translation_english: O son of Kunti, whatever forms are born from all the wombs, of them the great sustainer is the womb; I am the father who deposits the seed.
context_english: sarva—all; yoniṣhu—species of life; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; mūrtayaḥ—forms; sambhavanti—are produced; yāḥ—which; tāsām—of all of them; brahma-mahat—great material nature; yoniḥ—womb; aham—I; bīja-pradaḥ—seed-giving; pitā—Father

text: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।14.5।।
text_kannada:
ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ರಜಸ್ತಮ ಇತಿ ಗುಣಾಃ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಸಂಭವಾಃ |
ನಿಬಧ್ನಂತಿ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ದೇಹೇ ದೇಹಿನಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
సత్త్వం రజస్తమ ఇతి గుణాః ప్రకృతిసంభవాః |
నిబధ్నంతి మహాబాహో దేహే దేహినమవ్యయమ్ || ౫ ||
transliteration:
sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam
translation_english: O mighty-armed one, the qualities, viz. sattva, rajas, and tamas, born of Nature, are the immutable embodiments belonging to the body.
context_english: sattvam—mode of goodness; rajaḥ—mode of passion; tamaḥ—mode of ignorance; iti—thus; guṇāḥ—modes; prakṛiti—material nature; sambhavāḥ—consists of; nibadhnanti—bind; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one; dehe—in the body; dehinam—the embodied soul; avyayam—eternal

text: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।14.6।।
text_kannada:
ತತ್ರ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ನಿರ್ಮಲತ್ವಾತ್ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕಮನಾಮಯಮ್ |
ಸುಖಸಂಗೇನ ಬಧ್ನಾತಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಗೇನ ಚಾನಘ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
తత్ర సత్త్వం నిర్మలత్వాత్ప్రకాశకమనామయమ్ |
సుఖసంగేన బధ్నాతి జ్ఞానసంగేన చానఘ || ౬ ||
transliteration:
tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśhakam anāmayam
sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena chānagha
translation_english: Among them, sattva, being pure and nirmala (pure-transparent, i.e., capable of resisting any form of ignorance, and hence an illuminator, i.e. a revealer of Consciousness), is harmless. O sinless one, it binds through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.
context_english: tatra—amongst these; sattvam—mode of goodness; nirmalatvāt—being purest; prakāśhakam—illuminating; anāmayam—healthy and full of well-being; sukha—happiness; saṅgena—attachment; badhnāti—binds; jñāna—knowledge; saṅgena—attachment; cha—also; anagha—Arjun, the sinless one

text: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।14.7।।
text_kannada:
ರಜೋ ರಾಗಾತ್ಮಕಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ತೃಷ್ಣಾಸಂಗಸಮುದ್ಭವಮ್ |
ತನ್ನಿಬಧ್ನಾತಿ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಕರ್ಮಸಂಗೇನ ದೇಹಿನಮ್ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
రజో రాగాత్మకం విద్ధి తృష్ణాసంగసముద్భవమ్ |
తన్నిబధ్నాతి కౌంతేయ కర్మసంగేన దేహినమ్ || ౭ ||
transliteration:
rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛiṣhṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam
tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam
translation_english: Know rajas to be of the nature of passion, born of hankering and attachment. O son of Kunti, it binds the embodied one through attachment to action.

text: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।14.8।।
text_kannada:
ತಮಸ್ತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಜಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಮೋಹನಂ ಸರ್ವದೇಹಿನಾಮ್ |
ಪ್ರಮಾದಾಲಸ್ಯನಿದ್ರಾಭಿಸ್ತನ್ನಿಬಧ್ನಾತಿ ಭಾರತ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
తమస్త్వజ్ఞానజం విద్ధి మోహనం సర్వదేహినామ్ |
ప్రమాదాలస్యనిద్రాభిస్తన్నిబధ్నాతి భారత || ౮ ||
transliteration:
tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām
pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata
translation_english: On the other hand, know tamas, which deludes all embodied beings, to be born of ignorance. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, it binds through inadvertence, laziness, and sleep.

text: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.9।।
text_kannada:
ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಸುಖೇ ಸಂಜಯತಿ ರಜಃ ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾವೃತ್ಯ ತು ತಮಃ ಪ್ರಮಾದೇ ಸಂಜಯತ್ಯುತ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
సత్త్వం సుఖే సంజయతి రజః కర్మణి భారత |
జ్ఞానమావృత్య తు తమః ప్రమాదే సంజయత్యుత || ౯ ||
transliteration:
sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva attaches one to happiness, rajas to action, while tamas, obscuring knowledge, leads to inadvertence as well.

text: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।14.10।।
text_kannada:
ರಜಸ್ತಮಶ್ಚಾಭಿಭೂಯ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಭವತಿ ಭಾರತ |
ರಜಃ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ತಮಶ್ಚೈವ ತಮಃ ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ರಜಸ್ತಥಾ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
రజస్తమశ్చాభిభూయ సత్త్వం భవతి భారత |
రజః సత్త్వం తమశ్చైవ తమః సత్త్వం రజస్తథా || ౧౦ ||

rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva increases by subduing rajas and tamas; rajas increases by overpowering sattva and tamas; and tamas increases by dominating over sattva and rajas.

text: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत।।14.11।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವದ್ವಾರೇಷು ದೇಹೇಽಸ್ಮಿನ್ಪ್ರಕಾಶ ಉಪಜಾಯತೇ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಯದಾ ತದಾ ವಿದ್ಯಾದ್ವಿವೃದ್ಧಂ ಸತ್ತ್ವಮಿತ್ಯುತ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వద్వారేషు దేహేఽస్మిన్ప్రకాశ ఉపజాయతే |
జ్ఞానం యదా తదా విద్యాద్వివృద్ధం సత్త్వమిత్యుత || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate
jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta
translation_english: When the illumination of knowledge radiates through all the doors of the senses in this body, then one should know that sattva has greatly increased.

text: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.12।।
text_kannada:
ಲೋಭಃ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿರಾರಂಭಃ ಕರ್ಮಣಾಮಶಮಃ ಸ್ಪೃಹಾ |
ರಜಸ್ಯೇತಾನಿ ಜಾಯಂತೇ ವಿವೃದ್ಧೇ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
లోభః ప్రవృత్తిరారంభః కర్మణామశమః స్పృహా |
రజస్యేతాని జాయంతే వివృద్ధే భరతర్షభ || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā
rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha
translation_english: O best of the Bharata dynasty, when rajas becomes predominant, these come into being: avarice, restlessness, undertaking of actions, agitation, and craving.

text: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन।।14.13।।
text_kannada:
ಅಪ್ರಕಾಶೋಽಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಶ್ಚ ಪ್ರಮಾದೋ ಮೋಹ ಏವ ಚ |
ತಮಸ್ಯೇತಾನಿ ಜಾಯಂತೇ ವಿವೃದ್ಧೇ ಕುರುನಂದನ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
అప్రకాశోఽప్రవృత్తిశ్చ ప్రమాదో మోహ ఏవ చ |
తమస్యేతాని జాయంతే వివృద్ధే కురునందన || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha
tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana
translation_english: O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, when tamas predominates, these come into being without exception: non-discrimination, inactivity, inadvertence, and delusion.

text: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते।।14.14।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ಸತ್ತ್ವೇ ಪ್ರವೃದ್ಧೇ ತು ಪ್ರಲಯಂ ಯಾತಿ ದೇಹಭೃತ್ |
ತದೋತ್ತಮವಿದಾಂ ಲೋಕಾನಮಲಾನ್ಪ್ರತಿಪದ್ಯತೇ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
యదా సత్త్వే ప్రవృద్ధే తు ప్రలయం యాతి దేహభృత్ |
తదోత్తమవిదాం లోకానమలాన్ప్రతిపద్యతే || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit
tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate
translation_english: When an embodied one undergoes death while sattva is exclusively predominant, then he attains the untainted worlds of those who know the highest (entities).

text: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते।।14.15।।
text_kannada:
ರಜಸಿ ಪ್ರಲಯಂ ಗತ್ವಾ ಕರ್ಮಸಂಗಿಷು ಜಾಯತೇ |
ತಥಾ ಪ್ರಲೀನಸ್ತಮಸಿ ಮೂಢಯೋನಿಷು ಜಾಯತೇ || ೧೫ ||

tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate
translation_english: When one dies while rajas predominates, they are born among people attached to activity. Similarly, when one dies while tamas predominates, they take birth among the stupid species.

text: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्।।14.16।।

ಕರ್ಮಣಃ ಸುಕೃತಸ್ಯಾಹುಃ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಂ ನಿರ್ಮಲಂ ಫಲಮ್ |
ರಜಸಸ್ತು ಫಲಂ ದುಃಖಮಜ್ಞಾನಂ ತಮಸಃ ಫಲಮ್ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మణః సుకృతస్యాహుః సాత్త్వికం నిర్మలం ఫలమ్ |
రజసస్తు ఫలం దుఃఖమజ్ఞానం తమసః ఫలమ్ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam

translation_english: They say that the result of good work is pure and is born of Sattva. But the result of Rajas is sorrow; the result of Tamas is ignorance.

text_kannada:
ಸತ್ತ್ವಾತ್ಸಂಜಾಯತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ರಜಸೋ ಲೋಭ ಏವ ಚ |
ಪ್ರಮಾದಮೋಹೌ ತಮಸೋ ಭವತೋಽಜ್ಞಾನಮೇವ ಚ || ೧೭ ||

సత్త్వాత్సంజాయతే జ్ఞానం రజసో లోభ ఏవ చ |

translation_english: From sattva is born knowledge, and from rajas, avarice indeed. From tamas are born inadvertence, delusion, and ignorance, to be sure.

text_kannada:
ಊರ್ಧ್ವಂ ಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ ಸತ್ತ್ವಸ್ಥಾ ಮಧ್ಯೇ ತಿಷ್ಠಂತಿ ರಾಜಸಾಃ |
ಜಘನ್ಯಗುಣವೃತ್ತಿಸ್ಥಾ ಅಧೋ ಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ ತಾಮಸಾಃ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
ఊర్ధ్వం గచ్ఛంతి సత్త్వస్థా మధ్యే తిష్ఠంతి రాజసాః |
జఘన్యగుణవృత్తిస్థా అధో గచ్ఛంతి తామసాః || ౧౮ ||

translation_english: People who conform to sattva go higher up; those who conform to rajas stay in the middle; those who conform to tamas, who conform to the actions of the lowest quality, go down.

text: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति।।14.19।।

ನಾನ್ಯಂ ಗುಣೇಭ್ಯಃ ಕರ್ತಾರಂ ಯದಾ ದ್ರಷ್ಟಾನುಪಶ್ಯತಿ |
ಗುಣೇಭ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಪರಂ ವೇತ್ತಿ ಮದ್ಭಾವಂ ಸೋಽಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
నాన్యం గుణేభ్యః కర్తారం యదా ద్రష్టానుపశ్యతి |
గుణేభ్యశ్చ పరం వేత్తి మద్భావం సోఽధిగచ్ఛతి || ౧౯ ||

translation_english: When the witness sees none other than the qualities as the agent, and knows that which is superior to the qualities, he attains My nature.

text_kannada:
ಗುಣಾನೇತಾನತೀತ್ಯ ತ್ರೀಂದೇಹೀ ದೇಹಸಮುದ್ಭವಾನ್ |
ಜನ್ಮಮೃತ್ಯುಜರಾದುಃಖೈರ್ವಿಮುಕ್ತೋಽಮೃತಮಶ್ನುತೇ || ೨೦ ||

జన్మమృత్యుజరాదుఃఖైర్విముక్తోఽమృతమశ్నుతే || ౨౦ ||

yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī
translation_english: Thereafter, that state must be sought, going where they do not return again: I take refuge in that Primeval Person Himself, from whom the eternal Manifestation has ensued.
context_english: tataḥ—then; padam—place; tat—that; parimārgitavyam—one must search out; yasmin—where; gatāḥ—having gone; na—not; nivartanti—return; bhūyaḥ—again; tam—to him; eva—certainly; cha—and; ādyam—original; puruṣham—the Supreme Lord; prapadye—take refuge; yataḥ—whence; pravṛittiḥ—the activity; prasṛitā—streamed forth; purāṇi—very old

text: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्।।15.5।।
text_kannada:
ನಿರ್ಮಾನಮೋಹಾ ಜಿತಸಂಗದೋಷಾ    ಅಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಿತ್ಯಾ ವಿನಿವೃತ್ತಕಾಮಾಃ |
ದ್ವಂದ್ವೈರ್ವಿಮುಕ್ತಾಃ ಸುಖದುಃಖಸಂಜ್ಞೈ    ರ್ಗಚ್ಛಂತ್ಯಮೂಢಾಃ ಪದಮವ್ಯಯಂ ತತ್ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
నిర్మానమోహా జితసంగదోషా    అధ్యాత్మనిత్యా వినివృత్తకామాః |
ద్వంద్వైర్విముక్తాః సుఖదుఃఖసంజ్ఞై    ర్గచ్ఛంత్యమూఢాః పదమవ్యయం తత్ || ౫ ||
transliteration:
nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā
adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ
dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair
gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat
translation_english: The wise ones, free from pride and non-discrimination, who have conquered the evil of association [hatred and love arising from association with foes and friends], who are ever devoted to spirituality, completely free from desires, and free from the dualities of happiness and sorrow, reach that undecaying state.
context_english: niḥ—free from; māna—vanity; mohāḥ—delusion; jita—having overcome; saṅga—attachment; doṣhāḥ—evils; adhyātma-nityāḥ—dwelling constantly in the self and God; vinivṛitta—freed from; kāmāḥ—desire to enjoy senses; dvandvaiḥ—from the dualities; vimuktāḥ—liberated; sukha-duḥkha—pleasure and pain; saṁjñaiḥ—known as; gachchhanti—attain; amūḍhāḥ—unbewildered; padam—abode; avyayam—eternal; tat—that

text: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।15.6।।
text_kannada:
ನ ತದ್ಭಾಸಯತೇ ಸೂರ್ಯೋ ನ ಶಶಾಂಕೋ ನ ಪಾವಕಃ |
ಯದ್ಗತ್ವಾ ನ ನಿವರ್ತಂತೇ ತದ್ಧಾಮ ಪರಮಂ ಮಮ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
న తద్భాసయతే సూర్యో న శశాంకో న పావకః |
యద్గత్వా న నివర్తంతే తద్ధామ పరమం మమ || ౬ ||
transliteration:
na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
translation_english: Neither the sun nor the moon nor fire illuminates That. That is My supreme Abode, to which they do not return.
context_english: na—neither; tat—that; bhāsayate—illumine; sūryaḥ—the sun; na—nor; śhaśhāṅkaḥ—the moon; na—nor; pāvakaḥ—fire; yat—where; gatvā—having gone; na—never; nivartante—they return; tat—that; dhāma—abode; paramam—supreme; mama—mine

text: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।15.7।।
text_kannada:
ಮಮೈವಾಂಶೋ ಜೀವಲೋಕೇ ಜೀವಭೂತಃ ಸನಾತನಃ |
ಮನಃಷಷ್ಠಾನೀಂದ್ರಿಯಾಣಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಸ್ಥಾನಿ ಕರ್ಷತಿ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
మమైవాంశో జీవలోకే జీవభూతః సనాతనః |
మనఃషష్ఠానీంద్రియాణి ప్రకృతిస్థాని కర్షతి || ౭ ||
transliteration:
mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati
translation_english: It is indeed a part of Mine that, becoming the eternal individual soul in the region of living beings, draws the organs, which have the mind as their sixth, and which abide in Nature.
context_english: mama—my; eva—only; anśhaḥ—fragmental part; jīva-loke—in the material world; jīva-bhūtaḥ—the embodied souls; sanātanaḥ—eternal; manaḥ—with the mind; ṣhaṣhṭhāni—the six; indriyāṇi—senses; prakṛiti-sthāni—bound by material nature; karṣhati—struggling

text: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्।।15.8।।
text_kannada:
ಶರೀರಂ ಯದವಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಯಚ್ಚಾಪ್ಯುತ್ಕ್ರಾಮತೀಶ್ವರಃ |
ಗೃಹೀತ್ವೈತಾನಿ ಸಂಯಾತಿ ವಾಯುರ್ಗಂಧಾನಿವಾಶಯಾತ್ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
శరీరం యదవాప్నోతి యచ్చాప్యుత్క్రామతీశ్వరః |
గృహీత్వైతాని సంయాతి వాయుర్గంధానివాశయాత్ || ౮ ||
transliteration:
śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ
gṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt
translation_english: When the master leaves it and even when he assumes a body, he departs taking these with him, just as the wind carries away odours from their receptacles.
context_english: śharīram—the body; yat—as; avāpnoti—carries; yat—as; cha api—also; utkrāmati—leaves; īśhvaraḥ—the Lord of the material body, the embodied soul; gṛihītvā—taking; etāni—these; sanyāti—goes away; vāyuḥ—the air; gandhān—fragrance; iva—like; āśhayāt—from seats

text: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।15.9।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೋತ್ರಂ ಚಕ್ಷುಃ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶನಂ ಚ ರಸನಂ ಘ್ರಾಣಮೇವ ಚ |
ಅಧಿಷ್ಠಾಯ ಮನಶ್ಚಾಯಂ ವಿಷಯಾನುಪಸೇವತೇ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రోత్రం చక్షుః స్పర్శనం చ రసనం ఘ్రాణమేవ చ |
అధిష్ఠాయ మనశ్చాయం విషయానుపసేవతే || ౯ ||
transliteration:
śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha
adhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate
translation_english: This one enjoys the objects by presiding over the ears, eyes, skin, tongue, nose, and mind.
context_english: śhrotram—ears; chakṣhuḥ—eyes; sparśhanam—the sense of touch; cha—and; rasanam—tongue; ghrāṇam—nose; eva—also; cha—and; adhiṣhṭhāya—grouped around; manaḥ—mind; cha—also; ayam—they; viṣhayān—sense objects; upasevate—savors

text: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः।।15.10।।
text_kannada:
ಉತ್ಕ್ರಾಮಂತಂ ಸ್ಥಿತಂ ವಾಪಿ ಭುಂಜಾನಂ ವಾ ಗುಣಾನ್ವಿತಮ್ |
ವಿಮೂಢಾ ನಾನುಪಶ್ಯಂತಿ ಪಶ್ಯಂತಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಚಕ್ಷುಷಃ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
ఉత్క్రామంతం స్థితం వాపి భుంజానం వా గుణాన్వితమ్ |
విమూఢా నానుపశ్యంతి పశ్యంతి జ్ఞానచక్షుషః || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ
translation_english: Persons who are diversely deluded do not see it even when it is leaving, residing, experiencing, or in association with the qualities; those with the eye of knowledge see.
context_english: utkrāmantam—departing; sthitam—residing; vā api—or even; bhuñjānam—enjoys; vā—or; guṇa-anvitam—under the spell of the modes of material nature; vimūḍhāḥ—the ignorant; na—not; anupaśhyanti—percieve; paśhyanti—behold; jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ—those who possess the eyes of knowledge

text: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः।।15.11।।
text_kannada:
ಯತಂತೋ ಯೋಗಿನಶ್ಚೈನಂ ಪಶ್ಯಂತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತಮ್ |
ಯತಂತೋಽಪ್ಯಕೃತಾತ್ಮಾನೋ ನೈನಂ ಪಶ್ಯಂತ್ಯಚೇತಸಃ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
యతంతో యోగినశ్చైనం పశ్యంత్యాత్మన్యవస్థితమ్ |
యతంతోఽప్యకృతాత్మానో నైనం పశ్యంత్యచేతసః || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam
yatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ
translation_english: And the diligent yogis see this one existing within themselves. The non-discriminating ones who lack self-control, however, do not see this one, even though they are diligent.
context_english: yatantaḥ—striving; yoginaḥ—yogis; cha—too; enam—this (the soul); paśhyanti—see; ātmani—in the body; avasthitam—enshrined; yatantaḥ—strive; api—even though; akṛita-ātmānaḥ—those whose minds are not purified; na—not; enam—this; paśhyanti—cognize; achetasaḥ—unaware

text: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।15.12।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾದಿತ್ಯಗತಂ ತೇಜೋ ಜಗದ್ಭಾಸಯತೇಽಖಿಲಮ್ |
ಯಚ್ಚಂದ್ರಮಸಿ ಯಚ್ಚಾಗ್ನೌ ತತ್ತೇಜೋ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಮಾಮಕಮ್ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
యదాదిత్యగతం తేజో జగద్భాసయతేఽఖిలమ్ |
యచ్చంద్రమసి యచ్చాగ్నౌ తత్తేజో విద్ధి మామకమ్ || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam
yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam
translation_english: That light in the sun which illuminates the whole world, that which is in the moon, and that which is in fire—know that light to be Mine.
context_english: yat—which; āditya-gatam—in the sun; tejaḥ—brilliance; jagat—solar system; bhāsayate—illuminates; akhilam—entire; yat—which; chandramasi—in the moon; yat—which; cha—also; agnau—in the fire; tat—that; tejaḥ—brightness; viddhi—know; māmakam—mine

text: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः।।15.13।।
text_kannada:
ಗಾಮಾವಿಶ್ಯ ಚ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಧಾರಯಾಮ್ಯಹಮೋಜಸಾ |
ಪುಷ್ಣಾಮಿ ಚೌಷಧೀಃ ಸರ್ವಾಃ ಸೋಮೋ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ರಸಾತ್ಮಕಃ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
గామావిశ్య చ భూతాని ధారయామ్యహమోజసా |
పుష్ణామి చౌషధీః సర్వాః సోమో భూత్వా రసాత్మకః || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā
puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
translation_english: And entering the Earth, I sustain the beings through My power; and nourish all the plants by becoming Soma, which is of the nature of sap.
context_english: gām—earth; āviśhya—permeating; cha—and; bhūtāni—living beings; dhārayāmi—sustain; aham—I; ojasā—energy; puṣhṇāmi—nourish; cha—and; auṣhadhīḥ—plants; sarvāḥ—all; somaḥ—the moon; bhūtvā—becoming; rasa-ātmakaḥ—supplying the juice of life

text: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्।।15.14।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂ ವೈಶ್ವಾನರೋ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಪ್ರಾಣಿನಾಂ ದೇಹಮಾಶ್ರಿತಃ |
ಪ್ರಾಣಾಪಾನಸಮಾಯುಕ್ತಃ ಪಚಾಮ್ಯನ್ನಂ ಚತುರ್ವಿಧಮ್ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
అహం వైశ్వానరో భూత్వా ప్రాణినాం దేహమాశ్రితః |
ప్రాణాపానసమాయుక్తః పచామ్యన్నం చతుర్విధమ్ || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ
prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham
translation_english: Taking the form of Vaisvanara, and residing in the bodies of creatures, I, in association with Prana and Apana, digest the four kinds of food.
context_english: aham—I; vaiśhvānaraḥ—fire of digestion; bhūtvā—becoming; prāṇinām—of all living beings; deham—the body; āśhritaḥ—situated; prāṇa-apāna—outgoing and incoming breath; samāyuktaḥ—keeping in balance; pachāmi—I digest; annam—foods; chatuḥ-vidham—the four kinds

text: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्।।15.15।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಚಾಹಂ ಹೃದಿ ಸನ್ನಿವಿಷ್ಟೋ    ಮತ್ತಃ ಸ್ಮೃತಿರ್ಜ್ಞಾನಮಪೋಹನಂ ಚ |
ವೇದೈಶ್ಚ ಸರ್ವೈರಹಮೇವ ವೇದ್ಯೋ    ವೇದಾಂತಕೃದ್ವೇದವಿದೇವ ಚಾಹಮ್ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వస్య చాహం హృది సన్నివిష్టో    మత్తః స్మృతిర్జ్ఞానమపోహనం చ |
వేదైశ్చ సర్వైరహమేవ వేద్యో    వేదాంతకృద్వేదవిదేవ చాహమ్ || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo
mattaḥ smṛitir jñānam apohanaṁ cha
vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo
vedānta-kṛid veda-vid eva chāham
translation_english: And I am seated in the hearts of all. From Me come memory, knowledge, and their loss. I alone am the object to be known through all the Vedas; I am also the originator of the Vedanta, and I Myself am the knower of the Vedas.
context_english: sarvasya—of all living beings; cha—and; aham—I; hṛidi—in the hearts; sanniviṣhṭaḥ—seated; mattaḥ—from me; smṛitiḥ—memory; jñānam—knowledge; apohanam—forgetfulness; cha—as well as; vedaiḥ—by the Vedas; cha—and; sarvaiḥ—all; aham—I; eva—alone; vedyaḥ—to be known; vedānta-kṛit—the author of the Vedānt; veda-vit—the knower of the meaning of the Vedas; eva—alone; cha—and; aham—I

text: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।।15.16।।
text_kannada:
ದ್ವಾವಿಮೌ ಪುರುಷೌ ಲೋಕೇ ಕ್ಷರಶ್ಚಾಕ್ಷರ ಏವ ಚ |
ಕ್ಷರಃ ಸರ್ವಾಣಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಕೂಟಸ್ಥೋಽಕ್ಷರ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
ద్వావిమౌ పురుషౌ లోకే క్షరశ్చాక్షర ఏవ చ |
క్షరః సర్వాణి భూతాని కూటస్థోఽక్షర ఉచ్యతే || ౧౬ ||
transliteration:

kṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate
translation_english: There are two kinds of people in the world: the mutable and the immutable. The mutable consists of all things; the one existing as Maya is referred to as the immutable.

text: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः।।15.17।।
text_kannada:
ಉತ್ತಮಃ ಪುರುಷಸ್ತ್ವನ್ಯಃ ಪರಮಾತ್ಮೇತ್ಯುದಾಹೃತಃ |
ಯೋ ಲೋಕತ್ರಯಮಾವಿಶ್ಯ ಬಿಭರ್ತ್ಯವ್ಯಯ ಈಶ್ವರಃ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఉత్తమః పురుషస్త్వన్యః పరమాత్మేత్యుదాహృతః |
యో లోకత్రయమావిశ్య బిభర్త్యవ్యయ ఈశ్వరః || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ
yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ
translation_english: But the Supreme Person is different; He is spoken of as the transcendental Self, permeating the three worlds and upholding them, and He is the imperishable God.

text: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः।।15.18।।
text_kannada:
ಯಸ್ಮಾತ್ಕ್ಷರಮತೀತೋಽಹಮಕ್ಷರಾದಪಿ ಚೋತ್ತಮಃ |
ಅತೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಲೋಕೇ ವೇದೇ ಚ ಪ್ರಥಿತಃ ಪುರುಷೋತ್ತಮಃ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
యస్మాత్క్షరమతీతోఽహమక్షరాదపి చోత్తమః |
అతోఽస్మి లోకే వేదే చ ప్రథితః పురుషోత్తమః || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ
ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ
translation_english: Since I am transcendental to the mutable and above even the immutable, therefore I am well known in the world and in the Vedas as the supreme Person.

text: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत।।15.19।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋ ಮಾಮೇವಮಸಮ್ಮೂಢೋ ಜಾನಾತಿ ಪುರುಷೋತ್ತಮಮ್ |
ಸ ಸರ್ವವಿದ್ಭಜತಿ ಮಾಂ ಸರ್ವಭಾವೇನ ಭಾರತ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
యో మామేవమసమ్మూఢో జానాతి పురుషోత్తమమ్ |
స సర్వవిద్భజతి మాం సర్వభావేన భారత || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam
sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, he who, being free from delusion, knows Me, the supreme Person, thus, is all-knowing and adores Me with his whole being.

text: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत।।15.20।।
text_kannada:
ಇತಿ ಗುಹ್ಯತಮಂ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಮಿದಮುಕ್ತಂ ಮಯಾಽನಘ |
ಏತದ್ಬುದ್ಧ್ವಾ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮಾನ್ಸ್ಯಾತ್ಕೃತಕೃತ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಭಾರತ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
ఇతి గుహ్యతమం శాస్త్రమిదముక్తం మయాఽనఘ |
ఏతద్బుద్ధ్వా బుద్ధిమాన్స్యాత్కృతకృత్యశ్చ భారత || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha
etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata
translation_english: O sinless one, I have thus uttered this most secret scripture. Understanding this, one becomes wise and fulfills their duties, O scion of the Bharata dynasty.

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।

दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्।।16.1।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಅಭಯಂ ಸತ್ತ್ವಸಂಶುದ್ಧಿಃ ಜ್ಞಾನಯೋಗವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತಿಃ |
ದಾನಂ ದಮಶ್ಚ ಯಜ್ಞಶ್ಚ ಸ್ವಾಧ್ಯಾಯಸ್ತಪ ಆರ್ಜವಮ್ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
అభయం సత్త్వసంశుద్ధిః జ్ఞానయోగవ్యవస్థితిః |
దానం దమశ్చ యజ్ఞశ్చ స్వాధ్యాయస్తప ఆర్జవమ్ || ౧ ||
transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
abhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ
dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of mind, persistence in knowledge and yoga, charity, control of the external organs, sacrifice, scriptural study, austerity, and rectitude.

text: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्।।16.2।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಿಂಸಾ ಸತ್ಯಮಕ್ರೋಧಸ್ತ್ಯಾಗಃ ಶಾಂತಿರಪೈಶುನಮ್ |
ದಯಾ ಭೂತೇಷ್ವಲೋಲುಪ್ತ್ವಂ ಮಾರ್ದವಂ ಹ್ರೀರಚಾಪಲಮ್ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
అహింసా సత్యమక్రోధస్త్యాగః శాంతిరపైశునమ్ |
దయా భూతేష్వలోలుప్త్వం మార్దవం హ్రీరచాపలమ్ || ౨ ||
transliteration:
ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam
dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam
translation_english: Non-injury, truthfulness, absence of anger, renunciation, control of the inner self, absence of vilification, kindness to creatures, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and freedom from restlessness;

text:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।

भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत।।16.3।।
text_kannada:
ತೇಜಃ ಕ್ಷಮಾ ಧೃತಿಃ ಶೌಚಮದ್ರೋಹೋ ನಾತಿಮಾನಿತಾ |
ಭವಂತಿ ಸಂಪದಂ ದೈವೀಮಭಿಜಾತಸ್ಯ ಭಾರತ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
తేజః క్షమా ధృతిః శౌచమద్రోహో నాతిమానితా |
భవంతి సంపదం దైవీమభిజాతస్య భారత || ౩ ||
transliteration:
tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā
bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
translation_english: Vigour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from malice, absence of haughtiness—these, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, are the qualities of one born destined to have the divine nature.

text: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्।।16.4।।
text_kannada:
ದಂಭೋ ದರ್ಪೋಽಭಿಮಾನಶ್ಚ ಕ್ರೋಧಃ ಪಾರುಷ್ಯಮೇವ ಚ |
ಅಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಚಾಭಿಜಾತಸ್ಯ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸಂಪದಮಾಸುರೀಮ್ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
దంభో దర్పోఽభిమానశ్చ క్రోధః పారుష్యమేవ చ |
అజ్ఞానం చాభిజాతస్య పార్థ సంపదమాసురీమ్ || ౪ ||
transliteration:
dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha
ajñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm
translation_english: O son of Prtha, the attributes of one destined to have the demoniacal nature are religious ostentation, pride, haughtiness, self-conceit, anger, rudeness, and ignorance.

text: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव।।16.5।।
text_kannada:
ದೈವೀ ಸಂಪದ್ವಿಮೋಕ್ಷಾಯ ನಿಬಂಧಾಯಾಸುರೀ ಮತಾ |
ಮಾ ಶುಚಃ ಸಂಪದಂ ದೈವೀಮಭಿಜಾತೋಽಸಿ ಪಾಂಡವ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
దైవీ సంపద్విమోక్షాయ నిబంధాయాసురీ మతా |
మా శుచః సంపదం దైవీమభిజాతోఽసి పాండవ || ౫ ||
transliteration:
daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava
translation_english: The divine nature is Liberation, while the demoniacal is considered to be an inevitable bondage. Do not grieve, O son of Pandu! You are destined to possess the divine nature.

text: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु।।16.6।।
text_kannada:
ದ್ವೌ ಭೂತಸರ್ಗೌ ಲೋಕೇಽಸ್ಮಿನ್ ದೈವ ಆಸುರ ಏವ ಚ |
ದೈವೋ ವಿಸ್ತರಶಃ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತ ಆಸುರಂ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಮೇ ಶ್ರೃಣು || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
ద్వౌ భూతసర్గౌ లోకేఽస్మిన్ దైవ ఆసుర ఏవ చ |
దైవో విస్తరశః ప్రోక్త ఆసురం పార్థ మే శ్రృణు || ౬ ||
transliteration:
dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha
daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu
translation_english: In this world, there are two kinds of creation of beings: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been spoken of elaborately. Hear about the demoniacal from Me, O son of Prtha.

text: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते।।16.7।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಚ ನಿವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಚ ಜನಾ ನ ವಿದುರಾಸುರಾಃ |
ನ ಶೌಚಂ ನಾಪಿ ಚಾಚಾರೋ ನ ಸತ್ಯಂ ತೇಷು ವಿದ್ಯತೇ || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రవృత్తిం చ నివృత్తిం చ జనా న విదురాసురాః |
న శౌచం నాపి చాచారో న సత్యం తేషు విద్యతే || ౭ ||
transliteration:
pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ
na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate
translation_english: Neither do the demoniacal persons understand what should be done and what should not be done; nor do they possess purity, good conduct, or truthfulness.

text: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्।।16.8।।
text_kannada:
ಅಸತ್ಯಮಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಂ ತೇ ಜಗದಾಹುರನೀಶ್ವರಮ್ |
ಅಪರಸ್ಪರಸಂಭೂತಂ ಕಿಮನ್ಯತ್ಕಾಮಹೈತುಕಮ್ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
అసత్యమప్రతిష్ఠం తే జగదాహురనీశ్వరమ్ |
అపరస్పరసంభూతం కిమన్యత్కామహైతుకమ్ || ౮ ||
transliteration:
asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram
aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam
translation_english: They say that the world is unreal, having no basis, and without a God. It is born of mutual union brought about by passion! What other cause could there be?

text: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः।।16.9।।
text_kannada:
ಏತಾಂ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಮವಷ್ಟಭ್ಯ ನಷ್ಟಾತ್ಮಾನೋಽಲ್ಪಬುದ್ಧಯಃ |
ಪ್ರಭವಂತ್ಯುಗ್ರಕರ್ಮಾಣಃ ಕ್ಷಯಾಯ ಜಗತೋಽಹಿತಾಃ || ೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఏతాం దృష్టిమవష్టభ్య నష్టాత్మానోఽల్పబుద్ధయః |
ప్రభవంత్యుగ్రకర్మాణః క్షయాయ జగతోఽహితాః || ౯ ||
transliteration:
etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ
prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ
translation_english: Holding onto this view, those of depraved character, poor intellect, and given to fearful and harmful actions, wax strong and bring ruin to the world.
context_english: etām—such; dṛiṣhṭim—views; avaṣhṭabhya—holding; naṣhṭa—misdirected; ātmānaḥ—souls; alpa-buddhayaḥ—of small intellect; prabhavanti—arise; ugra—cruel; karmāṇaḥ—actions; kṣhayāya—destruction; jagataḥ—of the world; ahitāḥ—enemies

text: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः।।16.10।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಮಮಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ದುಷ್ಪೂರಂ ದಂಭಮಾನಮದಾನ್ವಿತಾಃ |
ಮೋಹಾದ್ಗೃಹೀತ್ವಾಸದ್ಗ್ರಾಹಾನ್ಪ್ರವರ್ತಂತೇಽಶುಚಿವ್ರತಾಃ || ೧೦ ||
text_telugu:
కామమాశ్రిత్య దుష్పూరం దంభమానమదాన్వితాః |
మోహాద్గృహీత్వాసద్గ్రాహాన్ప్రవర్తంతేఽశుచివ్రతాః || ౧౦ ||
transliteration:
kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ
mohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ
translation_english: Giving themselves up to insatiable passion, filled with vanity, pride, and arrogance, adopting bad adjectives due to delusion, and having impure resolves, they engage in actions.
context_english: kāmam—lust; āśhritya—harboring; duṣhpūram—insatiable; dambha—hypocrisy; māna—arrogance; mada-anvitāḥ—clinging to false tenets; mohāt—the illusioned; gṛihītvā—being attracted to; asat—impermanent; grāhān—things; pravartante—they flourish; aśhuchi-vratāḥ—with impure resolve

text: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः।।16.11।।
text_kannada:
ಚಿಂತಾಮಪರಿಮೇಯಾಂ ಚ ಪ್ರಲಯಾಂತಾಮುಪಾಶ್ರಿತಾಃ |
ಕಾಮೋಪಭೋಗಪರಮಾ ಏತಾವದಿತಿ ನಿಶ್ಿಚತಾಃ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
చింతామపరిమేయాం చ ప్రలయాంతాముపాశ్రితాః |
కామోపభోగపరమా ఏతావదితి నిశ్ిచతాః || ౧౧ ||
transliteration:
chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ
kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ
translation_english: Beset with innumerable cares that end only with death, holding that the enjoyment of desirable objects is the highest goal, they feel sure that this is all.
context_english: chintām—anxieties; aparimeyām—endless; cha—and; pralaya-antām—until death; upāśhritāḥ—taking refuge; kāma-upabhoga—gratification of desires; paramāḥ—the purpose of life; etāvat—still; iti—thus; niśhchitāḥ—with complete assurance

text: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्।।16.12।।
text_kannada:
ಆಶಾಪಾಶಶತೈರ್ಬದ್ಧಾಃ ಕಾಮಕ್ರೋಧಪರಾಯಣಾಃ |
ಈಹಂತೇ ಕಾಮಭೋಗಾರ್ಥಮನ್ಯಾಯೇನಾರ್ಥಸಂಚಯಾನ್ || ೧೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఆశాపాశశతైర్బద్ధాః కామక్రోధపరాయణాః |
ఈహంతే కామభోగార్థమన్యాయేనార్థసంచయాన్ || ౧౨ ||
transliteration:
āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān
translation_english: Bound by hundreds of shackles in the form of hope, giving themselves wholly to passion and anger, they endeavor to amass wealth through foul means for the enjoyment of desirable objects.
context_english: āśhā-pāśha—bondage of desires; śhataiḥ—by hundreds; baddhāḥ—bound; kāma—lust; krodha—anger; parāyaṇāḥ—dedicated to; īhante—strive; kāma—lust; bhoga—gratification of the senses; artham—for; anyāyena—by unjust means; artha—wealth; sañchayān—to accumulate

text: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्।।16.13।।
text_kannada:
ಇದಮದ್ಯ ಮಯಾ ಲಬ್ಧಮಿಮಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಸ್ಯೇ ಮನೋರಥಮ್ |
ಇದಮಸ್ತೀದಮಪಿ ಮೇ ಭವಿಷ್ಯತಿ ಪುನರ್ಧನಮ್ || ೧೩ ||
text_telugu:
ఇదమద్య మయా లబ్ధమిమం ప్రాప్స్యే మనోరథమ్ |
ఇదమస్తీదమపి మే భవిష్యతి పునర్ధనమ్ || ౧౩ ||
transliteration:
idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham
idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam
translation_english: 'I have gained this today; I will acquire this desired object. This is in hand; and this wealth will also come to me.'
context_english: idam—this; adya—today; mayā—by me; labdham—gained; imam—this; prāpsye—I shall acquire; manaḥ-ratham—desire; idam—this; asti—is; idam—this; api—also; me—mine; bhaviṣhyati—in future; punaḥ—again; dhanam—wealth;

text: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी।।16.14।।
text_kannada:
ಅಸೌ ಮಯಾ ಹತಃ ಶತ್ರುರ್ಹನಿಷ್ಯೇ ಚಾಪರಾನಪಿ |
ಈಶ್ವರೋಽಹಮಹಂ ಭೋಗೀ ಸಿದ್ಧೋಽಹಂ ಬಲವಾನ್ಸುಖೀ || ೧೪ ||
text_telugu:
అసౌ మయా హతః శత్రుర్హనిష్యే చాపరానపి |
ఈశ్వరోఽహమహం భోగీ సిద్ధోఽహం బలవాన్సుఖీ || ౧౪ ||
transliteration:
asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api
īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī
translation_english: 'I have slain that enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord, the Enjoyer, firmly established, powerful and joyous.'
context_english: asau—that; mayā—by me; hataḥ—has been destroyed; śhatruḥ—enemy; haniṣhye—I shall destroy; cha—and; aparān—others; api—also; īśhvaraḥ—God; aham—I; aham—I; bhogī—the enjoyer; siddhaḥ—powerful; aham—I; bala-vān—powerful; sukhī—happy;

text: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः।।16.15।।
text_kannada:
ಆಢ್ಯೋಽಭಿಜನವಾನಸ್ಮಿ ಕೋಽನ್ಯೋಽಸ್ತಿ ಸದೃಶೋ ಮಯಾ |
ಯಕ್ಷ್ಯೇ ದಾಸ್ಯಾಮಿ ಮೋದಿಷ್ಯ ಇತ್ಯಜ್ಞಾನವಿಮೋಹಿತಾಃ || ೧೫ ||
text_telugu:
ఆఢ్యోఽభిజనవానస్మి కోఽన్యోఽస్తి సదృశో మయా |
యక్ష్యే దాస్యామి మోదిష్య ఇత్యజ్ఞానవిమోహితాః || ౧౫ ||
transliteration:
āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā
yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ
 aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau
translation_english: 'I am wealthy and of noble birth; who else is like me? I shall perform sacrifices; I shall give, I shall rejoice'- thus, they are deluded by a lack of discernment in diverse ways.
context_english:
āḍhyaḥ—wealthy; abhijana-vān—having highly placed relatives; asmi—me; kaḥ—who; anyaḥ—else; asti—is; sadṛiśhaḥ—like; mayā—to me; yakṣhye—I shall perform sacrifices; dāsyāmi—I shall give alms; modiṣhye—I shall rejoice; iti—thus; ajñāna—ignorance; vimohitāḥ—deluded
 aneka—many; chitta—imaginings; vibhrāntāḥ—led astray; moha—delusion; jāla—mesh; samāvṛitāḥ—enveloped; prasaktāḥ—addicted; kāma-bhogeṣhu—gratification of sensuous pleasures; patanti—descend; narake—to hell; aśhuchau—murky

text: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ।।16.16।।
text_kannada:
ಅನೇಕಚಿತ್ತವಿಭ್ರಾಂತಾ ಮೋಹಜಾಲಸಮಾವೃತಾಃ |
ಪ್ರಸಕ್ತಾಃ ಕಾಮಭೋಗೇಷು ಪತಂತಿ ನರಕೇಽಶುಚೌ || ೧೬ ||
text_telugu:
అనేకచిత్తవిభ్రాంతా మోహజాలసమావృతాః |
ప్రసక్తాః కామభోగేషు పతంతి నరకేఽశుచౌ || ౧౬ ||
transliteration: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau
translation_english: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, ensnared in the net of delusion, and engrossed in the enjoyment of desirable objects, they fall into a foul hell.
context_english: aneka—numerous;    citta-vibhrāntāḥ—perplexed  by  anxieties;  moha—of illusions;  jāla—by a   network;    samāvṛtāḥ—surrounded;   prasaktāḥ—attached; kāma—lust;  bhogeṣu—sense  gratification;   patanti—glides  down; narake—into hell; aśucau—unclean.

text: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्।।16.17।।
text_kannada:
ಆತ್ಮಸಂಭಾವಿತಾಃ ಸ್ತಬ್ಧಾ ಧನಮಾನಮದಾನ್ವಿತಾಃ |
ಯಜಂತೇ ನಾಮಯಜ್ಞೈಸ್ತೇ ದಂಭೇನಾವಿಧಿಪೂರ್ವಕಮ್ || ೧೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఆత్మసంభావితాః స్తబ్ధా ధనమానమదాన్వితాః |
యజంతే నామయజ్ఞైస్తే దంభేనావిధిపూర్వకమ్ || ౧౭ ||
transliteration:
ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ
yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam
translation_english: Self-conceited, haughty, filled with pride and intoxicated by wealth, they perform sacrifices that are only in name, ostentatiously and without regard for the injunctions.
context_english: ātma-sambhāvitāḥ—self-conceited; stabdhāḥ—stubborn; dhana—wealth; māna—pride; mada—arrogance; anvitāḥ—full of; yajante—perform sacrifice; nāma—in name only; yajñaiḥ—sacrifices; te—they; dambhena—ostentatiously; avidhi-pūrvakam—with no regards to the rules of the scriptures

text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः।।16.18।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂಕಾರಂ ಬಲಂ ದರ್ಪಂ ಕಾಮಂ ಕ್ರೋಧಂ ಚ ಸಂಶ್ರಿತಾಃ |
ಮಾಮಾತ್ಮಪರದೇಹೇಷು ಪ್ರದ್ವಿಷಂತೋಽಭ್ಯಸೂಯಕಾಃ || ೧೮ ||
text_telugu:
అహంకారం బలం దర్పం కామం క్రోధం చ సంశ్రితాః |
మామాత్మపరదేహేషు ప్రద్విషంతోఽభ్యసూయకాః || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ
mām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ
translation_english: Resorting to egotism, power, arrogance, passion, and anger, hating Me in their own and others' bodies, they become envious by nature.
context_english: ahankāram—egotism; balam—strength; darpam—arrogance; kāmam—desire; krodham—anger; cha—and; sanśhritāḥ—covered by; mām—me; ātma-para-deheṣhu—within one’s own and bodies of others; pradviṣhantaḥ—abuse; abhyasūyakāḥ—the demoniac

text: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु।।16.19।।
text_kannada:
ತಾನಹಂ ದ್ವಿಷತಃ ಕ್ರೂರಾನ್ಸಂಸಾರೇಷು ನರಾಧಮಾನ್ |
ಕ್ಷಿಪಾಮ್ಯಜಸ್ರಮಶುಭಾನಾಸುರೀಷ್ವೇವ ಯೋನಿಷು || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
తానహం ద్విషతః క్రూరాన్సంసారేషు నరాధమాన్ |
క్షిపామ్యజస్రమశుభానాసురీష్వేవ యోనిషు || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān
kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu
translation_english: I cast forever those hateful, cruel, evil-doers in the worlds, the vilest of human beings, verily into the demonic classes.
context_english: tān—these; aham—I; dviṣhataḥ—hateful; krūrān—cruel; sansāreṣhu—in the material world; nara-adhamān—the vile and vicious of humankind; kṣhipāmi—I hurl; ajasram—again and again; aśhubhān—inauspicious; āsurīṣhu—demoniac; eva—indeed; yoniṣhu—in to the wombs;

text: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्।।16.20।।
text_kannada:
ಅಸುರೀಂ ಯೋನಿಮಾಪನ್ನಾ ಮೂಢಾ ಜನ್ಮನಿ ಜನ್ಮನಿ |
ಮಾಮಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯೈವ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ತತೋ ಯಾಂತ್ಯಧಮಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
అసురీం యోనిమాపన్నా మూఢా జన్మని జన్మని |
మామప్రాప్యైవ కౌంతేయ తతో యాంత్యధమాం గతిమ్ || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim
translation_english: Being born among the demoniacal species in birth after birth, the souls, without ever reaching Me, O son of Kunti, attain conditions lower than that.
context_english: āsurīm—demoniac; yonim—wombs; āpannāḥ—gaining; mūḍhāḥ—the ignorant; janmani janmani—in birth after birth; mām—me; aprāpya—failing to reach; eva—even; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; tataḥ—thereafter; yānti—go; adhamām—abominable; gatim—destination

text: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्।।16.21।।
text_kannada:
ತ್ರಿವಿಧಂ ನರಕಸ್ಯೇದಂ ದ್ವಾರಂ ನಾಶನಮಾತ್ಮನಃ |
ಕಾಮಃ ಕ್ರೋಧಸ್ತಥಾ ಲೋಭಸ್ತಸ್ಮಾದೇತತ್ತ್ರಯಂ ತ್ಯಜೇತ್ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
త్రివిధం నరకస్యేదం ద్వారం నాశనమాత్మనః |
కామః క్రోధస్తథా లోభస్తస్మాదేతత్త్రయం త్యజేత్ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet
translation_english: This door to hell, which destroys the soul, is of three kinds—passion, anger, and greed. Therefore, one should forsake these three.
context_english: tri-vidham—three types of; narakasya—to the hell; idam—this; dvāram—gates; nāśhanam—destruction; ātmanaḥ—self; kāmaḥ—lust; krodhaḥ—anger; tathā—and; lobhaḥ—greed; tasmāt—therefore; etat—these; trayam—three; tyajet—should abandon

text: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।16.22।।
text_kannada:
ಏತೈರ್ವಿಮುಕ್ತಃ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ತಮೋದ್ವಾರೈಸ್ತ್ರಿಭಿರ್ನರಃ |
ಆಚರತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಃ ಶ್ರೇಯಸ್ತತೋ ಯಾತಿ ಪರಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
ఏతైర్విముక్తః కౌంతేయ తమోద్వారైస్త్రిభిర్నరః |
ఆచరత్యాత్మనః శ్రేయస్తతో యాతి పరాం గతిమ్ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ
ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
translation_english: O son of Kunti, a person who is free from these three doors to darkness strives for the good of the soul; thereby, they attain the highest Goal.
context_english: etaiḥ—from this; vimuktaḥ—freed; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; tamaḥ-dvāraiḥ—gates to darkness; tribhiḥ—three; naraḥ—a person; ācharati—endeavor; ātmanaḥ—soul; śhreyaḥ—welfare; tataḥ—thereby; yāti—attain; parām—supreme; gatim—goal

text: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।।16.23।।
text_kannada:
ಯಃ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿಧಿಮುತ್ಸೃಜ್ಯ ವರ್ತತೇ ಕಾಮಕಾರತಃ |
ನ ಸ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಮವಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ನ ಸುಖಂ ನ ಪರಾಂ ಗತಿಮ್ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
యః శాస్త్రవిధిముత్సృజ్య వర్తతే కామకారతః |
న స సిద్ధిమవాప్నోతి న సుఖం న పరాం గతిమ్ || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ
na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim
translation_english: Ignoring the precepts of the scriptures, he who acts under the impulse of passion does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme goal.
context_english: yaḥ—who; śhāstra-vidhim—scriptural injunctions; utsṛijya—discarding; vartate—act; kāma-kārataḥ—under the impulse of desire; na—neither; saḥ—they; siddhim—perfection; avāpnoti—attain; na—nor; sukham—happiness; na—nor; parām—the supreme; gatim—goal

text: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि।।16.24।।
text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾಚ್ಛಾಸ್ತ್ರಂ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಂ ತೇ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಕಾರ್ಯವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತೌ |
ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿಧಾನೋಕ್ತಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕರ್ತುಮಿಹಾರ್ಹಸಿ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
తస్మాచ్ఛాస్త్రం ప్రమాణం తే కార్యాకార్యవ్యవస్థితౌ |
జ్ఞాత్వా శాస్త్రవిధానోక్తం కర్మ కర్తుమిహార్హసి || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau
jñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi
translation_english: Therefore, the scripture is your authority as regards determining what should be done and what should not be done. After understanding your duty as presented by scriptural injunction, you ought to perform it here.
context_english: tasmāt—therefore; śhāstram—scriptures; pramāṇam—authority; te—your; kārya—duty; akārya—forbidden action; vyavasthitau—in determining; jñātvā—having understood; śhāstra—scriptures; vidhāna—injunctions; uktam—as revealed; karma—actions; kartum—perform; iha—in this world; arhasi—you should

text: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः।।17.1।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚಯೇ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿಧಿಮುತ್ಸೃಜ್ಯ ಯಜಂತೇ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾಽನ್ವಿತಾಃ |
ತೇಷಾಂ ನಿಷ್ಠಾ ತು ಕಾ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಸತ್ತ್ವಮಾಹೋ ರಜಸ್ತಮಃ || ೧ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచయే శాస్త్రవిధిముత్సృజ్య యజంతే శ్రద్ధయాఽన్వితాః |
తేషాం నిష్ఠా తు కా కృష్ణ సత్త్వమాహో రజస్తమః || ౧ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
ye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ
translation_english: Arjuna said, But, O Krsna, what is the state of those who, endued with faith, perform sacrifices, distribute wealth, etc. in honour of gods and others, while ignoring the injunctions of the scriptures? Is it sattva, rajas, or tamas?
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; ye—who; śhāstra-vidhim—scriptural injunctions; utsṛijya—disregard; yajante—worship; śhraddhayā-anvitāḥ—with faith; teṣhām—their; niṣhṭhā—faith; tu—indeed; kā—what; kṛiṣhṇa—Krishna; sattvam—mode of goodness; āho—or; rajaḥ—mode of passion; tamaḥ—mode of ignorance

text: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु।।17.2।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚತ್ರಿವಿಧಾ ಭವತಿ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾ ದೇಹಿನಾಂ ಸಾ ಸ್ವಭಾವಜಾ |
ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕೀ ರಾಜಸೀ ಚೈವ ತಾಮಸೀ ಚೇತಿ ತಾಂ ಶ್ರೃಣು || ೨ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచత్రివిధా భవతి శ్రద్ధా దేహినాం సా స్వభావజా |
సాత్త్వికీ రాజసీ చైవ తామసీ చేతి తాం శ్రృణు || ౨ ||
transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā
sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu
translation_english: The Blessed Lord said, "That faith of the embodied beings, born of their own nature, is threefold—born of sattva, rajas, and tamas. Hear about it."
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Personality said; tri-vidhā—of three kinds; bhavati—is; śhraddhā—faith; dehinām—embodied beings; sā—which; sva-bhāva-jā—born of one’s innate nature; sāttvikī—of the mode of goodness; rājasī—of the mode of passion; cha—and; eva—certainly; tāmasī—of the mode of ignorance; cha—and; iti—thus; tām—about this; śhṛiṇu—hear

text: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः।।17.3।।
text_kannada:
ಸತ್ತ್ವಾನುರೂಪಾ ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾ ಭವತಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾಮಯೋಽಯಂ ಪುರುಷೋ ಯೋ ಯಚ್ಛ್ರದ್ಧಃ ಸ ಏವ ಸಃ || ೩ ||
text_telugu:
సత్త్వానురూపా సర్వస్య శ్రద్ధా భవతి భారత |
శ్రద్ధామయోఽయం పురుషో యో యచ్ఛ్రద్ధః స ఏవ సః || ౩ ||
transliteration:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata
śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
translation_english: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, the faith of all beings is in accordance with their minds. This person is composed of faith as the dominant factor. He is indeed what his faith is.
context_english: sattva-anurūpā—conforming to the nature of one’s mind; sarvasya—all; śhraddhā—faith; bhavati—is; bhārata—Arjun, the scion of Bharat; śhraddhāmayaḥ—possessing faith; ayam—that; puruṣhaḥ—human being; yaḥ—who; yat-śhraddhaḥ—whatever the nature of their faith; saḥ—their; eva—verily; saḥ—they

text: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः।।17.4।।
text_kannada:
ಯಜಂತೇ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಾ ದೇವಾನ್ಯಕ್ಷರಕ್ಷಾಂಸಿ ರಾಜಸಾಃ |
ಪ್ರೇತಾನ್ಭೂತಗಣಾಂಶ್ಚಾನ್ಯೇ ಯಜಂತೇ ತಾಮಸಾ ಜನಾಃ || ೪ ||
text_telugu:
యజంతే సాత్త్వికా దేవాన్యక్షరక్షాంసి రాజసాః |
ప్రేతాన్భూతగణాంశ్చాన్యే యజంతే తామసా జనాః || ౪ ||
transliteration:
yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ
pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
translation_english: Those with sattva quality worship the gods; those with rajas, the demigods and demons; and those with tamas, ghosts and hosts of spirits.
context_english: yajante—worship; sāttvikāḥ—those in the mode of goodness; devān—celestial gods; yakṣha—semi-celestial beings who exude power and wealth; rakṣhānsi—powerful beings who embody sensual enjoyment, revenge, and wrath; rājasāḥ—those in the mode of passion; pretān-bhūta-gaṇān—ghosts and spirits; cha—and; anye—others; yajante—worship; tāmasāḥ—those in the mode of ignorance; janāḥ—persons

text: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः।।17.5।।
text_kannada:
ಅಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವಿಹಿತಂ ಘೋರಂ ತಪ್ಯಂತೇ ಯೇ ತಪೋ ಜನಾಃ |
ದಂಭಾಹಂಕಾರಸಂಯುಕ್ತಾಃ ಕಾಮರಾಗಬಲಾನ್ವಿತಾಃ || ೫ ||
text_telugu:
అశాస్త్రవిహితం ఘోరం తప్యంతే యే తపో జనాః |
దంభాహంకారసంయుక్తాః కామరాగబలాన్వితాః || ౫ ||
transliteration:
aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
dambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ
translation_english: Those persons who, given to ostentation and pride, and possessed of passion, attachment, and strength, undertake severe austerities not sanctioned by the scriptures;
context_english: aśhāstra-vihitam—not enjoined by the scriptures; ghoram—stern; tapyante—perform; ye—who; tapaḥ—austerities; janāḥ—people; dambha—hypocrisy; ahankāra—egotism; sanyuktāḥ—possessed of; kāma—desire; rāga—attachment; bala—force; anvitāḥ—impelled by;

text: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्।।17.6।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಷಯಂತಃ ಶರೀರಸ್ಥಂ ಭೂತಗ್ರಾಮಮಚೇತಸಃ |
ಮಾಂ ಚೈವಾಂತಃಶರೀರಸ್ಥಂ ತಾನ್ವಿದ್ಧ್ಯಾಸುರನಿಶ್ಚಯಾನ್ || ೬ ||
text_telugu:
కర్షయంతః శరీరస్థం భూతగ్రామమచేతసః |
మాం చైవాంతఃశరీరస్థం తాన్విద్ధ్యాసురనిశ్చయాన్ || ౬ ||
transliteration:
karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ
māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān
translation_english: (And those who,) being non-discriminating, torture all the organs in the body as well as even Me who reside in the body—know them to be possessed of demoniacal conviction.
context_english: karṣhayantaḥ—torment; śharīra-stham—within the body; bhūta-grāmam—elements of the body; achetasaḥ—senseless; mām—me; cha—and; eva—even; antaḥ—within; śharīra-stham—dwelling in the body; tān—them; viddhi—know; āsura-niśhchayān—of demoniacal resolves

text: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु।।17.7।।
text_kannada:
ಆಹಾರಸ್ತ್ವಪಿ ಸರ್ವಸ್ಯ ತ್ರಿವಿಧೋ ಭವತಿ ಪ್ರಿಯಃ |
ಯಜ್ಞಸ್ತಪಸ್ತಥಾ ದಾನಂ ತೇಷಾಂ ಭೇದಮಿಮಂ ಶ್ರೃಣು || ೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఆహారస్త్వపి సర్వస్య త్రివిధో భవతి ప్రియః |
యజ్ఞస్తపస్తథా దానం తేషాం భేదమిమం శ్రృణు || ౭ ||
transliteration:
āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ
yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu
translation_english: Food, which is dear to all, is of three kinds; likewise, sacrifices, austerity, and charity are also of three kinds. Listen to this classification of them.
context_english: āhāraḥ—food; tu—indeed; api—even; sarvasya—of all; tri-vidhaḥ—of three kinds; bhavati—is; priyaḥ—dear; yajñaḥ—sacrifice; tapaḥ—austerity; tathā—and; dānam—charity; teṣhām—of them; bhedam—distinctions; imam—this; śhṛiṇu—hear

text: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।17.8।।
text_kannada:
ಆಯುಃಸತ್ತ್ವಬಲಾರೋಗ್ಯಸುಖಪ್ರೀತಿವಿವರ್ಧನಾಃ |
ರಸ್ಯಾಃ ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧಾಃ ಸ್ಥಿರಾ ಹೃದ್ಯಾ ಆಹಾರಾಃ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಪ್ರಿಯಾಃ || ೮ ||
text_telugu:
ఆయుఃసత్త్వబలారోగ్యసుఖప్రీతివివర్ధనాః |
రస్యాః స్నిగ్ధాః స్థిరా హృద్యా ఆహారాః సాత్త్వికప్రియాః || ౮ ||
transliteration:
āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ
translation_english: Foods that augment life, firmness of mind, strength, health, happiness, and delight, and which are succulent, oleaginous, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to one endowed with sattva.
context_english: āyuḥ sattva—which promote longevity; bala—strength; ārogya—health; sukha—happiness; prīti—satisfaction; vivardhanāḥ—increase; rasyāḥ—juicy; snigdhāḥ—succulent; sthirāḥ—nourishing; hṛidyāḥ—pleasing to the heart; āhārāḥ—food; sāttvika-priyāḥ—dear to those in the mode of goodness

text: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः।।17.9।।
text_kannada:
ಕಟ್ವಮ್ಲಲವಣಾತ್ಯುಷ್ಣತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣರೂಕ್ಷವಿದಾಹಿನಃ |
ಆಹಾರಾ ರಾಜಸಸ್ಯೇಷ್ಟಾ ದುಃಖಶೋಕಾಮಯಪ್ರದಾಃ || ೯ ||

text: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।17.10।।

ఉచ్ఛిష్టమపి చామేధ్యం భోజనం తామసప్రియమ్ || ౧౦ ||

ಅಫಲಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿಭಿರ್ಯಜ್ಞೋ ವಿಧಿದೃಷ್ಟೋ ಯ ಇಜ್ಯತೇ |
ಯಷ್ಟವ್ಯಮೇವೇತಿ ಮನಃ ಸಮಾಧಾಯ ಸ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಃ || ೧೧ ||
text_telugu:
అఫలాకాంక్షిభిర్యజ్ఞో విధిదృష్టో య ఇజ్యతే |

text: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्।।17.12।।

ಇಜ್ಯತೇ ಭರತಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ತಂ ಯಜ್ಞಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ರಾಜಸಮ್ || ೧೨ ||

ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam

శ్రద్ధావిరహితం యజ్ఞం తామసం పరిచక్షతే || ౧౩ ||

text: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.22।।
text_kannada:
ಅದೇಶಕಾಲೇ ಯದ್ದಾನಮಪಾತ್ರೇಭ್ಯಶ್ಚ ದೀಯತೇ |
ಅಸತ್ಕೃತಮವಜ್ಞಾತಂ ತತ್ತಾಮಸಮುದಾಹೃತಮ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:

text: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा।।17.23।।
text_kannada:
ತತ್ಸದಿತಿ ನಿರ್ದೇಶೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಸ್ತ್ರಿವಿಧಃ ಸ್ಮೃತಃ |

బ్రాహ్మణాస్తేన వేదాశ్చ యజ్ఞాశ్చ విహితాః పురా || ౨౩ ||

text_kannada:
ತಸ್ಮಾದೋಮಿತ್ಯುದಾಹೃತ್ಯ ಯಜ್ಞದಾನತಪಃಕ್ರಿಯಾಃ |
ಪ್ರವರ್ತಂತೇ ವಿಧಾನೋಕ್ತಾಃ ಸತತಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮವಾದಿನಾಮ್ || ೨೪ ||

తస్మాదోమిత్యుదాహృత్య యజ్ఞదానతపఃక్రియాః |
ప్రవర్తంతే విధానోక్తాః సతతం బ్రహ్మవాదినామ్ || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām
translation_english: Therefore, acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity, as prescribed through injunctions, of those who study and expound the Vedas, always commence after uttering the syllable ‘Om’.

text: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि।।17.25।।
text_kannada:
ತದಿತ್ಯನಭಿಸಂಧಾಯ ಫಲಂ ಯಜ್ಞತಪಃಕ್ರಿಯಾಃ |
ದಾನಕ್ರಿಯಾಶ್ಚ ವಿವಿಧಾಃ ಕ್ರಿಯಂತೇ ಮೋಕ್ಷಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
తదిత్యనభిసంధాయ ఫలం యజ్ఞతపఃక్రియాః |
దానక్రియాశ్చ వివిధాః క్రియంతే మోక్షకాంక్షి || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:

text: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते।।17.26।।
text_kannada:
ಸದ್ಭಾವೇ ಸಾಧುಭಾವೇ ಚ ಸದಿತ್ಯೇತತ್ಪ್ರಯುಜ್ಯತೇ |
ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತೇ ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ತಥಾ ಸಚ್ಛಬ್ದಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಯುಜ್ಯತೇ || ೨೬ ||

సద్భావే సాధుభావే చ సదిత్యేతత్ప్రయుజ్యతే |
ప్రశస్తే కర్మణి తథా సచ్ఛబ్దః పార్థ యుజ్యతే || ౨౬ ||

text_kannada:
ಯಜ್ಞೇ ತಪಸಿ ದಾನೇ ಚ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಃ ಸದಿತಿ ಚೋಚ್ಯತೇ |

యజ్ఞే తపసి దానే చ స్థితిః సదితి చోచ్యతే |

yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate

ಅಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ ಹುತಂ ದತ್ತಂ ತಪಸ್ತಪ್ತಂ ಕೃತಂ ಚ ಯತ್ |

అశ్రద్ధయా హుతం దత్తం తపస్తప్తం కృతం చ యత్ |

text:
अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्।

त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन।।18.1।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಸ್ಯ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ತತ್ತ್ವಮಿಚ್ಛಾಮಿ ವೇದಿತುಮ್ |
ತ್ಯಾಗಸ್ಯ ಚ ಹೃಷೀಕೇಶ ಪೃಥಕ್ಕೇಶಿನಿಷೂದನ || ೧ ||

sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum
tyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana
translation_english: Arjuna said, O mighty-armed Hrsikesa, O slayer of Kesi, I want to know separately the truth about sannyasa as well as about tyaga.

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।

सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः।।18.2।।
text_kannada:

ಕಾಮ್ಯಾನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಣಾಂ ನ್ಯಾಸಂ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಂ ಕವಯೋ ವಿದುಃ |
ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಫಲತ್ಯಾಗಂ ಪ್ರಾಹುಸ್ತ್ಯಾಗಂ ವಿಚಕ್ಷಣಾಃ || ೨ ||
text_telugu:

text:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।

translation_english: O the most excellent among the descendants of Bharata, hear from Me the firm conclusion regarding that tyaga. For, O greatest among men, tyaga has been clearly declared to be of three kinds.

text_telugu:
యజ్ఞదానతపఃకర్మ న త్యాజ్యం కార్యమేవ తత్ |

text_telugu:
జ్ఞానం జ్ఞేయం పరిజ్ఞాతా త్రివిధా కర్మచోదనా |
కరణం కర్మ కర్తేతి త్రివిధః కర్మసంగ్రహః || ౧౮ ||
transliteration:
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā
karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ
translation_english: Knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the knower—these are the threefold inducements to action. The comprehension of actions comes under three heads: the instruments, the object, and the subject.
context_english: jñānam—knowledge; jñeyam—the object of knowledge; parijñātā—the knower; tri-vidhā—three factors; karma-chodanā—factors that induce action; karaṇam—the instrumens of action; karma—the act; kartā—the doer; iti—thus; tri-vidhaḥ—threefold; karma-saṅgrahaḥ—constituents of action

text: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि।।18.19।।
text_kannada:
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಚ ಕರ್ತಾ ಚ ತ್ರಿಧೈವ ಗುಣಭೇದತಃ |
ಪ್ರೋಚ್ಯತೇ ಗುಣಸಂಖ್ಯಾನೇ ಯಥಾವಚ್ಛೃಣು ತಾನ್ಯಪಿ || ೧೯ ||
text_telugu:
జ్ఞానం కర్మ చ కర్తా చ త్రిధైవ గుణభేదతః |
ప్రోచ్యతే గుణసంఖ్యానే యథావచ్ఛృణు తాన్యపి || ౧౯ ||
transliteration:
jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ
prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api
translation_english: Knowledge, action, and agent are stated in the teaching about the gunas to be only of three kinds, according to the differences of the gunas. Hear about them also as they are.
context_english: jñānam—knowledge; karma—action; cha—and; kartā—doer; cha—also; tridhā—of three kinds; eva—certainly; guṇa-bhedataḥ—distinguished according to the three modes of material nature; prochyate—are declared; guṇa-saṅkhyāne—Sānkhya philosophy, which describes the modes of material nature; yathā-vat—as they are; śhṛiṇu—listen; tāni—them; api—also

text: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्।।18.20।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಭೂತೇಷು ಯೇನೈಕಂ ಭಾವಮವ್ಯಯಮೀಕ್ಷತೇ |
ಅವಿಭಕ್ತಂ ವಿಭಕ್ತೇಷು ತಜ್ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಮ್ || ೨೦ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వభూతేషు యేనైకం భావమవ్యయమీక్షతే |
అవిభక్తం విభక్తేషు తజ్జ్ఞానం విద్ధి సాత్త్వికమ్ || ౨౦ ||
transliteration:
sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate
avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam
translation_english: Know that knowledge to originate from sattva, through which one sees a single, undecaying, undivided entity in all the diversified things.
context_english: sarva-bhūteṣhu—within all living beings; yena—by which; ekam—one; bhāvam—nature; avyayam—imperishable; īkṣhate—one sees; avibhaktam—undivided; vibhakteṣhu—in diversity; tat—that; jñānam—knowledge; viddhi—understand; sāttvikam—in the mode of goodness

text: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्।।18.21।।
text_kannada:
ಪೃಥಕ್ತ್ವೇನ ತು ಯಜ್ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ನಾನಾಭಾವಾನ್ಪೃಥಗ್ವಿಧಾನ್ |
ವೇತ್ತಿ ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಭೂತೇಷು ತಜ್ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ರಾಜಸಮ್ || ೨೧ ||
text_telugu:
పృథక్త్వేన తు యజ్జ్ఞానం నానాభావాన్పృథగ్విధాన్ |
వేత్తి సర్వేషు భూతేషు తజ్జ్ఞానం విద్ధి రాజసమ్ || ౨౧ ||
transliteration:
pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān
vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam
translation_english: But know that knowledge to originate from rajas, which amidst all things apprehends the different entities of various kinds as distinct [as possessing distinct selves].
context_english: pṛithaktvena—unconnected; tu—however; yat—which; jñānam—knowledge; nānā-bhāvān—manifold entities; pṛithak-vidhān—of diversity; vetti—consider; sarveṣhu—in all; bhūteṣhu—living entities; tat—that; jñānam—knowledge; viddhi—know; rājasam—in the mode of passion

text: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.22।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ತು ಕೃತ್ಸ್ನವದೇಕಸ್ಮಿನ್ಕಾರ್ಯೇ ಸಕ್ತಮಹೈತುಕಮ್ |
ಅತತ್ತ್ವಾರ್ಥವದಲ್ಪಂ ಚ ತತ್ತಾಮಸಮುದಾಹೃತಮ್ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
యత్తు కృత్స్నవదేకస్మిన్కార్యే సక్తమహైతుకమ్ |
అతత్త్వార్థవదల్పం చ తత్తామసముదాహృతమ్ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam
atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
translation_english: But that (knowledge) is said to be born of tamas which is confined to one form as if it were all, which is irrational, unconcerned with truth, and trivial.
context_english: yat—which; tu—but; kṛitsna-vat—as if it encompasses the whole; ekasmin—in single; kārye—action; saktam—engrossed; ahaitukam—without a reason; atattva-artha-vat—not based on truth; alpam—fragmental; cha—and; tat—that; tāmasam—in the mode of ignorance; udāhṛitam—is said to be

text: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते।।18.23।।
text_kannada:
ನಿಯತಂ ಸಂಗರಹಿತಮರಾಗದ್ವೇಷತಃ ಕೃತಮ್ |
ಅಫಲಪ್ರೇಪ್ಸುನಾ ಕರ್ಮ ಯತ್ತತ್ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಮುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
నియతం సంగరహితమరాగద్వేషతః కృతమ్ |
అఫలప్రేప్సునా కర్మ యత్తత్సాత్త్వికముచ్యతే || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam
aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate
translation_english: The daily obligatory action which is performed without attachment and without likes or dislikes, by one who does not hanker for rewards, is said to be born of sattva.
context_english: niyatam—in accordance with scriptures; saṅga-rahitam—free from attachment; arāga-dveṣhataḥ—free from attachment and aversion; kṛitam—done; aphala-prepsunā—without desire for rewards; karma—action; yat—which; tat—that; sāttvikam—in the mode of goodness; uchyate—is called

text: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्।।18.24।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ತು ಕಾಮೇಪ್ಸುನಾ ಕರ್ಮ ಸಾಹಂಕಾರೇಣ ವಾ ಪುನಃ |
ಕ್ರಿಯತೇ ಬಹುಲಾಯಾಸಂ ತದ್ರಾಜಸಮುದಾಹೃತಮ್ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
యత్తు కామేప్సునా కర్మ సాహంకారేణ వా పునః |
క్రియతే బహులాయాసం తద్రాజసముదాహృతమ్ || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ
kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam
translation_english: But that action is said to be born of rajas which is done by one desirous of results or by one who is egotistical, and which is highly strenuous.
context_english: yat—which; tu—but; kāma-īpsunā—prompted by selfish desire; karma—action; sa-ahaṅkāreṇa—with pride; vā—or; punaḥ—again; kriyate—enacted; bahula-āyāsam—stressfully; tat—that; rājasam—in the nature of passion; udāhṛitam—is said to be

text: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते।।18.25।।
text_kannada:
ಅನುಬಂಧಂ ಕ್ಷಯಂ ಹಿಂಸಾಮನಪೇಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಚ ಪೌರುಷಮ್ |
ಮೋಹಾದಾರಭ್ಯತೇ ಕರ್ಮ ಯತ್ತತ್ತಾಮಸಮುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
అనుబంధం క్షయం హింసామనపేక్ష్య చ పౌరుషమ్ |
మోహాదారభ్యతే కర్మ యత్తత్తామసముచ్యతే || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham
mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate
translation_english: That action is said to be born of tamas which is undertaken out of delusion, without consideration of its consequences, loss, harm, and ability.
context_english: anubandham—consequences; kṣhayam—loss; hinsām—injury; anapekṣhya—by disregarding; cha—and; pauruṣham—one’s own ability; mohāt—out of delusion; ārabhyate—is begun; karma—action; yat—which; tat—that; tāmasam—in the mode of ignorance; uchyate—is declared to be

text: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते।।18.26।।
text_kannada:
ಮುಕ್ತಸಂಗೋಽನಹಂವಾದೀ ಧೃತ್ಯುತ್ಸಾಹಸಮನ್ವಿತಃ |
ಸಿದ್ಧ್ಯಸಿದ್ಧ್ಯೋರ್ನಿರ್ವಿಕಾರಃ ಕರ್ತಾ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
ముక్తసంగోఽనహంవాదీ ధృత్యుత్సాహసమన్వితః |
సిద్ధ్యసిద్ధ్యోర్నిర్వికారః కర్తా సాత్త్విక ఉచ్యతే || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ
siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate
translation_english: [Ast. introduces this verse with 'Idanim kartrbhedah ucyate, Now is being stated the distinctions among the agents.'-Tr.] The agent who is free from attachment [Attachment to results or the idea of agentship.], not egotistical, endowed with fortitude and diligence, and unperturbed by success and failure is said to be possessed of sattva.
context_english: mukta-saṅgaḥ—free from worldly attachment; anaham-vādī—free from ego; dhṛiti—strong resolve; utsāha—zeal; samanvitaḥ—endowed with; siddhi-asiddhyoḥ—in success and failure; nirvikāraḥ—unaffected; kartā—worker; sāttvikaḥ—in the mode of goodness; uchyate—is said to be

text: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.27।।
text_kannada:
ರಾಗೀ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಪ್ರೇಪ್ಸುರ್ಲುಬ್ಧೋ ಹಿಂಸಾತ್ಮಕೋಽಶುಚಿಃ |
ಹರ್ಷಶೋಕಾನ್ವಿತಃ ಕರ್ತಾ ರಾಜಸಃ ಪರಿಕೀರ್ತಿತಃ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
రాగీ కర్మఫలప్రేప్సుర్లుబ్ధో హింసాత్మకోఽశుచిః |
హర్షశోకాన్వితః కర్తా రాజసః పరికీర్తితః || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsātmako ‘śhuchiḥ
harṣha-śhokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
translation_english: The agent who has attachment, who is desirous of the results of actions, covetous, cruel by nature, unclean, and subject to joy and sorrow, is declared to be possessed of rajas.
context_english: rāgī—craving; karma-phala—fruit of work; prepsuḥ—covet; lubdhaḥ—greedy; hinsā-ātmakaḥ—violent-natured; aśhuchiḥ—impure; harṣha-śhoka-anvitaḥ—moved by joy and sorrow; kartā—performer; rājasaḥ—in the mode of passion; parikīrtitaḥ—is declared

text: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते।।18.28।।
text_kannada:
ಅಯುಕ್ತಃ ಪ್ರಾಕೃತಃ ಸ್ತಬ್ಧಃ ಶಠೋ ನೈಷ್ಕೃತಿಕೋಽಲಸಃ |
ವಿಷಾದೀ ದೀರ್ಘಸೂತ್ರೀ ಚ ಕರ್ತಾ ತಾಮಸ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
అయుక్తః ప్రాకృతః స్తబ్ధః శఠో నైష్కృతికోఽలసః |
విషాదీ దీర్ఘసూత్రీ చ కర్తా తామస ఉచ్యతే || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
ayuktaḥ prākṛitaḥ stabdhaḥ śhaṭho naiṣhkṛitiko ‘lasaḥ
viṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate
translation_english: The agent who is unsteady, naive, inflexible, deceitful, wicked, lazy, sullen, and procrastinating is said to be possessed of tamas.
context_english: ayuktaḥ—undisciplined; prākṛitaḥ—vulgar; stabdhaḥ—obstinate; śhaṭhaḥ—cunning; naiṣhkṛitikaḥ—dishonest or vile; alasaḥ—slothful; viṣhādī—unhappy and morose; dīrgha-sūtrī—procrastinating; cha—and; kartā—performer; tāmasaḥ—in the mode of ignorance; uchyate—is said to be

text: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय।।18.29।।
text_kannada:
ಬುದ್ಧೇರ್ಭೇದಂ ಧೃತೇಶ್ಚೈವ ಗುಣತಸ್ತ್ರಿವಿಧಂ ಶ್ರೃಣು |
ಪ್ರೋಚ್ಯಮಾನಮಶೇಷೇಣ ಪೃಥಕ್ತ್ವೇನ ಧನಂಜಯ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
బుద్ధేర్భేదం ధృతేశ్చైవ గుణతస్త్రివిధం శ్రృణు |
ప్రోచ్యమానమశేషేణ పృథక్త్వేన ధనంజయ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu
prochyamānam aśheṣheṇa pṛithaktvena dhanañjaya
translation_english: O Dhananjaya, listen to the classification of the intellect and fortitude, which is threefold according to the gunas, while it is being stated in detail and separately.
context_english: buddheḥ—of intellect; bhedam—the distinctions; dhṛiteḥ—of determination; cha—and; eva—certainly; guṇataḥ tri-vidham—according to the three modes of material nature; śhṛiṇu—hear; prochyamānam—described; aśheṣheṇa—in detail; pṛithaktvena—distinctly; dhanañjaya—conqueror of wealth, Arjun

text: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.30।।
text_kannada:
ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಚ ನಿವೃತ್ತಿಂ ಚ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಕಾರ್ಯೇ ಭಯಾಭಯೇ |
ಬಂಧಂ ಮೋಕ್ಷಂ ಚ ಯಾ ವೇತ್ತಿ ಬುದ್ಧಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕೀ || ೩೦ ||
text_telugu:
ప్రవృత్తిం చ నివృత్తిం చ కార్యాకార్యే భయాభయే |
బంధం మోక్షం చ యా వేత్తి బుద్ధిః సా పార్థ సాత్త్వికీ || ౩౦ ||
transliteration:
pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
translation_english: O Partha, that intellect is born of sattva which understands action and withdrawal, duty and what is not duty, the sources of fear and fearlessness, as well as bondage and freedom.

text: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.31।।
text_kannada:
ಯಯಾ ಧರ್ಮಮಧರ್ಮಂ ಚ ಕಾರ್ಯಂ ಚಾಕಾರ್ಯಮೇವ ಚ |
ಅಯಥಾವತ್ಪ್ರಜಾನಾತಿ ಬುದ್ಧಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ರಾಜಸೀ || ೩೧ ||
text_telugu:
యయా ధర్మమధర్మం చ కార్యం చాకార్యమేవ చ |
అయథావత్ప్రజానాతి బుద్ధిః సా పార్థ రాజసీ || ౩౧ ||
transliteration:
yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha
ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
translation_english: O Partha, that intellect is born of rajas with which one wrongly understands virtue and vice, as well as what ought to be done and ought not to be done.

text: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।18.32।।
text_kannada:
ಅಧರ್ಮಂ ಧರ್ಮಮಿತಿ ಯಾ ಮನ್ಯತೇ ತಮಸಾಽಽವೃತಾ |
ಸರ್ವಾರ್ಥಾನ್ವಿಪರೀತಾಂಶ್ಚ ಬುದ್ಧಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ತಾಮಸೀ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
అధర్మం ధర్మమితి యా మన్యతే తమసాఽఽవృతా |
సర్వార్థాన్విపరీతాంశ్చ బుద్ధిః సా పార్థ తామసీ || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā
sarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
translation_english: O Partha, that intellect is born of tamas which, being covered by darkness, considers vice as virtue, and indeed perceives all things contrary to what they are.

text: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.33।।
text_kannada:
ಧೃತ್ಯಾ ಯಯಾ ಧಾರಯತೇ ಮನಃಪ್ರಾಣೇಂದ್ರಿಯಕ್ರಿಯಾಃ |
ಯೋಗೇನಾವ್ಯಭಿಚಾರಿಣ್ಯಾ ಧೃತಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕೀ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
ధృత్యా యయా ధారయతే మనఃప్రాణేంద్రియక్రియాః |
యోగేనావ్యభిచారిణ్యా ధృతిః సా పార్థ సాత్త్వికీ || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
dhṛityā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ
yogenāvyabhichāriṇyā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
translation_english: O Partha, the firmness that is unfailing through concentration, with which one restrains the functions of the mind, vital forces, and the organs—that firmness is born of sattva.

text: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.34।।
text_kannada:
ಯಯಾ ತು ಧರ್ಮಕಾಮಾರ್ಥಾನ್ ಧೃತ್ಯಾ ಧಾರಯತೇಽರ್ಜುನ |
ಪ್ರಸಂಗೇನ ಫಲಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೀ ಧೃತಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ರಾಜಸೀ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
యయా తు ధర్మకామార్థాన్ ధృత్యా ధారయతేఽర్జున |
ప్రసంగేన ఫలాకాంక్షీ ధృతిః సా పార్థ రాజసీ || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛityā dhārayate ‘rjuna
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
translation_english: But, O Partha, the steadfastness with which one holds on to righteousness, covetable things, and wealth, desiring their fruits as the occasion for each arises, that steadfastness is born of rajas.

text: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च।न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।18.35।।
text_kannada:
ಯಯಾ ಸ್ವಪ್ನಂ ಭಯಂ ಶೋಕಂ ವಿಷಾದಂ ಮದಮೇವ ಚ |
ನ ವಿಮುಂಚತಿ ದುರ್ಮೇಧಾ ಧೃತಿಃ ಸಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ತಾಮಸೀ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
యయా స్వప్నం భయం శోకం విషాదం మదమేవ చ |

transliteration:
yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha

translation_english: That firmness is considered to be born of tamas, due to which a person with a corrupt intellect does not give up sleep, fear, sorrow, despondency, as well as sensuality.

text: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ।अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति।।18.36।।
text_kannada:
ಸುಖಂ ತ್ವಿದಾನೀಂ ತ್ರಿವಿಧಂ ಶ್ರೃಣು ಮೇ ಭರತರ್ಷಭ |
ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಾದ್ರಮತೇ ಯತ್ರ ದುಃಖಾಂತಂ ಚ ನಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
సుఖం త్విదానీం త్రివిధం శ్రృణు మే భరతర్షభ |
అభ్యాసాద్రమతే యత్ర దుఃఖాంతం చ నిగచ్ఛతి || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha
abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ cha nigachchhati
 yat tad agre viṣham iva pariṇāme ‘mṛitopamam
tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam

text: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्।तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्।।18.37।।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ತದಗ್ರೇ ವಿಷಮಿವ ಪರಿಣಾಮೇಽಮೃತೋಪಮಮ್ |
ತತ್ಸುಖಂ ಸಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಮಾತ್ಮಬುದ್ಧಿಪ್ರಸಾದಜಮ್ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
యత్తదగ్రే విషమివ పరిణామేఽమృతోపమమ్ |
తత్సుఖం సాత్త్వికం ప్రోక్తమాత్మబుద్ధిప్రసాదజమ్ || ౩౭ ||

translation_english: That which is like poison in the beginning, but is likened to nectar in the end, and which arises from the purity of one's intellect—that joy is spoken of as born of sattva.

text: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्।।18.38।।
text_kannada:
ವಿಷಯೇಂದ್ರಿಯಸಂಯೋಗಾದ್ಯತ್ತದಗ್ರೇಽಮೃತೋಪಮಮ್ |
ಪರಿಣಾಮೇ ವಿಷಮಿವ ತತ್ಸುಖಂ ರಾಜಸಂ ಸ್ಮೃತಮ್ || ೩೮ ||
text_telugu:
విషయేంద్రియసంయోగాద్యత్తదగ్రేఽమృతోపమమ్ |
పరిణామే విషమివ తత్సుఖం రాజసం స్మృతమ్ || ౩౮ ||

viṣhayendriya-sanyogād yat tad agre ’mṛitopamam
pariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam

text: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.39।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಗ್ರೇ ಚಾನುಬಂಧೇ ಚ ಸುಖಂ ಮೋಹನಮಾತ್ಮನಃ |
ನಿದ್ರಾಲಸ್ಯಪ್ರಮಾದೋತ್ಥಂ ತತ್ತಾಮಸಮುದಾಹೃತಮ್ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
యదగ్రే చానుబంధే చ సుఖం మోహనమాత్మనః |
నిద్రాలస్యప్రమాదోత్థం తత్తామసముదాహృతమ్ || ౩౯ ||
transliteration:
yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ
nidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
translation_english: That joy is said to be born of tamas, which, both in the beginning and in the end, is delusive to oneself and arises from sleep, laziness, and inadvertence.

text: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः।।18.40।।
text_kannada:
ನ ತದಸ್ತಿ ಪೃಥಿವ್ಯಾಂ ವಾ ದಿವಿ ದೇವೇಷು ವಾ ಪುನಃ |
ಸತ್ತ್ವಂ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಜೈರ್ಮುಕ್ತಂ ಯದೇಭಿಃ ಸ್ಯಾತ್ಿತ್ರಭಿರ್ಗುಣೈಃ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
న తదస్తి పృథివ్యాం వా దివి దేవేషు వా పునః |
సత్త్వం ప్రకృతిజైర్ముక్తం యదేభిః స్యాత్ిత్రభిర్గుణైః || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ
sattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ
translation_english: There is no entity in the world, nor among the gods in heaven, that can be free from these three gunas born of Nature.
