text: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः।।18.41।।
text_kannada:
ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯವಿಶಾಂ ಶೂದ್ರಾಣಾಂ ಚ ಪರಂತಪ |
ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಪ್ರವಿಭಕ್ತಾನಿ ಸ್ವಭಾವಪ್ರಭವೈರ್ಗುಣೈಃ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
బ్రాహ్మణక్షత్రియవిశాం శూద్రాణాం చ పరంతప |
కర్మాణి ప్రవిభక్తాని స్వభావప్రభవైర్గుణైః || ౪౧ ||
transliteration:
brāhmaṇa-kṣhatriya-viśhāṁ śhūdrāṇāṁ cha parantapa
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ
translation_english: O scorcher of enemies, the duties of the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras have been fully classified according to the gunas born from Nature.

text: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.42।।
text_kannada:
ಶಮೋ ದಮಸ್ತಪಃ ಶೌಚಂ ಕ್ಷಾಂತಿರಾರ್ಜವಮೇವ ಚ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಂ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಮಾಸ್ತಿಕ್ಯಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಕರ್ಮ ಸ್ವಭಾವಜಮ್ || ೪೨ ||
text_telugu:
శమో దమస్తపః శౌచం క్షాంతిరార్జవమేవ చ |
జ్ఞానం విజ్ఞానమాస్తిక్యం బ్రహ్మకర్మ స్వభావజమ్ || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha
jñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam
translation_english: The natural duties of the Brahmanas are the control of the internal and external organs, austerity, purity, forgiveness, straightforwardness, knowledge, as well as wisdom [Knowledge refers to the understanding of subjects presented by the scriptures; wisdom means making them matters of one's own experience.], and faith.
context_english: śhamaḥ—tranquility; damaḥ—restraint; tapaḥ—austerity; śhaucham—purity; kṣhāntiḥ—patience; ārjavam—integrity; eva—certainly; cha—and; jñānam—knowledge; vijñānam—wisdom; āstikyam—belief in a hereafter; brahma—of the priestly class; karma—work; svabhāva-jam—born of one’s intrinsic qualities

text: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.43।।
text_kannada:
ಶೌರ್ಯಂ ತೇಜೋ ಧೃತಿರ್ದಾಕ್ಷ್ಯಂ ಯುದ್ಧೇ ಚಾಪ್ಯಪಲಾಯನಮ್ |
ದಾನಮೀಶ್ವರಭಾವಶ್ಚ ಕ್ಷಾತ್ರಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಸ್ವಭಾವಜಮ್ || ೪೩ ||
text_telugu:
శౌర్యం తేజో ధృతిర్దాక్ష్యం యుద్ధే చాప్యపలాయనమ్ |
దానమీశ్వరభావశ్చ క్షాత్రం కర్మ స్వభావజమ్ || ౪౩ ||
transliteration:
śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam
dānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam
translation_english: The natural duties of the Ksatriyas are heroism, boldness, fortitude, capability, and not retreating from battle, generosity, and lordliness.
context_english: śhauryam—valor; tejaḥ—strength; dhṛitiḥ—fortitude; dākṣhyam yuddhe—skill in weaponry; cha—and; api—also; apalāyanam—not fleeing; dānam—large-heartedness; īśhvara—leadership; bhāvaḥ—qualities; cha—and; kṣhātram—of the warrior and administrative class; karma—work; svabhāva-jam—born of one’s intrinsic qualities

text: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्।।18.44।।
text_kannada:
ಕೃಷಿಗೌರಕ್ಷ್ಯವಾಣಿಜ್ಯಂ ವೈಶ್ಯಕರ್ಮ ಸ್ವಭಾವಜಮ್ |
ಪರಿಚರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಶೂದ್ರಸ್ಯಾಪಿ ಸ್ವಭಾವಜಮ್ || ೪೪ ||
text_telugu:
కృషిగౌరక్ష్యవాణిజ్యం వైశ్యకర్మ స్వభావజమ్ |
పరిచర్యాత్మకం కర్మ శూద్రస్యాపి స్వభావజమ్ || ౪౪ ||
transliteration:
kṛiṣhi-gau-rakṣhya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśhya-karma svabhāva-jam
paricharyātmakaṁ karma śhūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam
translation_english: The natural duties of the Vaisyas are agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trading. The natural duty of the Sudras, too, is in the form of service.
context_english: kṛiṣhi—agriculture; gau-rakṣhya—dairy farming; vāṇijyam—commerce; vaiśhya—of the mercantile and farming class; karma—work; svabhāva-jam—born of one’s intrinsic qualities; paricharyā—serving through work; ātmakam—natural; karma—duty; śhūdrasya—of the worker class; api—and; svabhāva-jam—born of one’s intrinsic qualities

text: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।।18.45।।
text_kannada:
ಸ್ವೇ ಸ್ವೇ ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯಭಿರತಃ ಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಲಭತೇ ನರಃ |
ಸ್ವಕರ್ಮನಿರತಃ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಯಥಾ ವಿಂದತಿ ತಚ್ಛೃಣು || ೪೫ ||
text_telugu:
స్వే స్వే కర్మణ్యభిరతః సంసిద్ధిం లభతే నరః |
స్వకర్మనిరతః సిద్ధిం యథా విందతి తచ్ఛృణు || ౪౫ ||
transliteration:
sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ
sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu
translation_english: Being devoted to his own duty, one attains complete success. Hear how one devoted to their own duty achieves success.
context_english: sve sve—respectively; karmaṇi—work; abhirataḥ—fulfilling; sansiddhim—perfection; labhate—achieve; naraḥ—a person; sva-karma—to one’s own prescribed duty; nirataḥ—engaged; siddhim—perfection; yathā—as; vindati—attains; tat—that; śhṛiṇu—hear

text: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।।18.46।।
text_kannada:
ಯತಃ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿರ್ಭೂತಾನಾಂ ಯೇನ ಸರ್ವಮಿದಂ ತತಮ್ |
ಸ್ವಕರ್ಮಣಾ ತಮಭ್ಯರ್ಚ್ಯ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ವಿಂದತಿ ಮಾನವಃ || ೪೬ ||
text_telugu:
యతః ప్రవృత్తిర్భూతానాం యేన సర్వమిదం తతమ్ |
స్వకర్మణా తమభ్యర్చ్య సిద్ధిం విందతి మానవః || ౪౬ ||
transliteration:
yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ
translation_english: A human being achieves success by adoring, through his own duties, Him from whom is the origin of creatures and by whom all this is pervaded.
context_english: yataḥ—from whom; pravṛittiḥ—have come into being; bhūtānām—of all living entities; yena—by whom; sarvam—all; idam—this; tatam—pervaded; sva-karmaṇā—by one’s natural occupation; tam—him; abhyarchya—by worshipping; siddhim—perfection; vindati—attains; mānavaḥ—a person

text: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।18.47।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೇಯಾನ್ಸ್ವಧರ್ಮೋ ವಿಗುಣಃ ಪರಧರ್ಮಾತ್ಸ್ವನುಷ್ಠಿತಾತ್ |
ಸ್ವಭಾವನಿಯತಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷಮ್ || ೪೭ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రేయాన్స్వధర్మో విగుణః పరధర్మాత్స్వనుష్ఠితాత్ |
స్వభావనియతం కర్మ కుర్వన్నాప్నోతి కిల్బిషమ్ || ౪౭ ||
transliteration:
śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
svabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
translation_english: One's own duty, though defective, is superior to another's duty well performed. By performing a duty according to one's own nature, one does not incur sin.
context_english: śhreyān—better; swa-dharmaḥ—one’s own prescribed occupational duty; viguṇaḥ—imperfectly done; para-dharmāt—than another’s dharma; su-anuṣhṭhitāt—perfectly done; svabhāva-niyatam—according to one’s innate nature; karma—duty; kurvan—by performing; na āpnoti—does not incur; kilbiṣham—sin

text: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।18.48।।
text_kannada:
ಸಹಜಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಸದೋಷಮಪಿ ನ ತ್ಯಜೇತ್ |
ಸರ್ವಾರಂಭಾ ಹಿ ದೋಷೇಣ ಧೂಮೇನಾಗ್ನಿರಿವಾವೃತಾಃ || ೪೮ ||
text_telugu:
సహజం కర్మ కౌంతేయ సదోషమపి న త్యజేత్ |
సర్వారంభా హి దోషేణ ధూమేనాగ్నిరివావృతాః || ౪౮ ||
transliteration:
saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet
sarvārambhā hi doṣheṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛitāḥ
translation_english: O son of Kunti, one should not give up the duty to which one is born, even though it be imperfect. For all undertakings are surrounded by evil, as fire is with smoke.
context_english: saha-jam—born of one’s nature; karma—duty; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; sa-doṣham—with defects; api—even if; na tyajet—one should not abandon; sarva-ārambhāḥ—all endeavors; hi—indeed; doṣheṇa—with evil; dhūmena—with smoke; agniḥ—fire; iva—as; āvṛitāḥ—veiled

text: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।18.49।।
text_kannada:
ಅಸಕ್ತಬುದ್ಧಿಃ ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಜಿತಾತ್ಮಾ ವಿಗತಸ್ಪೃಹಃ |
ನೈಷ್ಕರ್ಮ್ಯಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಪರಮಾಂ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸೇನಾಧಿಗಚ್ಛತಿ || ೪೯ ||
text_telugu:
అసక్తబుద్ధిః సర్వత్ర జితాత్మా విగతస్పృహః |
నైష్కర్మ్యసిద్ధిం పరమాం సంన్యాసేనాధిగచ్ఛతి || ౪౯ ||
transliteration:
asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛihaḥ
naiṣhkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigachchhati
translation_english: He whose intellect remains unattached to everything, who has conquered his internal organs and is desireless, attains through monasticism the supreme perfection consisting of the state of one free from duties.
context_english: asakta-buddhiḥ—those whose intellect is unattached; sarvatra—everywhere; jita-ātmā—who have mastered their mind; vigata-spṛihaḥ—free from desires; naiṣhkarmya-siddhim—state of actionlessness; paramām—highest; sanyāsena—by the practice of renunciation; adhigachchhati—attain

text: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा।।18.50।।
text_kannada:
ಸಿದ್ಧಿಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತೋ ಯಥಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ತಥಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ನಿಬೋಧ ಮೇ |
ಸಮಾಸೇನೈವ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ನಿಷ್ಠಾ ಜ್ಞಾನಸ್ಯ ಯಾ ಪರಾ || ೫೦ ||
text_telugu:
సిద్ధిం ప్రాప్తో యథా బ్రహ్మ తథాప్నోతి నిబోధ మే |
సమాసేనైవ కౌంతేయ నిష్ఠా జ్ఞానస్య యా పరా || ౫౦ ||
transliteration:
siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā
translation_english: Understand for certain from Me, in brief indeed, O son of Kunti, that process by which one who has achieved success attains Brahman, which is the supreme consummation of knowledge.
context_english: siddhim—perfection; prāptaḥ—attained; yathā—how; brahma—Brahman; tathā—also; āpnoti—attain; nibodha—hear; me—from me; samāsena—briefly; eva—indeed; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; niṣhṭhā—firmly fixed; jñānasya—of knowledge; yā—which; parā—transcendental

text: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च।।18.51।।
text_kannada:
ಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ ವಿಶುದ್ಧಯಾ ಯುಕ್ತೋ ಧೃತ್ಯಾಽಽತ್ಮಾನಂ ನಿಯಮ್ಯ ಚ |
ಶಬ್ದಾದೀನ್ ವಿಷಯಾಂಸ್ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ರಾಗದ್ವೇಷೌ ವ್ಯುದಸ್ಯ ಚ || ೫೧ ||
text_telugu:
బుద్ధ్యా విశుద్ధయా యుక్తో ధృత్యాఽఽత్మానం నియమ్య చ |
శబ్దాదీన్ విషయాంస్త్యక్త్వా రాగద్వేషౌ వ్యుదస్య చ || ౫౧ ||
transliteration:
buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha
śhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha
translation_english: Endowed with a pure intellect and controlling oneself with fortitude, one should reject the objects beginning from sound [sound, touch, form, color, taste, and smell - Tr.] and eliminate attachment and hatred.
context_english: buddhyā—intellect; viśhuddhayā—purified; yuktaḥ—endowed with; dhṛityā—by determination; ātmānam—the intellect; niyamya—restraining; cha—and; śhabda-ādīn viṣhayān—sound and other objects of the senses; tyaktvā—abandoning; rāga-dveṣhau—attachment and aversion; vyudasya—casting aside; cha—and;

text: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।18.52।।
text_kannada:
ವಿವಿಕ್ತಸೇವೀ ಲಘ್ವಾಶೀ ಯತವಾಕ್ಕಾಯಮಾನಸಃ |
ಧ್ಯಾನಯೋಗಪರೋ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ವೈರಾಗ್ಯಂ ಸಮುಪಾಶ್ರಿತಃ || ೫೨ ||
text_telugu:
వివిక్తసేవీ లఘ్వాశీ యతవాక్కాయమానసః |
ధ్యానయోగపరో నిత్యం వైరాగ్యం సముపాశ్రితః || ౫౨ ||
transliteration:
vivikta-sevī laghv-āśhī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ
dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśhritaḥ
translation_english: One who resorts to solitude, eats sparingly, has control over their speech, body, and mind, for whom meditation and concentration are ever the highest duty, and who is possessed of dispassion;
context_english: vivikta-sevī—relishing solitude; laghu-āśhī—eating light; yata—controls; vāk—speech; kāya—body; mānasaḥ—and mind; dhyāna-yoga-paraḥ—engaged in meditation; nityam—always; vairāgyam—dispassion; samupāśhritaḥ—having taken shelter of;

text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।18.53।।
text_kannada:
ಅಹಂಕಾರಂ ಬಲಂ ದರ್ಪಂ ಕಾಮಂ ಕ್ರೋಧಂ ಪರಿಗ್ರಹಮ್ |
ವಿಮುಚ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಮಮಃ ಶಾಂತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂಯಾಯ ಕಲ್ಪತೇ || ೫೩ ||
text_telugu:
అహంకారం బలం దర్పం కామం క్రోధం పరిగ్రహమ్ |
విముచ్య నిర్మమః శాంతో బ్రహ్మభూయాయ కల్పతే || ౫౩ ||
transliteration:
ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham
vimuchya nirmamaḥ śhānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
translation_english: Having discarded egotism, force, pride, desire, anger, and superfluous possessions, and being free from the idea of possession and serene, that person is fit for becoming Brahman.
context_english: ahankāram—egotism; balam—violence; darpam—arrogance; kāmam—desire; krodham—anger; parigraham—selfishness; vimuchya—being freed from; nirmamaḥ—without possessiveness of property; śhāntaḥ—peaceful; brahma-bhūyāya—union with Brahman; kalpate—is fit

text: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्।।18.54।।
text_kannada:
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂತಃ ಪ್ರಸನ್ನಾತ್ಮಾ ನ ಶೋಚತಿ ನ ಕಾಂಕ್ಷತಿ |
ಸಮಃ ಸರ್ವೇಷು ಭೂತೇಷು ಮದ್ಭಕ್ತಿಂ ಲಭತೇ ಪರಾಮ್ || ೫೪ ||
text_telugu:
బ్రహ్మభూతః ప్రసన్నాత్మా న శోచతి న కాంక్షతి |
సమః సర్వేషు భూతేషు మద్భక్తిం లభతే పరామ్ || ౫౪ ||
transliteration:
brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
samaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām
translation_english: One who has become Brahman and has attained the blissful Self does not grieve nor desire. Becoming the same towards all beings, he attains supreme devotion to Me.
context_english: brahma-bhūtaḥ—one situated in Brahman; prasanna-ātmā—mentally serene; na—neither; śhochati—grieving; na—nor; kāṅkṣhati—desiring; samaḥ—equitably disposed; sarveṣhu—toward all; bhūteṣhu—living beings; mat-bhaktim—devotion to me; labhate—attains; parām—supreme

text: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्।।18.55।।
text_kannada:
ಭಕ್ತ್ಯಾ ಮಾಮಭಿಜಾನಾತಿ ಯಾವಾನ್ಯಶ್ಚಾಸ್ಮಿ ತತ್ತ್ವತಃ |
ತತೋ ಮಾಂ ತತ್ತ್ವತೋ ಜ್ಞಾತ್ವಾ ವಿಶತೇ ತದನಂತರಮ್ || ೫೫ ||
text_telugu:
భక్త్యా మామభిజానాతి యావాన్యశ్చాస్మి తత్త్వతః |
తతో మాం తత్త్వతో జ్ఞాత్వా విశతే తదనంతరమ్ || ౫౫ ||
transliteration:
bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ
tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram
translation_english: Through devotion, he knows Me in reality, as to what and who I am. Then, having known Me truly, he enters into Me immediately afterward.
context_english: bhaktyā—by loving devotion; mām—me; abhijānāti—one comes to know; yāvān—as much as; yaḥ cha asmi—as I am; tattvataḥ—in truth; tataḥ—then; mām—me; tattvataḥ—in truth; jñātvā—having known; viśhate—enters; tat-anantaram—thereafter

text: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।।18.56।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣ್ಯಪಿ ಸದಾ ಕುರ್ವಾಣೋ ಮದ್ವ್ಯಪಾಶ್ರಯಃ |
ಮತ್ಪ್ರಸಾದಾದವಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಶಾಶ್ವತಂ ಪದಮವ್ಯಯಮ್ || ೫೬ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వకర్మాణ్యపి సదా కుర్వాణో మద్వ్యపాశ్రయః |
మత్ప్రసాదాదవాప్నోతి శాశ్వతం పదమవ్యయమ్ || ౫౬ ||
transliteration:
sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśhrayaḥ
mat-prasādād avāpnoti śhāśhvataṁ padam avyayam
translation_english: Ever engaging in all actions, one to whom I am the refuge, attains the eternal, immutable state through my grace.
context_english: sarva—all; karmāṇi—actions; api—though; sadā—always; kurvāṇaḥ—performing; mat-vyapāśhrayaḥ—take full refuge in me; mat-prasādāt—by my grace; avāpnoti—attain; śhāśhvatam—the eternal; padam—abode; avyayam—imperishable

text: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।18.57।।
text_kannada:
ಚೇತಸಾ ಸರ್ವಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಮಯಿ ಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಮತ್ಪರಃ |
ಬುದ್ಧಿಯೋಗಮುಪಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ಮಚ್ಚಿತ್ತಃ ಸತತಂ ಭವ || ೫೭ ||
text_telugu:
చేతసా సర్వకర్మాణి మయి సంన్యస్య మత్పరః |
బుద్ధియోగముపాశ్రిత్య మచ్చిత్తః సతతం భవ || ౫౭ ||
transliteration:
chetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
buddhi-yogam upāśhritya mach-chittaḥ satataṁ bhava
translation_english: Mentally surrendering all actions to Me and accepting Me as the supreme, keep your mind ever fixed on Me by resorting to the concentration of your intellect.
context_english: chetasā—by consciousness; sarva-karmāṇi—every activity; mayi—to me; sannyasya—dedicating; mat-paraḥ—having me as the supreme goal; buddhi-yogam—having the intellect united with God; upāśhritya—taking shelter of; mat-chittaḥ—consciousness absorbed in me; satatam—always; bhava—be

text: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि।।18.58।।
text_kannada:
ಮಚ್ಚಿತ್ತಃ ಸರ್ವದುರ್ಗಾಣಿ ಮತ್ಪ್ರಸಾದಾತ್ತರಿಷ್ಯಸಿ |
ಅಥ ಚೇತ್ತ್ವಮಹಂಕಾರಾನ್ನ ಶ್ರೋಷ್ಯಸಿ ವಿನಂಕ್ಷ್ಯಸಿ || ೫೮ ||
text_telugu:
మచ్చిత్తః సర్వదుర్గాణి మత్ప్రసాదాత్తరిష్యసి |
అథ చేత్త్వమహంకారాన్న శ్రోష్యసి వినంక్ష్యసి || ౫౮ ||
transliteration:
mach-chittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣhyasi
atha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi
translation_english: Having your mind fixed on Me, you will cross over all difficulties by My grace. If, however, you do not listen out of egotism, you will be destroyed.
context_english: mat-chittaḥ—by always remembering me; sarva—all; durgāṇi—obstacles; mat-prasādāt—by my grace; tariṣhyasi—you shall overcome; atha—but; chet—if; tvam—you; ahankārāt—due to pride; na śhroṣhyasi—do not listen; vinaṅkṣhyasi—you will perish

text: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति।।18.59।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಹಂಕಾರಮಾಶ್ರಿತ್ಯ ನ ಯೋತ್ಸ್ಯ ಇತಿ ಮನ್ಯಸೇ |
ಮಿಥ್ಯೈಷ ವ್ಯವಸಾಯಸ್ತೇ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಸ್ತ್ವಾಂ ನಿಯೋಕ್ಷ್ಯತಿ || ೫೯ ||
text_telugu:
యదహంకారమాశ్రిత్య న యోత్స్య ఇతి మన్యసే |
మిథ్యైష వ్యవసాయస్తే ప్రకృతిస్త్వాం నియోక్ష్యతి || ౫౯ ||
transliteration:
yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase
mithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati
translation_english: Though you think 'I shall not fight', relying on egotism, this determination of yours is vain. Your nature will impel you!
context_english: yat—if; ahankāram—motivated by pride; āśhritya—taking shelter; na yotsye—I shall not fight; iti—thus; manyase—you think; mithyā eṣhaḥ—this is all false; vyavasāyaḥ—determination; te—your; prakṛitiḥ—material nature; tvām—you; niyokṣhyati—will engage

text: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्।।18.60।।
text_kannada:
ಸ್ವಭಾವಜೇನ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ನಿಬದ್ಧಃ ಸ್ವೇನ ಕರ್ಮಣಾ |
ಕರ್ತುಂ ನೇಚ್ಛಸಿ ಯನ್ಮೋಹಾತ್ಕರಿಷ್ಯಸ್ಯವಶೋಽಪಿ ತತ್ || ೬೦ ||
text_telugu:
స్వభావజేన కౌంతేయ నిబద్ధః స్వేన కర్మణా |
కర్తుం నేచ్ఛసి యన్మోహాత్కరిష్యస్యవశోఽపి తత్ || ౬౦ ||
transliteration:
swbhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā
kartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat
translation_english: Being bound by your own duty, born of nature, O son of Kunti, you will, being helpless, verily do that which you do not wish to do, owing to indiscretion.
context_english: swabhāva-jena—born of one’s own material nature; kaunteya—Arjun, the son of Kunti; nibaddhaḥ—bound; svena—by your own; karmaṇā—actions; kartum—to do; na—not; ichchhasi—you wish; yat—which; mohāt—out of delusion; kariṣhyasi—you will do; avaśhaḥ—helplessly; api—even though; tat—that

text: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया।।18.61।।
text_kannada:
ಈಶ್ವರಃ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ಹೃದ್ದೇಶೇಽರ್ಜುನ ತಿಷ್ಠತಿ |
ಭ್ರಾಮಯನ್ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಿ ಯಂತ್ರಾರೂಢಾನಿ ಮಾಯಯಾ || ೬೧ ||
text_telugu:
ఈశ్వరః సర్వభూతానాం హృద్దేశేఽర్జున తిష్ఠతి |
భ్రామయన్సర్వభూతాని యంత్రారూఢాని మాయయా || ౬౧ ||
transliteration:
īśhvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛid-deśhe ‘rjuna tiṣhṭhati
bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
translation_english: O Arjuna, the Lord resides in the region of the hearts of all creatures, revolving through Maya all the creatures as though mounted on a machine!
context_english: īśhvaraḥ—the Supreme Lord; sarva-bhūtānām—in all living being; hṛit-deśhe—in the hearts; arjuna—Arjun; tiṣhṭhati—dwells; bhrāmayan—causing to wander; sarva-bhūtāni—all living beings; yantra ārūḍhani—seated on a machine; māyayā—made of the material energy

text: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।18.62।।
text_kannada:
ತಮೇವ ಶರಣಂ ಗಚ್ಛ ಸರ್ವಭಾವೇನ ಭಾರತ |
ತತ್ಪ್ರಸಾದಾತ್ಪರಾಂ ಶಾಂತಿಂ ಸ್ಥಾನಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಸಿ ಶಾಶ್ವತಮ್ || ೬೨ ||
text_telugu:
తమేవ శరణం గచ్ఛ సర్వభావేన భారత |
తత్ప్రసాదాత్పరాం శాంతిం స్థానం ప్రాప్స్యసి శాశ్వతమ్ || ౬౨ ||
transliteration:
tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata
tat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam
translation_english: Take refuge in Him alone with your whole being, O scion of the Bharata dynasty. Through His grace, you will attain supreme peace and the eternal abode.
context_english: tam—unto him; eva—only; śharaṇam gachchha—surrender; sarva-bhāvena—whole-heartedly; bhārata—Arjun, the son of Bharat; tat-prasādāt—by his grace; parām—supreme; śhāntim—peace; sthānam—the abode; prāpsyasi—you will attain; śhāśhvatam—eternal

text: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।18.63।।
text_kannada:
ಇತಿ ತೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾಖ್ಯಾತಂ ಗುಹ್ಯಾದ್ಗುಹ್ಯತರಂ ಮಯಾ |
ವಿಮೃಶ್ಯೈತದಶೇಷೇಣ ಯಥೇಚ್ಛಸಿ ತಥಾ ಕುರು || ೬೩ ||
text_telugu:
ఇతి తే జ్ఞానమాఖ్యాతం గుహ్యాద్గుహ్యతరం మయా |
విమృశ్యైతదశేషేణ యథేచ్ఛసి తథా కురు || ౬౩ ||
transliteration:
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā
vimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru
translation_english: To you I have imparted this knowledge, which is more secret than any secret. Ponder over this as a whole and do as you like.
context_english: iti—thus; te—to you; jñānam—knowledge; ākhyātam—explained; guhyāt—than secret knowledge; guhya-taram—still more secret knowledge; mayā—by me; vimṛiśhya—pondering; etat—on this; aśheṣheṇa—completely; yathā—as; ichchhasi—you wish; tathā—so; kuru—do

text: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।।18.64।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಗುಹ್ಯತಮಂ ಭೂಯಃ ಶ್ರೃಣು ಮೇ ಪರಮಂ ವಚಃ |
ಇಷ್ಟೋಽಸಿ ಮೇ ದೃಢಮಿತಿ ತತೋ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ತೇ ಹಿತಮ್ || ೬೪ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వగుహ్యతమం భూయః శ్రృణు మే పరమం వచః |
ఇష్టోఽసి మే దృఢమితి తతో వక్ష్యామి తే హితమ్ || ౬౪ ||
transliteration:
sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
iṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam
translation_english: Listen again to My highest utterance, which is the most profound of all. Since you are ever dear to Me, I shall speak what is beneficial to you.
context_english: sarva-guhya-tamam—the most confidential of all; bhūyaḥ—again; śhṛiṇu—hear; me—by me; paramam—supreme; vachaḥ—instruction; iṣhṭaḥ asi—you are dear; me—to me; dṛiḍham—very; iti—thus; tataḥ—because; vakṣhyāmi—I am speaking; te—for your; hitam—benefit

text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।18.65।।
text_kannada:
ಮನ್ಮನಾ ಭವ ಮದ್ಭಕ್ತೋ ಮದ್ಯಾಜೀ ಮಾಂ ನಮಸ್ಕುರು |
ಮಾಮೇವೈಷ್ಯಸಿ ಸತ್ಯಂ ತೇ ಪ್ರತಿಜಾನೇ ಪ್ರಿಯೋಽಸಿ ಮೇ || ೬೫ ||
text_telugu:
మన్మనా భవ మద్భక్తో మద్యాజీ మాం నమస్కురు |
మామేవైష్యసి సత్యం తే ప్రతిజానే ప్రియోఽసి మే || ౬౫ ||
transliteration:
man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me
translation_english: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, offer sacrifices to Me, and bow down to Me. Thus, you will come to Me alone. I promise you this truth, for you are dear to Me.
context_english: mat-manāḥ—thinking of me; bhava—be; mat-bhaktaḥ—my devotee; mat-yājī—worship me; mām—to me; namaskuru—offer obeisance; mām—to me; eva—certainly; eṣhyasi—you will come; satyam—truly; te—to you; pratijāne—I promise; priyaḥ—dear; asi—you are; me—to me

text: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।18.66।।
text_kannada:
ಸರ್ವಧರ್ಮಾನ್ಪರಿತ್ಯಜ್ಯ ಮಾಮೇಕಂ ಶರಣಂ ವ್ರಜ |
ಅಹಂ ತ್ವಾ ಸರ್ವಪಾಪೇಭ್ಯೋ ಮೋಕ್ಷಯಿಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಮಾ ಶುಚಃ || ೬೬ ||
text_telugu:
సర్వధర్మాన్పరిత్యజ్య మామేకం శరణం వ్రజ |
అహం త్వా సర్వపాపేభ్యో మోక్షయిష్యామి మా శుచః || ౬౬ ||
transliteration:
sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ
translation_english: Abandon all forms of rites and duties, and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all sins; do not grieve.
context_english: sarva-dharmān—all varieties of dharmas; parityajya—abandoning; mām—unto me; ekam—only; śharaṇam—take refuge; vraja—take; aham—I; tvām—you; sarva—all; pāpebhyaḥ—from sinful reactions; mokṣhayiṣhyāmi—shall liberate; mā—do not; śhuchaḥ—fear

text: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।18.67।।
text_kannada:
ಇದಂ ತೇ ನಾತಪಸ್ಕಾಯ ನಾಭಕ್ತಾಯ ಕದಾಚನ |
ನ ಚಾಶುಶ್ರೂಷವೇ ವಾಚ್ಯಂ ನ ಚ ಮಾಂ ಯೋಽಭ್ಯಸೂಯತಿ || ೬೭ ||
text_telugu:
ఇదం తే నాతపస్కాయ నాభక్తాయ కదాచన |
న చాశుశ్రూషవే వాచ్యం న చ మాం యోఽభ్యసూయతి || ౬౭ ||
transliteration:
idaṁ te nātapaskyāya nābhaktāya kadāchana
na chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi
translation_english: This (that I have taught) should never be taught to one who is devoid of austerities, one who is not a devotee, one who does not render service, or one who cavils at Me.
context_english: idam—this; te—by you; na—never; atapaskāya—to those who are not austere; na—never; abhaktāya—to those who are not devoted; kadāchana—at any time; na—never; cha—also; aśhuśhrūṣhave—to those who are averse to listening (to spiritual topics); vāchyam—to be spoken; na—never; cha—also; mām—toward me; yaḥ—who; abhyasūyati—those who are envious

text: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।।18.68।।
text_kannada:
ಯ ಇಮಂ ಪರಮಂ ಗುಹ್ಯಂ ಮದ್ಭಕ್ತೇಷ್ವಭಿಧಾಸ್ಯತಿ |
ಭಕ್ಿತಂ ಮಯಿ ಪರಾಂ ಕೃತ್ವಾ ಮಾಮೇವೈಷ್ಯತ್ಯಸಂಶಯಃ || ೬೮ ||
text_telugu:
య ఇమం పరమం గుహ్యం మద్భక్తేష్వభిధాస్యతి |
భక్ితం మయి పరాం కృత్వా మామేవైష్యత్యసంశయః || ౬౮ ||
transliteration:
ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati
bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ
translation_english: He who, entertaining supreme devotion to Me, speaks of this highest secret to My devotees, will without doubt reach Me alone.
context_english: yaḥ—who; idam—this; paramam—most; guhyam—confidential knowledge; mat-bhakteṣhu—amongst my devotees; abhidhāsyati—teaches; bhaktim—greatest act of love; mayi—to me; parām—transcendental; kṛitvā—doing; mām—to me; eva—certainly; eṣhyati—comes; asanśhayaḥ—without doubt

text: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।18.69।।
text_kannada:
ನ ಚ ತಸ್ಮಾನ್ಮನುಷ್ಯೇಷು ಕಶ್ಿಚನ್ಮೇ ಪ್ರಿಯಕೃತ್ತಮಃ |
ಭವಿತಾ ನ ಚ ಮೇ ತಸ್ಮಾದನ್ಯಃ ಪ್ರಿಯತರೋ ಭುವಿ || ೬೯ ||
text_telugu:
న చ తస్మాన్మనుష్యేషు కశ్ిచన్మే ప్రియకృత్తమః |
భవితా న చ మే తస్మాదన్యః ప్రియతరో భువి || ౬౯ ||
transliteration:
na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ
bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
translation_english: And compared to him, no other human is better at accomplishing what is dear to Me. Furthermore, there will be no one else in the world dearer to Me than him.
context_english: na—no; cha—and; tasmāt—than them; manuṣhyeṣhu—amongst human beings; kaśhchit—anyone; me—to me; priya-kṛit-tamaḥ—more dear; bhavitā—will be; na—never; cha—and; me—to me; tasmāt—than them; anyaḥ—another; priya-taraḥ—dearer; bhuvi—on this earth

text: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।18.70।।
text_kannada:
ಅಧ್ಯೇಷ್ಯತೇ ಚ ಯ ಇಮಂ ಧರ್ಮ್ಯಂ ಸಂವಾದಮಾವಯೋಃ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಯಜ್ಞೇನ ತೇನಾಹಮಿಷ್ಟಃ ಸ್ಯಾಮಿತಿ ಮೇ ಮತಿಃ || ೭೦ ||
text_telugu:
అధ్యేష్యతే చ య ఇమం ధర్మ్యం సంవాదమావయోః |
జ్ఞానయజ్ఞేన తేనాహమిష్టః స్యామితి మే మతిః || ౭౦ ||
transliteration:
adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ
jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ
translation_english: And he who will study this sacred conversation between us two, which is conducive to virtue, by him I shall be adored through the Sacrifice of Knowledge. This is My judgment.
context_english: adhyeṣhyate—study; cha—and; yaḥ—who; imam—this; dharmyam—sacred; saṁvādam—dialogue; āvayoḥ—of ours; jñāna—of knowledge; yajñena-tena—through the sacrifice of knowledge; aham—I; iṣhṭaḥ—worshipped; syām—shall be; iti—such; me—my; matiḥ—opinion

text: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।18.71।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಾನನಸೂಯಶ್ಚ ಶ್ರೃಣುಯಾದಪಿ ಯೋ ನರಃ |
ಸೋಽಪಿ ಮುಕ್ತಃ ಶುಭಾಁಲ್ಲೋಕಾನ್ಪ್ರಾಪ್ನುಯಾತ್ಪುಣ್ಯಕರ್ಮಣಾಮ್ || ೭೧ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రద్ధావాననసూయశ్చ శ్రృణుయాదపి యో నరః |
సోఽపి ముక్తః శుభాఁల్లోకాన్ప్రాప్నుయాత్పుణ్యకర్మణామ్ || ౭౧ ||
transliteration:
śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ
so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām
translation_english: Any man who, being reverent and free from caviling, listens to this (teaching) with reverence, he too, becoming free, shall attain the blessed worlds of those who perform virtuous deeds.
context_english: śhraddhā-vān—faithful; anasūyaḥ—without envy; cha—and; śhṛiṇuyāt—listen; api—certainly; yaḥ—who; naraḥ—a person; saḥ—that person; api—also; muktaḥ—liberated; śhubhān—the auspicious; lokān—abodes; prāpnuyāt—attain; puṇya-karmaṇām—of the pious

text: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।18.72।।
text_kannada:
ಕಚ್ಚಿದೇತಚ್ಛ್ರುತಂ ಪಾರ್ಥ ತ್ವಯೈಕಾಗ್ರೇಣ ಚೇತಸಾ |
ಕಚ್ಚಿದಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಮೋಹಃ ಪ್ರನಷ್ಟಸ್ತೇ ಧನಂಜಯ || ೭೨ ||
text_telugu:
కచ్చిదేతచ్ఛ్రుతం పార్థ త్వయైకాగ్రేణ చేతసా |
కచ్చిదజ్ఞానసంమోహః ప్రనష్టస్తే ధనంజయ || ౭౨ ||
transliteration:
kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā
kachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya
translation_english: O Partha, have you listened to this with a one-pointed mind? O Dhananjaya, has your delusion caused by ignorance been dispelled?
context_english: kachchit—whether; etat—this; śhrutam—heard; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; tvayā—by you; eka-agreṇa chetasā—with a concentrated mind; kachchit—whether; ajñāna—ignorance; sammohaḥ—delusion; pranaṣhṭaḥ—destroyed; te—your; dhanañjaya—Arjun, conqueror of wealth

text: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।18.73।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚನಷ್ಟೋ ಮೋಹಃ ಸ್ಮೃತಿರ್ಲಬ್ಧಾ ತ್ವತ್ಪ್ರಸಾದಾನ್ಮಯಾಚ್ಯುತ |
ಸ್ಥಿತೋಽಸ್ಮಿ ಗತಸಂದೇಹಃ ಕರಿಷ್ಯೇ ವಚನಂ ತವ || ೭೩ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచనష్టో మోహః స్మృతిర్లబ్ధా త్వత్ప్రసాదాన్మయాచ్యుత |
స్థితోఽస్మి గతసందేహః కరిష్యే వచనం తవ || ౭౩ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta
sthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava
translation_english: Arjuna said, "O Acyuta, my delusion has been destroyed and my memory has been regained through Your grace. I stand with my doubt removed; I shall follow Your instructions."
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; naṣhṭaḥ—dispelled; mohaḥ—illusion; smṛitiḥ—memory; labdhā—regained; tvat-prasādāt—by your grace; mayā—by me; achyuta—Shree Krishna, the infallible one; sthitaḥ—situated; asmi—I am; gata-sandehaḥ—free from doubts; kariṣhye—I shall act; vachanam—instructions; tava—your

text: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।18.74।।
text_kannada:
ಸಂಜಯ ಉವಾಚಇತ್ಯಹಂ ವಾಸುದೇವಸ್ಯ ಪಾರ್ಥಸ್ಯ ಚ ಮಹಾತ್ಮನಃ |
ಸಂವಾದಮಿಮಮಶ್ರೌಷಮದ್ಭುತಂ ರೋಮಹರ್ಷಣಮ್ || ೭೪ ||
text_telugu:
సంజయ ఉవాచఇత్యహం వాసుదేవస్య పార్థస్య చ మహాత్మనః |
సంవాదమిమమశ్రౌషమద్భుతం రోమహర్షణమ్ || ౭౪ ||
transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ
saṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam
translation_english: Sanjaya said, "I thus heard this conversation between Vasudeva and the great-souled Partha, which is unique and makes one's hair stand on end."
context_english: sañjayaḥ uvācha—Sanjay said; iti—thus; aham—I; vāsudevasya—of Shree Krishna; pārthasya—Arjun; cha—and; mahā-ātmanaḥ—the noble hearted soul; saṁvādam—conversation; imam—this; aśhrauṣham—have heard; adbhutam—wonderful; roma-harṣhaṇam—which causes the hair to stand on end

text: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्।।18.75।।
text_kannada:
ವ್ಯಾಸಪ್ರಸಾದಾಚ್ಛ್ರುತವಾನೇತದ್ಗುಹ್ಯಮಹಂ ಪರಮ್ |
ಯೋಗಂ ಯೋಗೇಶ್ವರಾತ್ಕೃಷ್ಣಾತ್ಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕಥಯತಃ ಸ್ವಯಮ್ || ೭೫ ||
text_telugu:
వ్యాసప్రసాదాచ్ఛ్రుతవానేతద్గుహ్యమహం పరమ్ |
యోగం యోగేశ్వరాత్కృష్ణాత్సాక్షాత్కథయతః స్వయమ్ || ౭౫ ||
transliteration:
vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param
yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam
translation_english: Through the favor of Vyasa, I heard this secret concerning the supreme Yoga from Krishna, the Lord of Yogas, while He Himself was speaking!
context_english: vyāsa-prasādāt—by the grace of Ved Vyas; śhrutavān—have heard; etat—this; guhyam—secret; aham—I; param—supreme; yogam—Yog; yoga-īśhvarāt—from the Lod of Yog; kṛiṣhṇāt—from Shree Krishna; sākṣhāt—directly; kathayataḥ—speaking; svayam—himself

text: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।18.76।।
text_kannada:
ರಾಜನ್ಸಂಸ್ಮೃತ್ಯ ಸಂಸ್ಮೃತ್ಯ ಸಂವಾದಮಿಮಮದ್ಭುತಮ್ |
ಕೇಶವಾರ್ಜುನಯೋಃ ಪುಣ್ಯಂ ಹೃಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಚ ಮುಹುರ್ಮುಹುಃ || ೭೬ ||
text_telugu:
రాజన్సంస్మృత్య సంస్మృత్య సంవాదమిమమద్భుతమ్ |
కేశవార్జునయోః పుణ్యం హృష్యామి చ ముహుర్ముహుః || ౭౬ ||
transliteration:
rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam
keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ
translation_english: And, O King, while repeatedly remembering this unique, sacred dialogue between Kesava and Arjuna, I rejoice every moment.
context_english: rājan—King; sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya—repeatedly recalling; saṁvādam—dialogue; imam—this; adbhutam—astonishing; keśhava-arjunayoḥ—between Lord Shree Krishna and Arjun; puṇyam—pious; hṛiṣhyāmi—I rejoice; cha—and; muhuḥ muhuḥ—repeatedly

text:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः।

विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।18.77।।
text_kannada:
ತಚ್ಚ ಸಂಸ್ಮೃತ್ಯ ಸಂಸ್ಮೃತ್ಯ ರೂಪಮತ್ಯದ್ಭುತಂ ಹರೇಃ |
ವಿಸ್ಮಯೋ ಮೇ ಮಹಾನ್ ರಾಜನ್ ಹೃಷ್ಯಾಮಿ ಚ ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ || ೭೭ ||
text_telugu:
తచ్చ సంస్మృత్య సంస్మృత్య రూపమత్యద్భుతం హరేః |
విస్మయో మే మహాన్ రాజన్ హృష్యామి చ పునః పునః || ౭౭ ||
transliteration:
tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ
vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ
translation_english: O King, repeatedly recollecting that greatly extraordinary form of Hari, I am struck with wonder and rejoice again and again.
context_english: tat—that; cha—and; sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya—remembering repeatedly; rūpam—cosmic form; ati—most; adbhutam—wonderful; hareḥ—of Lord Krishna; vismayaḥ—astonishment; me—my; mahān—great; rājan—King; hṛiṣhyāmi—I am thrilled with joy; cha—and; punaḥ punaḥ—over and over again

text:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।

तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78।
text_kannada:
ಯತ್ರ ಯೋಗೇಶ್ವರಃ ಕೃಷ್ಣೋ ಯತ್ರ ಪಾರ್ಥೋ ಧನುರ್ಧರಃ |
ತತ್ರ ಶ್ರೀರ್ವಿಜಯೋ ಭೂತಿರ್ಧ್ರುವಾ ನೀತಿರ್ಮತಿರ್ಮಮ || ೭೮ ||
text_telugu:
యత్ర యోగేశ్వరః కృష్ణో యత్ర పార్థో ధనుర్ధరః |
తత్ర శ్రీర్విజయో భూతిర్ధ్రువా నీతిర్మతిర్మమ || ౭౮ ||
transliteration:
yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ
tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama
translation_english: Where there is Krishna, the Lord of yogas, and where there is Partha, the wielder of the bow, there is fortune, victory, prosperity, and unfailing prudence. Such is my conviction.
context_english: yatra—wherever; yoga-īśhvaraḥ—Shree Krishna, the Lord of Yog; kṛiṣhṇaḥ—Shree Krishna; yatra—wherever; pārthaḥ—Arjun, the son of Pritha; dhanuḥ-dharaḥ—the supreme archer; tatra—there; śhrīḥ—opulence; vijayaḥ—victory; bhūtiḥ—prosperity; dhruvā—unending; nītiḥ—righteousness; matiḥ mama—my opinion
